{"headword":"championship","explanation":"名詞「冠軍賽/錦標賽」或「冠軍頭銜」。常與 win, hold, defend 等動詞連用。注意拼字，中間有 'p'。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school basketball team practiced hard for months and finally won the national <championship> *in* a thrilling final game.","translation":"學校籃球隊努力練習了數月，最終在一場激動人心的決賽中贏得了全國冠軍。","explanation":"指贏得比賽的頭銜。搭配介係詞 in 或 of。"},{"sentence":"The professional tennis player is currently defending her <championship> *title* against a talented young challenger from another country.","translation":"這位職業網球選手目前正在捍衛她的冠軍頭銜，對手是來自另一個國家的天才年輕挑戰者。","explanation":"指冠軍頭銜。常與 title 連用。"}],"related_forms":["championships"]}

{"headword":"characteristic","explanation":"名詞「特徵/特色」；形容詞「典型的/特有的」。名詞常與 feature, trait 互換。形容詞常搭配介係詞 of。","entries":[{"sentence":"One of the most important <characteristic>s *of* a good leader is the ability to listen to others' opinions patiently.","translation":"好領導者最重要的特徵之一，就是能夠耐心地傾聽他人的意見。","explanation":"名詞「特徵」。常搭配 of 說明屬於某人或某物的特徵。"},{"sentence":"It is <characteristic> *of* him to arrive early for every meeting, as he is known for being extremely punctual.","translation":"每次會議都提早到達是他的典型作風，因為他以極度準時而聞名。","explanation":"形容詞「典型的」。句型 It is characteristic of sb to V。"}],"related_forms":["characteristics","characterize"]}

{"headword":"charity","explanation":"名詞「慈善/慈善機構」。常用於慈善捐款或活動。注意複數形為 charities。","entries":[{"sentence":"The wealthy businessman decided to donate a large portion of his fortune *to* local <charity> organizations to help the poor.","translation":"這位富有的商人決定將他財富的一大部分捐給當地的慈善機構，以幫助窮人。","explanation":"指慈善機構。常搭配 donate to。"},{"sentence":"They organized a <charity> *event* to raise money for children who lack access to proper education in remote areas.","translation":"他們舉辦了一場慈善活動，為偏遠地區缺乏適當教育機會的兒童募款。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾名詞 event。"}],"related_forms":["charities","charitable"]}

{"headword":"chemistry","explanation":"名詞「化學」或「人與人之間的默契/化學反應」。在人際關係中指相處融洽。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student found <chemistry> to be a challenging subject, especially when it came to memorizing the complex periodic table.","translation":"這名學生發現化學是一門具有挑戰性的學科，特別是在背誦複雜的元素週期表時。","explanation":"指學科。常與 subject 連用。"},{"sentence":"The two actors had great <chemistry> *on* screen, which made their romantic scenes look incredibly natural and convincing to viewers.","translation":"這兩位演員在螢幕上有很好的默契，這使得他們的浪漫場景看起來非常自然，且令觀眾信服。","explanation":"指人與人之間的默契。常搭配 have chemistry with/between。"}],"related_forms":["chemical","chemist"]}

{"headword":"cherish","explanation":"動詞「珍愛/懷念」。常用於珍視回憶、友情或時光。為及物動詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"I will always <cherish> the *memories* of the summer we spent volunteering together at the local animal shelter.","translation":"我將永遠珍藏我們一起在當地動物收容所擔任志工的那個夏天的回憶。","explanation":"珍視回憶。常搭配 memories。"},{"sentence":"We should <cherish> the *time* we have with our family members because life is unpredictable and precious.","translation":"我們應該珍惜與家人相處的時光，因為人生是不可預測且珍貴的。","explanation":"珍惜時光。常搭配 time。"}],"related_forms":["cherished","cherishing"]}

{"headword":"chew","explanation":"動詞「咀嚼」；名詞「咀嚼」。常與 food, gum 連用。注意 chew over 指「深思熟慮」。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is important to <chew> your *food* thoroughly before swallowing to ensure better digestion and avoid choking.","translation":"吞嚥前徹底咀嚼食物很重要，以確保更好的消化並避免噎到。","explanation":"動詞「咀嚼」。常與 food 連用。"},{"sentence":"The student needed some time to <chew> *over* the teacher's advice before making a final decision about his future career.","translation":"這名學生在對未來職業做出最終決定之前，需要一些時間來深思熟慮老師的建議。","explanation":"片語 chew over = think about carefully。"}],"related_forms":["chewed","chewing"]}

{"headword":"choke","explanation":"動詞「噎住/窒息」；名詞「窒息」。常搭配介係詞 on。注意與 choke up (哽咽) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young child started to <choke> *on* a piece of hard candy, so his mother immediately performed the Heimlich maneuver.","translation":"這名幼童開始被一塊硬糖噎住，所以他母親立即執行了哈姆立克急救法。","explanation":"動詞「噎住」。搭配介係詞 on。"},{"sentence":"The thick smoke from the forest fire made it difficult for the residents to breathe and caused them to <choke>.","translation":"森林大火產生的濃煙使居民難以呼吸，並導致他們窒息。","explanation":"動詞「窒息」。指因空氣品質差而無法呼吸。"}],"related_forms":["choked","choking"]}

{"headword":"chorus","explanation":"名詞「合唱團/副歌」。在音樂中指歌曲重複的部分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school <chorus> *sang* a beautiful song during the graduation ceremony, moving many parents and teachers to tears.","translation":"學校合唱團在畢業典禮上唱了一首優美的歌曲，感動了許多家長和老師。","explanation":"指合唱團。常搭配 sing。"},{"sentence":"Everyone in the audience joined in the <chorus> of the popular song, creating a very lively and joyful atmosphere.","translation":"觀眾席上的每個人都跟著唱這首流行歌的副歌，營造出一種非常熱鬧且歡樂的氣氛。","explanation":"指歌曲的副歌。"}],"related_forms":["choruses"]}

{"headword":"circular","explanation":"形容詞「圓形的/循環的」。常用於描述形狀或邏輯。","entries":[{"sentence":"The architect designed a <circular> *staircase* in the center of the library, which became the most eye-catching feature of the building.","translation":"建築師在圖書館中心設計了一個圓形樓梯，這成為該建築最引人注目的特色。","explanation":"形容詞「圓形的」。"},{"sentence":"The argument he provided was purely <circular>, as he simply repeated the same point without offering any new evidence.","translation":"他提供的論點純粹是循環論證，因為他只是重複相同的觀點，而沒有提供任何新的證據。","explanation":"形容詞「循環的」。指邏輯上的循環。"}],"related_forms":["circle"]}

{"headword":"circulate","explanation":"動詞「循環/傳播」。指空氣、血液或消息的流動。","entries":[{"sentence":"Opening the windows helps fresh air <circulate> *through* the classroom, which is essential for maintaining a healthy learning environment.","translation":"打開窗戶有助於新鮮空氣在教室內循環，這對於維持健康的學習環境至關重要。","explanation":"動詞「循環」。搭配介係詞 through。"},{"sentence":"False rumors began to <circulate> *among* the students after the principal announced the sudden cancellation of the school trip.","translation":"校長宣布突然取消校外教學後，錯誤的謠言開始在學生之間流傳。","explanation":"動詞「傳播」。指消息或謠言的散布。"}],"related_forms":["circulation","circulated"]}

{"headword":"circulation","explanation":"名詞「循環/流通/發行量」。常指血液循環或報紙發行量。","entries":[{"sentence":"Regular exercise is known to improve blood <circulation>, which can lead to better overall health and increased energy levels.","translation":"規律運動已知能改善血液循環，這能帶來更好的整體健康和增加能量水平。","explanation":"名詞「循環」。常搭配 blood。"},{"sentence":"The newspaper has a large <circulation> *of* over one million copies per day, making it the most popular paper in the city.","translation":"這份報紙每天有超過一百萬份的發行量，使其成為該市最受歡迎的報紙。","explanation":"名詞「發行量」。"}],"related_forms":["circulate"]}

{"headword":"circumstance","explanation":"名詞「情況/環境」。常用複數形 circumstances。片語 under no circumstances (絕不) 為重點考點。","entries":[{"sentence":"Under no <circumstance>s *should* you leave the laboratory without turning off all the electrical equipment properly.","translation":"在任何情況下，你都不應該在沒有正確關閉所有電器設備的情況下離開實驗室。","explanation":"片語 under no circumstances。注意倒裝句型，助動詞 should 移至主詞前。"},{"sentence":"Due to the difficult financial <circumstance>s of his family, he had to work part-time while attending university.","translation":"由於家庭經濟狀況困難，他必須在讀大學的同時打工。","explanation":"名詞「情況」。常用複數形。"}],"related_forms":["circumstances"]}

{"headword":"civilian","explanation":"名詞「平民」；形容詞「平民的」。相對於軍人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government promised to protect innocent <civilian>s *from* harm during the ongoing conflict in the border region.","translation":"政府承諾在邊境地區持續的衝突中保護無辜平民免受傷害。","explanation":"名詞「平民」。"},{"sentence":"After serving in the army for ten years, he finally returned to <civilian> *life* and started a small business in his hometown.","translation":"在軍隊服役十年後，他終於回歸平民生活，並在家鄉開了一家小店。","explanation":"形容詞「平民的」。"}],"related_forms":["civilians"]}

{"headword":"civilization","explanation":"名詞「文明」。指人類社會的發展階段或特定文化。","entries":[{"sentence":"Ancient Egyptian <civilization> is famous for its magnificent pyramids and its advanced knowledge of mathematics and astronomy.","translation":"古埃及文明以其宏偉的金字塔以及在數學和天文學方面的先進知識而聞名。","explanation":"名詞「文明」。"},{"sentence":"Many historians study how different <civilization>s *developed* and interacted with each other throughout the course of human history.","translation":"許多歷史學家研究不同的文明如何在人類歷史的進程中發展並相互影響。","explanation":"名詞「文明」。常用複數形。"}],"related_forms":["civilize","civilized"]}

{"headword":"clarify","explanation":"動詞「澄清/闡明」。指讓事情變得清楚易懂。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor asked the student to <clarify> his *point* because the initial explanation was too vague to be understood.","translation":"教授要求這名學生澄清他的觀點，因為最初的解釋太模糊而無法理解。","explanation":"動詞「澄清」。常搭配 point 或 meaning。"},{"sentence":"The company issued a statement to <clarify> the *situation* regarding the recent product recall and reassure the concerned customers.","translation":"公司發布了一份聲明來澄清有關最近產品召回的情況，並讓擔心的顧客放心。","explanation":"動詞「闡明」。常搭配 situation。"}],"related_forms":["clarified","clarification"]}

{"headword":"clash","explanation":"名詞「衝突/不調和」；動詞「衝突」。指意見不合或顏色不搭。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two politicians had a heated <clash> *over* the new tax policy during the televised debate last night.","translation":"這兩位政治人物昨晚在電視辯論中，針對新的稅收政策發生了激烈的衝突。","explanation":"名詞「衝突」。搭配介係詞 over。"},{"sentence":"I decided not to wear the red shirt with the orange pants because the colors <clash> *with* each other.","translation":"我決定不穿那件紅襯衫配橘色褲子，因為這兩種顏色很不搭。","explanation":"動詞「不調和」。搭配介係詞 with。"}],"related_forms":["clashed","clashing"]}

{"headword":"classification","explanation":"名詞「分類」。指將事物分門別類。","entries":[{"sentence":"The library uses a complex <classification> *system* to help students find books on specific topics quickly and efficiently.","translation":"圖書館使用一套複雜的分類系統，來幫助學生快速且有效地找到特定主題的書籍。","explanation":"名詞「分類」。常與 system 連用。"},{"sentence":"The scientific <classification> of animals is based on their physical characteristics and genetic relationships to one another.","translation":"動物的科學分類是基於它們的身體特徵以及彼此之間的基因關係。","explanation":"名詞「分類」。"}],"related_forms":["classify"]}

{"headword":"classify","explanation":"動詞「分類」。常搭配介係詞 as。","entries":[{"sentence":"Biologists <classify> whales *as* mammals rather than fish because they breathe air and give birth to live young.","translation":"生物學家將鯨魚歸類為哺乳動物而非魚類，因為牠們用肺呼吸並產下活的幼體。","explanation":"動詞「分類」。句型 classify A as B。"},{"sentence":"The documents were <classified> *into* different categories based on their level of importance and the date they were created.","translation":"這些文件根據其重要程度和創建日期被分類成不同的類別。","explanation":"動詞「分類」。搭配介係詞 into。"}],"related_forms":["classified","classification"]}

{"headword":"claw","explanation":"名詞「爪子」；動詞「抓/撕」。指動物的爪子或用爪子抓。","entries":[{"sentence":"The eagle used its sharp <claw>s to grab the fish from the surface of the lake with incredible speed.","translation":"老鷹用牠鋒利的爪子以驚人的速度從湖面上抓起魚。","explanation":"名詞「爪子」。常用複數形。"},{"sentence":"The cat tried to <claw> *at* the door to get the attention of its owner who was busy in the kitchen.","translation":"貓試圖抓門以引起在廚房忙碌的主人的注意。","explanation":"動詞「抓」。搭配介係詞 at。"}],"related_forms":["claws","clawed"]}

{"headword":"cliff","explanation":"名詞「懸崖」。常與 edge, fall 連用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hikers stood at the edge of the <cliff> and enjoyed the breathtaking view of the ocean below them.","translation":"登山客站在懸崖邊，欣賞下方海洋令人屏息的美景。","explanation":"名詞「懸崖」。常搭配 edge。"},{"sentence":"It is extremely dangerous to walk too close to the <cliff> because the ground might be unstable and slippery.","translation":"走得太靠近懸崖是非常危險的，因為地面可能不穩定且濕滑。","explanation":"名詞「懸崖」。"}],"related_forms":["cliffs"]}

{"headword":"clumsy","explanation":"形容詞「笨拙的」，指動作不協調或處理事情不圓滑。常見搭配：clumsy mistake (粗心的錯誤)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Being <clumsy>, the young boy often *knocks over* his glass of water while reaching for the salt at the dinner table.","translation":"因為動作笨拙，那個小男孩在餐桌上伸手拿鹽時，常會打翻他的水杯。","explanation":"形容人動作不協調，常用 knock over 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The politician made a <clumsy> *remark* about the economic crisis, which offended many citizens and caused a public outcry online.","translation":"那位政治人物針對經濟危機發表了不得體的言論，冒犯了許多市民並在網路上引發公憤。","explanation":"形容言語或處理方式不圓滑、不得體。"}],"related_forms":["clumsily","clumsiness"]}

{"headword":"coarse","explanation":"形容詞「粗糙的」，指質地不細緻，或指言語「粗俗的」。注意與 course (課程/路線) 的拼字區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmer wore a shirt made of <coarse> *fabric* to protect his skin while working in the rough, thorny fields.","translation":"農夫穿著一件由粗糙布料製成的襯衫，以保護他在多刺的田野中工作時的皮膚。","explanation":"指質地粗糙，與 fine (細緻的) 相對。"},{"sentence":"The teacher warned the students that using <coarse> *language* in the classroom would result in a serious disciplinary action immediately.","translation":"老師警告學生，在教室使用粗俗的語言將會立即導致嚴重的懲處。","explanation":"指言語粗俗、不雅，常與 language 搭配。"}],"related_forms":["coarsely","coarseness"]}

{"headword":"code","explanation":"名詞「代碼/密碼/規範」；動詞「編碼」。常見搭配：dress code (服裝規定)、moral code (道德準則)。","entries":[{"sentence":"All employees are expected to follow the company's strict dress <code > *by* wearing formal business attire during the work week.","translation":"所有員工都被要求遵守公司嚴格的服裝規定，在工作週期間穿著正式商務服裝。","explanation":"名詞「規範/準則」。"},{"sentence":"The computer programmer spent the entire night trying to <code > *a* new application that could help students organize their study schedules.","translation":"電腦程式設計師花了一整晚試圖編寫一個能幫助學生安排讀書計畫的新應用程式。","explanation":"動詞「編寫程式/編碼」。"}],"related_forms":["codes","coded","coding"]}

{"headword":"collapse","explanation":"名詞與動詞「倒塌/崩潰/昏倒」。常用於建築物倒塌或經濟、健康崩潰。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old bridge was on the verge of <collapse> *due to* the heavy rain and lack of maintenance over the years.","translation":"由於大雨和多年來缺乏維護，那座舊橋處於倒塌的邊緣。","explanation":"名詞「倒塌」。"},{"sentence":"The exhausted marathon runner <collapsed> *on* the track just a few meters away from the finish line during the race.","translation":"那位精疲力竭的馬拉松選手在比賽中，距離終點線僅幾公尺處倒在跑道上。","explanation":"動詞「昏倒/倒下」。"}],"related_forms":["collapses","collapsed","collapsing"]}

{"headword":"colleague","explanation":"名詞「同事」。僅用於工作場合，不可用於同學 (classmate)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I often discuss my research projects with my <colleague> *at* the university to gain new perspectives and improve my work.","translation":"我常與大學的同事討論我的研究計畫，以獲得新的觀點並改進我的工作。","explanation":"指工作上的夥伴。"},{"sentence":"It is important to maintain a professional relationship with every <colleague> in the office to ensure a productive working environment.","translation":"與辦公室裡的每一位同事保持專業關係，對於確保高生產力的工作環境至關重要。","explanation":"強調職場人際關係。"}],"related_forms":["colleagues"]}

{"headword":"combination","explanation":"名詞「結合/組合」。常用搭配：a combination of A and B (A與B的結合)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Success in the final exam is often a <combination> *of* hard work, effective study strategies, and a good night's sleep.","translation":"期末考的成功通常是努力工作、有效的讀書策略以及充足睡眠的結合。","explanation":"指多種因素的綜合。"},{"sentence":"The chef created a unique <combination> *of* flavors by mixing spicy peppers with sweet honey in the main course.","translation":"主廚透過將辣胡椒與甜蜂蜜混合在主菜中，創造了一種獨特的風味組合。","explanation":"指不同事物的搭配。"}],"related_forms":["combinations"]}

{"headword":"comedy","explanation":"名詞「喜劇」。與 tragedy (悲劇) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students decided to perform a lighthearted <comedy> *for* the school talent show to make the audience laugh and relax.","translation":"學生們決定在學校才藝表演中演出一齣輕鬆的喜劇，讓觀眾開懷大笑並放鬆心情。","explanation":"指戲劇類型。"},{"sentence":"Watching a classic <comedy> *after* a long and stressful day is the best way for me to decompress and feel happy.","translation":"在漫長且充滿壓力的一天後看一部經典喜劇，是我減壓並感到快樂的最佳方式。","explanation":"指喜劇電影或節目。"}],"related_forms":["comedies","comedian"]}

{"headword":"commander","explanation":"名詞「指揮官/司令」。指軍隊或組織中的領導者。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <commander> *ordered* the soldiers to retreat to a safer position before the enemy launched their next major attack.","translation":"指揮官命令士兵在敵人發動下一次大規模攻擊前，撤退到更安全的位置。","explanation":"指軍事指揮官。"},{"sentence":"As the <commander> *of* the rescue mission, she had to make quick decisions to save the trapped hikers in the mountains.","translation":"身為救援任務的指揮官，她必須做出快速決策以拯救困在山中的登山客。","explanation":"指任務負責人。"}],"related_forms":["commanders","command"]}

{"headword":"comment","explanation":"名詞「評論」；動詞「評論」。常見搭配：make a comment on/about (對...發表評論)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor made a positive <comment> *on* my essay, which gave me the confidence to continue improving my writing skills.","translation":"教授對我的文章給予了正面評價，這給了我繼續提升寫作技巧的信心。","explanation":"名詞「評論」，介係詞用 on。"},{"sentence":"It is not appropriate to <comment> *on* someone's personal appearance during a formal interview, as it may seem unprofessional and rude.","translation":"在正式面試中評論某人的個人外表是不恰當的，因為這看起來可能不專業且無禮。","explanation":"動詞「評論」，介係詞用 on。"}],"related_forms":["comments","commented","commenting"]}

{"headword":"commerce","explanation":"名詞「商業/貿易」。較正式，常指大規模的經濟活動。","entries":[{"sentence":"The rapid development of e-<commerce> *has* changed the way people shop, allowing them to purchase goods from all over the world.","translation":"電子商務的快速發展改變了人們購物的方式，讓他們能購買來自世界各地的商品。","explanation":"指電子商務。"},{"sentence":"The government is trying to promote international <commerce> *by* reducing tariffs and simplifying the procedures for exporting local products.","translation":"政府正試圖透過降低關稅和簡化出口當地產品的程序來促進國際貿易。","explanation":"指國家間的貿易活動。"}],"related_forms":["commercial"]}

{"headword":"commit","explanation":"動詞「犯(罪/錯)」、「承諾/投入」。常見搭配：commit a crime (犯罪)、commit oneself to (致力於)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young man was shocked to realize that he had <committed> *a* serious mistake by accidentally deleting the important project files.","translation":"那個年輕人震驚地意識到，他因為不小心刪除了重要的專案檔案而犯下了一個嚴重的錯誤。","explanation":"指犯錯或犯罪，搭配 a mistake/crime。"},{"sentence":"To achieve his goal of becoming a doctor, he <committed> *himself* to studying hard and volunteering at the local hospital every weekend.","translation":"為了實現成為醫生的目標，他致力於努力讀書，並在每個週末到當地醫院當志工。","explanation":"片語 commit oneself to V-ing，表「致力於/投入」。"}],"related_forms":["commits","committed","committing","commitment"]}

{"headword":"communication","explanation":"名詞「溝通/通訊」。常見搭配：communication skills (溝通技巧)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Effective <communication> *between* teachers and parents is essential for supporting students' academic and personal development throughout the school year.","translation":"老師與家長之間有效的溝通，對於在整個學年中支持學生的學業與個人發展至關重要。","explanation":"指人際間的溝通。"},{"sentence":"Modern <communication> *technology* has made it possible for people to stay connected with their friends regardless of the distance.","translation":"現代通訊技術使得人們無論距離多遠，都能與朋友保持聯繫。","explanation":"指通訊技術。"}],"related_forms":["communications","communicate"]}

{"headword":"community","explanation":"名詞「社區/群體」。指居住在同一地區的人們或具有共同特徵的群體。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local <community> *organized* a cleanup event last Saturday to improve the environment and build stronger bonds among the neighbors.","translation":"當地社區上週六舉辦了一場清潔活動，以改善環境並建立鄰居間更緊密的聯繫。","explanation":"指居住社區。"},{"sentence":"The scientific <community> *is* working together to find a cure for the disease that has affected many people worldwide recently.","translation":"科學界正共同努力尋找治療方法，以對抗最近影響全球許多人的疾病。","explanation":"指特定領域的群體。"}],"related_forms":["communities"]}

{"headword":"companion","explanation":"名詞「同伴/伴侶」。指一起旅行或相處的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the long journey across the country, he was a great <companion> *who* always kept the mood light with his funny stories.","translation":"在橫跨全國的長途旅行中，他是一位很棒的同伴，總是能用他有趣的故事讓氣氛保持輕鬆。","explanation":"指旅行同伴。"},{"sentence":"Many elderly people find that having a pet as a <companion> *helps* them feel less lonely and more active in their daily lives.","translation":"許多長者發現養寵物作為伴侶，能幫助他們減少孤獨感，並在日常生活中變得更活躍。","explanation":"指心靈伴侶。"}],"related_forms":["companions"]}

{"headword":"competition","explanation":"名詞「競爭/比賽」。常見搭配：in competition with (與...競爭)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The intense <competition> *among* the students for the limited scholarships encourages everyone to work harder and perform their best.","translation":"學生之間為了有限獎學金的激烈競爭，鼓勵每個人更努力並表現出最好的一面。","explanation":"指競爭狀態。"},{"sentence":"She decided to enter the national piano <competition> *to* challenge herself and gain more experience performing in front of a large audience.","translation":"她決定參加全國鋼琴比賽來挑戰自己，並獲得更多在大量觀眾面前表演的經驗。","explanation":"指比賽活動。"}],"related_forms":["competitions"]}

{"headword":"competitive","explanation":"形容詞「競爭激烈的/好勝的」。常用於描述市場、考試或人的性格。","entries":[{"sentence":"The job market for graduates is highly <competitive>, so it is important to gain practical experience through internships during college.","translation":"畢業生的就業市場競爭非常激烈，因此在大學期間透過實習獲得實務經驗很重要。","explanation":"指競爭激烈的環境。"},{"sentence":"He has a very <competitive> *nature*, which drives him to always strive for the top position in every sport he plays.","translation":"他有著非常好勝的本性，這驅使他在參與的每項運動中總是力爭上游。","explanation":"形容人好勝。"}],"related_forms":["competitively"]}

{"headword":"competitor","explanation":"名詞「競爭者/參賽者」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company needs to analyze the strategies of every major <competitor> *in* the industry to maintain its leading position in the market.","translation":"公司需要分析產業中每一位主要競爭者的策略，以維持其在市場上的領先地位。","explanation":"指商業競爭對手。"},{"sentence":"Every <competitor> *in* the race trained for months to ensure they were in the best physical condition for the final event.","translation":"比賽中的每一位參賽者都訓練了數月，以確保他們在決賽時處於最佳身體狀態。","explanation":"指比賽選手。"}],"related_forms":["competitors"]}

{"headword":"complicate","explanation":"動詞「使複雜化」。常用被動語態或主動語態描述事情變得難處理。","entries":[{"sentence":"Adding too many rules to the project will only <complicate> *the* process and make it harder for the team to finish on time.","translation":"在專案中增加太多規則只會使過程複雜化，並讓團隊更難準時完成。","explanation":"指使事情變得複雜。"},{"sentence":"The unexpected bad weather <complicated> *our* travel plans, forcing us to cancel the outdoor activities we had scheduled for the weekend.","translation":"突如其來的惡劣天氣使我們的旅遊計畫變得複雜，迫使我們取消原定週末的戶外活動。","explanation":"指使情況變得難以處理。"}],"related_forms":["complicates","complicated","complicating"]}

{"headword":"compose","explanation":"動詞「組成/創作(音樂/詩)」。常用 be composed of (由...組成)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The committee is <composed> *of* five experts who are responsible for reviewing the new educational policies proposed by the government.","translation":"該委員會由五位專家組成，負責審查政府提出的新教育政策。","explanation":"片語 be composed of = consist of，表「由...組成」。"},{"sentence":"The famous musician <composed> *a* beautiful melody to express his deep love for his hometown during his stay abroad.","translation":"那位著名的音樂家在國外停留期間，創作了一首優美的旋律來表達他對家鄉的深愛。","explanation":"指創作音樂。"}],"related_forms":["composes","composed","composing","composition"]}

{"headword":"composer","explanation":"名詞「作曲家」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Beethoven is widely considered one of the greatest <composer>s *in* history, known for his powerful and emotional symphonies.","translation":"貝多芬被廣泛認為是歷史上最偉大的作曲家之一，以其強而有力且充滿情感的交響曲聞名。","explanation":"指古典音樂作曲家。"},{"sentence":"The young <composer> *spent* years studying music theory before he was able to write his first original piece for the orchestra.","translation":"那位年輕的作曲家花了數年研究音樂理論，才得以寫出他為管弦樂團創作的第一首原創曲目。","explanation":"指作曲者。"}],"related_forms":["composers"]}

{"headword":"composition","explanation":"名詞用法：(1)「作文/作品」，指書寫的成品；(2)「構成/成分」，指組成事物的元素。注意與 compose (動詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher asked every student to write a short <composition> *about* their most unforgettable travel experience during the summer vacation.","translation":"老師要求每位學生寫一篇關於他們暑假最難忘旅遊經驗的短文。","explanation":"指學校作業中的「作文」。"},{"sentence":"Scientists analyzed the chemical <composition> *of* the soil samples to determine why the plants in this area failed to grow properly.","translation":"科學家分析了土壤樣本的化學成分，以確定為什麼該地區的植物無法正常生長。","explanation":"指事物的「構成成分」。"}],"related_forms":["compositions"]}

{"headword":"concentrate","explanation":"動詞用法：(1)「專注於」，常搭配 on；(2)「集中/聚集」，指將資源或力量匯集於某處。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is difficult for students to <concentrate> *on* their studies when there is too much noise coming from the construction site nearby.","translation":"當附近工地傳來太多噪音時，學生很難專注於課業。","explanation":"concentrate on sth 是常見用法，指專心做某事。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <concentrate> its *resources* *on* improving public transportation to reduce traffic congestion in the downtown area.","translation":"政府決定將資源集中在改善大眾運輸，以減少市中心的交通擁堵。","explanation":"指將力量或資源集中於特定目標。"}],"related_forms":["concentrates","concentrated","concentrating"]}

{"headword":"concentration","explanation":"名詞用法：(1)「專注/專心」；(2)「濃度/含量」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Deep breathing exercises can help improve your <concentration> and reduce stress before taking an important final examination at school.","translation":"深呼吸練習有助於在學校參加重要期末考前提升專注力並減輕壓力。","explanation":"指心理上的專注狀態。"},{"sentence":"The high <concentration> *of* carbon dioxide in the atmosphere is considered the primary cause of global warming in recent years.","translation":"大氣中二氧化碳的高濃度被認為是近年來全球暖化的主要原因。","explanation":"指化學或物理上的濃度。"}],"related_forms":["concentrations"]}

{"headword":"concept","explanation":"名詞用法：指「概念/觀念」。常與 abstract (抽象的) 或 basic (基本的) 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher explained the difficult scientific <concept> *in* simple terms so that all the students could understand the core theory easily.","translation":"老師用簡單的術語解釋了這個困難的科學概念，以便所有學生都能輕鬆理解核心理論。","explanation":"指抽象的科學或學術概念。"},{"sentence":"Many teenagers have a different <concept> *of* success compared to their parents, valuing personal happiness more than high social status.","translation":"許多青少年對成功的觀念與父母不同，他們更重視個人快樂而非崇高的社會地位。","explanation":"指對某事物的認知或觀念。"}],"related_forms":["concepts","conceptual"]}

{"headword":"concerning","explanation":"介係詞用法：意為「關於/涉及」，等於 about 或 regarding。注意它本身即為介係詞，後接名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The principal sent an email to all parents <concerning> the *upcoming* school anniversary celebration and the schedule for the sports meet.","translation":"校長發了一封電子郵件給所有家長，內容是關於即將到來的校慶慶祝活動以及運動會的時程表。","explanation":"作為介係詞，表示「關於」。"},{"sentence":"There are many questions <concerning> the *safety* of the new technology, so the experts will hold a meeting to discuss it.","translation":"有許多關於這項新技術安全性的問題，因此專家們將召開會議進行討論。","explanation":"用於引出討論的主題。"}],"related_forms":["concern"]}

{"headword":"concrete","explanation":"用法：(1) 形容詞「具體的/實體的」；(2) 名詞「混凝土」。與 abstract (抽象的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"Instead of making vague promises, the candidate provided <concrete> *evidence* to show how he would improve the local economy.","translation":"候選人沒有做出模糊的承諾，而是提供了具體的證據來展示他將如何改善當地經濟。","explanation":"形容詞，指具體的、實質的。"},{"sentence":"The workers poured wet <concrete> *into* the wooden frames to build the foundation of the new library building on campus.","translation":"工人們將濕混凝土倒入木框中，以建造校園內新圖書館大樓的地基。","explanation":"名詞，指建築材料混凝土。"}],"related_forms":["concretes"]}

{"headword":"conductor","explanation":"名詞用法：(1)「指揮家」；(2)「導體」(物理學)；(3)「列車長/售票員」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The talented <conductor> waved his baton to lead the orchestra through a beautiful performance of Beethoven's famous symphony last night.","translation":"那位才華洋溢的指揮家揮動指揮棒，帶領管弦樂團在昨晚演奏了貝多芬著名的交響曲。","explanation":"指音樂指揮。"},{"sentence":"Copper is known as an excellent <conductor> *of* electricity, which is why it is widely used in various electronic devices today.","translation":"銅被認為是極佳的導體，這就是為什麼它今天被廣泛用於各種電子設備中。","explanation":"指物理學上的導體。"}],"related_forms":["conductors","conduct"]}

{"headword":"conference","explanation":"名詞用法：指「會議/研討會」，通常規模較大且正式。常用搭配：attend a conference, hold a conference。","entries":[{"sentence":"Experts from around the world gathered at the international <conference> *to* share their latest research findings on climate change mitigation.","translation":"來自世界各地的專家齊聚國際會議，分享他們在減緩氣候變遷方面的最新研究成果。","explanation":"指正式的國際會議。"},{"sentence":"The professor will attend a three-day academic <conference> in Tokyo next month to present his paper on modern linguistics.","translation":"教授下個月將前往東京參加為期三天的學術研討會，發表他關於現代語言學的論文。","explanation":"指學術性的研討會。"}],"related_forms":["conferences"]}

{"headword":"confess","explanation":"動詞用法：(1)「坦承/招供」；(2)「懺悔」。常搭配 to + V-ing 或名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The thief finally <confessed> *to* stealing the expensive diamond necklace after the police presented him with undeniable video evidence.","translation":"在警方出示了不可否認的影片證據後，小偷終於坦承偷了那條昂貴的鑽石項鍊。","explanation":"confess to + V-ing 是常見用法，注意介係詞 to 不能省略。"},{"sentence":"I must <confess> *that* I forgot to finish the report on time, even though I had plenty of time to work on it.","translation":"我必須承認我忘了準時完成報告，儘管我有充足的時間來處理它。","explanation":"confess that 子句，用於坦承事實。"}],"related_forms":["confesses","confessed","confessing","confession"]}

{"headword":"confidence","explanation":"名詞用法：指「信心/自信」。常用搭配：have confidence in sb/sth, gain confidence。","entries":[{"sentence":"The coach has full <confidence> *in* his team's ability to win the championship if they continue to practice hard every day.","translation":"教練對他的球隊有十足的信心，只要他們繼續每天努力練習，就能贏得冠軍。","explanation":"have confidence in 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"Public <confidence> *in* the economy has increased significantly since the government announced the new plan to create more job opportunities.","translation":"自從政府宣布創造更多就業機會的新計畫以來，大眾對經濟的信心顯著提升。","explanation":"指大眾對某事物的信任。"}],"related_forms":["confident"]}

{"headword":"confusion","explanation":"名詞用法：指「困惑/混亂」。常用搭配：cause confusion, in a state of confusion。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden change in the exam schedule caused a lot of <confusion> *among* the students who had already made other plans.","translation":"考試時間表的突然變更在已經另有計畫的學生之間造成了許多困惑。","explanation":"指心理上的困惑。"},{"sentence":"There was a great deal of <confusion> *at* the airport because of the heavy snow, leading to many flight cancellations and delays.","translation":"由於大雪，機場陷入一片混亂，導致許多航班取消和延誤。","explanation":"指現場的混亂狀態。"}],"related_forms":["confuse","confused","confusing"]}

{"headword":"congratulate","explanation":"動詞用法：指「恭喜/祝賀」。常用句型：congratulate sb on sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The principal stood on the stage to <congratulate> the graduates *on* their outstanding academic achievements during the past three years.","translation":"校長站在台上恭喜畢業生在過去三年中取得的傑出學術成就。","explanation":"congratulate sb on sth 是固定用法。"},{"sentence":"I would like to <congratulate> you *on* winning the first prize in the national English speech contest held last weekend.","translation":"我想恭喜你在上週末舉行的全國英語演講比賽中獲得第一名。","explanation":"用於正式場合的祝賀。"}],"related_forms":["congratulates","congratulated","congratulating","congratulation"]}

{"headword":"congress","explanation":"名詞用法：(1)「國會」(大寫時指美國國會)；(2)「正式會議」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The members of <Congress> are currently debating the new tax law to decide whether it will benefit the middle class citizens.","translation":"國會議員目前正在辯論新的稅法，以決定它是否會造福中產階級公民。","explanation":"指美國國會，首字母通常大寫。"},{"sentence":"The international medical <congress> will take place in Geneva next month to discuss the latest developments in vaccine research and production.","translation":"國際醫學會議將於下個月在日內瓦舉行，討論疫苗研究和生產方面的最新進展。","explanation":"指大型的正式學術或專業會議。"}],"related_forms":["congresses","congressional"]}

{"headword":"conquer","explanation":"動詞用法：(1)「征服/克服」；(2)「佔領」。","entries":[{"sentence":"With great determination and constant practice, the young athlete finally managed to <conquer> his *fear* of heights during the climbing competition.","translation":"憑藉著巨大的決心和不斷的練習，這位年輕運動員終於在攀岩比賽中克服了他對高度的恐懼。","explanation":"指克服心理障礙。"},{"sentence":"In ancient history, many powerful empires tried to <conquer> neighboring territories to expand their influence and gain more natural resources.","translation":"在古代歷史中，許多強大的帝國試圖征服鄰近領土以擴大影響力並獲得更多自然資源。","explanation":"指軍事上的征服或佔領。"}],"related_forms":["conquers","conquered","conquering","conquest"]}

{"headword":"conscience","explanation":"名詞用法：指「良心」。常用搭配：clear conscience (問心無愧), guilty conscience (良心不安)。","entries":[{"sentence":"He felt a guilty <conscience> *after* he realized that he had accidentally broken his friend's favorite vase and didn't tell the truth.","translation":"在他意識到自己不小心打破了朋友最喜歡的花瓶卻沒有說實話後，他感到良心不安。","explanation":"指內心的道德感。"},{"sentence":"Having a clear <conscience> allows you to sleep peacefully at night, knowing that you have always acted with honesty and integrity.","translation":"擁有問心無愧的良心讓你晚上能睡得安穩，因為你知道自己一直以來都誠實且正直地行事。","explanation":"clear conscience 指問心無愧。"}],"related_forms":["consciences","conscientious"]}

{"headword":"consequence","explanation":"名詞用法：指「結果/後果」。常指負面後果。常用搭配：suffer the consequences, in consequence of。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you continue to ignore the school rules, you will have to face the serious <consequence> *of* being suspended from your classes.","translation":"如果你繼續無視校規，你將必須面對被停課的嚴重後果。","explanation":"指行為帶來的負面結果。"},{"sentence":"The environmental damage is a direct <consequence> *of* industrial pollution, which has affected the health of local residents for many years.","translation":"環境破壞是工業污染的直接後果，這多年來已經影響了當地居民的健康。","explanation":"指因果關係中的結果。"}],"related_forms":["consequences"]}

{"headword":"consequent","explanation":"形容詞用法：指「隨之發生的/作為結果的」。常與 on 或 upon 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The economic crisis and the <consequent> *rise* in unemployment rates have made it difficult for many families to afford basic living expenses.","translation":"經濟危機以及隨之而來的失業率上升，使得許多家庭難以負擔基本生活開銷。","explanation":"指因某事而隨之發生的結果。"},{"sentence":"Heavy rainfall and the <consequent> *flooding* in the low-lying areas forced the local government to evacuate all the residents immediately.","translation":"強降雨以及隨之而來的低窪地區淹水，迫使當地政府立即撤離所有居民。","explanation":"指因果鏈中的後續事件。"}],"related_forms":["consequently"]}

{"headword":"conservative","explanation":"用法：(1) 形容詞「保守的」；(2) 名詞「保守派人士」。","entries":[{"sentence":"My grandfather has very <conservative> *views* on fashion, preferring to wear traditional clothes rather than following the latest trends among teenagers.","translation":"我祖父對時尚有非常保守的看法，寧願穿傳統服裝，也不願追隨青少年間的最新潮流。","explanation":"形容詞，指思想保守。"},{"sentence":"The <conservative> *estimate* of the project's cost is around one million dollars, but the actual expenses might be even higher than that.","translation":"該計畫成本的保守估計約為一百萬美元，但實際支出可能會比那更高。","explanation":"指數字上的「保守估計」。"}],"related_forms":["conservatives","conservatism"]}

{"headword":"consist","explanation":"動詞用法：指「由...組成/構成」。固定搭配：consist of (不可用於被動語態)。","entries":[{"sentence":"A balanced diet should <consist> *of* a variety of foods, including vegetables, fruits, proteins, and whole grains for better health.","translation":"均衡飲食應該由多種食物組成，包括蔬菜、水果、蛋白質和全穀類，以獲得更好的健康。","explanation":"consist of 是固定用法，指組成成分。"},{"sentence":"The committee <consists> *of* five experienced teachers who are responsible for organizing all the school events throughout the academic year.","translation":"該委員會由五位經驗豐富的老師組成，他們負責組織整個學年中所有的學校活動。","explanation":"注意主詞為單數時，動詞要加 s。"}],"related_forms":["consists","consisted","consisting"]}

{"headword":"consistent","explanation":"形容詞用法：(1)「一致的/連貫的」；(2)「持續的」。常用搭配：be consistent with (與...一致)。","entries":[{"sentence":"His actions are not <consistent> *with* his words, which makes it hard for his classmates to trust him in the future.","translation":"他的行為與他的言語不一致，這使得他的同學未來很難信任他。","explanation":"be consistent with 是固定搭配，指與某事相符。"},{"sentence":"The athlete has shown <consistent> *performance* throughout the season, winning medals in almost every competition she has participated in this year.","translation":"這位運動員在整個賽季中表現穩定，在今年參加的幾乎每場比賽中都贏得了獎牌。","explanation":"指表現持續且穩定。"}],"related_forms":["consistency"]}

{"headword":"constitute","explanation":"動詞，意為「構成、組成」或「被視為」。常與「整體」搭配，強調部分組成整體。注意主詞通常是部分，受詞是整體。","entries":[{"sentence":"These small, local businesses <constitute> *a* significant *part* of the national economy, providing jobs for thousands of people every year.","translation":"這些小型在地企業構成了國民經濟的重要部分，每年為數千人提供就業機會。","explanation":"表「構成」，常接整體名詞。此處為構成整體的一部分。"},{"sentence":"The lack of evidence does not <constitute> *a* valid *reason* to dismiss the serious allegations against the manager of the company.","translation":"缺乏證據並不構成駁回針對該公司經理之嚴重指控的合理理由。","explanation":"表「被視為/等於」，常與否定句連用，表示某事不構成某種狀態。"}],"related_forms":["constitutes","constituted","constituting"]}

{"headword":"constitution","explanation":"名詞，意為「憲法」或「體質、構造」。GSAT常考「憲法」之義，需注意與政治相關的詞彙搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is debating whether to amend the <constitution> to *protect* the fundamental *rights* of all citizens in the country.","translation":"政府正在辯論是否要修正憲法，以保護該國所有公民的基本權利。","explanation":"表「憲法」。常見搭配：amend/violate the constitution。"},{"sentence":"Due to her weak <constitution>, she often catches a cold when the weather changes suddenly during the winter season.","translation":"由於她體質虛弱，每當冬季天氣突然變化時，她就很容易感冒。","explanation":"表「體質」。形容詞常搭配 weak, strong, healthy。"}],"related_forms":["constitutions"]}

{"headword":"construct","explanation":"動詞，意為「建造、構築」。亦可指抽象概念的「構建」。注意與 construction 的詞性區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city council plans to <construct> *a* new *bridge* across the river to reduce traffic congestion during the morning rush hour.","translation":"市議會計畫在河上建造一座新橋，以減少早晨尖峰時刻的交通擁堵。","explanation":"表「建造」。常與 bridge, building, road 等實體名詞連用。"},{"sentence":"It is difficult for students to <construct> *a* logical *argument* if they do not have enough background knowledge on the topic.","translation":"如果學生對該主題沒有足夠的背景知識，就很難構建出合乎邏輯的論點。","explanation":"表「構建（抽象概念）」。常搭配 argument, theory, sentence。"}],"related_forms":["constructs","constructed","constructing"]}

{"headword":"construction","explanation":"名詞，意為「建造、建築工程」。常指正在進行的工程狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new library is currently *under* <construction>, so students will have to use the temporary study room for the next semester.","translation":"新圖書館目前正在施工中，所以學生下學期必須使用臨時自習室。","explanation":"片語 under construction 是固定用法，表「施工中」。"},{"sentence":"Safety regulations must be strictly followed at the <construction> *site* to prevent any accidents among the workers on duty.","translation":"建築工地必須嚴格遵守安全規定，以防止值班工人發生任何意外。","explanation":"表「建築的」。construction site 為常見複合名詞。"}],"related_forms":["constructions"]}

{"headword":"constructive","explanation":"形容詞，意為「建設性的」。常用於形容建議、批評或意見，表示對改進有幫助。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher provided <constructive> *feedback* on my essay, which helped me improve my writing skills significantly for the final exam.","translation":"老師對我的作文提供了建設性的回饋，這幫助我在期末考前顯著提升了寫作技巧。","explanation":"constructive feedback 是常見搭配，表「建設性的意見」。"},{"sentence":"Instead of complaining about the problems, we should focus on offering <constructive> *solutions* to make the project more successful.","translation":"與其抱怨問題，我們應該專注於提供建設性的解決方案，讓專案更成功。","explanation":"表「建設性的」。常與 solutions, suggestions, criticism 搭配。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"consult","explanation":"動詞，意為「諮詢、請教」或「查閱」。注意與 consult with (與某人商量) 及 consult (查閱資料) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before making a final decision, you should <consult> *with* your parents to see if they have any better ideas or suggestions.","translation":"在做最終決定之前，你應該與父母商量，看看他們是否有更好的想法或建議。","explanation":"表「諮詢某人」。consult with sb 為常見用法。"},{"sentence":"If you are unsure about the meaning of the word, you can <consult> *a* dictionary to find the correct definition and usage.","translation":"如果你不確定這個詞的意思，你可以查閱字典來找到正確的定義和用法。","explanation":"表「查閱（書籍/資料）」。此處不加 with。"}],"related_forms":["consults","consulted","consulting"]}

{"headword":"consultant","explanation":"名詞，意為「顧問」。指提供專業建議的專家。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company hired a financial <consultant> to *help* them manage their investments and reduce unnecessary expenses for the coming year.","translation":"該公司聘請了一位財務顧問來幫助他們管理投資，並減少來年不必要的開支。","explanation":"表「顧問」。常搭配 hire, employ 等動詞。"},{"sentence":"As a marketing <consultant>, she travels around the world to provide professional advice to various international corporations and small businesses.","translation":"身為行銷顧問，她到世界各地為各類跨國企業和小公司提供專業建議。","explanation":"表「顧問」。常與職業名詞連用。"}],"related_forms":["consultants"]}

{"headword":"consume","explanation":"動詞，意為「消耗、消費」或「吃喝」。強調資源的耗盡或對食物的攝取。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new electric car <consumes> *less* energy than traditional gasoline vehicles, making it a more environmentally friendly choice for daily commuting.","translation":"這款新款電動車消耗的能源比傳統汽油車少，使其成為日常通勤更環保的選擇。","explanation":"表「消耗（能源/資源）」。"},{"sentence":"It is recommended that people <consume> *a* balanced *diet* rich in fruits and vegetables to maintain good health and energy levels.","translation":"建議人們攝取富含水果和蔬菜的均衡飲食，以維持良好的健康和體力。","explanation":"表「攝取（食物）」。consume a diet 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["consumes","consumed","consuming"]}

{"headword":"consumer","explanation":"名詞，意為「消費者」。常與市場、權益相關。","entries":[{"sentence":"Modern <consumer> *behavior* has changed significantly due to the rise of online shopping and the convenience of mobile payment systems.","translation":"由於網購的興起和行動支付系統的便利，現代消費者的行為已經發生了顯著的變化。","explanation":"consumer behavior 為常見搭配，表「消費者行為」。"},{"sentence":"The government has passed new laws to *protect* <consumer> *rights* against unfair business practices and misleading advertisements in the market.","translation":"政府已通過新法以保護消費者權益，免受市場上的不公平商業行為和誤導性廣告的侵害。","explanation":"consumer rights 為常見搭配，表「消費者權益」。"}],"related_forms":["consumers"]}

{"headword":"container","explanation":"名詞，意為「容器、貨櫃」。指用來裝載物品的物體。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please put the leftover food into a plastic <container> and store it in the refrigerator to keep it fresh for tomorrow.","translation":"請將剩餘的食物放入塑膠容器中，並存放在冰箱裡，以保持明天的新鮮度。","explanation":"表「容器」。"},{"sentence":"The large ship was carrying hundreds of <container> *boxes* filled with electronic products from Asia to ports in Europe and America.","translation":"那艘大船載著數百個貨櫃，裡面裝滿了從亞洲運往歐美港口的電子產品。","explanation":"表「貨櫃」。"}],"related_forms":["containers"]}

{"headword":"content","explanation":"名詞，意為「內容、目錄」；形容詞，意為「滿足的」。注意名詞重音在第一音節，形容詞重音在第二音節。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <content> *of* the lecture was so fascinating that all the students listened attentively without checking their phones once.","translation":"演講的內容非常引人入勝，以至於所有學生都專注地聽，一次都沒有看手機。","explanation":"名詞「內容」。常接 of 介係詞。"},{"sentence":"After years of hard work, he finally felt <content> *with* his life and decided to retire to the countryside to relax.","translation":"經過多年的努力工作，他終於對自己的生活感到滿足，並決定退休到鄉下放鬆。","explanation":"形容詞「滿足的」。常搭配 be content with sth。"}],"related_forms":["contents"]}

{"headword":"content","explanation":"動詞，意為「使滿足」；名詞，意為「滿足感」。常與 oneself 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"He had to <content> *himself* *with* a small salary because he valued the opportunity to learn more at the startup company.","translation":"他必須滿足於微薄的薪水，因為他看重在該新創公司學習更多機會的價值。","explanation":"動詞片語 content oneself with sth，表「使自己滿足於...」。"},{"sentence":"True <contentment> comes from appreciating what you already have rather than constantly chasing after things that are beyond your reach.","translation":"真正的滿足感來自於欣賞你已經擁有的東西，而不是不斷追求那些你無法企及的事物。","explanation":"名詞「滿足感」。"}],"related_forms":["contents","contented","contenting","contentment"]}

{"headword":"contest","explanation":"名詞，意為「比賽、競賽」；動詞，意為「競爭、爭辯」。注意動詞重音在第二音節。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to enter the singing <contest> to challenge herself and gain more experience performing in front of a large audience.","translation":"她決定參加歌唱比賽來挑戰自己，並獲得更多在觀眾面前表演的經驗。","explanation":"名詞「比賽」。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer decided to <contest> *the* *results* of the election, claiming that there were serious irregularities during the voting process.","translation":"律師決定對選舉結果提出異議，聲稱投票過程中存在嚴重的違規行為。","explanation":"動詞「爭辯/質疑」。"}],"related_forms":["contests","contested","contesting"]}

{"headword":"context","explanation":"名詞，意為「上下文、背景」。在閱讀測驗中，常指透過前後文推敲字義。","entries":[{"sentence":"You can often guess the meaning of an unfamiliar word by looking at the <context> *in* which it is used in the sentence.","translation":"你通常可以透過觀察生字在句子中使用的上下文來猜測其含義。","explanation":"表「上下文」。"},{"sentence":"To understand the historical event, we must consider the social and political <context> *of* that time period in the country.","translation":"為了理解該歷史事件，我們必須考慮當時該國的社會和政治背景。","explanation":"表「背景」。"}],"related_forms":["contexts"]}

{"headword":"continual","explanation":"形容詞，意為「頻繁的、持續不斷的」。通常帶有負面含義，指令人厭煩的重複。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <continual> *interruptions* during the meeting made it impossible for the team to reach a final agreement on the new project.","translation":"會議期間持續不斷的打斷，使得團隊無法對新專案達成最終協議。","explanation":"表「頻繁的/令人厭煩的」。"},{"sentence":"Despite the <continual> *complaints* from the neighbors, the construction work continued late into the night without any signs of stopping.","translation":"儘管鄰居們持續不斷地抱怨，施工工作仍持續到深夜，沒有任何停止的跡象。","explanation":"表「持續不斷的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"continuous","explanation":"形容詞，意為「連續不斷的」。強調過程沒有中斷，通常為中性或客觀描述。","entries":[{"sentence":"The machine requires <continuous> *monitoring* to ensure that the production line runs smoothly without any technical errors or unexpected breakdowns.","translation":"該機器需要持續的監控，以確保生產線運作順暢，不會出現技術錯誤或意外故障。","explanation":"表「連續的」。"},{"sentence":"After three days of <continuous> *rain*, the river finally overflowed its banks and caused severe flooding in the nearby low-lying areas.","translation":"經過三天的連續降雨，河水終於溢出河岸，並在附近的低窪地區造成了嚴重的洪水。","explanation":"表「連續不斷的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"contrary","explanation":"名詞/形容詞，意為「相反的」。常與 to 搭配，表示與某事相反。","entries":[{"sentence":"Contrary *to* popular <belief>, eating chocolate in moderation can actually have some health benefits for your heart and mood.","translation":"與大眾的認知相反，適量吃巧克力實際上對你的心臟和情緒有一些健康益處。","explanation":"片語 contrary to 為固定用法，表「與...相反」。"},{"sentence":"He insisted on doing the opposite, despite my advice to the <contrary> and the potential risks involved in his reckless plan.","translation":"儘管我有相反的建議，且他的魯莽計畫涉及潛在風險，他仍堅持做相反的事。","explanation":"片語 advice to the contrary，表「相反的建議」。"}],"related_forms":["contraries"]}

{"headword":"contrast","explanation":"名詞/動詞，意為「對比、差異」。常與 between 或 with 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"There is a sharp <contrast> *between* the rich lifestyle of the city center and the poverty found in the remote rural villages.","translation":"市中心的富裕生活方式與偏遠農村的貧困之間存在著鮮明的對比。","explanation":"名詞「對比」。常搭配 contrast between A and B。"},{"sentence":"If you <contrast> *the* two *paintings*, you will notice that the artist used completely different colors to convey different emotional states.","translation":"如果你對比這兩幅畫，你會發現藝術家使用了完全不同的顏色來傳達不同的情緒狀態。","explanation":"動詞「對比」。"}],"related_forms":["contrasts","contrasted","contrasting"]}

{"headword":"contribute","explanation":"動詞，意為「貢獻、捐獻」或「導致」。常與 to 搭配，注意 to 是介係詞，後接名詞或動名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many volunteers <contribute> *their* *time* and effort to help the local community center provide free meals for the elderly people.","translation":"許多志工貢獻他們的時間和精力，幫助當地社區中心為老年人提供免費餐點。","explanation":"表「貢獻」。"},{"sentence":"Lack of exercise and poor eating habits can <contribute> *to* the development of various health problems as people get older.","translation":"缺乏運動和不良的飲食習慣可能會導致人們在年紀漸長時出現各種健康問題。","explanation":"表「導致」。注意 to 是介係詞，後接名詞或 V-ing。"}],"related_forms":["contributes","contributed","contributing"]}

{"headword":"contribution","explanation":"名詞，意為「貢獻」。常與 make 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist made a significant <contribution> *to* the field of medicine by discovering a new way to treat rare diseases.","translation":"這位科學家透過發現治療罕見疾病的新方法，對醫學領域做出了重大貢獻。","explanation":"片語 make a contribution to 為固定用法。"},{"sentence":"We are collecting money to make a <contribution> *to* the disaster relief fund for the victims of the recent earthquake.","translation":"我們正在募款，以便對最近地震的受害者進行捐助。","explanation":"表「捐獻」。"}],"related_forms":["contributions"]}

{"headword":"convenience","explanation":"名詞「便利/方便」。常見片語：at your earliest convenience (盡快)；for the sake of convenience (為了方便)。注意不可數名詞用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new subway station was built for the <convenience> *of* commuters who travel between the suburbs and the city center daily.","translation":"新的地鐵站是為了通勤者在郊區和市中心之間每日往返的便利而建的。","explanation":"名詞「便利」。常用搭配 for the convenience of sb."},{"sentence":"Please reply to this email at your earliest <convenience> so that we can finalize the schedule for the upcoming school event.","translation":"請在您最方便時儘快回覆此郵件，以便我們能敲定即將到來的學校活動時間表。","explanation":"固定片語 at one's earliest convenience，意為「在某人方便時儘快」。"}],"related_forms":["convenient","conveniently"]}

{"headword":"convention","explanation":"名詞「習俗/慣例」或「會議/大會」。注意與 conventional 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is a social <convention> *to* shake hands when meeting someone for the first time in many Western business cultures.","translation":"在許多西方商業文化中，初次見面時握手是一種社交慣例。","explanation":"名詞「習俗/慣例」。常搭配 social convention 或 break with convention。"},{"sentence":"Thousands of tech enthusiasts gathered in Taipei for the annual international gaming <convention> to explore the latest virtual reality products.","translation":"數千名科技愛好者聚集在台北參加年度國際遊戲大會，探索最新的虛擬實境產品。","explanation":"名詞「大型會議/大會」。"}],"related_forms":["conventions"]}

{"headword":"conventional","explanation":"形容詞「傳統的/慣例的」。常用於描述非創新、守舊的事物。","entries":[{"sentence":"Unlike <conventional> *methods* of teaching, this new program encourages students to participate in hands-on experiments rather than just listening.","translation":"與傳統教學方法不同，這個新課程鼓勵學生參與實作實驗，而不僅僅是聽講。","explanation":"形容詞「傳統的」。常與 unconventional 或 modern 做對比。"},{"sentence":"The artist decided to abandon <conventional> *styles* of painting and instead created abstract works that challenged the viewer's perception.","translation":"這位藝術家決定放棄傳統的繪畫風格，轉而創作挑戰觀眾感知的抽象作品。","explanation":"形容詞「傳統的」。"}],"related_forms":["conventionally"]}

{"headword":"converse","explanation":"動詞「交談」。注意重音在第二音節。名詞形式為 conversation。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the language exchange program, students were encouraged to <converse> *with* native speakers to improve their oral communication skills effectively.","translation":"在語言交換計畫期間，學生們被鼓勵與母語人士交談，以有效提升口語溝通能力。","explanation":"動詞「交談」。常用搭配 converse with sb. about sth."},{"sentence":"The professor stopped to <converse> *briefly* with the student about the research proposal before heading to the faculty meeting room.","translation":"教授在前往教職員會議室之前，停下來與該學生簡短地討論了研究計畫。","explanation":"動詞「交談」。"}],"related_forms":["conversed","conversing"]}

{"headword":"convey","explanation":"動詞「傳達/運送」。常用於傳達訊息、情感或想法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The author uses vivid imagery in her novel to <convey> the deep sense of loneliness felt by the main character throughout.","translation":"作者在小說中運用生動的意象來傳達主角內心深處感受到的強烈孤獨感。","explanation":"動詞「傳達」。常接訊息、情感或意義。"},{"sentence":"Please <convey> my sincere *apologies* to your parents for missing the dinner party due to an unexpected work emergency yesterday.","translation":"請代我向你的父母轉達我誠摯的歉意，因為昨天突發的工作緊急狀況導致我錯過了晚宴。","explanation":"動詞「傳達/轉達」。"}],"related_forms":["conveyed","conveying","conveyance"]}

{"headword":"convince","explanation":"動詞「說服/使確信」。常見句型：convince sb. of sth. 或 convince sb. that 子句。","entries":[{"sentence":"It took a lot of effort to <convince> the committee *of* the necessity of installing solar panels on the school roof.","translation":"花了很多努力才說服委員會在學校屋頂安裝太陽能板的必要性。","explanation":"動詞「說服」。固定搭配 convince sb. of sth."},{"sentence":"The evidence presented in court was strong enough to <convince> the jury *that* the defendant was innocent of the crime charged.","translation":"法庭上提出的證據足以說服陪審團被告對被指控的罪行是無辜的。","explanation":"動詞「使確信」。後接 that 子句。"}],"related_forms":["convinced","convincing"]}

{"headword":"cooperate","explanation":"動詞「合作」。注意介係詞搭配：cooperate with sb. on sth.","entries":[{"sentence":"The two research teams decided to <cooperate> *with* each other to finish the complex scientific project before the deadline arrived.","translation":"這兩個研究團隊決定互相合作，以便在截止日期前完成這個複雜的科學計畫。","explanation":"動詞「合作」。"},{"sentence":"If all citizens <cooperate> *in* following the new recycling regulations, the city will become much cleaner and more sustainable for everyone.","translation":"如果所有市民都合作遵守新的回收規定，這座城市對每個人來說將會變得更乾淨、更永續。","explanation":"動詞「合作」。cooperate in sth. 表在某事上合作。"}],"related_forms":["cooperated","cooperating"]}

{"headword":"cooperation","explanation":"名詞「合作」。常與 in 搭配，如 in cooperation with。","entries":[{"sentence":"The successful launch of the new satellite was achieved *in* <cooperation> *with* several international space agencies over the past five years.","translation":"新衛星的成功發射是在過去五年中與數個國際太空機構合作下達成的。","explanation":"名詞「合作」。固定片語 in cooperation with。"},{"sentence":"Close <cooperation> between the government and local businesses is essential for revitalizing the economy in this rural area of Taiwan.","translation":"政府與當地企業之間的密切合作對於振興台灣這個農村地區的經濟至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「合作」。"}],"related_forms":["cooperations"]}

{"headword":"cooperative","explanation":"形容詞「合作的/樂於助人的」；名詞「合作社」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher praised the students for being so <cooperative> *during* the group project, as they shared tasks and helped each other out.","translation":"老師稱讚學生們在小組專題期間非常樂於合作，因為他們分擔工作並互相幫助。","explanation":"形容詞「合作的/樂於助人的」。"},{"sentence":"The local farmers formed a <cooperative> to sell their organic vegetables directly to consumers, cutting out the need for expensive middlemen.","translation":"當地農民組成了一個合作社，直接將有機蔬菜賣給消費者，省去了昂貴的中間商需求。","explanation":"名詞「合作社」。"}],"related_forms":["cooperatively"]}

{"headword":"cope","explanation":"動詞「應付/處理」。常用搭配：cope with sth. (處理困難的事物)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many students find it difficult to <cope> *with* the immense pressure of preparing for the upcoming university entrance examinations every year.","translation":"許多學生發現很難應付每年準備大學入學考試的巨大壓力。","explanation":"動詞「應付」。常與 with 搭配，處理負面或困難的情境。"},{"sentence":"She learned how to <cope> *with* stress by practicing meditation and taking short walks in the park during her lunch breaks.","translation":"她學會了透過練習冥想和在午休時間去公園散步來應付壓力。","explanation":"動詞「應付」。"}],"related_forms":["coped","coping"]}

{"headword":"copper","explanation":"名詞「銅」；形容詞「銅製的/紅銅色的」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because <copper> is an excellent *conductor* of electricity, it is widely used in electrical wiring and various electronic devices today.","translation":"因為銅是極佳的導電體，所以它在現今的電線和各種電子設備中被廣泛使用。","explanation":"名詞「銅」。"},{"sentence":"The old kitchen was decorated with several <copper> *pots* and pans hanging from the ceiling, giving it a rustic and warm atmosphere.","translation":"舊廚房裝飾著幾個掛在天花板上的銅製鍋具，賦予它一種鄉村且溫暖的氛圍。","explanation":"形容詞「銅製的」。"}],"related_forms":["coppers"]}

{"headword":"cord","explanation":"名詞「細繩/電線」。注意與 rope (粗繩) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please make sure to unplug the power <cord> from the wall outlet before you start cleaning the back of the computer monitor.","translation":"在開始清潔電腦螢幕背面之前，請務必將電源線從牆上的插座拔掉。","explanation":"名詞「電線」。"},{"sentence":"The hiker used a strong <cord> to tie his heavy backpack securely to the frame of his bicycle for the long trip.","translation":"這位徒步旅行者用一條堅固的細繩將他沉重的背包牢牢地綁在自行車架上，準備長途旅行。","explanation":"名詞「細繩」。"}],"related_forms":["cords"]}

{"headword":"correspond","explanation":"動詞「符合/一致」或「通信」。注意介係詞：correspond to/with (符合)；correspond with (通信)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The results of the laboratory experiment do not <correspond> *to* the initial hypothesis, suggesting that further investigation is required immediately.","translation":"實驗室實驗的結果與最初的假設不符，這顯示需要立即進行進一步的調查。","explanation":"動詞「符合/一致」。"},{"sentence":"Even after moving to different countries, the two best friends continued to <correspond> *with* each other through handwritten letters for many years.","translation":"即使搬到不同的國家，這兩位摯友多年來仍持續透過手寫信件保持通信。","explanation":"動詞「通信」。"}],"related_forms":["corresponded","corresponding","correspondence"]}

{"headword":"costume","explanation":"名詞「服裝/戲服」。指特定場合或表演穿的衣服，而非日常服裝 (clothes)。","entries":[{"sentence":"All the actors spent hours putting on their elaborate <costume> *designs* before the opening night of the school's annual drama performance.","translation":"在學校年度戲劇表演的首演之夜前，所有演員都花了數小時穿上他們精緻的戲服設計。","explanation":"名詞「戲服」。"},{"sentence":"Many children enjoy wearing a colorful <costume> *on* Halloween, dressing up as their favorite superheroes or characters from popular fairy tales.","translation":"許多孩子喜歡在萬聖節穿上色彩鮮豔的服裝，打扮成他們最喜歡的超級英雄或童話故事中的角色。","explanation":"名詞「服裝」。"}],"related_forms":["costumes"]}

{"headword":"cottage","explanation":"名詞「村舍/小屋」。通常指鄉間的小房子。","entries":[{"sentence":"They decided to rent a small, cozy <cottage> *in* the countryside to spend their summer vacation away from the noise of the city.","translation":"他們決定在鄉間租一間舒適的小屋，遠離城市的喧囂度過暑假。","explanation":"名詞「小屋」。"},{"sentence":"The old stone <cottage> was surrounded by a beautiful garden filled with blooming flowers, making it look like a scene from a storybook.","translation":"那座古老的石造小屋被一座開滿鮮花的美麗花園環繞，看起來就像故事書裡的場景。","explanation":"名詞「小屋」。"}],"related_forms":["cottages"]}

{"headword":"council","explanation":"名詞「委員會/地方議會」。注意拼字，不要與 counsel (建議) 混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city <council> *voted* in favor of the new policy to increase green spaces in the downtown area to improve air quality.","translation":"市議會投票贊成這項增加市中心綠地以改善空氣品質的新政策。","explanation":"名詞「地方議會」。"},{"sentence":"The student <council> *organized* a charity event to raise funds for the local animal shelter during the winter break last year.","translation":"學生會去年寒假期間舉辦了一場慈善活動，為當地動物收容所募款。","explanation":"名詞「委員會」。"}],"related_forms":["councils","councillor"]}

{"headword":"counter","explanation":"名詞「櫃檯」；動詞「反駁/對抗」；形容詞/副詞「相反的」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The customer waited at the service <counter> for several minutes before a staff member finally arrived to assist with the return process.","translation":"顧客在服務櫃檯等了幾分鐘，才終於有工作人員過來協助退貨流程。","explanation":"名詞「櫃檯」。"},{"sentence":"The politician tried to <counter> the opponent's *arguments* by presenting new data that proved his own economic plan was more effective.","translation":"這位政治人物試圖透過提出證明他自己的經濟計畫更有效的新數據，來反駁對手的論點。","explanation":"動詞「反駁」。"}],"related_forms":["counters","countered","countering"]}

{"headword":"courageous","explanation":"形容詞「勇敢的」。常用於形容面對困難或危險時的表現。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was a <courageous> *decision* for the young athlete to continue competing in the race despite suffering a painful ankle injury earlier.","translation":"這位年輕運動員儘管早先受了痛苦的腳踝傷，仍決定繼續參加比賽，這是一個勇敢的決定。","explanation":"形容詞「勇敢的」。"},{"sentence":"The firefighter made a <courageous> *attempt* to rescue the trapped family from the burning building before the roof finally collapsed completely.","translation":"消防員在屋頂最終完全坍塌前，勇敢地嘗試將受困家庭從燃燒的建築物中救出。","explanation":"形容詞「勇敢的」。"}],"related_forms":["courage","courageously"]}

{"headword":"courtesy","explanation":"名詞「禮貌/謙恭」。常見片語：by courtesy of (承蒙...提供)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Showing <courtesy> *to* others, such as holding the door open for someone behind you, is a simple way to make the world better.","translation":"對他人表現出禮貌，例如為身後的人扶住門，是讓世界變得更美好的一種簡單方式。","explanation":"名詞「禮貌」。"},{"sentence":"The beautiful photographs in this exhibition were provided *by* <courtesy> *of* the local museum, which holds a vast collection of historical images.","translation":"本次展覽中精美的照片是承蒙當地博物館提供，該館收藏了大量的歷史影像。","explanation":"固定片語 by courtesy of，意為「承蒙...提供」。"}],"related_forms":["courteous"]}

{"headword":"coward","explanation":"名詞「懦夫」。形容詞形式為 cowardly。","entries":[{"sentence":"He was labeled a <coward> *for* running away from the challenge instead of facing his fears and trying to solve the problem.","translation":"他因為逃避挑戰而不是面對恐懼並試圖解決問題，而被貼上懦夫的標籤。","explanation":"名詞「懦夫」。"},{"sentence":"It is not a sign of being a <coward> to admit that you need help when you are overwhelmed by difficult tasks.","translation":"當你被艱鉅的任務壓得喘不過氣時，承認你需要幫助並不是懦夫的表現。","explanation":"名詞「懦夫」。"}],"related_forms":["cowards","cowardly"]}

{"headword":"crack","explanation":"名詞表「裂縫/爆裂聲」；動詞表「使破裂/破解(密碼/難題)」。注意 crack a joke (講笑話) 的固定搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"A small <crack> appeared in the *windowpane* after the heavy storm hit the school building last night.","translation":"昨晚強烈風暴襲擊校舍後，窗戶玻璃上出現了一道小裂縫。","explanation":"名詞用法，指物體表面的裂縫。"},{"sentence":"The detective finally managed to <crack> the *secret code* after working on the case for several weeks.","translation":"偵探在處理該案件幾週後，終於成功破解了秘密代碼。","explanation":"動詞用法，指破解密碼或難題。"}],"related_forms":["cracks","cracked","cracking"]}

{"headword":"craft","explanation":"名詞表「工藝/手藝」或「飛行器/船隻」。注意 craft 複數形仍為 craft (指交通工具時)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local villagers are famous for their traditional <craft> *skills*, especially in weaving beautiful baskets from bamboo.","translation":"當地村民以其傳統工藝技術聞名，特別是將竹子編織成精美的籃子。","explanation":"名詞表手藝、工藝。"},{"sentence":"The astronauts boarded the space <craft> to begin their *scientific mission* to explore the distant planet.","translation":"太空人登上太空船，開始他們探索遙遠行星的科學任務。","explanation":"名詞表飛行器或船隻。"}],"related_forms":["crafts","craftsman","craftsmanship"]}

{"headword":"creation","explanation":"名詞表「創造/創造物」。常與 God 或 artistic works 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist's latest <creation> is a *stunning sculpture* made entirely from recycled materials found on the beach.","translation":"這位藝術家最新的創作是一座完全由在海灘上發現的回收材料製成的驚人雕塑。","explanation":"名詞表創造出來的作品。"},{"sentence":"The <creation> of the new *national park* has helped protect many endangered species from losing their natural habitats.","translation":"新國家公園的建立有助於保護許多瀕危物種免於失去自然棲息地。","explanation":"名詞表創造的過程或行為。"}],"related_forms":["creations","creative"]}

{"headword":"creativity","explanation":"名詞表「創造力」。常與 foster, encourage, spark 等動詞搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher encourages <creativity> in the classroom by allowing students to *express their ideas* through various art projects.","translation":"老師透過允許學生透過各種藝術專案表達想法，來鼓勵課堂上的創造力。","explanation":"名詞表創造力，不可數。"},{"sentence":"Solving complex problems often requires a great deal of <creativity> and *out-of-the-box thinking* from the entire team.","translation":"解決複雜的問題通常需要整個團隊具備大量的創造力和跳脫框架的思考。","explanation":"名詞表創造力，強調解決問題的能力。"}],"related_forms":["creative"]}

{"headword":"creep","explanation":"動詞表「緩慢移動/爬行」。注意過去式為 crept。","entries":[{"sentence":"The thief tried to <creep> *silently* across the floor to avoid waking up the sleeping family members.","translation":"小偷試圖安靜地爬過地板，以避免吵醒睡覺的家人。","explanation":"動詞表悄悄地移動。"},{"sentence":"As the deadline approached, a sense of *anxiety* began to <creep> into the students' minds during the exam.","translation":"隨著截止日期臨近，考試期間學生心中開始產生一種焦慮感。","explanation":"動詞表緩慢地產生或蔓延。"}],"related_forms":["crept","creeping"]}

{"headword":"critic","explanation":"名詞表「評論家/批評者」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The famous film <critic> gave the new movie a *glowing review*, praising the director's unique storytelling style.","translation":"著名的影評人給了這部新電影極高的評價，稱讚導演獨特的敘事風格。","explanation":"名詞表專業評論家。"},{"sentence":"Despite being a harsh <critic> of the government's *economic policy*, he admitted that the new tax law was necessary.","translation":"儘管他是政府經濟政策的嚴厲批評者，但他承認新的稅法是有必要的。","explanation":"名詞表批評者。"}],"related_forms":["critics"]}

{"headword":"critical","explanation":"形容詞表「關鍵的/批判性的/嚴重的」。GSAT常考「批判性思考」critical thinking。","entries":[{"sentence":"Developing <critical> *thinking skills* is essential for students to analyze information and make informed decisions in life.","translation":"培養批判性思考能力對於學生分析資訊並在生活中做出明智決定至關重要。","explanation":"形容詞表批判性的。"},{"sentence":"The patient is in <critical> *condition* after the accident, and the doctors are doing their best to save him.","translation":"病人在事故後情況危急，醫生們正盡全力搶救他。","explanation":"形容詞表極其嚴重的、危急的。"}],"related_forms":["critically"]}

{"headword":"criticism","explanation":"名詞表「批評/評論」。常搭配 face/receive criticism。","entries":[{"sentence":"The politician faced heavy <criticism> from the public after his *controversial remarks* were broadcast on national television.","translation":"這位政治人物在爭議言論於全國電視播出後，面臨來自大眾的沉重批評。","explanation":"名詞表批評。"},{"sentence":"Constructive <criticism> can help you improve your *writing skills* if you are willing to listen to others' suggestions.","translation":"如果你願意聽取他人的建議，建設性的批評可以幫助你提升寫作技巧。","explanation":"名詞表建設性的評論。"}],"related_forms":["criticisms"]}

{"headword":"criticize","explanation":"動詞表「批評」。注意拼字，美式為 -ize，英式為 -ise。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is unfair to <criticize> others for their *personal choices* when you do not know the full story.","translation":"當你不了解完整情況時，因為他人的個人選擇而批評他們是不公平的。","explanation":"動詞表批評。"},{"sentence":"The professor <criticized> the student's *research paper* for lacking sufficient evidence to support the main argument.","translation":"教授批評該學生的研究報告，因為缺乏足夠的證據來支持主要論點。","explanation":"動詞表提出負面意見。"}],"related_forms":["criticized","criticizing"]}

{"headword":"cruelty","explanation":"名詞表「殘酷/虐待」。常搭配 animal cruelty。","entries":[{"sentence":"The organization is dedicated to preventing animal <cruelty> and ensuring that all pets are *treated with kindness*.","translation":"該組織致力於防止虐待動物，並確保所有寵物都受到友善對待。","explanation":"名詞表殘酷行為。"},{"sentence":"He was shocked by the <cruelty> of the *harsh punishment* inflicted upon the prisoners in the ancient times.","translation":"他對古代囚犯所受到的殘酷懲罰感到震驚。","explanation":"名詞表殘酷的性質。"}],"related_forms":["cruel"]}

{"headword":"crunchy","explanation":"形容詞表「酥脆的」。常用於描述食物口感。","entries":[{"sentence":"I love eating <crunchy> *vegetables* like carrots and celery as a healthy snack during my afternoon study break.","translation":"我喜歡在下午讀書休息時吃像胡蘿蔔和芹菜這樣酥脆的蔬菜作為健康零食。","explanation":"形容詞表酥脆的。"},{"sentence":"The cookies were perfectly baked, with a <crunchy> *texture* on the outside and a soft center inside.","translation":"餅乾烤得非常完美，外層口感酥脆，內層柔軟。","explanation":"形容詞表口感。"}],"related_forms":["crunch"]}

{"headword":"crush","explanation":"動詞表「壓碎/迷戀」；名詞表「迷戀/擁擠的人群」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Be careful not to <crush> the *delicate flowers* while you are walking through the garden this afternoon.","translation":"今天下午走過花園時，小心不要壓壞了嬌嫩的花朵。","explanation":"動詞表壓碎。"},{"sentence":"She has had a secret <crush> *on* her classmate since the beginning of the school year last September.","translation":"自從去年九月開學以來，她一直暗戀著她的同學。","explanation":"名詞表迷戀，常搭配 have a crush on sb。"}],"related_forms":["crushed","crushing"]}

{"headword":"cube","explanation":"名詞表「立方體/冰塊」；動詞表「切成丁」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please <cube> the *potatoes* into small pieces before you add them to the soup for the dinner party.","translation":"在將馬鈴薯加入晚餐派對的湯之前，請先將它們切成小丁。","explanation":"動詞表切成丁。"},{"sentence":"The math teacher used a wooden <cube> to explain the *geometric concept* of volume to the students today.","translation":"數學老師今天用一個木製立方體向學生解釋體積的幾何概念。","explanation":"名詞表立方體。"}],"related_forms":["cubes","cubic"]}

{"headword":"cue","explanation":"名詞表「提示/暗示」；動詞表「給予提示」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The actor waited for his <cue> *from* the director before he walked onto the stage to start the performance.","translation":"演員在走上舞台開始表演前，等待著導演給他的提示。","explanation":"名詞表提示。"},{"sentence":"The teacher <cued> the students to *start writing* the essay by ringing a small bell in the classroom.","translation":"老師透過在教室裡搖響小鈴鐺，提示學生開始寫作論文。","explanation":"動詞表給予提示。"}],"related_forms":["cues","cued"]}

{"headword":"cunning","explanation":"形容詞表「狡猾的」；名詞表「狡猾」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <cunning> fox managed to *outsmart* the hunters and escape into the deep forest without being caught.","translation":"狡猾的狐狸成功地勝過獵人，並逃進深林中而未被抓住。","explanation":"形容詞表狡猾的。"},{"sentence":"With great <cunning>, the spy *deceived* the enemy and obtained the classified information he needed for the mission.","translation":"間諜以極大的狡猾欺騙了敵人，並獲得了任務所需的機密資訊。","explanation":"名詞表狡猾的特質。"}],"related_forms":["cunningly"]}

{"headword":"curiosity","explanation":"名詞表「好奇心」。常搭配 satisfy one's curiosity。","entries":[{"sentence":"Her <curiosity> about the *unknown world* led her to travel to many remote countries during her summer vacation.","translation":"她對未知世界的好奇心使她在暑假期間前往許多偏遠國家旅行。","explanation":"名詞表好奇心。"},{"sentence":"He opened the mysterious box just to *satisfy* his <curiosity> regarding what was hidden inside for so long.","translation":"他打開那個神秘的盒子，只是為了滿足他對於裡面隱藏了這麼久的東西的好奇心。","explanation":"名詞表好奇心，搭配 satisfy。"}],"related_forms":["curious"]}

{"headword":"curl","explanation":"名詞表「捲髮/捲曲物」；動詞表「使捲曲」。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to <curl> her *long hair* for the school dance to look more elegant and stylish tonight.","translation":"她決定為了今晚的學校舞會將長髮捲起來，看起來更優雅時髦。","explanation":"動詞表使捲曲。"},{"sentence":"The cat likes to <curl> *up* on the sofa and sleep peacefully during the cold winter afternoons at home.","translation":"貓咪喜歡在寒冷的冬日下午蜷縮在沙發上安靜地睡覺。","explanation":"動詞片語 curl up，指蜷縮。"}],"related_forms":["curls","curly"]}

{"headword":"curse","explanation":"名詞表「詛咒/咒罵」；動詞表「詛咒」。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the fairy tale, the witch cast a <curse> *on* the prince, turning him into a frog for many years.","translation":"在童話故事中，女巫對王子下了詛咒，讓他變成了青蛙多年。","explanation":"名詞表詛咒。"},{"sentence":"He was so angry that he started to <curse> *at* everyone who tried to help him solve the difficult problem.","translation":"他非常生氣，開始咒罵每一個試圖幫助他解決困難問題的人。","explanation":"動詞表咒罵。"}],"related_forms":["cursed","cursing"]}

{"headword":"curve","explanation":"名詞表「曲線/彎曲處」；動詞表「使彎曲」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The road begins to <curve> *sharply* as it goes up the mountain, so drivers should be very careful there.","translation":"道路在爬山時開始急劇彎曲，所以駕駛在那裡應該要非常小心。","explanation":"動詞表彎曲。"},{"sentence":"The graph shows a steep <curve> *upward*, indicating that the company's sales have increased significantly this year.","translation":"圖表顯示出一條陡峭的向上曲線，表明該公司的銷售額今年顯著增長。","explanation":"名詞表曲線。"}],"related_forms":["curves","curved"]}

{"headword":"cushion","explanation":"名詞表「坐墊/緩衝物」；動詞表「減輕衝擊」。","entries":[{"sentence":"She placed a soft <cushion> on the wooden chair to make it more *comfortable* for sitting for long hours.","translation":"她在木椅上放了一個柔軟的坐墊，讓長時間坐著更舒適。","explanation":"名詞表坐墊。"},{"sentence":"The thick layer of snow helped to <cushion> the *impact* of his fall when he slipped on the ice.","translation":"厚厚的積雪幫助減輕了他滑倒時的衝擊力。","explanation":"動詞表減輕衝擊。"}],"related_forms":["cushions","cushioned"]}

{"headword":"damp","explanation":"形容詞表「潮濕的」；名詞表「濕氣」；動詞表「使潮濕/抑制」。注意形容詞常指令人不舒服的濕氣，與 humid（氣候潮濕）不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"The basement was <damp> and cold, so we decided to store our important documents in a *dry* place upstairs instead.","translation":"地下室又濕又冷，所以我們決定把重要文件存放在樓上乾燥的地方。","explanation":"形容詞「潮濕的」。常與 cold, dark 搭配描述環境。"},{"sentence":"The heavy rain <damped> the *spirits* of the students who were looking forward to the outdoor sports meet all week.","translation":"大雨澆熄了那些整週都期待著戶外運動會的學生們的熱情。","explanation":"動詞「抑制/減弱」。dampen/damp spirits 為常見搭配，意指澆熄熱情。"}],"related_forms":["damps","damped","dampening"]}

{"headword":"deadline","explanation":"名詞「截止日期」。常與動詞 meet（趕上）或 miss（錯過）搭配使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"To *meet* the strict <deadline> for the science project, the team members worked late into the night every single day.","translation":"為了趕上科學專題的嚴格截止日期，團隊成員每天都工作到深夜。","explanation":"meet the deadline 為固定搭配，意指準時完成。"},{"sentence":"The professor refused to accept any late assignments, even though several students *missed* the <deadline> due to technical issues.","translation":"教授拒絕接受任何遲交的作業，儘管有幾位學生因為技術問題錯過了截止日期。","explanation":"miss the deadline 為固定搭配，意指錯過期限。"}],"related_forms":["deadlines"]}

{"headword":"declare","explanation":"動詞「宣佈/申報」。常用於正式場合或海關申報物品。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government <declared> a *state* of emergency after the massive earthquake destroyed most of the infrastructure in the city.","translation":"在大地震摧毀了城市大部分基礎設施後，政府宣佈了緊急狀態。","explanation":"declare a state of... 為正式用法，意指宣佈某種狀態。"},{"sentence":"Travelers are required to <declare> any *valuable* items, such as expensive jewelry or large amounts of cash, at the customs office.","translation":"旅客在海關必須申報任何貴重物品，例如昂貴珠寶或大量現金。","explanation":"海關用語，declare sth 指申報物品。"}],"related_forms":["declared","declaring","declaration"]}

{"headword":"decoration","explanation":"名詞「裝飾/裝飾品」。常用於節慶或室內設計。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students spent the whole afternoon putting up colorful <decorations> to *create* a festive atmosphere for the school dance party.","translation":"學生們花了一整個下午掛上色彩繽紛的裝飾品，為學校舞會營造節日氣氛。","explanation":"put up decorations 為常見動詞片語，意指佈置裝飾。"},{"sentence":"Minimalist interior design focuses on function rather than excessive <decoration>, making the living space feel more *spacious* and organized.","translation":"極簡主義室內設計著重於功能而非過度的裝飾，使居住空間感覺更寬敞且有條理。","explanation":"不可數用法，指裝飾風格或行為。"}],"related_forms":["decorations","decorate"]}

{"headword":"defeat","explanation":"名詞「失敗/擊敗」；動詞「擊敗」。注意與 defeat 相關的搭配詞常與比賽或戰爭有關。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite their best efforts, the team suffered a bitter <defeat> in the *final* match against their long-time rival school.","translation":"儘管盡了最大努力，該隊在對抗長期競爭對手的決賽中仍遭受了慘痛的失敗。","explanation":"suffer a defeat 為固定搭配，意指遭受失敗。"},{"sentence":"The champion managed to <defeat> all his opponents in the tournament, proving that his *rigorous* training had truly paid off.","translation":"冠軍成功擊敗了錦標賽中所有的對手，證明他嚴格的訓練確實有了回報。","explanation":"動詞「擊敗」。defeat one's opponent 為常見用法。"}],"related_forms":["defeats","defeated","defeating"]}

{"headword":"defend","explanation":"動詞「防禦/辯護」。常與 against 搭配使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soldiers were ordered to <defend> the *border* against any potential invasion to ensure the safety of the citizens living nearby.","translation":"士兵們奉命防禦邊境以抵禦任何潛在的入侵，確保附近居民的安全。","explanation":"defend... against... 為固定搭配，意指防禦某物以對抗某威脅。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer tried to <defend> his client by presenting new evidence that *challenged* the witness's credibility in the courtroom.","translation":"律師試圖透過提出挑戰證人可信度的新證據，在法庭上為他的委託人辯護。","explanation":"動詞「辯護」。defend one's client 為法律領域常用詞。"}],"related_forms":["defended","defending","defense"]}

{"headword":"defense","explanation":"名詞「防禦/辯護」。注意美式拼法為 defense，英式為 defence。","entries":[{"sentence":"The country increased its spending on national <defense> to improve its *military* capabilities in response to rising regional tensions.","translation":"該國增加了國防開支以提升軍事能力，以應對日益升高的區域緊張局勢。","explanation":"national defense 為固定搭配，意指國防。"},{"sentence":"In his own <defense>, the student explained that he had been absent because of a *sudden* medical emergency at home.","translation":"為了替自己辯護，該學生解釋說他缺席是因為家裡發生了突發的醫療緊急狀況。","explanation":"in one's defense 為固定片語，意指為了替自己辯解。"}],"related_forms":["defenses","defend"]}

{"headword":"defensible","explanation":"形容詞「可防禦的/站得住腳的」。常用於論點或軍事策略。","entries":[{"sentence":"The general argued that the current position was easily <defensible> because of the *natural* barriers provided by the surrounding mountains.","translation":"將軍認為由於周圍山脈提供的天然屏障，目前的位置很容易防守。","explanation":"形容詞「可防禦的」。"},{"sentence":"While his decision was controversial, he provided a <defensible> *argument* based on the economic data available at that time.","translation":"雖然他的決定備受爭議，但他根據當時可取得的經濟數據，提出了一個站得住腳的論點。","explanation":"形容詞「站得住腳的」。defensible argument 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["defend"]}

{"headword":"defensive","explanation":"形容詞「防禦性的」。常指態度或戰術。","entries":[{"sentence":"The coach decided to adopt a <defensive> *strategy* for the second half to protect their narrow lead against the opponent.","translation":"教練決定在下半場採取防禦性策略，以保護他們對對手的微弱領先優勢。","explanation":"defensive strategy 為常見搭配，意指防守戰術。"},{"sentence":"She became very <defensive> when her colleagues asked about the *mistakes* she made in the final report last week.","translation":"當同事問起她上週在最終報告中犯的錯誤時，她變得非常有防衛心。","explanation":"形容詞「防衛的/自我保護的」。be defensive about sth 為常見用法。"}],"related_forms":["defend","defense"]}

{"headword":"definite","explanation":"形容詞「明確的/肯定的」。注意與 definitive（決定性的）區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"We need a <definite> *answer* by tomorrow so that we can proceed with the travel arrangements for the school trip.","translation":"我們明天前需要一個明確的答案，這樣我們才能繼續進行校外教學的旅遊安排。","explanation":"definite answer 為常見搭配，意指肯定的回答。"},{"sentence":"There is a <definite> *improvement* in his writing skills after he attended the intensive English workshop this summer.","translation":"在他參加了今年夏天的密集英語工作坊後，他的寫作技巧有了明確的進步。","explanation":"形容詞「明確的」。"}],"related_forms":["definitely"]}

{"headword":"delicate","explanation":"形容詞「精緻的/脆弱的/棘手的」。根據語境不同，意思差異很大。","entries":[{"sentence":"The antique vase is extremely <delicate>, so please handle it with *great* care when you move it to the display case.","translation":"這只古董花瓶非常脆弱，所以當你把它移到展示櫃時，請務必小心處理。","explanation":"形容詞「脆弱的」。"},{"sentence":"The diplomat had to handle the <delicate> *situation* with caution to avoid causing any further conflict between the two nations.","translation":"外交官必須謹慎處理這棘手的情況，以避免在兩國之間造成任何進一步的衝突。","explanation":"形容詞「棘手的」。delicate situation 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["delicacy"]}

{"headword":"delight","explanation":"名詞「高興/樂事」；動詞「使高興」。常用片語 to one's delight。","entries":[{"sentence":"To the students' <delight>, the teacher announced that there would be no *homework* assigned for the upcoming long weekend.","translation":"令學生們高興的是，老師宣佈即將到來的連續假期不會指派任何家庭作業。","explanation":"to one's delight 為固定片語，意指令某人高興的是。"},{"sentence":"The chef <delights> in *creating* new recipes that combine traditional ingredients with modern cooking techniques from around the world.","translation":"這位廚師樂於創造結合傳統食材與世界各地現代烹飪技術的新食譜。","explanation":"delight in doing sth 為固定用法，意指樂於做某事。"}],"related_forms":["delights","delighted","delightful"]}

{"headword":"delightful","explanation":"形容詞「令人愉快的」。常用於形容天氣、經驗或人。","entries":[{"sentence":"We had a <delightful> *time* chatting with the local residents during our short visit to the small village in the mountains.","translation":"我們在短暫造訪山區小村莊期間，與當地居民聊得非常愉快。","explanation":"delightful time 為常見搭配，意指愉快的時光。"},{"sentence":"The garden was filled with <delightful> *scents* of blooming flowers, making it the perfect place for an afternoon tea party.","translation":"花園裡充滿了盛開花朵的迷人香氣，使其成為舉辦下午茶派對的完美場所。","explanation":"形容詞「令人愉快的」。"}],"related_forms":["delight"]}

{"headword":"demand","explanation":"名詞「需求」；動詞「要求」。注意 demand that S + (should) + V 的用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <demand> for *electric* vehicles has increased significantly as more people become aware of the importance of environmental protection.","translation":"隨著越來越多人意識到環境保護的重要性，對電動車的需求顯著增加。","explanation":"demand for sth 為固定搭配，意指對某物的需求。"},{"sentence":"The workers <demanded> that the company *improve* working conditions and provide better benefits for all employees immediately.","translation":"工人們要求公司立即改善工作條件，並為所有員工提供更好的福利。","explanation":"動詞「要求」。注意子句中動詞用原形（省略 should）。"}],"related_forms":["demands","demanded","demanding"]}

{"headword":"demonstrate","explanation":"動詞「示範/證明/顯示」。常用於教學或科學實驗。","entries":[{"sentence":"The science teacher <demonstrated> how to *conduct* the experiment safely before letting the students try it on their own.","translation":"科學老師在讓學生自己嘗試之前，先示範了如何安全地進行實驗。","explanation":"動詞「示範」。"},{"sentence":"The recent survey results <demonstrate> a *clear* preference among young people for online shopping over traditional brick-and-mortar stores.","translation":"最近的調查結果顯示，年輕人明顯偏好網購勝過傳統實體店面。","explanation":"動詞「證明/顯示」。"}],"related_forms":["demonstrated","demonstrating","demonstration"]}

{"headword":"demonstration","explanation":"名詞「示範/證明/示威遊行」。注意其多義性。","entries":[{"sentence":"The software company gave a live <demonstration> of their new *application*, showing how it can simplify daily task management.","translation":"這家軟體公司對他們的新應用程式進行了現場演示，展示它如何簡化日常任務管理。","explanation":"名詞「示範」。"},{"sentence":"Thousands of people joined the <demonstration> in the city center to *protest* against the new policy proposed by the government.","translation":"成千上萬的人參加了市中心的示威遊行，以抗議政府提出的新政策。","explanation":"名詞「示威遊行」。"}],"related_forms":["demonstrations","demonstrate"]}

{"headword":"dense","explanation":"形容詞「稠密的/濃厚的」。常用於形容森林、煙霧或人口。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hikers found it difficult to navigate through the <dense> *forest* because the trees were growing so close together.","translation":"登山客發現很難在茂密的森林中穿行，因為樹木長得太密集了。","explanation":"形容詞「稠密的」。"},{"sentence":"A <dense> *fog* covered the entire valley this morning, causing several traffic accidents on the main highway leading to the city.","translation":"今天早上濃霧籠罩了整個山谷，導致通往城市的主要高速公路上發生了幾起交通事故。","explanation":"形容詞「濃厚的」。"}],"related_forms":["density"]}
