{"headword":"hose","explanation":"名詞「水管/軟管」；動詞「用水管沖洗」。注意與 house 的拼字區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The gardener used a long rubber <hose> *to* water the flowers and clean the dusty driveway in the backyard.","translation":"園丁用一條長橡膠水管澆花，並清理後院佈滿灰塵的車道。","explanation":"名詞用法，指澆花或消防用的軟管。"},{"sentence":"After the muddy soccer game, the coach <hosed> *down* the players' dirty uniforms to remove the thick mud.","translation":"在泥濘的足球賽後，教練用水管沖洗球員髒掉的制服，以去除厚厚的泥巴。","explanation":"動詞用法，hose down 指用水管沖洗。"}],"related_forms":["hoses","hosed","hosing"]}

{"headword":"household","explanation":"名詞「家庭/一家人」。常指共同居住的一群人。注意與 housework 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Every <household> *in* this small village has received a notice about the upcoming water supply interruption next week.","translation":"這個小村莊的每個家庭都收到了一份關於下週即將停水的通知。","explanation":"名詞用法，指住在一起的一家人或住戶。"},{"sentence":"Modern <household> *appliances*, such as washing machines and microwaves, have made our daily lives much more convenient.","translation":"現代的家用電器，例如洗衣機和微波爐，讓我們的日常生活方便多了。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指「家用的」。"}],"related_forms":["households"]}

{"headword":"housework","explanation":"名詞「家事/家務」。為不可數名詞，不可加 s。常用搭配 do housework。","entries":[{"sentence":"Sharing the <housework> *among* all family members is a great way to reduce the burden on parents.","translation":"在所有家庭成員間分擔家務是減輕父母負擔的好方法。","explanation":"不可數名詞，指清潔、烹飪等家務。"},{"sentence":"After a long day at work, she felt too tired to *do* any <housework> and decided to order some takeout instead.","translation":"在工作了一整天後，她感到太累而無法做任何家事，因此決定叫外送。","explanation":"固定搭配 do housework，表示做家事。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"humanity","explanation":"名詞「人類/人性/人道」。指全人類時常與 mankind 同義；指人道時常與 kindness 相關。","entries":[{"sentence":"The invention of the internet has changed the way <humanity> *communicates* and shares information across the globe.","translation":"網際網路的發明改變了全人類在全球溝通與分享資訊的方式。","explanation":"名詞用法，指全人類。"},{"sentence":"The doctor's act of kindness towards the poor patients showed the true meaning of <humanity> *in* the medical field.","translation":"醫生對貧困病人的善舉展現了醫療領域中人性的真正意義。","explanation":"名詞用法，指人性、仁慈或人道精神。"}],"related_forms":["human","humane"]}

{"headword":"humidity","explanation":"名詞「濕度」。常用 high/low humidity。注意與 humid (形容詞) 的拼字差異。","entries":[{"sentence":"The high <humidity> *in* the summer makes people feel very uncomfortable and sticky when they are outdoors.","translation":"夏日的高濕度讓人們在戶外時感到非常不舒服且黏膩。","explanation":"名詞用法，指空氣中的濕度。"},{"sentence":"Plants in the greenhouse grow faster because the *level* *of* <humidity> is kept constant throughout the year.","translation":"溫室裡的植物長得更快，因為濕度水平全年都保持恆定。","explanation":"指濕度水平，常搭配 level of。"}],"related_forms":["humid"]}

{"headword":"hurricane","explanation":"名詞「颶風」。指發生在大西洋或東北太平洋的強烈熱帶氣旋。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city government issued a warning as a powerful <hurricane> *approached* the coast, bringing heavy rain and strong winds.","translation":"當強烈颶風接近海岸時，市政府發布了警告，帶來了大雨和強風。","explanation":"名詞用法，指強烈熱帶氣旋。"},{"sentence":"Many houses were destroyed when the <hurricane> *hit* the small island last night with unexpected force.","translation":"當颶風昨晚以出乎意料的威力襲擊這座小島時，許多房屋被摧毀了。","explanation":"動詞 hit 常與 hurricane 搭配，表示颶風來襲。"}],"related_forms":["hurricanes"]}

{"headword":"hush","explanation":"名詞「寂靜/安靜」；動詞「使安靜」。常與 hush up (掩蓋) 或 hush-hush (秘密的) 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"A sudden <hush> *fell* *over* the classroom when the teacher walked in with the final exam papers.","translation":"當老師帶著期末考卷走進教室時，教室裡突然變得一片寂靜。","explanation":"名詞用法，指突然的安靜。"},{"sentence":"The mother tried to <hush> *the* crying baby by singing a soft lullaby in the middle of the night.","translation":"母親試著在半夜唱輕柔的搖籃曲來讓哭泣的嬰兒安靜下來。","explanation":"動詞用法，指使人安靜。"}],"related_forms":["hushed"]}

{"headword":"hydrogen","explanation":"名詞「氫」。化學元素，符號為 H。","entries":[{"sentence":"<Hydrogen> *is* the lightest and most abundant chemical element in the entire universe, often found in stars.","translation":"氫是整個宇宙中最輕且最豐富的化學元素，常在恆星中發現。","explanation":"名詞用法，指化學元素氫。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are researching how to use <hydrogen> *as* a clean energy source to replace traditional fossil fuels.","translation":"科學家正在研究如何將氫作為一種清潔能源來取代傳統化石燃料。","explanation":"指氫氣作為能源的應用。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"identical","explanation":"形容詞「完全相同的」。常用搭配 identical to/with。注意與 similar 的區別，identical 強調完全一樣。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two brothers are <identical> *twins*, so it is very difficult for their teachers to tell them apart.","translation":"這對兄弟是同卵雙胞胎，所以老師很難分辨他們。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指完全一樣的。"},{"sentence":"Her answer to the math problem was <identical> *to* mine, even though we used different methods to solve it.","translation":"她對這道數學題的答案與我的完全相同，儘管我們使用了不同的方法來解題。","explanation":"固定搭配 identical to，表示與...完全相同。"}],"related_forms":["identically"]}

{"headword":"identification","explanation":"名詞「身分證明/鑑定」。常簡稱為 ID。常用搭配 show/check identification。","entries":[{"sentence":"You must show your <identification> *at* the entrance before you are allowed to enter the high-security building.","translation":"在被允許進入這棟高安全性的建築物之前，你必須在入口處出示身分證明。","explanation":"名詞用法，指身分證件。"},{"sentence":"The police are working on the <identification> *of* the suspects based on the security camera footage.","translation":"警方正根據監視器畫面進行嫌疑人的身分鑑定工作。","explanation":"名詞用法，指鑑定或辨認的過程。"}],"related_forms":["identify"]}

{"headword":"identify","explanation":"動詞「辨認/鑑定」。常用搭配 identify A as B (將 A 辨認為 B)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is important to <identify> *the* main cause of the problem before trying to find a suitable solution.","translation":"在試圖找到合適的解決方案之前，找出問題的主要原因是很重要的。","explanation":"動詞用法，指找出或辨認出。"},{"sentence":"The witness was able to <identify> *the* thief *as* the man who was wearing a black jacket yesterday.","translation":"目擊者能夠辨認出小偷就是昨天穿著黑色夾克的那個男人。","explanation":"固定搭配 identify A as B，表示將 A 辨認為 B。"}],"related_forms":["identification","identical"]}

{"headword":"idiom","explanation":"名詞「慣用語/成語」。指特定語言中約定俗成的固定詞組。","entries":[{"sentence":"Learning a new <idiom> *every* day can help students improve their English writing and speaking skills significantly.","translation":"每天學習一個新慣用語可以幫助學生顯著提升他們的英文寫作與口說能力。","explanation":"名詞用法，指慣用語。"},{"sentence":"The English teacher explained the <idiom> *break* *a* leg, which is used to wish someone good luck before a performance.","translation":"英文老師解釋了「break a leg」這個慣用語，它是用來在表演前祝某人好運的。","explanation":"指特定的慣用語。"}],"related_forms":["idiomatic"]}

{"headword":"idle","explanation":"形容詞「閒置的/懶惰的」；動詞「虛度/閒置」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many factories remained <idle> *during* the economic crisis because there was not enough demand for their products.","translation":"許多工廠在經濟危機期間處於閒置狀態，因為對其產品的需求不足。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指閒置的。"},{"sentence":"He decided not to <idle> *away* his summer vacation and signed up for a computer programming course instead.","translation":"他決定不要虛度暑假，反而報名參加了電腦程式設計課程。","explanation":"動詞片語 idle away，指虛度光陰。"}],"related_forms":["idly"]}

{"headword":"idol","explanation":"名詞「偶像」。指受崇拜的對象，常指明星或崇拜的目標。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young singer has become a pop <idol> *for* many teenagers who admire her talent and fashion style.","translation":"這位年輕歌手已成為許多崇拜她才華與時尚風格的青少年的流行偶像。","explanation":"名詞用法，指偶像。"},{"sentence":"He has always considered his father to be his <idol> *because* of his hard work and honesty.","translation":"因為父親的勤奮與誠實，他一直將父親視為自己的偶像。","explanation":"指崇拜的對象。"}],"related_forms":["idols"]}

{"headword":"ignorance","explanation":"名詞「無知」。常用搭配 ignorance of sth。注意與 ignore (動詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"His <ignorance> *of* the local traffic laws led to a serious accident while he was driving in the city.","translation":"他對當地交通法規的無知，導致他在城裡開車時發生了嚴重的事故。","explanation":"名詞用法，指對某事的不了解。"},{"sentence":"The teacher told the students that <ignorance> *is* no excuse for breaking the school rules.","translation":"老師告訴學生，無知不能作為違反校規的藉口。","explanation":"指無知作為藉口。"}],"related_forms":["ignorant"]}

{"headword":"ignorant","explanation":"形容詞「無知的/不了解的」。常用搭配 be ignorant of sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people are <ignorant> *of* the potential dangers of using their smartphones while walking on the street.","translation":"許多人對於在街上走路時使用智慧型手機的潛在危險一無所知。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指對某事不了解。"},{"sentence":"It is unfair to criticize others when you are <ignorant> *about* the full story behind the situation.","translation":"當你對情況背後的全部事實一無所知時，批評他人是不公平的。","explanation":"指對情況不了解。"}],"related_forms":["ignorance"]}

{"headword":"illustrate","explanation":"動詞「說明/圖解」。常用於用例子來說明某事。注意與 illustration 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor used several real-life examples to <illustrate> *the* complex theory during the lecture this morning.","translation":"教授在今天早上的演講中用了幾個真實生活的例子來說明這個複雜的理論。","explanation":"動詞用法，指用例子說明。"},{"sentence":"The graph was created to <illustrate> *how* the population of the city has changed over the last ten years.","translation":"這張圖表是為了說明過去十年來該城市人口是如何變化的。","explanation":"指用圖表說明。"}],"related_forms":["illustration","illustrator"]}

{"headword":"illustration","explanation":"名詞「插圖/說明」。指書中的圖畫或用來解釋的例子。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children's book is filled with colorful <illustrations> *that* help young readers understand the story better.","translation":"這本童書充滿了色彩鮮豔的插圖，幫助小讀者更好地理解故事。","explanation":"名詞用法，指書中的插圖。"},{"sentence":"The teacher provided a clear <illustration> *of* the concept by drawing a simple diagram on the whiteboard.","translation":"老師在白板上畫了一個簡單的圖表，對這個概念提供了清晰的說明。","explanation":"指對概念的說明或圖解。"}],"related_forms":["illustrate"]}

{"headword":"imaginary","explanation":"形容詞「想像的/虛構的」。注意與 imaginative (有想像力的) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young child often talks to his <imaginary> *friend*, who he believes lives in the garden behind the house.","translation":"這個年幼的孩子常與他想像中的朋友說話，他相信那位朋友住在屋後的花園裡。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指想像出來的。"},{"sentence":"The characters in this novel are purely <imaginary>, but their emotions feel very real to the readers.","translation":"這部小說中的角色純粹是虛構的，但他們的情感對讀者來說感覺非常真實。","explanation":"指虛構的。"}],"related_forms":["imagine","imagination"]}

{"headword":"imaginative","explanation":"形容詞「富有想像力的」，常用於形容藝術作品、想法或人。注意與 imaginary (虛構的) 區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young artist came up with an <imaginative> *solution* to the complex design problem that had been bothering the team for weeks.","translation":"這位年輕藝術家為困擾團隊數週的複雜設計問題提出了一個富有想像力的解決方案。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾 solution。imaginative solution 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Children are often very <imaginative>, turning simple cardboard boxes into castles or spaceships during their playtime.","translation":"孩子們通常非常有想像力，在玩耍時會把簡單的紙箱變成城堡或太空船。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾 children。強調創造力。"}],"related_forms":["imagination","imagine"]}

{"headword":"imitate","explanation":"動詞「模仿」，指模仿某人的行為、聲音或風格。注意與 mimic (滑稽地模仿) 的細微差別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Young children often <imitate> their parents' *behavior* and speech patterns as they learn how to interact with the world around them.","translation":"年幼的孩子在學習如何與周圍世界互動時，經常模仿父母的行為和說話方式。","explanation":"動詞用法，模仿行為。imitate behavior 是常用搭配。"},{"sentence":"The actor was able to <imitate> the famous singer's *voice* so perfectly that the audience could not tell the difference.","translation":"這位演員能夠完美地模仿那位著名歌手的聲音，以至於觀眾無法分辨出差異。","explanation":"動詞用法，模仿聲音。imitate voice 是常見用法。"}],"related_forms":["imitation","imitator"]}

{"headword":"imitation","explanation":"名詞「模仿」或「仿製品」。作仿製品時，常指廉價的替代品。","entries":[{"sentence":"Learning a new language often requires a great deal of <imitation> *of* native speakers to master the correct pronunciation and intonation.","translation":"學習新語言通常需要大量模仿母語人士，才能掌握正確的發音和語調。","explanation":"名詞用法，指模仿的過程。imitation of sb 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"The bag she bought at the market was just an <imitation> *of* the expensive designer brand, costing only a fraction of the original price.","translation":"她在市場買的那個包只是昂貴設計師品牌的仿製品，價格只有原價的一小部分。","explanation":"名詞用法，指仿製品。imitation of sth 表示某物的仿製品。"}],"related_forms":["imitate","imitator"]}

{"headword":"immigrant","explanation":"名詞「移民」，指移入某國的人。注意與 emigrant (移出者) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city has a large population of <immigrant> *workers* who contribute significantly to the local economy and cultural diversity.","translation":"這座城市有大量移民工人，他們對當地經濟和文化多樣性做出了重大貢獻。","explanation":"名詞作為形容詞用法，修飾 workers。immigrant workers 是常見的社會議題詞彙。"},{"sentence":"Many an <immigrant> *arrives* in a new country with the hope of finding better job opportunities and a safer life for their family.","translation":"許多移民來到一個新國家，希望能為家人找到更好的工作機會和更安全的生活。","explanation":"名詞用法。強調移民的動機。"}],"related_forms":["immigrate","immigration"]}

{"headword":"immigrate","explanation":"動詞「移居(入)」，指從外國移入本國。注意介係詞 to 的搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thousands of people <immigrate> *to* this country every year to escape poverty and seek a better future for their children.","translation":"每年有成千上萬的人移居到這個國家，以逃離貧困並為他們的孩子尋求更好的未來。","explanation":"動詞用法。immigrate to + 地點 是固定用法。"},{"sentence":"After finishing his studies abroad, he decided to <immigrate> *to* Canada permanently to start his own business.","translation":"在國外完成學業後，他決定永久移居加拿大開始自己的事業。","explanation":"動詞用法。強調永久性的移居。"}],"related_forms":["immigrant","immigration"]}

{"headword":"immigration","explanation":"名詞「移民(現象/政策)」。指國家對外來人口的控管或整體移民趨勢。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is currently debating new <immigration> *policies* to better manage the flow of people entering the country for work.","translation":"政府目前正在辯論新的移民政策，以更好地管理進入該國工作的人流。","explanation":"名詞作為形容詞用法，修飾 policies。immigration policy 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Strict <immigration> *laws* are in place to ensure that everyone entering the country has the necessary legal documents.","translation":"嚴格的移民法規已到位，以確保每個進入該國的人都有必要的法律文件。","explanation":"名詞作為形容詞用法，修飾 laws。"}],"related_forms":["immigrant","immigrate"]}

{"headword":"impact","explanation":"名詞「影響/衝擊」，動詞「對...產生影響」。作動詞時，後面直接接受詞，不加介係詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new technology has had a significant <impact> *on* the way students learn and access information in the classroom.","translation":"這項新技術對學生在課堂上學習和獲取資訊的方式產生了重大影響。","explanation":"名詞用法。have an impact on 是核心片語，務必記住介係詞 on。"},{"sentence":"Climate change will likely <impact> *the* agricultural production of many countries, leading to higher food prices worldwide.","translation":"氣候變遷可能會影響許多國家的農業生產，導致全球食品價格上漲。","explanation":"動詞用法。直接接受詞 the agricultural production，不可加 on。"}],"related_forms":["impactful"]}

{"headword":"imply","explanation":"動詞「暗示/意味著」。指非直接說出，而是透過語氣或情境傳達訊息。","entries":[{"sentence":"His silence seemed to <imply> *that* he was not satisfied with the final results of the project, even though he said nothing.","translation":"他的沉默似乎暗示他對專案的最終結果不滿意，儘管他什麼也沒說。","explanation":"動詞用法。imply that 子句是常見結構。"},{"sentence":"The teacher's words did not directly criticize the students, but they did <imply> *a* need for more effort in their future studies.","translation":"老師的話並沒有直接批評學生，但確實暗示了他們未來的學習需要付出更多努力。","explanation":"動詞用法。imply a need for sth 表示暗示某種需求。"}],"related_forms":["implication"]}

{"headword":"impose","explanation":"動詞「強加/徵收」。常指強迫他人接受某事，或政府徵收稅款。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government decided to <impose> *new* taxes *on* luxury goods to increase national revenue and reduce social inequality.","translation":"政府決定對奢侈品徵收新稅，以增加國家收入並減少社會不平等。","explanation":"動詞用法。impose sth on sb/sth 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"Parents should not <impose> *their* own dreams *on* their children, but rather encourage them to pursue their own interests.","translation":"父母不應該將自己的夢想強加在孩子身上，而應該鼓勵他們追求自己的興趣。","explanation":"動詞用法。指強加想法，搭配介係詞 on。"}],"related_forms":["imposition"]}

{"headword":"impression","explanation":"名詞「印象」。常用搭配為 make/give/leave an impression on sb。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is important to make a good first <impression> *on* your interviewer when you are applying for a new job.","translation":"在申請新工作時，給面試官留下良好的第一印象非常重要。","explanation":"名詞用法。make an impression on sb 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"The beautiful scenery of the mountain left a lasting <impression> *on* all the tourists who visited the area last summer.","translation":"山區美麗的風景給去年夏天造訪該地區的所有遊客留下了深刻的印象。","explanation":"名詞用法。lasting impression 表示深刻的印象。"}],"related_forms":["impress","impressive"]}

{"headword":"incident","explanation":"名詞「事件/事故」。通常指發生的小插曲或突發事件，有時帶有負面含義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police are investigating the <incident> *that* occurred near the school gate yesterday afternoon to ensure student safety.","translation":"警方正在調查昨天下午發生在校門附近的事件，以確保學生的安全。","explanation":"名詞用法。指具體的事件。"},{"sentence":"There was a minor <incident> *in* the laboratory, but fortunately, no one was injured during the chemistry experiment.","translation":"實驗室發生了一起小事故，但幸運的是，在化學實驗過程中沒有人受傷。","explanation":"名詞用法。minor incident 表示小事故。"}],"related_forms":["incidental"]}

{"headword":"including","explanation":"介係詞「包含/包括」。用於列舉部分成員，後面直接接名詞或名詞片語。","entries":[{"sentence":"The price of the tour package covers everything, <including> *meals*, accommodation, and transportation to all the major tourist attractions.","translation":"旅遊套裝行程的價格包含一切，包括餐點、住宿以及前往所有主要旅遊景點的交通費用。","explanation":"介係詞用法。用於列舉項目。"},{"sentence":"Many people attended the meeting, <including> *the* school principal, several teachers, and representatives from the student council.","translation":"許多人參加了會議，包括校長、幾位老師以及學生會的代表。","explanation":"介係詞用法。列舉與會者。"}],"related_forms":["include"]}

{"headword":"incredible","explanation":"形容詞「極好的/難以置信的」。口語中常用來表示「非常棒」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely <incredible>, making the long and tiring climb worth every step.","translation":"從山頂看到的景色簡直令人難以置信，讓漫長而疲憊的攀登過程顯得一切都值得。","explanation":"形容詞用法。表示極好的。"},{"sentence":"It is <incredible> *that* he managed to finish such a difficult task in only two days without any help.","translation":"他竟然能在沒有任何幫助的情況下，在短短兩天內完成如此艱鉅的任務，真是令人難以置信。","explanation":"形容詞用法。incredible that 子句結構。"}],"related_forms":["incredibly"]}

{"headword":"indication","explanation":"名詞「跡象/徵兆」。指顯示某事正在發生或即將發生的線索。","entries":[{"sentence":"A sudden drop in temperature is often an <indication> *of* an approaching storm, so please prepare your rain gear.","translation":"氣溫突然下降通常是暴風雨即將來臨的跡象，所以請準備好您的雨具。","explanation":"名詞用法。indication of sth 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"The high number of applicants is a clear <indication> *that* the new scholarship program is very popular among students.","translation":"大量的申請人數清楚地顯示這項新的獎學金計畫在學生中非常受歡迎。","explanation":"名詞用法。indication that 子句結構。"}],"related_forms":["indicate"]}

{"headword":"infant","explanation":"名詞「嬰兒」。指非常年幼的孩子，通常指一歲以下。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <infant> *needs* constant care and attention from its parents to ensure it grows up healthy and happy.","translation":"嬰兒需要父母持續的照顧和關注，以確保他健康快樂地成長。","explanation":"名詞用法。"},{"sentence":"During the flight, the <infant> *cried* loudly because of the changes in air pressure, but the mother managed to calm him down.","translation":"飛行期間，嬰兒因為氣壓變化而大聲哭鬧，但母親成功地讓他平靜下來。","explanation":"名詞用法。"}],"related_forms":["infancy"]}

{"headword":"infection","explanation":"名詞「感染」。指細菌或病毒引起的疾病。","entries":[{"sentence":"To prevent a serious <infection>, you should always clean the wound thoroughly and cover it with a sterile bandage.","translation":"為了預防嚴重的感染，你應該隨時徹底清潔傷口並用無菌繃帶覆蓋。","explanation":"名詞用法。prevent an infection 是常用搭配。"},{"sentence":"The doctor prescribed some medicine to treat the ear <infection> that had been causing him pain for several days.","translation":"醫生開了一些藥來治療已經讓他疼痛好幾天的耳部感染。","explanation":"名詞用法。ear infection 是常見的健康詞彙。"}],"related_forms":["infect"]}

{"headword":"inflation","explanation":"名詞「通貨膨脹」。指物價持續上漲，貨幣購買力下降的經濟現象。","entries":[{"sentence":"Rising <inflation> *has* made it difficult for many families to afford basic daily necessities like food and electricity.","translation":"通貨膨脹上漲使得許多家庭難以負擔食物和電力等基本日常必需品。","explanation":"名詞用法。常與 rising, high 等形容詞搭配。"},{"sentence":"The central bank is taking measures to control <inflation> *and* keep the economy stable for the long term.","translation":"中央銀行正在採取措施控制通貨膨脹，並保持經濟長期穩定。","explanation":"名詞用法。control inflation 是常見的經濟搭配。"}],"related_forms":["inflate"]}

{"headword":"influential","explanation":"形容詞「有影響力的」。常用於形容人、組織或想法。","entries":[{"sentence":"She is one of the most <influential> *figures* in the field of science, having made many important discoveries in her career.","translation":"她是科學領域最有影響力的人物之一，在她的職業生涯中做出了許多重要的發現。","explanation":"形容詞用法。influential figures 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The book had an <influential> *effect* on his thinking, changing his perspective on life and his future goals.","translation":"這本書對他的思想產生了深遠的影響，改變了他對生活和未來目標的看法。","explanation":"形容詞用法。修飾 effect。"}],"related_forms":["influence"]}

{"headword":"informative","explanation":"形容詞「資訊豐富的/有益的」。常用於形容書籍、演講或網站。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lecture was very <informative>, providing us with a lot of useful information about the history of the local area.","translation":"那場演講資訊非常豐富，為我們提供了許多關於當地歷史的有用資訊。","explanation":"形容詞用法。informative lecture 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"I found the documentary to be quite <informative>, as it explained the complex process of recycling in a simple way.","translation":"我覺得那部紀錄片資訊量很大，因為它用簡單的方式解釋了複雜的回收過程。","explanation":"形容詞用法。強調內容豐富。"}],"related_forms":["inform"]}

{"headword":"ingredient","explanation":"名詞「成分/原料」。常用於烹飪或製作產品的原料。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before you start cooking, make sure you have all the necessary <ingredients> *for* the recipe on the kitchen counter.","translation":"在開始烹飪之前，請確保廚房檯面上有食譜所需的所有原料。","explanation":"名詞用法。ingredients for sth 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"Check the list of <ingredients> *on* the back of the package to see if there is anything you might be allergic to.","translation":"檢查包裝背面的成分表，看看是否有你可能過敏的東西。","explanation":"名詞用法。list of ingredients 是常見用法。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"initial","explanation":"形容詞「最初的」；名詞「首字母」。注意 initial 常用於描述過程的開端。常見搭配：initial stage, initial reaction。","entries":[{"sentence":"My <initial> *reaction* to the news was shock, but I soon realized that it was actually a great opportunity for me to grow.","translation":"我對這則新聞的最初反應是震驚，但我很快意識到這其實是我成長的絕佳機會。","explanation":"形容詞「最初的」。常搭配 reaction, stage, phase 等名詞。"},{"sentence":"The students were asked to write their <initials> *on* the top right corner of the exam paper before they started answering the questions.","translation":"學生在開始作答前，被要求在考卷的右上角寫上他們的名字縮寫。","explanation":"名詞「姓名的首字母」。通常指名字的縮寫，而非全名。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to <initialize> the new software system after the <initial> *testing* phase was completed successfully last week.","translation":"在最初的測試階段於上週成功完成後，公司決定啟動新的軟體系統。","explanation":"動詞「初始化」。此處強調系統啟動的過程。"}],"related_forms":["initially","initialize"]}

{"headword":"injure","explanation":"動詞「傷害/使受傷」。注意與 wound (多指武器造成的傷口) 的區別。常見用法：be injured in an accident。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young athlete was <injured> *in* a car accident, which unfortunately ended his dream of participating in the Olympic Games this year.","translation":"這位年輕運動員在一場車禍中受傷，不幸終結了他今年參加奧運的夢想。","explanation":"動詞被動態「受傷」。常搭配 in an accident/a fall。"},{"sentence":"She did not mean to <injure> his *feelings* when she told him the truth about his performance in the music competition.","translation":"當她告訴他關於他在音樂比賽中表現的真相時，她並非有意要傷害他的感情。","explanation":"動詞「傷害（感情/自尊）」。常用搭配 injure one's feelings/pride。"},{"sentence":"The safety equipment is designed to prevent workers from being <injured> *during* the construction process at the factory site.","translation":"這些安全設備旨在防止工人在工廠現場的施工過程中受傷。","explanation":"動詞「使受傷」。強調防止意外發生。"}],"related_forms":["injury","injured"]}

{"headword":"innocence","explanation":"名詞「清白/無罪」或「天真」。常見搭配：prove one's innocence (證明清白)；loss of innocence (失去純真)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lawyer worked hard to *prove* his client's <innocence> by presenting new evidence to the judge during the trial yesterday.","translation":"律師努力工作，透過在昨天的審判中向法官提出新證據來證明他當事人的清白。","explanation":"名詞「清白」。常用搭配 prove/establish one's innocence。"},{"sentence":"The child's face was full of <innocence> as she watched the colorful butterflies flying in the garden on a sunny afternoon.","translation":"在一個晴朗的午後，當小女孩看著彩色蝴蝶在花園中飛舞時，她的臉上充滿了天真。","explanation":"名詞「天真/純真」。指小孩特有的純潔特質。"},{"sentence":"Despite the strong accusations from the public, the politician maintained his <innocence> throughout the entire investigation process.","translation":"儘管來自公眾的強烈指控，那位政治人物在整個調查過程中始終堅持他的清白。","explanation":"名詞「清白」。常用 maintain one's innocence。"}],"related_forms":["innocent"]}

{"headword":"input","explanation":"名詞「投入/輸入」；動詞「輸入」。在電腦或商業語境中極為常見。注意 input 為不可數名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The manager welcomed any <input> *from* the team members regarding the new marketing strategy for the upcoming holiday season.","translation":"經理歡迎團隊成員針對即將到來的假日季節的新行銷策略提出任何意見。","explanation":"名詞「意見/投入」。指提供給某事的建議或資訊。"},{"sentence":"Please <input> your *password* into the system so that you can access the private files stored on the company server.","translation":"請將您的密碼輸入系統，以便您可以存取儲存在公司伺服器上的私人檔案。","explanation":"動詞「輸入（資料）」。常與 data, password, information 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The success of this project requires significant <input> *of* time and effort from every employee in the department.","translation":"這個專案的成功需要部門內每一位員工投入大量的時間與精力。","explanation":"名詞「投入」。指資源或心力的付出。"}],"related_forms":["inputs"]}

{"headword":"insert","explanation":"動詞「插入/放入」。常見搭配：insert A into B。名詞為 insert (插入物/夾頁)。","entries":[{"sentence":"You need to <insert> the *key* *into* the lock and turn it slowly to open the heavy wooden door of the old house.","translation":"你需要把鑰匙插入鎖中並慢慢轉動，才能打開那棟老房子的厚重木門。","explanation":"動詞「插入」。常用搭配 insert into。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to <insert> a *picture* *into* their reports to make the content more interesting and easier to understand.","translation":"老師要求學生在報告中插入一張圖片，使內容更有趣且更容易理解。","explanation":"動詞「插入（內容）」。指在文件或報告中加入元素。"},{"sentence":"Before you start the machine, please make sure to <insert> the *battery* correctly according to the user manual.","translation":"在啟動機器之前，請務必根據使用手冊正確地放入電池。","explanation":"動詞「放入/裝入」。指將零件安裝到設備中。"}],"related_forms":["insertion"]}

{"headword":"inspection","explanation":"名詞「檢查/視察」。常用搭配：under inspection, carry out an inspection。動詞為 inspect。","entries":[{"sentence":"The factory undergoes a *safety* <inspection> every six months to ensure that all equipment is working properly and safely.","translation":"該工廠每六個月進行一次安全檢查，以確保所有設備運作正常且安全。","explanation":"名詞「檢查」。常用搭配 safety inspection。"},{"sentence":"Upon close <inspection>, the expert found that the painting was not an original work by the famous artist.","translation":"經過仔細檢查，專家發現這幅畫並非那位著名藝術家的原創作品。","explanation":"名詞「檢查/審視」。常用搭配 upon close inspection (經仔細檢查後)。"},{"sentence":"The principal made a *surprise* <inspection> of the classrooms to check if the students were studying quietly and effectively.","translation":"校長對教室進行了突擊檢查，以查看學生是否安靜且有效地在學習。","explanation":"名詞「視察/檢查」。常用搭配 surprise inspection (突擊檢查)。"}],"related_forms":["inspect","inspector"]}

{"headword":"inspiration","explanation":"名詞「靈感/啟發」。常用搭配：be a source of inspiration, find inspiration。注意與 inspire 的詞性區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The beautiful scenery of the mountains served as a great *source* *of* <inspiration> for the young painter's latest landscape work.","translation":"山區美麗的風景成為了這位年輕畫家最新風景畫作的靈感來源。","explanation":"名詞「靈感」。常用搭配 source of inspiration。"},{"sentence":"Many young athletes look to their coaches for <inspiration> when they face difficult challenges during their training sessions.","translation":"許多年輕運動員在訓練過程中遇到困難挑戰時，會向教練尋求啟發。","explanation":"名詞「啟發/鼓舞」。指激勵人心的人或事物。"},{"sentence":"She found <inspiration> *in* the stories of successful women who overcame various obstacles to achieve their dreams in life.","translation":"她從那些克服各種障礙並實現人生夢想的成功女性故事中找到了靈感。","explanation":"名詞「靈感」。常用搭配 find inspiration in sth。"}],"related_forms":["inspire","inspirational"]}

{"headword":"inspire","explanation":"動詞「啟發/激勵」。常用句型：inspire sb to do sth。注意其被動用法 be inspired by。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher's passion for science <inspired> the students *to* study harder and pursue their own dreams in the future.","translation":"老師對科學的熱情激勵了學生們更加努力學習，並在未來追求自己的夢想。","explanation":"動詞「激勵」。常用句型 inspire sb to do sth。"},{"sentence":"The young musician was <inspired> *by* the classical music he heard in the concert hall, so he began to write his own songs.","translation":"這位年輕音樂家受到他在音樂廳聽到的古典音樂所啟發，因此他開始創作自己的歌曲。","explanation":"動詞被動態「受到啟發」。常用搭配 be inspired by。"},{"sentence":"Her dedication to helping the poor has <inspired> many people *in* the community to volunteer their time for charity work.","translation":"她致力於幫助窮人的奉獻精神，激勵了社區中的許多人貢獻時間從事慈善工作。","explanation":"動詞「激勵」。指透過行為影響他人。"}],"related_forms":["inspiration","inspirational"]}

{"headword":"install","explanation":"動詞「安裝/設置」。常用於軟體、設備或家具。名詞為 installation。","entries":[{"sentence":"The technician will come tomorrow to <install> the *new* *software* on your computer so that you can complete your project on time.","translation":"技術人員明天會過來在你的電腦上安裝新軟體，這樣你就能準時完成你的專案。","explanation":"動詞「安裝（軟體）」。"},{"sentence":"We decided to <install> a *security* *system* in our house to protect our family and property from potential burglars.","translation":"我們決定在屋內安裝安全系統，以保護我們的家人和財產免受潛在竊賊的侵害。","explanation":"動詞「安裝（設備）」。"},{"sentence":"The city government plans to <install> more *street* *lights* in the park to make it safer for people to walk at night.","translation":"市政府計畫在公園內安裝更多路燈，讓民眾在晚上行走時更安全。","explanation":"動詞「設置/安裝」。"}],"related_forms":["installation"]}

{"headword":"instinct","explanation":"名詞「本能/直覺」。常用搭配：by instinct, follow one's instinct。","entries":[{"sentence":"Animals often rely on their natural <instinct> to find food and protect themselves from danger in the wild environment.","translation":"動物通常依靠牠們的自然本能來尋找食物，並在野外環境中保護自己免受危險。","explanation":"名詞「本能」。指動物天生的生存能力。"},{"sentence":"I had a strong <instinct> that something was wrong, so I decided to call my friend to check if she was okay.","translation":"我有種強烈的直覺覺得有些不對勁，所以我決定打電話給我的朋友確認她是否還好。","explanation":"名詞「直覺」。"},{"sentence":"Sometimes it is better to *follow* your <instinct> when you are making a difficult decision rather than overthinking every possible outcome.","translation":"當你在做困難的決定時，有時聽從你的直覺會比過度思考每一個可能的結果更好。","explanation":"名詞「直覺」。常用搭配 follow one's instinct。"}],"related_forms":["instinctive"]}

{"headword":"instruct","explanation":"動詞「指導/指示」。常用句型：instruct sb to do sth。名詞為 instruction。","entries":[{"sentence":"The coach <instructed> the *players* *to* practice their passing skills for another hour before the game starts tomorrow evening.","translation":"教練指示球員們在明天傍晚比賽開始前，再練習傳球技巧一個小時。","explanation":"動詞「指示」。常用句型 instruct sb to do sth。"},{"sentence":"The manual clearly <instructs> users *on* how to assemble the furniture without needing any professional tools or assistance.","translation":"手冊清楚地指導使用者如何組裝家具，而不需要任何專業工具或協助。","explanation":"動詞「指導/說明」。常用搭配 instruct on how to。"},{"sentence":"The doctor <instructed> her *to* take the medicine twice a day after meals to help her recover from the bad cold.","translation":"醫生指示她每天飯後服用兩次藥物，以幫助她從重感冒中恢復。","explanation":"動詞「指示/囑咐」。"}],"related_forms":["instruction","instructor"]}

{"headword":"instructor","explanation":"名詞「教練/講師」。指教授特定技能的人。注意與 teacher 的區別，instructor 較強調技術傳授。","entries":[{"sentence":"The yoga <instructor> showed us the correct way to breathe and stretch during our first class at the community center.","translation":"瑜伽教練在我們社區中心的第一次課程中，向我們展示了正確的呼吸和伸展方式。","explanation":"名詞「教練/導師」。"},{"sentence":"My driving <instructor> was very patient and helped me pass the road test on my very first attempt last month.","translation":"我的駕訓教練非常有耐心，幫助我在上個月第一次嘗試時就通過了路考。","explanation":"名詞「教練」。"},{"sentence":"The fitness <instructor> designed a special workout plan for beginners to help them build their strength and improve their health.","translation":"健身教練為初學者設計了一套特殊的運動計畫，幫助他們增強力量並改善健康。","explanation":"名詞「健身教練」。"}],"related_forms":["instruct","instruction"]}

{"headword":"insult","explanation":"動詞/名詞「侮辱」。注意重音位置：名詞重音在第一音節，動詞重音在第二音節。","entries":[{"sentence":"He felt deeply <insulted> *by* the rude comments made by his coworker during the meeting this afternoon.","translation":"他對今天下午會議中同事所說的粗魯言論感到深受侮辱。","explanation":"動詞被動態「被侮辱」。常用搭配 feel insulted by。"},{"sentence":"It is never a good idea to *throw* an <insult> *at* someone just because you disagree with their opinion on a specific topic.","translation":"僅僅因為你不同意某人對特定主題的看法就對他進行侮辱，這絕不是個好主意。","explanation":"名詞「侮辱」。常用搭配 throw an insult at sb。"},{"sentence":"The actor decided to leave the interview after the reporter asked him a question that he considered to be a personal <insult>.","translation":"那位演員在記者問了他一個他認為是人身侮辱的問題後，決定離開採訪。","explanation":"名詞「侮辱」。"}],"related_forms":["insulting"]}

{"headword":"insurance","explanation":"名詞「保險」。常用搭配：health insurance, car insurance, take out insurance。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is important to *have* *health* <insurance> so that you can cover the costs of medical treatment if you get sick.","translation":"擁有健康保險很重要，這樣如果你生病了，你才能支付醫療費用。","explanation":"名詞「保險」。常用搭配 health insurance。"},{"sentence":"Before you travel abroad, you should *take* *out* travel <insurance> to protect yourself against lost luggage or unexpected medical expenses.","translation":"在出國旅遊之前，你應該購買旅遊保險，以保護自己免受行李遺失或意外醫療費用的損失。","explanation":"名詞「保險」。常用搭配 take out insurance (購買保險)。"},{"sentence":"The car <insurance> company paid for the repairs after the accident, which saved the driver a lot of money.","translation":"汽車保險公司在事故後支付了維修費用，這為駕駛省下了很多錢。","explanation":"名詞「保險」。"}],"related_forms":["insure"]}

{"headword":"intellectual","explanation":"形容詞「智力的/知識份子的」；名詞「知識份子」。強調與思考、學習相關。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university provides many <intellectual> *activities* for students, such as book clubs and debates, to encourage critical thinking.","translation":"大學為學生提供許多智力活動，例如讀書會和辯論，以鼓勵批判性思考。","explanation":"形容詞「智力的」。"},{"sentence":"She is known as a brilliant <intellectual> who has written many books about history and philosophy over the past decade.","translation":"她被譽為一位才華橫溢的知識份子，在過去十年中寫了許多關於歷史和哲學的書。","explanation":"名詞「知識份子」。"},{"sentence":"Engaging in <intellectual> *discussions* with friends can help you broaden your horizons and see the world from different perspectives.","translation":"與朋友進行知識性的討論可以幫助你開闊視野，並從不同的角度看待世界。","explanation":"形容詞「智力的/知識性的」。"}],"related_forms":["intelligence"]}

{"headword":"intelligence","explanation":"名詞「智力/聰明才智」。注意 intelligence 為不可數名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young boy showed great <intelligence> by solving the complex math problem in just a few minutes during the competition.","translation":"這個小男孩在比賽中僅用了幾分鐘就解決了複雜的數學問題，展現了極高的智力。","explanation":"名詞「智力」。"},{"sentence":"Artificial <intelligence> is changing the way we live and work by helping us process information much faster than ever before.","translation":"人工智慧正在改變我們的生活和工作方式，透過幫助我們比以往更快地處理資訊。","explanation":"名詞「智慧」。常用搭配 artificial intelligence (AI)。"},{"sentence":"It takes both hard work and <intelligence> to achieve long-term success in such a competitive business environment.","translation":"在如此競爭的商業環境中，取得長期成功需要努力工作和聰明才智。","explanation":"名詞「聰明才智」。"}],"related_forms":["intelligent"]}

{"headword":"intend","explanation":"動詞「打算/計畫」。常用句型：intend to do sth。注意與 intention 的詞性區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"I <intend> *to* finish reading this novel by the end of the week because I want to start a new one on Monday.","translation":"我打算在週末前讀完這本小說，因為我想在週一開始讀一本新的。","explanation":"動詞「打算」。常用句型 intend to do sth。"},{"sentence":"The company does not <intend> *to* increase the prices of its products despite the rising costs of raw materials.","translation":"儘管原物料成本上漲，公司並不打算調高其產品價格。","explanation":"動詞「打算」。"},{"sentence":"She <intended> *to* arrive at the station early, but she missed the bus because of the heavy traffic in the city center.","translation":"她本來打算早點到達車站，但因為市中心嚴重的交通堵塞而錯過了公車。","explanation":"動詞「打算」。常用過去式表達原本的計畫。"}],"related_forms":["intention","intended"]}

{"headword":"intense","explanation":"形容詞「強烈的/激烈的」。常用於描述情緒、競爭或天氣。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athletes felt <intense> *pressure* before the final race, as they all wanted to win the gold medal for their country.","translation":"運動員們在決賽前感到強烈的壓力，因為他們都想為國家贏得金牌。","explanation":"形容詞「強烈的」。常用搭配 intense pressure。"},{"sentence":"There was <intense> *competition* among the students to get the only scholarship available for the summer exchange program.","translation":"學生之間為了爭取夏季交換計畫中唯一的一個獎學金，展開了激烈的競爭。","explanation":"形容詞「激烈的」。常用搭配 intense competition。"},{"sentence":"The <intense> *heat* of the summer sun made it difficult for the workers to continue their construction work in the afternoon.","translation":"夏日陽光的強烈熱度使得工人們難以在下午繼續他們的施工工作。","explanation":"形容詞「強烈的」。常用搭配 intense heat。"}],"related_forms":["intensity","intensify"]}

{"headword":"intensity","explanation":"名詞「強度/強烈」。常用於描述光線、聲音或情緒的程度。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <intensity> *of* the storm increased as it moved closer to the coast, causing heavy rain and strong winds.","translation":"當暴風雨向海岸移動時，其強度增加，導致大雨和強風。","explanation":"名詞「強度」。常用搭配 intensity of sth。"},{"sentence":"The athletes were surprised by the <intensity> *of* the training program, which required them to exercise for several hours every day.","translation":"運動員們對訓練計畫的強度感到驚訝，這要求他們每天運動好幾個小時。","explanation":"名詞「強度」。"},{"sentence":"You can adjust the <intensity> *of* the light by turning the knob on the side of the desk lamp.","translation":"你可以透過轉動檯燈側面的旋鈕來調整燈光的強度。","explanation":"名詞「強度」。常用於調節設備。"}],"related_forms":["intense","intensify"]}

{"headword":"intensive","explanation":"形容詞「密集的/加強的」。常用搭配：intensive course, intensive care。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to sign up for an <intensive> *English* *course* to improve her speaking skills before traveling to the UK.","translation":"她決定報名參加密集英語課程，以在前往英國旅遊前提升她的口說技巧。","explanation":"形容詞「密集的」。常用搭配 intensive course。"},{"sentence":"The patient was moved to the <intensive> *care* unit after the surgery because he needed constant monitoring by the doctors.","translation":"病人在手術後被轉移到加護病房，因為他需要醫生的持續監護。","explanation":"形容詞「加強的」。常用搭配 intensive care unit (ICU)。"},{"sentence":"The <intensive> *farming* methods used on this land have helped the farmers produce more crops than they did in the past.","translation":"在這片土地上使用的集約化農業耕作方式，幫助農民生產了比過去更多的農作物。","explanation":"形容詞「集約的/密集的」。"}],"related_forms":["intense","intensity"]}

{"headword":"kettle","explanation":"指用於燒水的「水壺」。常見搭配為 boil the kettle (燒水)。注意與 teapot (茶壺) 的區別，kettle 通常用於加熱，而 teapot 用於泡茶。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please *boil* the <kettle> so that we can make some hot tea for our guests who just arrived.","translation":"請燒開水壺，好讓我們能為剛抵達的客人泡些熱茶。","explanation":"boil the kettle 是常見的固定搭配，指燒開水。"},{"sentence":"The electric <kettle> automatically turns off when the water reaches the boiling point to save energy and ensure safety.","translation":"當水達到沸點時，電水壺會自動關閉，以節省能源並確保安全。","explanation":"描述電器功能，electric kettle 為常見用法。"},{"sentence":"She filled the <kettle> with fresh water and placed it on the stove to prepare for her morning coffee.","translation":"她將水壺裝滿清水並放在爐子上，準備沖泡她的晨間咖啡。","explanation":"描述使用水壺的動作。"}],"related_forms":["kettles"]}

{"headword":"kneel","explanation":"動詞「跪下」。過去式與過去分詞為 knelt 或 kneeled。常用片語為 kneel down (跪下)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The knight <knelt> *before* the king to show his loyalty and respect during the grand ceremony at the palace.","translation":"騎士在宮殿的盛大儀式中，跪在國王面前以展現他的忠誠與敬意。","explanation":"kneel before sb 為常見用法，表示在某人面前下跪。"},{"sentence":"You should *kneel* <down> on the soft mat while doing these yoga exercises to protect your knees from injury.","translation":"做這些瑜珈動作時，你應該跪在軟墊上以保護膝蓋不受傷。","explanation":"kneel down 強調跪下的動作。"},{"sentence":"She <knelt> *on* the floor to search for the small earring that she had accidentally dropped while cleaning the room.","translation":"她跪在地板上搜尋她在打掃房間時不小心掉落的小耳環。","explanation":"kneel on the floor 描述跪下的位置。"}],"related_forms":["knelt","kneeled"]}

{"headword":"knob","explanation":"名詞「門把」、「旋鈕」。指圓形的把手或控制開關的旋鈕。","entries":[{"sentence":"He *turned* the door <knob> slowly to enter the room without making any noise, hoping to surprise his friends inside.","translation":"他緩緩轉動門把進入房間，沒有發出任何聲音，希望能給裡面的朋友一個驚喜。","explanation":"turn the door knob 是常見的動作搭配。"},{"sentence":"Please *adjust* the volume <knob> on the radio if the music is too loud for people studying in the library.","translation":"如果音樂對在圖書館讀書的人來說太大聲，請調整收音機上的音量旋鈕。","explanation":"adjust the knob 指調整旋鈕。"},{"sentence":"The antique dresser has beautiful brass <knobs> that make it look very elegant and valuable in the bedroom.","translation":"這座古董梳妝台有美麗的黃銅旋鈕，讓它在臥室裡看起來非常優雅且珍貴。","explanation":"描述家具上的旋鈕。"}],"related_forms":["knobs"]}

{"headword":"labor","explanation":"名詞「勞動、勞工、分娩」；動詞「努力工作」。美式拼法為 labor，英式為 labour。常見搭配：manual labor (體力勞動)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The construction project requires a lot of *manual* <labor>, so the company decided to hire more workers from the local area.","translation":"這項營建工程需要大量的體力勞動，因此公司決定從當地聘請更多工人。","explanation":"manual labor 為固定搭配，指體力勞動。"},{"sentence":"After hours of hard <labor> in the garden, he finally finished planting all the flowers and felt very satisfied.","translation":"在花園裡辛苦勞動了幾個小時後，他終於種完了所有的花，並感到非常滿足。","explanation":"hard labor 指辛苦的勞動工作。"},{"sentence":"The government is trying to *protect* <labor> rights to ensure that all employees are treated fairly in the workplace.","translation":"政府正致力於保護勞工權益，以確保所有員工在工作場所受到公平對待。","explanation":"labor rights 指勞工權益。"}],"related_forms":["labors","labored","laboring"]}

{"headword":"laboratory","explanation":"名詞「實驗室」，口語常簡稱為 lab。注意重音位置在第一音節。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students *conducted* an <experiment> *in* the school <laboratory> to learn more about chemical reactions and safety rules.","translation":"學生們在學校實驗室進行實驗，以學習更多關於化學反應與安全規則的知識。","explanation":"conduct an experiment in the laboratory 是常見的學術搭配。"},{"sentence":"Researchers *work* *in* the <laboratory> every day to develop new medicines that can help cure serious illnesses.","translation":"研究人員每天在實驗室工作，以研發能幫助治癒嚴重疾病的新藥。","explanation":"work in the laboratory 描述研究人員的工作場域。"},{"sentence":"Before entering the <laboratory>, you must *wear* a *protective* coat and safety glasses to prevent any accidents.","translation":"進入實驗室前，你必須穿上防護衣並戴上安全眼鏡，以防止任何意外發生。","explanation":"描述進入實驗室的規定。"}],"related_forms":["laboratories","lab"]}

{"headword":"lag","explanation":"動詞「落後、延遲」；名詞「延遲、落後」。常見搭配：lag behind (落後於)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Some small companies <lag> *behind* larger ones in adopting new technology because they lack sufficient funds for investment.","translation":"一些小型公司在採用新技術方面落後於大型公司，因為他們缺乏足夠的投資資金。","explanation":"lag behind sth 是常見的片語，表示在某方面落後。"},{"sentence":"There was a slight time <lag> during the video call, making it difficult for us to hear each other clearly.","translation":"視訊通話期間有一點時間延遲，導致我們很難聽清楚對方的聲音。","explanation":"time lag 指時間上的延遲。"},{"sentence":"The student <lagged> *behind* his classmates in math, so he decided to attend extra classes after school.","translation":"那名學生在數學上落後於同學，因此他決定放學後去參加額外的課程。","explanation":"lag behind 描述學習進度落後。"}],"related_forms":["lagged","lagging","lags"]}

{"headword":"landmark","explanation":"名詞「地標、里程碑」。指明顯的標誌物，或在歷史上具有重要意義的事件。","entries":[{"sentence":"The Taipei 101 building is a famous <landmark> that attracts thousands of tourists from all over the world every year.","translation":"台北101大樓是一個著名的地標，每年吸引成千上萬來自世界各地的遊客。","explanation":"描述著名的建築地標。"},{"sentence":"The invention of the internet was a <landmark> in human history, changing the way we communicate and share information.","translation":"網際網路的發明是人類歷史上的一個里程碑，改變了我們溝通與分享資訊的方式。","explanation":"landmark 亦可引申為「里程碑/重大事件」。"},{"sentence":"We used the old church as a <landmark> to help us find our way back to the hotel in the city center.","translation":"我們將那座古老的教堂作為地標，幫助我們找到回到市中心飯店的路。","explanation":"使用地標來辨識方向。"}],"related_forms":["landmarks"]}

{"headword":"landscape","explanation":"名詞「風景、景觀」；動詞「美化景觀」。指大片的土地或自然景色。","entries":[{"sentence":"The beautiful <landscape> of the countryside, with its green hills and clear rivers, made us feel very relaxed.","translation":"鄉村美麗的風景，有著翠綠的山丘與清澈的河流，讓我們感到非常放鬆。","explanation":"landscape 指自然景觀。"},{"sentence":"They hired a professional to <landscape> the garden, adding many new plants and a small pond to the area.","translation":"他們聘請了一位專家來美化花園，在該區域增加了許多新植物與一個小池塘。","explanation":"動詞用法，指園藝美化。"},{"sentence":"Looking out from the mountain top, we could see a wide <landscape> that stretched as far as the eye could see.","translation":"從山頂望去，我們可以看到一片廣闊的風景，延伸至視線所及之處。","explanation":"描述廣闊的視野景觀。"}],"related_forms":["landscapes","landscaped","landscaping"]}

{"headword":"largely","explanation":"副詞「主要地、很大程度上」。常用於修飾動詞或形容詞，表示某事的主要原因或程度。","entries":[{"sentence":"The success of the new product was <largely> *due* *to* the hard work of the entire marketing and design team.","translation":"新產品的成功很大程度上歸功於整個行銷與設計團隊的努力工作。","explanation":"largely due to 是常見的用法，表示主要原因。"},{"sentence":"The problem has been <largely> *solved* after the engineers found the main cause of the system failure yesterday.","translation":"在工程師昨天找到系統故障的主因後，這個問題已在很大程度上被解決了。","explanation":"largely solved 表示程度上的解決。"},{"sentence":"Our decision to move to the city was <largely> *based* *on* the need to be closer to our workplaces.","translation":"我們決定搬到城市，很大程度上是基於需要離工作地點更近的需求。","explanation":"largely based on 表示決策的主要依據。"}],"related_forms":["large"]}

{"headword":"launch","explanation":"動詞「發射、發起、推出」；名詞「發射、發表會」。常用於 launch a product (推出產品) 或 launch a campaign (發起活動)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company plans to <launch> a *new* *product* next month, and they have already started advertising it on social media.","translation":"公司計畫下個月推出一項新產品，並且已經開始在社群媒體上為其打廣告。","explanation":"launch a product 是常見的商業搭配。"},{"sentence":"The space agency will <launch> a *rocket* into space to explore more about the planets in our solar system.","translation":"太空總署將發射一枚火箭進入太空，以探索更多關於我們太陽系中行星的知識。","explanation":"launch a rocket 指發射火箭。"},{"sentence":"They decided to <launch> a *campaign* to raise money for the local animal shelter before the winter arrives.","translation":"他們決定在冬天來臨前發起一項活動，為當地的動物收容所募款。","explanation":"launch a campaign 指發起活動。"}],"related_forms":["launches","launched","launching"]}

{"headword":"lawful","explanation":"形容詞「合法的」。與 legal 同義，但 lawful 更強調符合法律規範或道德標準。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is a <lawful> *requirement* for all citizens to pay their taxes on time to support the government's public services.","translation":"所有公民按時繳稅以支持政府的公共服務是一項合法的要求。","explanation":"lawful requirement 指法律上的要求。"},{"sentence":"The police confirmed that the protest was <lawful> and that the participants had followed all the necessary rules.","translation":"警方證實該抗議活動是合法的，且參與者遵守了所有必要的規則。","explanation":"描述活動的合法性。"},{"sentence":"You should ensure that your business activities are <lawful> to avoid any legal trouble in the future.","translation":"你應該確保你的商業活動是合法的，以避免未來發生任何法律問題。","explanation":"描述商業行為的合法性。"}],"related_forms":["lawfully"]}

{"headword":"lean","explanation":"動詞「傾斜、倚靠」；形容詞「瘦的、精簡的」。常用片語：lean against (倚靠在...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please do not <lean> *against* the glass door, as it might break if you put too much weight on it.","translation":"請不要倚靠在玻璃門上，因為如果你施加太多重量，它可能會破裂。","explanation":"lean against 是常見的動作搭配。"},{"sentence":"He <leaned> *forward* to hear what the teacher was saying because the classroom was quite noisy during the break.","translation":"他向前傾以聽清楚老師在說什麼，因為下課時教室相當吵雜。","explanation":"lean forward 指身體向前傾。"},{"sentence":"The old tree <leaned> *to* one side because of the strong winds that hit the area last night.","translation":"那棵老樹因為昨晚襲擊該地區的強風而向一側傾斜。","explanation":"描述物體傾斜的狀態。"}],"related_forms":["leaned","leant","leaning"]}

{"headword":"learned","explanation":"形容詞「博學的」。注意發音為 [ˈlɜːrnɪd]，與 learn 的過去式 [lɜːrnd] 不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <learned> *professor* gave a fascinating speech about the history of art to all the students at the university.","translation":"那位博學的教授向大學裡所有的學生發表了一場關於藝術史的精彩演講。","explanation":"learned professor 是常見的搭配。"},{"sentence":"She spent many years studying in different countries and became a very <learned> person in the field of science.","translation":"她在不同國家學習多年，成為科學領域中一位非常博學的人。","explanation":"描述一個人在某領域的學識淵博。"},{"sentence":"The library contains many <learned> *books* that provide deep knowledge about various academic subjects for researchers.","translation":"圖書館收藏了許多學術著作，為研究人員提供關於各種學科的深奧知識。","explanation":"learned books 指學術性、深奧的書籍。"}],"related_forms":["learn"]}

{"headword":"lecture","explanation":"名詞「演講、講課」；動詞「講課、訓誡」。常用搭配：attend a lecture (聽演講/上課)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I need to *attend* a <lecture> *on* economics this afternoon, so I cannot join you for lunch.","translation":"我今天下午需要去聽一場經濟學講座，所以我不能和你們一起吃午餐。","explanation":"attend a lecture 是學生常見的活動。"},{"sentence":"The professor <lectures> *to* a large group of students every Monday morning in the main hall of the school.","translation":"教授每週一早上在學校大禮堂對一大群學生講課。","explanation":"lecture to sb 指對某人講課。"},{"sentence":"My father <lectured> me *on* the importance of saving money after I spent all my allowance in one week.","translation":"在我一週內花光所有零用錢後，我父親對我進行了關於存錢重要性的訓誡。","explanation":"lecture sb on sth 可表示「訓誡/說教」。"}],"related_forms":["lectures","lectured","lecturing"]}

{"headword":"lecturer","explanation":"名詞「講師」。指在大學或學院中負責授課的教職人員。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <lecturer> *explained* the complex theory clearly, making it much easier for the students to understand the main points.","translation":"講師清楚地解釋了複雜的理論，讓學生更容易理解重點。","explanation":"描述講師的教學行為。"},{"sentence":"She is a guest <lecturer> who visits our school once a month to share her experiences in the fashion industry.","translation":"她是一位客座講師，每個月造訪我們學校一次，分享她在時尚產業的經驗。","explanation":"guest lecturer 指客座講師。"},{"sentence":"Many students went to the office to ask the <lecturer> questions about their final research projects.","translation":"許多學生去辦公室詢問講師關於他們期末研究計畫的問題。","explanation":"描述學生與講師的互動。"}],"related_forms":["lecturers"]}

{"headword":"legend","explanation":"名詞「傳說、傳奇人物」。指流傳已久的民間故事或在某領域極具影響力的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"According to an *ancient* <legend>, a hidden treasure is buried somewhere on this mysterious island.","translation":"根據一個古老的傳說，寶藏被埋在這座神秘島嶼的某個地方。","explanation":"ancient legend 指古老的傳說。"},{"sentence":"He is a basketball <legend> because he won five championships during his long and successful career.","translation":"他是一位籃球傳奇人物，因為他在漫長且成功的職業生涯中贏得了五次冠軍。","explanation":"legend 用於指代某領域的傳奇人物。"},{"sentence":"The <legend> *of* Robin Hood has been told for many generations, inspiring people to help the poor.","translation":"羅賓漢的傳說已經流傳了許多世代，激勵人們去幫助窮人。","explanation":"the legend of... 是常見的用法。"}],"related_forms":["legends"]}

{"headword":"leisurely","explanation":"形容詞/副詞「悠閒的(地)」。雖然結尾是 -ly，但它是形容詞，修飾名詞或動詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"We took a <leisurely> *walk* *along* the beach, enjoying the warm sunlight and the sound of the waves.","translation":"我們沿著海灘悠閒地散步，享受著溫暖的陽光與海浪聲。","explanation":"leisurely walk 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"After finishing all our work, we spent a <leisurely> *afternoon* reading books in the quiet garden.","translation":"完成所有工作後，我們在安靜的花園裡度過了一個悠閒的下午。","explanation":"leisurely afternoon 描述悠閒的時光。"},{"sentence":"They walked <leisurely> *through* the park, looking at the colorful flowers and talking about their future plans.","translation":"他們悠閒地走過公園，看著色彩繽紛的花朵，聊著他們未來的計畫。","explanation":"副詞用法，修飾動詞 walk。"}],"related_forms":["leisure"]}

{"headword":"lengthen","explanation":"動詞「使變長、延長」。由 length (長度) 變化而來。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tailor decided to <lengthen> the *sleeves* of my jacket because they were a little too short for me.","translation":"裁縫決定把我的外套袖子加長，因為對我來說它們有點太短了。","explanation":"lengthen the sleeves 指加長袖子。"},{"sentence":"The days begin to <lengthen> in spring, giving us more time to enjoy outdoor activities after school.","translation":"春天時白天開始變長，給我們更多時間在放學後享受戶外活動。","explanation":"描述白天時間變長。"},{"sentence":"The government plans to <lengthen> the *duration* of the training program to ensure that all workers are well-prepared.","translation":"政府計畫延長訓練計畫的期間，以確保所有員工都準備充分。","explanation":"lengthen the duration 指延長時間/期間。"}],"related_forms":["lengthens","lengthened","lengthening"]}

{"headword":"liar","explanation":"名詞「說謊者」。由 lie (說謊) 變化而來，注意拼字。","entries":[{"sentence":"He is a known <liar>, so you should not believe anything he says about his past experiences.","translation":"他是個眾所周知的說謊者，所以你不該相信任何關於他過去經歷的話。","explanation":"a known liar 指眾所周知的說謊者。"},{"sentence":"She felt hurt when her friend called her a <liar> because she had always been honest with everyone.","translation":"當她的朋友稱她是個說謊者時，她感到很受傷，因為她對每個人一直都很誠實。","explanation":"call sb a liar 是常見的指控用法。"},{"sentence":"Don't be a <liar>; just tell the truth about what happened, and we will try to help you.","translation":"不要當個說謊者；只要說出發生了什麼事的真相，我們會盡力幫助你。","explanation":"勸告他人不要說謊。"}],"related_forms":["liars","lie"]}

{"headword":"librarian","explanation":"名詞「圖書館員」。注意拼字，中間是 libr-。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <librarian> *helped* me find the books I needed for my history project in the school library.","translation":"圖書館員幫我在學校圖書館找到我做歷史報告所需的書。","explanation":"描述圖書館員的工作內容。"},{"sentence":"If you have any questions about how to use the library system, please ask the <librarian> *at* the front desk.","translation":"如果你對如何使用圖書館系統有任何疑問，請詢問櫃檯的圖書館員。","explanation":"詢問圖書館員資訊。"},{"sentence":"The <librarian> *organized* all the new magazines and newspapers so that students could find them easily.","translation":"圖書館員整理了所有的新雜誌與報紙，好讓學生能輕鬆找到它們。","explanation":"描述圖書館員整理館藏。"}],"related_forms":["librarians"]}

{"headword":"intention","explanation":"名詞「意圖、打算」。常用搭配：have the intention of doing sth. 或 with the intention of doing sth. 注意介係詞用 of，後接動名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"He had no <intention> *of* hurting your feelings; he just spoke too quickly without thinking about the consequences.","translation":"他完全沒有要傷害你感情的意思；他只是說話太快，沒考慮後果。","explanation":"have no intention of doing sth. 是非常實用的句型，表示「沒有做某事的打算」。"},{"sentence":"The company announced its <intention> *to* expand into the international market by opening three new branches next year.","translation":"該公司宣布了明年開設三家新分公司以擴展至國際市場的計畫。","explanation":"intention 後方可接不定詞 to V，表示「做某事的意圖」。"}],"related_forms":["intent","intentional"]}

{"headword":"interact","explanation":"動詞「互動、交流」。常用搭配：interact with sb./sth. 表示與某人或某物互動。在科學或社會學情境中常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"Teachers often encourage students to <interact> *with* their classmates during group projects to improve their communication skills.","translation":"老師常鼓勵學生在小組專題中與同學互動，以增進溝通技巧。","explanation":"interact with 是固定用法，表示與他人進行交流。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying how different chemicals <interact> *with* each other in the human body to create new medical treatments.","translation":"科學家正在研究不同的化學物質如何在人體內相互作用，以創造新的醫療方式。","explanation":"在科學語境下，interact with 可表示物質間的相互作用。"}],"related_forms":["interaction","interactive"]}

{"headword":"interaction","explanation":"名詞「互動、交流」。指人與人之間或事物之間的相互影響。常見搭配：social interaction (社交互動)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <interaction> *between* parents and children plays a vital role in the development of a child's personality and social skills.","translation":"親子之間的互動在孩子的人格發展與社交技巧中扮演重要角色。","explanation":"interaction between A and B 是表示互動對象的標準用法。"},{"sentence":"Limited face-to-face <interaction> *due* *to* the pandemic has made many people feel lonely and disconnected from their friends.","translation":"由於疫情導致的面對面互動減少，使許多人感到孤單並與朋友疏遠。","explanation":"face-to-face interaction 是常見的學術與生活詞彙。"}],"related_forms":["interact","interactive"]}

{"headword":"interfere","explanation":"動詞「干涉、妨礙」。常用搭配：interfere with sth. (妨礙某事)；interfere in sth. (干涉某事，通常帶有負面意涵)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Loud music from the neighbor's house started to <interfere> *with* my ability to focus on my homework this evening.","translation":"鄰居家傳來的吵雜音樂開始妨礙我今晚專注於功課的能力。","explanation":"interfere with 常指對某種運作或狀態造成干擾。"},{"sentence":"It is generally considered rude to <interfere> *in* other people's private matters unless they ask for your help.","translation":"除非他人請求幫忙，否則干涉他人的私事通常被認為是不禮貌的。","explanation":"interfere in 常用於干涉他人的事務或爭端。"}],"related_forms":["interference"]}

{"headword":"intermediate","explanation":"形容詞「中級的」；名詞「中間物」；動詞「調解」。GSAT最常考形容詞用法，指程度介於初級與高級之間。","entries":[{"sentence":"This English course is designed for <intermediate> *students* who already have a basic understanding of grammar and vocabulary.","translation":"這門英語課程是為已經具備基礎文法與字彙的中級學生所設計的。","explanation":"intermediate students 是常見的搭配，指中級程度的學習者。"},{"sentence":"The hiker reached an <intermediate> *point* on the mountain trail where he decided to take a short break to drink some water.","translation":"這位登山客到達了登山步道的中間點，決定休息一下喝點水。","explanation":"指位置或階段位於中間。"}],"related_forms":["intermediary"]}

{"headword":"interpret","explanation":"動詞「解釋、詮釋、口譯」。注意名詞變化為 interpretation。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is difficult to <interpret> *the* *meaning* of the poem because the author used many complex symbols and metaphors.","translation":"很難詮釋這首詩的含義，因為作者用了許多複雜的符號與隱喻。","explanation":"interpret the meaning of sth. 是詮釋文學作品時的標準用法。"},{"sentence":"The professional guide had to <interpret> *for* the foreign visitors so they could understand the local history of the temple.","translation":"專業導遊必須為外國遊客進行口譯，這樣他們才能了解這座寺廟的在地歷史。","explanation":"interpret for sb. 在此處指擔任口譯員。"}],"related_forms":["interpretation","interpreter"]}

{"headword":"interruption","explanation":"名詞「中斷、干擾」。常見搭配：without interruption (連續不斷地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden power <interruption> *caused* by the storm forced the factory to stop all production lines for several hours.","translation":"暴風雨導致的突然斷電，迫使工廠停止所有生產線數小時。","explanation":"power interruption 指電力中斷。"},{"sentence":"He was able to work for five hours *without* any <interruption>, which helped him finish the report much earlier than expected.","translation":"他能夠連續工作五小時而不受任何干擾，這幫助他比預期提早許多完成了報告。","explanation":"without interruption 是常見的片語，表示「不間斷地」。"}],"related_forms":["interrupt"]}

{"headword":"intimate","explanation":"形容詞「親密的、私下的」；名詞「密友」。形容詞用法最常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"They have been <intimate> *friends* since elementary school and have shared many secrets over the years.","translation":"他們從國小起就是親密好友，多年來分享了許多秘密。","explanation":"intimate friends 指關係非常親近的朋友。"},{"sentence":"The small cafe provides an <intimate> *atmosphere* that makes it a perfect place for couples to have a quiet conversation.","translation":"這家小咖啡館提供了溫馨私密的氛圍，使其成為情侶安靜交談的絕佳場所。","explanation":"intimate atmosphere 指溫馨、私密且舒適的環境。"}],"related_forms":["intimacy"]}

{"headword":"intuition","explanation":"名詞「直覺」。常用搭配：by intuition (憑直覺)；have an intuition (有種直覺)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to trust her <intuition> *and* chose the path that felt right, even though her friends disagreed with her.","translation":"她決定相信自己的直覺，選擇了感覺對的那條路，儘管她的朋友們不同意她。","explanation":"trust one's intuition 是常見搭配，表示相信自己的直覺。"},{"sentence":"Sometimes, a person's <intuition> *can* *be* more accurate than logical analysis when making quick decisions in a crisis.","translation":"有時候，在危機中做快速決定時，一個人的直覺可能比邏輯分析更準確。","explanation":"intuition 與 logical analysis 形成對比，強調直覺的重要性。"}],"related_forms":["intuitive"]}

{"headword":"invade","explanation":"動詞「入侵、侵略、侵犯」。常用於軍事入侵或隱私侵犯。","entries":[{"sentence":"The army planned to <invade> *the* *neighboring* country at dawn to take control of the important resources along the border.","translation":"軍隊計畫在黎明時分入侵鄰國，以控制邊境沿線的重要資源。","explanation":"invade a country 是標準的軍事用語。"},{"sentence":"Many people feel that cameras in public spaces <invade> *their* *privacy* and make them feel uncomfortable while walking on the street.","translation":"許多人認為公共場所的攝影機侵犯了他們的隱私，讓他們在街上行走時感到不自在。","explanation":"invade one's privacy 是非常重要的搭配，指侵犯隱私。"}],"related_forms":["invasion","invader"]}

{"headword":"invasion","explanation":"名詞「入侵、侵略」。常與 of 連用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <invasion> *of* the island by foreign forces led to a long war that lasted for over ten years.","translation":"外國勢力對該島的入侵導致了一場持續十多年的長期戰爭。","explanation":"invasion of sth. 是常見用法，指對某處的侵略。"},{"sentence":"The sudden <invasion> *of* insects into the kitchen forced the family to call a professional pest control service immediately.","translation":"廚房突然遭到昆蟲入侵，迫使這家人立即打電話給專業除蟲服務。","explanation":"invasion 也可用於指大量生物的侵入。"}],"related_forms":["invade"]}

{"headword":"invention","explanation":"名詞「發明、發明物」。注意與 discovery (發現) 的區別：invention 是創造出原本不存在的東西。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <invention> *of* the internet has completely changed the way we communicate, work, and access information in our daily lives.","translation":"網際網路的發明徹底改變了我們在日常生活中溝通、工作與獲取資訊的方式。","explanation":"invention of sth. 指某項發明。"},{"sentence":"Thomas Edison is famous for his many <inventions>, including the light bulb, which brought light to millions of homes.","translation":"湯瑪斯·愛迪生以他的許多發明聞名，其中包括電燈泡，它為數百萬個家庭帶來了光明。","explanation":"inventions 是可數名詞，指具體的發明項目。"}],"related_forms":["invent","inventor"]}

{"headword":"invest","explanation":"動詞「投資」。常用搭配：invest in sth. (投資某物)；invest time/money in sth. (投入時間/金錢在某事上)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is a smart idea to <invest> *in* your education because knowledge is something that no one can ever take away from you.","translation":"投資教育是個聰明的想法，因為知識是沒人能從你身上奪走的東西。","explanation":"invest in sth. 不僅指金錢，也可用於抽象事物如教育。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to <invest> *a* *large* *amount* *of* *money* *in* developing new technology to stay ahead of its competitors.","translation":"該公司決定投入大量資金開發新技術，以保持在競爭對手中的領先地位。","explanation":"invest money in sth. 表示將錢投入某專案。"}],"related_forms":["investment","investor"]}

{"headword":"investigation","explanation":"名詞「調查」。常用搭配：conduct/launch an investigation (進行/發起調查)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police have launched a thorough <investigation> *into* the cause of the fire that destroyed the old building last night.","translation":"警方已針對昨晚燒毀舊建築的火災原因展開徹底調查。","explanation":"investigation into sth. 是固定搭配，表示對某事的調查。"},{"sentence":"After a long <investigation>, the committee finally found the evidence needed to prove that the manager was innocent.","translation":"經過長時間的調查，委員會終於找到了證明經理清白的必要證據。","explanation":"after a long investigation 表示調查過程。"}],"related_forms":["investigate","investigator"]}

{"headword":"involve","explanation":"動詞「包含、涉及、使參與」。常用搭配：be involved in sth. (參與某事/與某事有關)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The project will <involve> *working* *with* a team of experts to solve the environmental problems in the local area.","translation":"該專案將涉及與專家團隊合作，以解決當地的環境問題。","explanation":"involve 後接動名詞 (V-ing)，表示包含某項活動。"},{"sentence":"She has been <involved> *in* many volunteer activities since she entered university to help those in need.","translation":"自從進入大學以來，她一直參與許多志願活動，以幫助那些需要幫助的人。","explanation":"be involved in 是非常重要的片語，表示參與某事。"}],"related_forms":["involvement"]}

{"headword":"isolate","explanation":"動詞「隔離、使孤立」。常用搭配：isolate sb./sth. from sth. (將某人/物從某處隔離)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor decided to <isolate> *the* *patient* *from* others to prevent the spread of the infectious disease in the hospital.","translation":"醫生決定將該病患與他人隔離，以防止傳染病在醫院內擴散。","explanation":"isolate sb. from sth. 是標準的隔離用法。"},{"sentence":"Living in a remote village can sometimes make people feel <isolated> *from* the rest of the world and the latest news.","translation":"住在偏遠村莊有時會讓人感到與世界其他地方及最新消息隔絕。","explanation":"feel isolated from sth. 表示感到與某處脫節或孤立。"}],"related_forms":["isolation","isolated"]}

{"headword":"isolation","explanation":"名詞「隔離、孤立」。常與 in 連用，表示處於孤立狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"After working in complete <isolation> *for* several months, the writer finally finished his novel and was ready to share it.","translation":"在完全與世隔絕地工作了幾個月後，這位作家終於完成了他的小說，並準備好與人分享。","explanation":"in isolation 表示處於孤立或單獨的狀態。"},{"sentence":"The country suffered from political <isolation> *because* of its controversial policies that angered many other nations.","translation":"由於其激怒許多國家的爭議政策，該國遭受了政治孤立。","explanation":"political isolation 指在國際政治上的孤立。"}],"related_forms":["isolate"]}

{"headword":"issue","explanation":"名詞「議題、問題」；動詞「發布、核發」。名詞用法在GSAT中極為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"Climate change is a global <issue> *that* requires cooperation from every country to protect our planet for future generations.","translation":"氣候變遷是一個全球性議題，需要每個國家的合作，才能為後代保護我們的地球。","explanation":"global issue 是常見搭配，指全球性的問題。"},{"sentence":"The government will <issue> *a* *new* *set* *of* rules next week to improve traffic safety in the city center.","translation":"政府下週將發布一套新規則，以改善市中心的交通安全。","explanation":"issue rules/statements 指正式發布規則或聲明。"}],"related_forms":["issues"]}

{"headword":"jealousy","explanation":"名詞「嫉妒、猜忌」。注意與 envy 的區別：jealousy 通常指害怕失去已擁有的東西，或對他人的佔有慾。","entries":[{"sentence":"His <jealousy> *of* his brother's success caused a lot of tension in their relationship over the past few years.","translation":"他對哥哥成功的嫉妒在過去幾年裡導致他們關係中出現了許多緊張氣氛。","explanation":"jealousy of sb./sth. 是標準用法，表示對某人或某事的嫉妒。"},{"sentence":"She tried to hide her <jealousy> *when* she saw her best friend spending time with someone else at the party.","translation":"當她看到最好的朋友在派對上與其他人相處時，她試圖隱藏自己的嫉妒。","explanation":"描述在特定情境下產生的嫉妒情緒。"}],"related_forms":["jealous"]}

{"headword":"keen","explanation":"形容詞「熱衷的、敏銳的」。常用搭配：be keen on sth. (熱衷於某事)；keen eyesight (敏銳的視力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"He is very <keen> *on* playing basketball and spends every weekend practicing at the local sports center.","translation":"他非常熱衷於打籃球，每個週末都花時間在當地的運動中心練習。","explanation":"be keen on sth. = be interested in sth.，是非常實用的口語與寫作句型。"},{"sentence":"Eagles have <keen> *eyesight*, which allows them to spot small animals from a great distance in the sky.","translation":"老鷹有敏銳的視力，這使牠們能從天空中的遠處發現小動物。","explanation":"keen eyesight 指視力敏銳，keen 在此處意為「敏銳的」。"}],"related_forms":["keenly"]}

{"headword":"license","explanation":"名詞指「執照/許可證」，動詞指「發給執照/授權」。常見搭配：driver's license, marriage license。注意拼字：美式英語名詞動詞皆為 license，英式英語名詞為 licence。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before you can drive a car on public roads, you must obtain a valid driver's <license> *from* the local government office.","translation":"在你可以在公共道路上開車之前，你必須從當地政府辦公室取得有效的駕駛執照。","explanation":"名詞用法，指官方核發的許可文件。搭配動詞 obtain/get/apply for。"},{"sentence":"The restaurant was <licensed> *to* sell alcoholic drinks after the owner passed the strict health and safety inspection.","translation":"在店主通過嚴格的健康與安全檢查後，這家餐廳獲准販售含酒精飲料。","explanation":"動詞用法，指獲得授權。常用被動語態 be licensed to do sth。"}],"related_forms":["licensed","licensing"]}

{"headword":"lifeguard","explanation":"名詞「救生員」。常指在海邊或游泳池負責監視泳客安全的人員。注意此字為單一複合名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <lifeguard> *on* duty quickly jumped into the water to save a young child who was struggling to stay afloat.","translation":"值勤的救生員迅速跳入水中，救起了一名努力保持浮在水面上的幼童。","explanation":"名詞用法，指負責水域安全的人員。on duty 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Many students work *as* a <lifeguard> during the hot summer months to earn extra money for their college tuition.","translation":"許多學生在炎熱的夏季擔任救生員，以賺取額外的學費。","explanation":"work as a... 為常見用法，表示從事某種職業。"}],"related_forms":["lifeguards"]}

{"headword":"limitation","explanation":"名詞「限制/局限」。常用於描述能力、資源或系統的不足。常與 impose, set, overcome 等動詞連用。","entries":[{"sentence":"Every person has their own <limitations>, so it is important to know when to ask for help from others.","translation":"每個人都有自己的局限，所以知道何時該向他人求助是很重要的。","explanation":"名詞用法，指能力上的限制。常用複數形。"},{"sentence":"The new law *imposes* strict <limitations> *on* the amount of plastic waste that companies can produce each year.","translation":"新法律對公司每年可以產生的塑膠廢棄物數量施加了嚴格的限制。","explanation":"impose limitations on... 為常見的高級搭配，意指施加限制。"}],"related_forms":["limit","limited"]}

{"headword":"linen","explanation":"名詞「亞麻布/亞麻製品」。常指床單、桌布或毛巾等家用織品。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to change the bed <linen> after the guests left because she wanted the room to be fresh and clean.","translation":"客人在離開後，她決定更換床單，因為她希望房間保持清新乾淨。","explanation":"名詞用法，指床單、枕套等寢具。"},{"sentence":"The store sells high-quality <linen> products that are perfect for keeping you cool during the hot summer season.","translation":"這家店販售高品質的亞麻產品，非常適合在炎熱的夏季讓你保持涼爽。","explanation":"名詞作為形容詞修飾名詞，指材質。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"lipstick","explanation":"名詞「口紅/唇膏」。常見搭配：wear lipstick, apply lipstick。","entries":[{"sentence":"She looked in the mirror and *applied* some bright red <lipstick> before heading out to the party with her friends.","translation":"她在出門參加朋友派對前，照了鏡子並塗了一些亮紅色的口紅。","explanation":"apply lipstick 為常見動詞搭配。"},{"sentence":"It is common for many women to *wear* <lipstick> to enhance their appearance for professional or social occasions.","translation":"許多女性為了在專業或社交場合提升外表，習慣塗抹口紅。","explanation":"wear lipstick 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["lipsticks"]}

{"headword":"liquor","explanation":"名詞「烈酒/含酒精飲料」。注意與 alcohol 的區別，liquor 通常指蒸餾酒。","entries":[{"sentence":"The shop is *not* allowed to sell <liquor> to anyone who is under the legal drinking age of eighteen.","translation":"這家商店不得將烈酒販售給任何未滿十八歲法定飲酒年齡的人。","explanation":"指烈酒。legal drinking age 為相關詞彙。"},{"sentence":"Drinking too much <liquor> can lead to serious health problems and affect your ability to make good decisions.","translation":"飲用過多烈酒會導致嚴重的健康問題，並影響你做出正確決定的能力。","explanation":"指酒精飲料的攝取。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"literary","explanation":"形容詞「文學的」。指與文學作品或研究相關的，不要與 literal (字面上的) 搞混。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor has made a great <literary> *contribution* to the study of modern poetry in the twentieth century.","translation":"這位教授對二十世紀現代詩歌的研究做出了巨大的文學貢獻。","explanation":"literary contribution 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Many students enjoy joining a <literary> *club* to discuss their favorite novels and share their thoughts with others.","translation":"許多學生喜歡參加文學社，討論他們最喜歡的小說並與他人分享想法。","explanation":"literary club 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["literature"]}

{"headword":"literature","explanation":"名詞「文學/文獻」。指文學作品或特定主題的書面資料。","entries":[{"sentence":"Studying English <literature> helps students develop a deeper understanding of human nature and different cultural perspectives.","translation":"學習英國文學有助於學生對人性與不同的文化觀點產生更深層的理解。","explanation":"指文學這個學科。"},{"sentence":"The researcher reviewed all the existing scientific <literature> before starting her own experiment on climate change.","translation":"研究人員在開始她自己的氣候變遷實驗之前，審閱了所有現有的科學文獻。","explanation":"指特定領域的文獻資料，此時為不可數名詞。"}],"related_forms":["literary"]}

{"headword":"loan","explanation":"名詞「貸款」，動詞「借出」。常見搭配：take out a loan, student loan。","entries":[{"sentence":"He had to *take* *out* a student <loan> to pay for his college tuition and living expenses for four years.","translation":"他必須申請學生貸款來支付他四年的大學學費和生活費。","explanation":"take out a loan 為固定用法，指申請貸款。"},{"sentence":"The local library *is* <loaned> *out* thousands of books to students who need them for their research projects.","translation":"當地圖書館將數千本書借給需要進行研究計畫的學生們。","explanation":"動詞用法，指借出物品。loan out sth to sb。"}],"related_forms":["loans","loaned"]}

{"headword":"lobster","explanation":"名詞「龍蝦」。指海鮮的一種。","entries":[{"sentence":"For their wedding anniversary, they went to a fancy restaurant and ordered a fresh <lobster> to share.","translation":"為了慶祝結婚紀念日，他們去了一家高級餐廳，點了一隻新鮮龍蝦一起享用。","explanation":"指龍蝦這種食物。"},{"sentence":"The fishermen work hard every day to catch <lobster> in the cold waters off the northern coast.","translation":"漁民們每天辛苦工作，在北部海岸外寒冷的水域中捕捉龍蝦。","explanation":"指捕捉龍蝦的活動。"}],"related_forms":["lobsters"]}

{"headword":"logic","explanation":"名詞「邏輯/道理」。指推理過程或合理性。","entries":[{"sentence":"There is no <logic> *in* his argument, so it is difficult for most people to agree with his conclusion.","translation":"他的論點毫無邏輯，所以大多數人很難同意他的結論。","explanation":"logic in sth 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The detective used his sharp <logic> to solve the mystery and find the person who stole the diamond.","translation":"偵探運用他敏銳的邏輯推理破解了謎團，並找到了偷走鑽石的人。","explanation":"指推理能力。"}],"related_forms":["logical"]}

{"headword":"logical","explanation":"形容詞「合乎邏輯的」。指推理正確或行為合理。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is a <logical> *choice* to save money when you are young so that you can have more freedom later.","translation":"年輕時存錢是一個合乎邏輯的選擇，這樣你以後才能擁有更多的自由。","explanation":"logical choice 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to provide a <logical> *explanation* for why they were late for class this morning.","translation":"老師要求學生對於今天早上為何遲到提供一個合理的解釋。","explanation":"logical explanation 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["logic"]}

{"headword":"loosen","explanation":"動詞「放鬆/鬆開」。常指解開繩子、緊繃的肌肉或限制。","entries":[{"sentence":"You should <loosen> your tie a little bit so that you can feel more comfortable during the long meeting.","translation":"你應該把領帶稍微鬆開一點，這樣在漫長的會議中你會感到比較舒服。","explanation":"指鬆開衣物。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <loosen> the travel restrictions to encourage more international tourists to visit the country.","translation":"政府決定放寬旅遊限制，以鼓勵更多國際遊客造訪該國。","explanation":"指放寬限制，常用於政策。"}],"related_forms":["loosened","loosening"]}

{"headword":"lousy","explanation":"形容詞「糟糕的/差勁的」。口語用法，表達強烈的不滿或品質低劣。","entries":[{"sentence":"I had a <lousy> *day* at work because I made several mistakes on the important report for my boss.","translation":"我今天工作過得很糟糕，因為我在給老闆的重要報告上犯了幾個錯誤。","explanation":"lousy day 為常見口語搭配。"},{"sentence":"The movie was really <lousy>, so we left the cinema halfway through and went to get some ice cream.","translation":"那部電影真的很爛，所以我們看到一半就離開電影院去買冰淇淋了。","explanation":"形容品質差勁。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"loyal","explanation":"形容詞「忠誠的」。常用搭配：loyal to sb/sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The dog remained <loyal> *to* its owner even after many years of being separated from each other.","translation":"即使分開多年，這隻狗依然對牠的主人保持忠誠。","explanation":"loyal to sb 為固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"Many <loyal> *customers* return to this bakery every week because they love the taste of the fresh bread.","translation":"許多忠實顧客每週都回到這家麵包店，因為他們喜愛新鮮麵包的口感。","explanation":"loyal customer 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["loyalty"]}

{"headword":"loyalty","explanation":"名詞「忠誠」。指對人、組織或信念的堅定支持。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company rewards its employees for their hard work and <loyalty> by offering them extra bonuses at the end of the year.","translation":"公司透過在年底提供額外獎金，來獎勵員工的辛勤工作與忠誠度。","explanation":"loyalty to a company 為常見用法。"},{"sentence":"Friendship is built on trust and <loyalty>, which are the most important things in any long-lasting relationship.","translation":"友誼建立在信任與忠誠之上，這是任何長久關係中最重要的事情。","explanation":"指人際關係中的忠誠。"}],"related_forms":["loyal"]}

{"headword":"luxurious","explanation":"形容詞「奢華的/豪華的」。指昂貴、舒適且高品質的。","entries":[{"sentence":"They stayed in a <luxurious> *hotel* with a beautiful view of the ocean and excellent room service.","translation":"他們住進了一家豪華飯店，擁有美麗的海景和優質的客房服務。","explanation":"luxurious hotel 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"She enjoys living a <luxurious> *lifestyle* with expensive clothes, fine dining, and frequent trips abroad.","translation":"她享受過著奢華的生活方式，包括昂貴的衣服、精緻的餐點以及頻繁的出國旅行。","explanation":"luxurious lifestyle 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["luxury"]}

{"headword":"luxury","explanation":"名詞「奢侈/豪華」。指昂貴的享受或高級品。","entries":[{"sentence":"For most students, eating out at a fancy restaurant is a <luxury> that they can only afford on special occasions.","translation":"對大多數學生而言，去高級餐廳外食是一種只有在特殊場合才負擔得起的奢侈享受。","explanation":"指一種難得的享受。"},{"sentence":"The car is equipped with every possible <luxury>, including leather seats and a high-quality sound system.","translation":"這輛車配備了所有可能的豪華功能，包括真皮座椅和高品質音響系統。","explanation":"指豪華的配備。"}],"related_forms":["luxurious"]}

{"headword":"machinery","explanation":"名詞「機器/機械裝置」。集合名詞，不可數，不可加 s。","entries":[{"sentence":"The factory uses heavy <machinery> *to* produce thousands of parts for cars every single day.","translation":"這家工廠使用重型機械，每天生產數以千計的汽車零件。","explanation":"machinery 為不可數名詞，不可說 machineries。"},{"sentence":"Workers must be very careful when operating the complex <machinery> to avoid any dangerous accidents in the workplace.","translation":"工人在操作複雜機械時必須非常小心，以避免工作場所發生任何危險事故。","explanation":"operating machinery 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["machine"]}

{"headword":"magnetic","explanation":"形容詞「磁性的/有吸引力的」。可用於物理學，也可用於形容人很有魅力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <magnetic> *field* of the Earth protects us from harmful radiation coming from outer space.","translation":"地球的磁場保護我們免受來自外太空的有害輻射影響。","explanation":"magnetic field 為常見物理學搭配。"},{"sentence":"He has a <magnetic> *personality* that makes people want to talk to him and be his friend.","translation":"他有一種吸引人的個性，讓人們想要與他交談並成為他的朋友。","explanation":"magnetic personality 為常見搭配，指人很有魅力。"}],"related_forms":["magnet"]}

{"headword":"magnificent","explanation":"形容詞，意為「壯麗的、宏偉的」，常用於描述建築、風景或表現。注意拼字，中間為 'i' 而非 'e'。","entries":[{"sentence":"The palace is a <magnificent> *building* with a long history, attracting thousands of tourists from all over the world every single year.","translation":"這座宮殿是一座擁有悠久歷史的宏偉建築，每年吸引成千上萬來自世界各地的遊客。","explanation":"描述建築物時常用 magnificent building 或 magnificent palace。"},{"sentence":"The pianist gave a <magnificent> *performance* at the concert hall, and the audience stood up to applaud for several minutes.","translation":"那位鋼琴家在音樂廳帶來了精彩絕倫的表演，觀眾起立鼓掌了好幾分鐘。","explanation":"magnificent performance 為常見搭配，用於稱讚藝術表現。"}],"related_forms":["magnificently"]}

{"headword":"makeup","explanation":"名詞，意為「化妝品」或「組成/結構」。注意作為「化妝品」時通常為不可數名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"She spent a lot of time putting on her <makeup> *in front of* the mirror before going to the party with her friends.","translation":"在與朋友去參加派對之前，她花了很多時間在鏡子前化妝。","explanation":"put on makeup 是常見搭配，指化妝的動作。"},{"sentence":"The chemical <makeup> *of* this soil is very special, which makes it perfect for growing these rare and beautiful flowers.","translation":"這種土壤的化學組成非常特殊，這使得它非常適合種植這些稀有而美麗的花朵。","explanation":"指事物的組成結構時，後方常接 of。"}],"related_forms":["make up"]}

{"headword":"manual","explanation":"名詞為「手冊、指南」；形容詞為「手工的、體力的」。注意區分詞性。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before you start using the new camera, please read the user <manual> *carefully* to understand all its functions and settings.","translation":"在使用這台新相機之前，請仔細閱讀使用手冊，以了解其所有功能與設定。","explanation":"user manual 是常見的固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"Many people prefer to do <manual> *labor* in the garden because it helps them relax and stay physically active during the weekend.","translation":"許多人喜歡在花園裡做體力勞動，因為這有助於他們在週末放鬆身心並保持身體活動。","explanation":"manual labor 指體力勞動。"}],"related_forms":["manually"]}

{"headword":"manufacture","explanation":"動詞「製造、生產」；名詞「製造業」。注意與 producer 的區別，此字多用於工業大規模生產。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company <manufactures> *high-quality* electronic products that are sold in many different countries around the globe.","translation":"這家公司生產高品質的電子產品，並銷往全球許多不同的國家。","explanation":"manufacture 指工廠大規模生產。"},{"sentence":"The <manufacture> *of* cars has changed a lot because of the use of robots and advanced computer technology in factories.","translation":"由於工廠中機器人和先進電腦技術的使用，汽車的製造方式已經發生了很大的變化。","explanation":"名詞用法，後接 of 表示製造的對象。"}],"related_forms":["manufacturing"]}

{"headword":"manufacturer","explanation":"名詞，意為「製造商、生產商」。通常指公司或企業。","entries":[{"sentence":"This local <manufacturer> *is* well-known for its excellent customer service and the durability of its home appliances.","translation":"這家在地製造商以其優質的客戶服務和家電的耐用性而聞名。","explanation":"指公司時為單數，可搭配 is。"},{"sentence":"We contacted the <manufacturer> *to* ask for a replacement because the product we bought last week was broken.","translation":"我們聯繫了製造商要求更換，因為我們上週買的產品壞了。","explanation":"contact the manufacturer 是常見的商務用法。"}],"related_forms":["manufacture"]}

{"headword":"marathon","explanation":"名詞，意為「馬拉松比賽」或「長時間的活動」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thousands of runners gathered in the city center to participate in the annual <marathon> *race* held on Sunday morning.","translation":"成千上萬的跑者聚集在市中心，參加週日上午舉行的年度馬拉松比賽。","explanation":"marathon race 為常見用法。"},{"sentence":"After finishing the final exam, the students had a movie <marathon> *at* home to celebrate the end of the semester.","translation":"期末考結束後，學生們在家裡進行了馬拉松式的電影馬拉松，以慶祝學期結束。","explanation":"movie marathon 指長時間連續觀看電影。"}],"related_forms":[]}
