{"headword":"margin","explanation":"名詞，意為「頁邊空白」、「邊緣」或「差距（如勝負差距、利潤空間）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please write your answers clearly and leave a wide <margin> *on* the left side of the paper for the teacher's comments.","translation":"請清楚地寫下您的答案，並在紙張左側留出寬大的空白處，以便老師寫下評語。","explanation":"指書寫頁面空白處。"},{"sentence":"The candidate won the election by a narrow <margin> *of* only five hundred votes, which surprised many political experts.","translation":"該候選人以僅五百票的微小差距贏得了選舉，這讓許多政治專家感到驚訝。","explanation":"a narrow margin of 指勝負差距。"}],"related_forms":["marginal"]}

{"headword":"maturity","explanation":"名詞，意為「成熟」。可用於形容人的心智或事物的發展階段。","entries":[{"sentence":"With age comes <maturity>, and he is now much more careful about the decisions he makes in his daily life.","translation":"隨著年齡增長，人會變得成熟，他現在對日常生活中所做的決定更加謹慎。","explanation":"指心智成熟。"},{"sentence":"The project has reached a level of <maturity> *where* we can finally start to see some positive results from our hard work.","translation":"該專案已達到成熟階段，我們終於可以開始看到我們努力工作所帶來的一些正面成果。","explanation":"指專案發展成熟，常用 reached a level of maturity。"}],"related_forms":["mature"]}

{"headword":"maximum","explanation":"形容詞「最大值的」；名詞「最大量、最大值」。注意與 minimum 的對比。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <maximum> *speed* limit on this highway is one hundred kilometers per hour to ensure the safety of all drivers.","translation":"這條高速公路的最高速限為時速一百公里，以確保所有駕駛的安全。","explanation":"maximum speed limit 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The <maximum> *number* of students allowed in the laboratory at one time is twenty, so please sign up in advance.","translation":"一次允許進入實驗室的學生人數最多為二十人，所以請提前登記。","explanation":"maximum number of 指最大數量。"}],"related_forms":["maximize"]}

{"headword":"measurable","explanation":"形容詞，意為「可測量的、顯著的」。常用於科學或數據分析。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new teaching method has had a <measurable> *impact* on the students' test scores over the past six months.","translation":"在過去六個月裡，這種新的教學方法對學生的考試成績產生了顯著的影響。","explanation":"measurable impact 指可量化、顯著的影響。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are looking for <measurable> *changes* in the environment to understand how climate change affects our local wildlife.","translation":"科學家們正在尋找環境中可測量的變化，以了解氣候變遷如何影響我們的在地野生動物。","explanation":"measurable changes 指可觀測到的數據變化。"}],"related_forms":["measure"]}

{"headword":"measure","explanation":"名詞「措施、方法」；動詞「測量」。作為措施時，常用複數 measures。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school has *taken* strict <measures> *to* prevent cheating during the final exams and ensure fairness for everyone.","translation":"學校已採取嚴格措施防止期末考作弊，並確保對每個人公平。","explanation":"take measures to do sth 是固定用法。"},{"sentence":"Before you buy the new sofa, you should <measure> *the* size of your living room to make sure it will fit perfectly.","translation":"在購買新沙發之前，你應該測量客廳的大小，以確保它能完美放入。","explanation":"動詞用法，指測量尺寸。"}],"related_forms":["measurement"]}

{"headword":"mechanic","explanation":"名詞，意為「技工、機械師」。注意與 machine (機器) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"My car broke down on the way to work, so I had to call a <mechanic> *to* fix the engine for me.","translation":"我的車在上班途中拋錨了，所以我不得不打電話請技工幫我修理引擎。","explanation":"call a mechanic 是常見用法。"},{"sentence":"The experienced <mechanic> *checked* the brakes thoroughly before telling me that the car was safe to drive again.","translation":"那位經驗豐富的技工在告訴我車子可以安全駕駛前，徹底檢查了煞車。","explanation":"mechanic 檢查機械設備。"}],"related_forms":["mechanical"]}

{"headword":"mechanical","explanation":"形容詞，意為「機械的、機械式的」。指與機器有關或像機器一樣缺乏情感。","entries":[{"sentence":"The factory uses <mechanical> *arms* to assemble the parts quickly and accurately without making any mistakes.","translation":"這家工廠使用機械手臂來快速且精確地組裝零件，不會犯任何錯誤。","explanation":"mechanical arms 指機械手臂。"},{"sentence":"He gave a <mechanical> *smile* to the guests, as he was too tired to show any real excitement during the meeting.","translation":"他對客人露出機械式的微笑，因為他太累了，在會議中無法表現出任何真正的興奮。","explanation":"指像機器一樣缺乏情感的反應。"}],"related_forms":["mechanic"]}

{"headword":"memorable","explanation":"形容詞，意為「難忘的、值得紀念的」。常用於描述美好的經歷。","entries":[{"sentence":"We had a <memorable> *trip* to the mountains last summer, where we enjoyed the fresh air and beautiful scenery.","translation":"去年夏天我們去山區進行了一次難忘的旅行，在那裡我們享受了新鮮的空氣和美麗的風景。","explanation":"memorable trip 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"It was a <memorable> *moment* when the team finally won the championship after years of hard practice and dedication.","translation":"當球隊在經過多年的刻苦練習與奉獻後終於贏得冠軍時，那是一個值得紀念的時刻。","explanation":"memorable moment 指難忘的時刻。"}],"related_forms":["memory"]}

{"headword":"memorial","explanation":"形容詞「紀念的」；名詞「紀念碑、紀念物」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city built a <memorial> *statue* in the park to honor the soldiers who fought bravely for our country.","translation":"這座城市在公園裡建了一座紀念雕像，以紀念那些為我們國家英勇奮戰的士兵。","explanation":"memorial statue 指紀念雕像。"},{"sentence":"Many people visited the war <memorial> *on* the national holiday to pay their respects to those who lost their lives.","translation":"許多人在國定假日參觀戰爭紀念碑，以向那些失去生命的人表示敬意。","explanation":"war memorial 指戰爭紀念碑。"}],"related_forms":["memory"]}

{"headword":"memorize","explanation":"動詞，意為「記憶、背誦」。注意拼字，美式拼法為 -ize。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students are often asked to <memorize> *vocabulary* words every day to improve their English reading and writing skills.","translation":"學生們經常被要求每天背誦單字，以提高他們的英語閱讀和寫作能力。","explanation":"memorize vocabulary 是學習常見活動。"},{"sentence":"It is difficult to <memorize> *the* entire speech in just one night, so you should start practicing as early as possible.","translation":"要在一個晚上背下整篇演講稿是很困難的，所以你應該儘早開始練習。","explanation":"memorize the speech 指背誦演講稿。"}],"related_forms":["memory"]}

{"headword":"merchant","explanation":"名詞，意為「商人」。多指從事批發或貿易的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <merchant> *sold* various goods to the local people and became quite wealthy after many years of hard work.","translation":"那位商人將各種商品賣給當地人，在多年辛勤工作後變得相當富有。","explanation":"merchant sold goods 是常見用法。"},{"sentence":"In the past, the ancient <merchant> *traveled* across the desert to trade silk and spices with other countries.","translation":"過去，那位古代商人穿越沙漠，與其他國家進行絲綢和香料的貿易。","explanation":"指古代貿易商人。"}],"related_forms":["merchandise"]}

{"headword":"mercy","explanation":"名詞，意為「仁慈、憐憫」。常用片語 at the mercy of (受...支配/任由...擺佈)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The judge showed <mercy> *to* the young thief because it was his first time breaking the law.","translation":"法官對那個年輕的小偷表現出仁慈，因為那是他第一次觸犯法律。","explanation":"show mercy to sb 是常見用法。"},{"sentence":"The small boat was *at* the <mercy> *of* the strong waves during the storm, and the sailors were very afraid.","translation":"暴風雨中，這艘小船任由強浪擺佈，水手們非常害怕。","explanation":"at the mercy of 是重要片語，意為「任由...擺佈」。"}],"related_forms":["merciful"]}

{"headword":"mere","explanation":"形容詞，意為「僅僅的、只不過是」。用於強調某事物的微不足道或單純。","entries":[{"sentence":"It took him a <mere> *five* minutes to finish the task that most people would spend an hour doing.","translation":"他只花了短短五分鐘就完成了大多數人需要花一小時才能做完的工作。","explanation":"a mere + 數字，強調時間短。"},{"sentence":"The problem is not a <mere> *matter* of money; it is also about how we treat our employees in the company.","translation":"這個問題不僅僅是錢的問題，還涉及我們在公司如何對待員工。","explanation":"a mere matter of 指不僅僅是...的問題。"}],"related_forms":["merely"]}

{"headword":"merit","explanation":"名詞，意為「優點、價值」。常用於討論某事物的長處。","entries":[{"sentence":"Every student has their own <merit>, and teachers should help them find their strengths and develop their potential.","translation":"每個學生都有自己的優點，老師應該幫助他們找到長處並發展潛力。","explanation":"指個人的優點。"},{"sentence":"The committee decided to *judge* the project based on its own <merit> *rather* than the popularity of the team members.","translation":"委員會決定根據專案本身的價值來評斷，而不是根據團隊成員的受歡迎程度。","explanation":"on its own merit 指根據其本身的價值。"}],"related_forms":["meritorious"]}

{"headword":"messenger","explanation":"指傳遞訊息的人或物。在現代語境中也常指通訊軟體（Messaging App）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient king sent a <messenger> to deliver a *secret message* to his allies in the distant kingdom.","translation":"古代國王派了一名信差將秘密訊息傳遞給他遙遠王國的盟友。","explanation":"名詞「信差/傳令者」。常用搭配 deliver a message。"},{"sentence":"Many teenagers use an online <messenger> to *keep in touch* with their classmates after the school day ends.","translation":"許多青少年使用線上通訊軟體在放學後與同學保持聯繫。","explanation":"現代用法，指即時通訊軟體（如Line, Facebook Messenger）。"}],"related_forms":["messages","messaging"]}

{"headword":"messy","explanation":"形容詞，意為「髒亂的、混亂的」。常用於形容環境或複雜的局面。","entries":[{"sentence":"His bedroom is always <messy> because he never puts his books and clothes *back in* their proper places.","translation":"他的臥室總是很髒亂，因為他從不把書和衣服放回原位。","explanation":"形容詞，指環境髒亂。"},{"sentence":"The breakup between the two famous stars became a very <messy> *public affair* involving many false rumors.","translation":"這兩位名星之間的分手演變成了一場混亂的公眾事件，涉及許多不實謠言。","explanation":"形容詞，指局面混亂、棘手。"}],"related_forms":["mess","messily","messiness"]}

{"headword":"microscope","explanation":"名詞，指「顯微鏡」。生物學相關考題常見詞彙。","entries":[{"sentence":"The science teacher asked students to *look through* the <microscope> to observe the *tiny cells* of an onion skin.","translation":"自然老師要求學生透過顯微鏡觀察洋蔥皮的微小細胞。","explanation":"名詞，指觀察微小事物的儀器。常用搭配 look through / under the microscope。"},{"sentence":"Under the powerful <microscope>, the *hidden bacteria* in the water became clearly visible to all the students.","translation":"在強力的顯微鏡下，水中的隱藏細菌對所有學生來說變得清晰可見。","explanation":"常用搭配 under the microscope 意為「在顯微鏡下」。"}],"related_forms":["microscopic"]}

{"headword":"mild","explanation":"形容詞，意為「溫和的、輕微的」。可用於天氣、個性、疾病或味道。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is a <mild> winter this year, so we do not need to wear *heavy coats* when walking outside.","translation":"今年是個溫和的冬天，所以我們在外面走的時候不需要穿厚重的大衣。","explanation":"形容天氣溫暖而不寒冷。"},{"sentence":"Although he had a <mild> *fever* last night, he feels much better and can go to school today.","translation":"雖然他昨晚發了輕微的燒，但他現在感覺好多了，今天可以去上學。","explanation":"形容疾病程度輕微。"},{"sentence":"She has a <mild> *personality* and never gets angry even when things go wrong at work.","translation":"她性格溫和，即使工作出錯時也從不生氣。","explanation":"形容個性溫和、脾氣好。"}],"related_forms":["mildly","mildness"]}

{"headword":"mill","explanation":"名詞指「工廠、磨坊」；動詞指「研磨、磨碎」。片語 mill around 意為「徘徊/漫無目的地走動」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old wind <mill> stands on the hill, reminding the villagers of the town's *long history* of farming.","translation":"這座古老的風車磨坊矗立在山丘上，提醒著村民們這個小鎮悠久的農業歷史。","explanation":"名詞，指磨坊或工廠。"},{"sentence":"The workers are busy <milling> the *raw wheat* into flour inside the large factory near the river.","translation":"工人們正忙著在河邊的大工廠裡將小麥原物料磨成麵粉。","explanation":"動詞，指磨碎。"},{"sentence":"Students were <milling> *around* the *school gate* while waiting for the results of the final exam to be posted.","translation":"學生們在校門口徘徊，等待期末考成績公布。","explanation":"片語 mill around 指人群在某處徘徊、無目的地走動。"}],"related_forms":["miller","milling"]}

{"headword":"millionaire","explanation":"名詞，指「百萬富翁」。","entries":[{"sentence":"After winning the lottery, the quiet teacher suddenly became a *self-made* <millionaire> and decided to travel the world.","translation":"贏得樂透後，這位安靜的老師突然成為了白手起家的百萬富翁，並決定環遊世界。","explanation":"名詞，指富有的人。"},{"sentence":"The young <millionaire> *donated* a large amount of money to help local children build a new library.","translation":"這位年輕的百萬富翁捐了一大筆錢，幫助當地兒童建立一座新圖書館。","explanation":"常用搭配 donate money to，形容詞常見 self-made (白手起家的)。"}],"related_forms":["million","millionth"]}

{"headword":"miner","explanation":"名詞，指「礦工」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <miner> spent all day *digging for* coal deep underground in the dark and dangerous tunnels.","translation":"礦工整天都在黑暗而危險的隧道深處挖掘煤炭。","explanation":"名詞，指從事採礦工作的人。常用搭配 dig for coal/gold。"},{"sentence":"Many <miners> *risked their lives* to ensure that the factory had enough resources to produce energy for the city.","translation":"許多礦工冒著生命危險，確保工廠有足夠的資源為城市生產能源。","explanation":"常用搭配 risk one's life 冒生命危險。"}],"related_forms":["mine","mining"]}

{"headword":"mineral","explanation":"名詞，指「礦物質、礦物」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Drinking enough water that contains *essential* <minerals> is important for keeping your body healthy and strong.","translation":"喝含有必需礦物質的水對於保持身體健康強壯很重要。","explanation":"名詞，指對身體有益的礦物質。常用搭配 essential minerals。"},{"sentence":"The science museum has a *large collection* of rare <minerals> from all over the world on display for visitors.","translation":"科學博物館展示了來自世界各地的大量稀有礦物，供遊客參觀。","explanation":"名詞，指天然礦物。"}],"related_forms":["mineralize"]}

{"headword":"minimum","explanation":"形容詞「最低限度的」；名詞「最低限度」。常見片語：at a minimum, minimum wage。","entries":[{"sentence":"You need a <minimum> *of* three years' experience to apply for this *job position* at the company.","translation":"你需要至少三年的經驗才能申請這家公司的這個職位。","explanation":"名詞用法，a minimum of... 意為「至少...」。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to *raise* the <minimum> *wage* to improve the living standards of workers in the country.","translation":"政府決定提高最低工資，以改善國內工人的生活水準。","explanation":"名詞用法，minimum wage 為固定搭配「最低工資」。"},{"sentence":"To pass the test, you must answer a <minimum> *number of* questions correctly within the time limit.","translation":"要通過考試，你必須在時限內正確回答最少數量的問題。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾名詞數量。"}],"related_forms":["minimal","minimize","minimally"]}

{"headword":"minister","explanation":"名詞，指「部長」（政府官員）或「牧師」。GSAT題目多指政府部門首長。","entries":[{"sentence":"The *Minister of Education* announced a new plan to *reduce* the amount of homework for high school students.","translation":"教育部長宣布了一項減少高中生作業量的新計畫。","explanation":"名詞，指政府部長。常搭配 Minister of + 部門名稱。"},{"sentence":"The church <minister> gave a *moving speech* to the people who were gathered there on Sunday morning.","translation":"教堂牧師對週日早上聚集在那裡的人們發表了感人的演講。","explanation":"名詞，指宗教領袖/牧師。"}],"related_forms":["ministry","ministerial"]}

{"headword":"ministry","explanation":"名詞「政府部門/部會」。通常指國家級行政部門，如 Ministry of Education（教育部）、Ministry of Foreign Affairs（外交部）。注意首字母通常大寫。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <Ministry> *of* Education announced a new policy to reduce the pressure of exams on high school students across the country.","translation":"教育部宣佈了一項新政策，以減輕全國高中生的考試壓力。","explanation":"指政府的「部」。常與介係詞 of 連用，且首字母需大寫。"},{"sentence":"After years of working in the <ministry>, the official decided to resign to spend more time with his aging parents.","translation":"在該部門工作多年後，這位官員決定辭職，以便有更多時間陪伴年邁的父母。","explanation":"指一般的政府部門機構。"}],"related_forms":["minister"]}

{"headword":"mischief","explanation":"名詞「惡作劇/胡鬧」。不可數名詞。常指孩子或年輕人為尋求樂趣而造成的輕微損害或麻煩，並非惡意犯罪。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children were full of <mischief> *during* the long summer vacation, often playing tricks on their neighbors for fun.","translation":"孩子們在漫長的暑假裡調皮搗蛋，常為了好玩而捉弄鄰居。","explanation":"be full of mischief 指充滿調皮搗蛋的活力。"},{"sentence":"Although the boy *caused* a bit of <mischief> *by* hiding his sister's toys, he didn't mean to hurt anyone's feelings.","translation":"雖然這個男孩藏起姐姐的玩具造成了一點小麻煩，但他並非有意傷害任何人的感情。","explanation":"cause mischief 為固定搭配，表示製造麻煩或惡作劇。"}],"related_forms":["mischievous"]}

{"headword":"miserable","explanation":"形容詞「痛苦的/悲慘的」。描述極度的不快樂、身體的不適或生活環境的惡劣。","entries":[{"sentence":"He felt absolutely <miserable> *after* failing the important math test, as he had studied very hard for it all week.","translation":"在重要的數學考試不及格後，他感到非常痛苦，因為他整個禮拜都為了考試努力讀書。","explanation":"形容心理上的痛苦或沮喪。"},{"sentence":"The homeless man spent a <miserable> *winter* night outside, shivering in the cold wind without any warm clothes.","translation":"那個無家可歸的人在戶外度過了一個悲慘的冬夜，在寒風中因沒有保暖衣物而發抖。","explanation":"形容環境或生活狀況的淒慘。"},{"sentence":"Living in a small, dark room with no windows made the poor student feel <miserable> *about* her daily life.","translation":"住在沒有窗戶的小暗房裡，讓那位貧窮的學生對她的日常生活感到很悲慘。","explanation":"常用 feel miserable about sth 表達對某事感到難過。"}],"related_forms":["miserably","misery"]}

{"headword":"misfortune","explanation":"名詞「不幸/災難」。指運氣不好導致的壞事或不幸的遭遇。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was his great <misfortune> *to* lose his wallet on the very first day of his trip to a foreign country.","translation":"他非常不幸，在出國旅行的第一天就弄丟了錢包。","explanation":"It is one's misfortune to... 是常見句型，表示某人不幸遭遇某事。"},{"sentence":"Despite the many *misfortunes* she faced in her youth, she never lost hope and eventually became a successful writer.","translation":"儘管她在年輕時面臨許多不幸，她從未失去希望，最終成為了一位成功的作家。","explanation":"misfortunes 可用複數，指多次不幸的事件。"},{"sentence":"We should show sympathy for those who suffer from the <misfortune> *of* losing their homes in natural disasters.","translation":"我們應該對那些在自然災害中失去家園而遭遇不幸的人表示同情。","explanation":"suffer from misfortune 表示遭受不幸。"}],"related_forms":["unfortunate"]}

{"headword":"mislead","explanation":"動詞「誤導」。指提供錯誤資訊或做出錯誤引導，使他人產生誤解。常用被動語態或 be misled by。","entries":[{"sentence":"The advertisement was designed to <mislead> *consumers* into believing that the product could cure all kinds of diseases.","translation":"這則廣告旨在誤導消費者，使他們相信該產品能治癒各種疾病。","explanation":"mislead sb into V-ing 是常見用法，指誤導某人去做某事。"},{"sentence":"Don't let the low price <mislead> *you*; the quality of this cheap camera is actually very poor.","translation":"別讓低價誤導了你；這台廉價相機的品質其實非常差。","explanation":"let sb mislead you 結構。"},{"sentence":"The students were <misled> *by* the rumors on the internet and started a protest based on false information.","translation":"學生們被網路上的謠言誤導，並基於錯誤的資訊發起了抗議。","explanation":"be misled by 為被動語態用法，指被某事物誤導。"}],"related_forms":["misled","misleading"]}

{"headword":"misunderstand","explanation":"動詞「誤解」。指因為溝通不良或資訊偏差而對人或事產生錯誤理解。","entries":[{"sentence":"I think you <misunderstood> *my* point; I was actually trying to support your idea, not criticize it.","translation":"我想你誤解了我的觀點；我其實是想支持你的想法，而不是批評它。","explanation":"misunderstand one's point 指誤解某人的意思。"},{"sentence":"It is very easy to <misunderstand> *someone's* tone in a short text message since there is no facial expression.","translation":"在簡訊中，由於缺乏表情，很容易誤解他人的語氣。","explanation":"指透過簡訊等溝通媒介容易產生誤解。"},{"sentence":"Please don't <misunderstand> *me*, but I think we need to change our plan to make it work better.","translation":"請不要誤解我的意思，但我認為我們需要改變計畫，讓它運作得更好。","explanation":"Don't misunderstand me 是常見的口語片語，用於澄清意圖。"}],"related_forms":["misunderstood","misunderstanding"]}

{"headword":"moderate","explanation":"形容詞「適度的/中等的」。指在程度、數量或強度上不極端。也可當動詞表示「節制/緩和」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor suggested that we take <moderate> *exercise* every day to keep our hearts healthy and strong.","translation":"醫生建議我們每天進行適度的運動，以保持心臟健康強壯。","explanation":"moderate exercise 是常見搭配，指適度運動。"},{"sentence":"The hotel charges a <moderate> *price* for its rooms, making it a good choice for students on a budget.","translation":"這家旅館的房價適中，對於預算有限的學生來說是一個不錯的選擇。","explanation":"moderate price 指價格合理、中等。"},{"sentence":"We need to <moderate> *our* demands during the negotiation so that both sides can reach an agreement.","translation":"我們需要在談判中緩和我們的要求，以便雙方都能達成協議。","explanation":"此處當動詞用，指緩和、減低強度。"}],"related_forms":["moderation"]}

{"headword":"modest","explanation":"形容詞「謙虛的/適度的/樸素的」。指不愛誇耀自己，或指數量、規模不大。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite his great success in business, the billionaire remained very <modest> *about* his achievements and rarely talked about himself.","translation":"儘管他在商業上取得了巨大的成功，這位億萬富翁對自己的成就依然保持謙虛，很少談論自己。","explanation":"modest about sth 表示對某事謙虛。"},{"sentence":"The family lives in a <modest> *house* on the edge of town, but they are very happy with their simple life.","translation":"這家人住在鎮邊一棟樸素的房子裡，但他們對這種簡單的生活感到非常快樂。","explanation":"modest house 指規模不大、樸素的房子。"},{"sentence":"She made a <modest> *contribution* to the charity, but it was all the money she could spare this month.","translation":"她對慈善機構做出了一點點貢獻，但那已經是她這個月能省下的所有錢了。","explanation":"modest contribution 指數量適度、不算多的捐獻。"}],"related_forms":["modesty"]}

{"headword":"modesty","explanation":"名詞「謙虛/端莊」。指一種不過分誇耀自己的品德，或指行為舉止合乎禮儀。","entries":[{"sentence":"His <modesty> *is* well-known among his colleagues, as he always shares the credit for his work with his team.","translation":"他的謙虛在同事間很有名，因為他總是與團隊分享工作功勞。","explanation":"名詞用法，指謙虛的特質。"},{"sentence":"She accepted the award with great <modesty>, thanking everyone who had helped her along the way.","translation":"她非常謙虛地接受了這個獎項，並感謝了一路幫助她的人。","explanation":"with modesty 是常見搭配，表示以謙虛的態度。"}],"related_forms":["modest"]}

{"headword":"monitor","explanation":"名詞「螢幕/班長」；動詞「監控/監測」。指觀察某事物的進展或螢幕設備。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientists need to <monitor> *the* temperature of the water closely to see how the climate change affects the fish.","translation":"科學家們需要密切監控水溫，以觀察氣候變遷如何影響魚類。","explanation":"動詞用法，指監控、持續觀察。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the class <monitor> *to* help clean the blackboard after the history class ended.","translation":"老師請班長在歷史課結束後幫忙擦黑板。","explanation":"名詞用法，在校園情境中指班長。"},{"sentence":"Please keep your eyes on the computer <monitor> *while* you are typing the report for your manager.","translation":"當你為經理打報告時，請盯著電腦螢幕看。","explanation":"名詞用法，指顯示器/螢幕。"},{"sentence":"The health department will continue to <monitor> *the* spread of the virus to ensure the safety of the public.","translation":"衛生部門將繼續監測病毒的傳播，以確保公眾的安全。","explanation":"動詞用法，指監測疫情發展。"}],"related_forms":["monitors","monitoring"]}

{"headword":"monument","explanation":"名詞「紀念碑、紀念館」。常與介係詞 to 連用（如：a monument to the hero）。也可引申為「歷史遺跡」或「不朽的成就」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city built a tall stone <monument> *to* the soldiers who fought bravely in the war many years ago.","translation":"這座城市為多年前在戰爭中英勇作戰的士兵建立了一座高大的石碑。","explanation":"monument to sb/sth 是常見結構，指「為紀念某人/某事而建的紀念碑」。"},{"sentence":"This ancient palace stands as a <monument> *to* the incredible skills of the architects from the Ming Dynasty.","translation":"這座古老的宮殿是明朝建築師精湛技藝的見證（紀念碑）。","explanation":"引申用法：a monument to sth 指「...的見證/象徵」。"}],"related_forms":["monumental"]}

{"headword":"moreover","explanation":"連接副詞，表「此外、而且」。用於增加額外資訊，連接兩個獨立句子。比 furthermore 或 in addition 更強調「更重要的是」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new restaurant offers delicious food at a low price; <moreover>, the staff there *are* very *friendly* to every customer.","translation":"這家新餐廳提供美味且價格低廉的食物；此外，那裡的員工對每位顧客都非常友善。","explanation":"moreover 用於句首，後接逗號，用來補充說明前面的正面評價。"},{"sentence":"Regular exercise can improve your health significantly; <moreover>, it *helps* you *reduce* stress after a busy day at school.","translation":"規律運動能顯著改善你的健康；此外，它能幫助你在忙碌的學校生活後減輕壓力。","explanation":"用於連接兩個相關論點，moreover 前面通常有分號或句點。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"motivate","explanation":"動詞「激勵、給予動機」。常見句型為 motivate sb to do sth。注意與 inspire 的區別，motivate 較強調產生行動的動力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher tried to <motivate> all the students *to* *participate* in the science project by offering extra credit.","translation":"老師試圖透過提供額外加分來激勵所有學生參與科學專題。","explanation":"motivate sb to do sth 為必考句型。"},{"sentence":"Sometimes, small rewards are enough to <motivate> teenagers *to* *finish* their homework on time without being told.","translation":"有時，小獎勵足以激勵青少年在沒有被告知的情況下準時完成作業。","explanation":"動詞用法，後接不定詞詞組，說明激勵的目標動作。"}],"related_forms":["motivation","motivating","motivated"]}

{"headword":"motivation","explanation":"名詞「動機、動力」。常搭配 lack (缺乏) 或 have (擁有) 動力。固定搭配為 motivation for/to do sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"Winning the competition gave her enough <motivation> *to* *study* harder and achieve her goal of becoming an athlete.","translation":"贏得比賽給了她足夠的動力去更努力學習，並達成成為運動員的目標。","explanation":"motivation to do sth 是常見的搭配，表示「做某事的動力」。"},{"sentence":"The main <motivation> *behind* his decision to move to the countryside was his desire for a peaceful life.","translation":"他決定搬到鄉下的主要動機是他對平靜生活的渴望。","explanation":"motivation behind sth 表示「某事背後的動機」。"}],"related_forms":["motivate","motivational"]}

{"headword":"mountainous","explanation":"形容詞「多山的、巨大的」。(1) 地理上形容地形多山；(2) 引申為數量或體積巨大（如：a mountainous pile of work）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <mountainous> region *in* the north of the country is famous for its beautiful scenery and fresh air.","translation":"該國北部多山的地區以美麗的風景和清新的空氣而聞名。","explanation":"形容地形，mountainous region 是標準用法。"},{"sentence":"After the long vacation, the student *faced* a <mountainous> *pile* of homework that needed to be finished by tomorrow.","translation":"長假過後，這名學生面對著堆積如山、必須在明天前完成的作業。","explanation":"引申用法，形容數量巨大，常與 pile 或 task 搭配。"}],"related_forms":["mountain"]}

{"headword":"muddy","explanation":"形容詞「泥濘的」。用於形容路面、鞋子或天氣。注意與 dirt/dirty 的區別，muddy 特指有泥漿的。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please *take* *off* your <muddy> boots before you enter the living room to keep the floor clean.","translation":"在你進入客廳前請脫掉你沾滿泥巴的靴子，以保持地板乾淨。","explanation":"形容物品沾滿泥巴，常與 take off 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The hiking trail became very <muddy> *after* the heavy rain, making it difficult for the group to walk safely.","translation":"大雨過後登山步道變得很泥濘，使得這群人很難安全行走。","explanation":"形容地形或路面，常與 after rain 連結。"}],"related_forms":["mud"]}

{"headword":"mule","explanation":"名詞「騾子」。(1) 動物騾子；(2) 引申為「頑固的人」（stubborn as a mule）；(3) 俚語指非法運毒的「運毒者」。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the past, farmers used a <mule> *to* *carry* heavy bags of rice up the steep hill to the market.","translation":"過去，農夫會用騾子將沉重的米袋運上陡峭的山坡到市場。","explanation":"最基礎的動物義，強調其負重能力。"},{"sentence":"Don't be *as* stubborn *as* a <mule>; you should listen to your friends' advice once in a while.","translation":"別像騾子一樣固執；你偶爾也該聽聽朋友的建議。","explanation":"慣用語 stubborn as a mule，形容人非常固執。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"multiple","explanation":"形容詞「多個的、多種的」。指數量或種類繁多，常與 choice, reasons 等詞連用。注意與 many 的區別，multiple 更強調「複合性」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company decided to *take* <multiple> *factors* into account before building a new factory in this small town.","translation":"公司決定在小鎮建新工廠前，將多項因素納入考量。","explanation":"multiple factors 是常見搭配，表示多方面的考量。"},{"sentence":"She *suffered* *from* <multiple> *injuries* in the car accident and had to stay in the hospital for a long time.","translation":"她在車禍中身受多處傷害，不得不長時間住院。","explanation":"multiple injuries 常見於新聞或醫療敘述，指多處受傷。"}],"related_forms":["multiply","multiplication"]}

{"headword":"murderer","explanation":"名詞「殺人犯」。與 murder (謀殺) 相關。注意與 killer 的區別，murderer 特指犯下「謀殺罪」的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police *finally* *caught* the <murderer> after searching for clues in the city for over two weeks.","translation":"警方在城市中搜尋線索兩週多後，終於抓到了那名殺人犯。","explanation":"catch the murderer 是常見的犯罪新聞動詞搭配。"},{"sentence":"The novel tells a story about a detective who *hunts* *down* a <murderer> hiding in a small, quiet village.","translation":"這部小說講述了一位偵探追捕躲在寧靜小村莊裡的殺人犯的故事。","explanation":"hunt down 常用於形容追捕罪犯。"}],"related_forms":["murder"]}

{"headword":"murmur","explanation":"動詞/名詞「低語、私下抱怨」。指聲音小而模糊的說話聲。常搭配介係詞 to 或 in。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students *began* *to* <murmur> *among* themselves when the teacher announced that there would be a surprise test.","translation":"當老師宣布有突擊測驗時，學生們開始私下竊竊私語。","explanation":"murmur among themselves 指在人群中私下低聲討論/抱怨。"},{"sentence":"She could hear the soft <murmur> *of* the ocean waves as she fell asleep in her room by the beach.","translation":"當她在海邊的房間入睡時，她能聽到海洋波浪輕柔的低語聲。","explanation":"名詞用法，形容聲音輕柔如低語，常與 of 連用。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"mutual","explanation":"形容詞「相互的、彼此的」。(1) 常見 collocations: mutual understanding, mutual respect, mutual benefit。(2) 易錯：不可混淆為互相幫助的「一起做」，它強調的是兩方對於彼此都有相同的感覺或行為。","entries":[{"sentence":"After working together for several years, the colleagues developed a *sense* *of* <mutual> trust and respect that improved their productivity.","translation":"在共事幾年後，同事們建立了相互信任與尊重的感覺，這提升了他們的工作效率。","explanation":"mutual trust/respect 是常見搭配，形容雙方都有此感受。"},{"sentence":"The two countries signed a trade agreement for <mutual> *benefit*, aiming to boost their economies and create more job opportunities for their citizens.","translation":"兩國簽署了一項互利貿易協定，旨在促進經濟並為公民創造更多就業機會。","explanation":"mutual benefit 指雙方皆可獲益。"},{"sentence":"Although they had different opinions at first, they reached a <mutual> *agreement* after discussing the project details for a long time.","translation":"儘管起初意見不同，但在長時間討論專案細節後，他們達成了共識。","explanation":"mutual agreement 表示雙方共同同意某事。"}],"related_forms":["mutually"]}

{"headword":"mysterious","explanation":"形容詞「神秘的、不可思議的」。(1) 常修飾名詞如 disappearance, case, figure, behavior。(2) 常用字根 myst- (神秘)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police are still investigating the <mysterious> *disappearance* of the famous painting from the local art museum last night.","translation":"警方仍在調查昨晚這幅名畫從當地美術館神秘失蹤的案件。","explanation":"mysterious disappearance 是常見搭配，形容原因不明的失蹤。"},{"sentence":"A <mysterious> *figure* was seen wandering around the old mansion in the middle of the night, frightening the neighbors nearby.","translation":"半夜有人看到一個神秘的身影在老宅附近徘徊，嚇壞了附近的鄰居。","explanation":"mysterious figure 用來指身分不明或看起來怪異的人。"},{"sentence":"The scientist discovered a <mysterious> *signal* from deep space, but she could not explain where it came from or what it meant.","translation":"科學家發現了一個來自深空的神秘訊號，但她無法解釋它來自何處或代表什麼意義。","explanation":"形容無法用科學或邏輯解釋的事物。"}],"related_forms":["mystery","mysteriousness"]}

{"headword":"namely","explanation":"副詞「即、也就是說」。(1) 用於引出具體說明或清單。(2) 常見於學術寫作或正式報告。(3) 語法功能類似 that is (to say)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Only one person was missing from the meeting, <namely> *the* *manager*, who had to attend another urgent conference in Taipei.","translation":"會議上只有一個人缺席，也就是經理，他必須參加在台北舉行的另一場緊急會議。","explanation":"用於進一步澄清缺席者是誰。"},{"sentence":"The company has two major goals for this year, <namely> *increasing* sales revenue and improving customer satisfaction in the international market.","translation":"公司今年有兩個主要目標，即增加銷售收入以及提升國際市場的客戶滿意度。","explanation":"用 namely 引出兩個具體目標。"}],"related_forms":["name"]}

{"headword":"nationality","explanation":"名詞「國籍」。(1) 問國籍常見問法：What is your nationality? 或 What country are you from? (2) 常與 country, person 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"When filling out the form at the hotel, you are required to state your name, date of birth, and <nationality> *for* security reasons.","translation":"在飯店填寫表格時，基於安全理由，你需要填寫姓名、出生日期和國籍。","explanation":"在機場或飯店登記時，nationality 是必填資訊。"},{"sentence":"The international school welcomes students of every <nationality>, encouraging them to share their unique cultures and learn from one another.","translation":"這所國際學校歡迎來自各國籍的學生，鼓勵他們分享獨特的文化並互相學習。","explanation":"every nationality 強調多元背景。"}],"related_forms":["national","nation"]}

{"headword":"needy","explanation":"形容詞「貧窮的、需要幫助的」。(1) 指缺乏生活必需品的人。(2) 現代用法也可用於形容人情感上「需要依賴他人的」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The charity organization works hard to provide food and clothes to <needy> *families* who lost their homes during the recent earthquake.","translation":"該慈善組織努力為在最近地震中失去家園的貧困家庭提供食物和衣服。","explanation":"needy families 是常見搭配，指經濟弱勢家庭。"},{"sentence":"Many volunteers spent their weekends helping <needy> *children* in remote villages gain better access to education and medical resources.","translation":"許多志工利用週末幫助偏鄉地區需要幫助的孩子，讓他們能獲得更好的教育和醫療資源。","explanation":"needy children 指處境困難、需要幫助的孩童。"}],"related_forms":["need","needless"]}

{"headword":"neglect","explanation":"動詞「忽視、疏忽」；名詞「疏忽、怠慢」。(1) 動詞常接 V-ing 或名詞。(2) 易混淆：與 ignore 略有不同，ignore 是「故意不理」，neglect 較常指「未盡到照顧責任」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Parents should not <neglect> *their* *children's* education, as it plays a crucial role in shaping their future success and personal development.","translation":"父母不應忽視孩子的教育，因為這對塑造他們未來的成功和個人發展至關重要。","explanation":"neglect one's duty/education 表示未盡到責任。"},{"sentence":"The garden was full of weeds because the owner had <neglected> *to* *water* the plants for several weeks during the hot summer.","translation":"花園裡長滿了雜草，因為主人在炎熱的夏天裡已經好幾週疏忽了澆水。","explanation":"neglect to V 表示「疏忽而忘了做某事」。"},{"sentence":"The old building collapsed due to years of <neglect> *and* lack of maintenance, posing a serious danger to people walking nearby.","translation":"這棟舊建築因多年的疏忽和缺乏維護而倒塌，對附近的行人構成了嚴重威脅。","explanation":"名詞用法，指長期的無人照料。"}],"related_forms":["neglected","negligence"]}

{"headword":"negotiate","explanation":"動詞「談判、協商」。(1) 常見搭配：negotiate with sb, negotiate a deal/contract。(2) 談判結果通常用 reach an agreement。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is trying to <negotiate> *a* *new* trade deal with neighboring countries to lower tariffs and boost the economy.","translation":"政府正試圖與鄰國協商一項新的貿易協定，以降低關稅並促進經濟。","explanation":"negotiate a deal 指透過談判達成協議。"},{"sentence":"Labor unions are <negotiating> *with* the management to secure better working conditions and higher wages for all factory workers.","translation":"工會正在與管理層談判，為所有工廠工人爭取更好的工作條件和更高的薪資。","explanation":"negotiate with sb 是常見用法，指雙方協商。"}],"related_forms":["negotiation","negotiator"]}

{"headword":"nevertheless","explanation":"副詞「儘管如此、然而」。(1) 用於連接兩個句子，表示轉折。(2) 比 however 更正式，常置於句首或句中。","entries":[{"sentence":"The experiment did not produce the expected results; <nevertheless>, the researchers learned a lot about the chemical reactions involved.","translation":"實驗並沒有產生預期的結果；儘管如此，研究人員對於其中涉及的化學反應學到了很多。","explanation":"用於轉折語氣，表示雖然失敗，但仍有收穫。"},{"sentence":"The weather was terrible, and the road was blocked. <Nevertheless>, the team decided to continue their journey to the mountain peak.","translation":"天氣很糟糕，道路也被封鎖了。儘管如此，團隊還是決定繼續前往山頂的旅程。","explanation":"置於句首，強調即便在困難情況下仍堅持。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"nightmare","explanation":"名詞「惡夢」。(1) 可指睡夢中的惡夢，也可比喻「令人極度痛苦或困擾的經歷/狀況」。","entries":[{"sentence":"I had a terrible <nightmare> *about* being chased by a wild animal, and I woke up feeling very scared in the middle of the night.","translation":"我做了一個被野生動物追趕的可怕惡夢，半夜醒來時感到非常害怕。","explanation":"nightmare about sth 是常見表達。"},{"sentence":"Traveling without a map in a foreign country can be a <nightmare>, especially when you do not speak the local language.","translation":"在國外沒有地圖旅遊可能是一場惡夢，特別是當你不會說當地語言時。","explanation":"比喻用法，形容令人困擾的災難性狀況。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"noble","explanation":"形容詞「高貴的、崇高的」；名詞「貴族」。(1) 形容詞常用於描述人的品格或動機 (noble cause/goal)。(2) 也可指外表或身分高貴。","entries":[{"sentence":"The charity foundation was founded for a <noble> *cause*, which is to provide clean water to people living in poverty-stricken areas.","translation":"該慈善基金會是為了崇高的目標而成立，即為居住在貧困地區的人們提供乾淨的水。","explanation":"noble cause 指崇高的事業或目標。"},{"sentence":"He made a <noble> *sacrifice* to save his friends from the fire, putting his own life at great risk.","translation":"為了從火場中救出朋友，他做出了崇高的犧牲，將自己的生命置於極大的危險之中。","explanation":"noble sacrifice 形容犧牲行為的高尚。"}],"related_forms":["nobility","nobly"]}

{"headword":"nonsense","explanation":"名詞「胡說八道、無意義的事」。常搭配動詞 talk, speak 等。注意不可數名詞，不可說 a nonsense，若要指一件荒謬的事，可用 a piece of nonsense。","entries":[{"sentence":"The politician's claim that taxes would disappear overnight is absolute <nonsense>, and most voters know it.","translation":"那位政治人物聲稱稅收會在一夜之間消失，這絕對是胡說八道，大多數選民都知道這一點。","explanation":"形容某種說法荒謬、不可信。常用搭配 absolute nonsense。"},{"sentence":"Stop listening to his <nonsense> and focus on your studies; he is just trying to distract you from the exam.","translation":"別再聽他的胡言亂語了，專注於你的學業；他只是想讓你分心，無法準備考試。","explanation":"指無意義的談話或廢話。listen to nonsense 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["senseless"]}

{"headword":"nowadays","explanation":"副詞「現今、時下」。常用於句首或句尾，指與過去不同的現代情況。注意它是副詞，不可當形容詞使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"<Nowadays>, many teenagers prefer to communicate through social media apps rather than meeting in person.","translation":"現今，許多青少年更喜歡透過社群媒體應用程式溝通，而不是面對面見面。","explanation":"用於句首強調當前趨勢。often used to contrast with the past."},{"sentence":"It is much easier to travel between countries <nowadays> because of the rapid development of low-cost airlines.","translation":"由於廉價航空的快速發展，現今在不同國家間旅行容易多了。","explanation":"用於句尾說明現今狀況。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"nuclear","explanation":"形容詞「核子的、原子核的」。常用於核能議題 (nuclear power/energy) 或武器 (nuclear weapons)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is debating whether to continue using <nuclear> *power* as a main source of electricity for the country.","translation":"政府正在辯論是否繼續使用核能作為該國的主要電力來源。","explanation":"nuclear power 為固定用法，指核能發電。"},{"sentence":"Many scientists are concerned about the risks associated with the storage of <nuclear> *waste* from power plants.","translation":"許多科學家對於發電廠核廢料儲存相關的風險感到擔憂。","explanation":"nuclear waste 指核廢料，為常見議題詞彙。"}],"related_forms":["nucleus"]}

{"headword":"numerous","explanation":"形容詞「許多的、極多的」。比 many 更具強調數量之多。後接複數可數名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student has received <numerous> *awards* for her excellent performance in the national science competition.","translation":"那位學生因為在全國科學競賽中的優異表現，獲得了無數獎項。","explanation":"numerous awards 為常見搭配，強調數量很多。"},{"sentence":"There are <numerous> *reasons* why people choose to live in the city, including better job opportunities and entertainment.","translation":"人們選擇住在城市的原因有很多，包括更好的工作機會和娛樂。","explanation":"numerous reasons 為常見搭配，後接複數名詞。"}],"related_forms":["number","numerical"]}

{"headword":"nursery","explanation":"名詞「托兒所、育嬰室」。也可指「苗圃」(培育幼苗的地方)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Both parents work full-time, so they decided to send their toddler to a local <nursery> during the day.","translation":"父母雙方都全職工作，所以他們決定白天將幼兒送到當地的托兒所。","explanation":"指照顧幼兒的場所。"},{"sentence":"We visited a flower <nursery> yesterday to buy some fresh plants for our small balcony garden.","translation":"我們昨天參觀了一間花卉苗圃，為我們的小陽台花園買了一些新鮮植物。","explanation":"指培育植物的場所。"}],"related_forms":["nurse","nursing"]}

{"headword":"nutritious","explanation":"形容詞「有營養的」。注意拼字，中間有 'i'。常用於描述食物或飲食習慣。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is important to eat a <nutritious> *breakfast* every day to provide your body with the energy it needs.","translation":"每天吃一份有營養的早餐對提供身體所需的能量很重要。","explanation":"nutritious breakfast 為常見健康相關搭配。"},{"sentence":"Fruits and vegetables are highly <nutritious> *foods* that can help boost your immune system effectively.","translation":"水果和蔬菜是非常有營養的食物，可以有效地幫助增強你的免疫系統。","explanation":"形容食物具備高營養價值。"}],"related_forms":["nutrition","nutrient"]}

{"headword":"obedience","explanation":"名詞「服從、遵守」。動詞為 obey。常用於訓練寵物或遵守規則、權威。","entries":[{"sentence":"The dog trainer emphasized that <obedience> is the most important skill for a well-behaved family pet.","translation":"訓犬師強調服從是乖巧的家庭寵物最重要的技能。","explanation":"指順從的行為或特質。"},{"sentence":"Soldiers are trained to show strict <obedience> *to* their commanders during military operations.","translation":"士兵在軍事行動期間被訓練要對指揮官表現出嚴格的服從。","explanation":"obedience to sb/sth 為常見固定搭配。"}],"related_forms":["obey","obedient"]}

{"headword":"obedient","explanation":"形容詞「服從的、順從的」。指人或動物願意聽從指示。注意拼字，結尾是 -ient。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <obedient> *student* followed all the teacher's instructions carefully during the science experiment.","translation":"那位聽話的學生在科學實驗過程中小心地遵守了老師所有的指示。","explanation":"形容學生聽從教導。"},{"sentence":"She has an <obedient> *dog* that always sits and waits when she gives the command.","translation":"她有一隻聽話的狗，當她下指令時，牠總是坐著等待。","explanation":"常用於形容寵物或孩子聽話。"}],"related_forms":["obey","obedience"]}

{"headword":"objection","explanation":"名詞「反對、異議」。常用搭配 have an objection to sth 或 raise an objection。","entries":[{"sentence":"Does anyone have any <objection> *to* the plan, or are we all ready to start the project now?","translation":"有人對這個計畫有任何反對意見嗎？還是我們現在都準備好開始這個專案了？","explanation":"have objection to sth 為固定搭配，介係詞用 to。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer raised a strong <objection> *to* the witness's statement because it was based on rumors, not facts.","translation":"律師對證人的證詞提出了強烈反對，因為它是基於傳聞而非事實。","explanation":"raise an objection (to) 為法律或正式場合常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["object"]}

{"headword":"objective","explanation":"名詞「目標、目的」；形容詞「客觀的」。名詞用法常與 goal 或 aim 互換；形容詞用法常與 subjective (主觀的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The main <objective> *of* this training program is to improve the communication skills of all new employees.","translation":"這個培訓計畫的主要目標是提升所有新進員工的溝通技巧。","explanation":"名詞用法，指目標。objective of sth 為常見用法。"},{"sentence":"When writing a news report, it is essential for journalists to remain <objective> and avoid letting personal opinions influence the story.","translation":"撰寫新聞報導時，記者保持客觀並避免讓個人意見影響報導內容是至關重要的。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指客觀的。常用搭配 remain objective。"}],"related_forms":["object"]}

{"headword":"observation","explanation":"名詞，意為「觀察」或「觀察結果」。常用搭配包含 make an observation (進行觀察)、close/careful observation (細心的觀察)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist made a *careful* <observation> *of* the bird's behavior in the wild to understand its nesting habits.","translation":"科學家對野外鳥類的行為進行了仔細的觀察，以了解其築巢習性。","explanation":"名詞「觀察」。形容詞 careful 常與 observation 搭配。"},{"sentence":"Based *on* my <observation>, the students in this class prefer working in groups rather than studying alone.","translation":"根據我的觀察，這班的學生比較喜歡小組合作，而不是獨自學習。","explanation":"名詞「觀察結果」。片語 based on my observation 很常用。"},{"sentence":"Detailed <observation> *of* the stars is easier when you move away from the bright city lights at night.","translation":"當你在晚上遠離明亮的城市燈光時，對星星的詳細觀察會變得更容易。","explanation":"名詞「觀測/觀察」。形容詞 detailed 常修飾 observation。"}],"related_forms":["observe","observer"]}

{"headword":"obstacle","explanation":"名詞，意為「障礙」或「阻礙」。常用搭配有 face/overcome an obstacle (面對/克服障礙)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Lack of experience is a *major* <obstacle> *to* finding a good job, so many students look for internships.","translation":"缺乏經驗是找到好工作的主要障礙，所以許多學生會尋找實習機會。","explanation":"名詞「障礙」。major obstacle 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"He managed *to* <overcome> every <obstacle> *in* his path and finally achieved his dream of becoming a doctor.","translation":"他設法克服了路上的每一個障礙，最終實現了成為醫生的夢想。","explanation":"動詞 overcome 與 obstacle 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The heavy traffic was a *significant* <obstacle> *for* us, so we arrived at the concert ten minutes late.","translation":"沉重的交通對我們來說是一個巨大的障礙，所以我們遲到了十分鐘才到達音樂會現場。","explanation":"名詞「阻礙」。significant 修飾 obstacle 強調程度。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"obtain","explanation":"動詞，意為「獲得」或「取得」。比 get 更正式。常用搭配：obtain permission, obtain information。","entries":[{"sentence":"You need *to* <obtain> *written permission* from your parents before you can join the school's mountain climbing trip.","translation":"在參加學校的登山活動之前，你需要獲得父母的書面許可。","explanation":"動詞「獲得」。obtain permission 是常見用法。"},{"sentence":"It is often difficult *to* <obtain> *accurate information* *on* the internet because there are so many fake news stories.","translation":"在網路上取得正確資訊通常很困難，因為有太多假新聞報導。","explanation":"動詞「取得」。obtain accurate information 是重要搭配。"},{"sentence":"After years of hard work, she was finally able *to* <obtain> a *master's degree* from a top university.","translation":"經過多年的努力，她終於能夠從頂尖大學獲得碩士學位。","explanation":"動詞「獲得（學位）」。"}],"related_forms":["obtainment"]}

{"headword":"occasional","explanation":"形容詞，意為「偶爾的」或「非經常的」。注意此字不作副詞用，副詞為 occasionally。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite his busy schedule, he makes an <occasional> *visit* *to* his grandparents in the countryside on weekends.","translation":"儘管行程繁忙，他週末還是會偶爾去鄉下探望祖父母。","explanation":"形容詞「偶爾的」。occasional visit 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"We can expect <occasional> *showers* *throughout* the afternoon, so please remember to bring your umbrella.","translation":"我們預計整個下午會有偶爾的陣雨，所以請記得帶傘。","explanation":"形容詞「偶爾的」。occasional showers 是天氣描述常見用法。"},{"sentence":"Though she enjoys city life, she has an <occasional> *need* *for* peace and quiet in the mountains.","translation":"雖然她喜歡城市生活，但她偶爾還是需要山裡的寧靜。","explanation":"形容詞「偶爾的」。"}],"related_forms":["occasion","occasionally"]}

{"headword":"occupation","explanation":"名詞，意為(1)職業 (2)佔領。需透過上下文區分這兩個截然不同的意義。","entries":[{"sentence":"When asked about his *future* <occupation>, the teenager replied that he wanted to be a pilot.","translation":"當被問及未來的職業時，這名青少年回答他想成為一名飛行員。","explanation":"名詞「職業」。future occupation 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The history book describes the *long military* <occupation> *of* the country during the second world war.","translation":"這本歷史書描述了第二次世界大戰期間該國長期的軍事佔領。","explanation":"名詞「佔領」。military occupation 是特定用法。"},{"sentence":"Choosing a *suitable* <occupation> requires careful thought about your personal interests and your special skills.","translation":"選擇一個合適的職業需要仔細思考你的個人興趣和特殊技能。","explanation":"名詞「職業」。"},{"sentence":"The island was *under foreign* <occupation> *for* many years before it finally gained independence in the twentieth century.","translation":"這座島嶼在二十世紀終於獲得獨立之前，已經被外國佔領多年。","explanation":"名詞「佔領」。under occupation 為常見片語。"}],"related_forms":["occupy"]}

{"headword":"occupy","explanation":"動詞，意為(1)佔領 (2)佔用（空間或時間）。be occupied with (忙於...) 為常用片語。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students <occupied> *all* the *seats* in the library, so there was no place left for newcomers to sit.","translation":"學生們佔滿了圖書館所有的座位，所以沒有地方留給後來的人坐。","explanation":"動詞「佔用」。"},{"sentence":"The enemy troops <occupied> the small village *by* force, forcing the local people to leave their homes.","translation":"敵軍以武力佔領了這個小村莊，強迫當地人離開家園。","explanation":"動詞「佔領」。"},{"sentence":"She is currently <occupied> *with* preparing for the final exam, so she cannot go to the movies tonight.","translation":"她目前忙於準備期末考，所以今晚不能去看電影。","explanation":"動詞「使忙碌」。be occupied with 為必考片語。"},{"sentence":"This project <occupies> *most* of my *time* during the week, leaving me very little room for hobbies.","translation":"這個專案佔據了我週間大部分的時間，讓我幾乎沒有空間進行愛好。","explanation":"動詞「佔據（時間）」。"}],"related_forms":["occupation"]}

{"headword":"offend","explanation":"動詞，意為「冒犯」或「得罪」。注意用法為 offend + 人。","entries":[{"sentence":"He did not mean *to* <offend> *anyone*, but his joke about the teacher was clearly in bad taste.","translation":"他並不是故意要冒犯任何人，但他關於老師的玩笑顯然很不妥當。","explanation":"動詞「冒犯」。"},{"sentence":"If you speak too loudly in the library, you will *likely* <offend> other students who are trying to study.","translation":"如果你在圖書館大聲說話，你很可能會冒犯到其他正在努力讀書的學生。","explanation":"動詞「冒犯」。"},{"sentence":"It is easy *to* <offend> *people* if you do not understand the cultural differences in a foreign country.","translation":"如果你不了解外國的文化差異，很容易得罪人。","explanation":"動詞「得罪」。"}],"related_forms":["offense","offensive"]}

{"headword":"offense","explanation":"名詞，意為(1)冒犯 (2)罪行 (3)攻擊（運動賽事中）。take offense at (對...感到冒犯) 為常見片語。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please do not <take> *offense* *at* my suggestion; I am only trying to help you improve your work.","translation":"請不要對我的建議感到冒犯；我只是想幫助你改進工作。","explanation":"名詞「冒犯」。take offense at 為固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"Driving without a valid license is a *serious criminal* <offense> *in* almost every country in the world.","translation":"無照駕駛在世界上幾乎每個國家都是嚴重的刑事犯罪。","explanation":"名詞「罪行」。criminal offense 是法律常見用語。"},{"sentence":"The coach decided *to* strengthen the team's <offense> *by* adding two fast players to the starting lineup.","translation":"教練決定透過增加兩名速度快的球員到先發陣容中，來加強球隊的攻擊力。","explanation":"名詞「攻擊」。在運動賽事中常與 defense 相對。"},{"sentence":"His rude comments *caused* great <offense> *among* the guests at the dinner party last night.","translation":"他粗魯的評論在昨晚的晚宴上引起了賓客們極大的不滿。","explanation":"名詞「冒犯」。cause offense 為固定用法。"}],"related_forms":["offend","offensive"]}

{"headword":"offensive","explanation":"形容詞，意為「冒犯的」、「令人討厭的」或「攻擊性的」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher warned the students that using <offensive> *language* *in* the classroom would lead to serious punishment.","translation":"老師警告學生在教室裡使用冒犯性的語言會導致嚴重的懲罰。","explanation":"形容詞「冒犯的」。offensive language 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The smell coming from the old trash can was truly <offensive>, so we decided to clean it immediately.","translation":"從舊垃圾桶散發出的氣味真的很令人討厭，所以我們決定立刻清理它。","explanation":"形容詞「令人討厭的」。"},{"sentence":"The team's <offensive> *strategy* *was* very successful, allowing them to score three goals in the first half.","translation":"球隊的攻擊策略非常成功，讓他們在上半場就進了三球。","explanation":"形容詞「攻擊性的」。在運動中指進攻方面的。"}],"related_forms":["offend","offense"]}

{"headword":"opera","explanation":"名詞，意為「歌劇」。","entries":[{"sentence":"My mother loves *to go to* the <opera> every winter to enjoy the beautiful music and dramatic performances.","translation":"我媽媽每年冬天都喜歡去聽歌劇，欣賞美妙的音樂和戲劇性的演出。","explanation":"名詞「歌劇」。go to the opera 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The famous composer spent years writing his *final* <opera>, which later became one of his most popular works.","translation":"這位著名作曲家花了幾年時間創作他最後一部歌劇，後來成為他最受歡迎的作品之一。","explanation":"名詞「歌劇」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"oppose","explanation":"動詞「反對」。常用被動語態 be opposed to (介係詞to是關鍵) 或主動語態 oppose + V-ing。注意oppose後面直接接名詞或動名詞，不可加介係詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local residents strongly <oppose> the *construction* *of* a new factory, fearing that it will cause serious pollution in their neighborhood.","translation":"當地居民強烈反對興建一座新工廠，擔心這會對他們社區造成嚴重的污染。","explanation":"oppose + 名詞 (construction)。注意句型結構，oppose 後面接事物的名詞形式。"},{"sentence":"Many citizens are *firmly* <opposed> *to* the new law, arguing that it violates their basic human rights and freedom of speech.","translation":"許多市民堅決反對這項新法律，認為這侵犯了他們的基本人權和言論自由。","explanation":"be opposed to + 名詞/V-ing。這是GSAT常考的用法，務必記住介係詞to。"},{"sentence":"Some students <opposed> *changing* the date of the school sports day, as they had already made plans for the weekend.","translation":"一些學生反對更改學校運動會的日期，因為他們週末已經有安排了。","explanation":"oppose + V-ing。注意這裡的用法，強調反對某個動作。"}],"related_forms":["opposition","opposing"]}

{"headword":"option","explanation":"名詞「選擇/選項」。常見搭配有 have the option of (doing sth.) 和 keep one's options open。注意與 choice 的區別，option 強調在特定範圍內的選項。","entries":[{"sentence":"After graduating from high school, students have the <option> *of* attending a university or entering the workforce directly to gain experience.","translation":"高中畢業後，學生有選擇上大學或直接進入職場累積經驗的選項。","explanation":"have the option of + V-ing。這是關於人生規劃的常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The travel agent gave us several <options> *for* our summer vacation, including a trip to the beach or a mountain hiking tour.","translation":"旅行社給了我們幾個暑假旅遊的選擇，包括去海邊或是山區健行之旅。","explanation":"options for + 名詞。常用來表示針對某事的各種選項。"},{"sentence":"We should <keep> all our <options> *open* before making a final decision about which college to apply to next year.","translation":"在決定明年要申請哪所大學之前，我們應該保持各種選擇的開放性。","explanation":"片語 keep one's options open 表示不急著做決定，保留多種可能性。"}],"related_forms":["optional"]}

{"headword":"orbit","explanation":"名詞「軌道」；動詞「繞軌道運行」。GSAT常考天文學主題，注意 in orbit (在軌道上) 以及與 celestial body 的搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The satellite has been in <orbit> *around* the Earth for three years, sending back valuable data about weather patterns and climate change.","translation":"這顆衛星已在地球軌道上運行了三年，傳回關於天氣模式和氣候變遷的珍貴數據。","explanation":"in orbit around sth.。這是描述衛星或太空船位置的標準說法。"},{"sentence":"The moon <orbits> the Earth approximately once every twenty-eight days, which affects the tides in the ocean.","translation":"月球大約每二十八天繞地球運行一次，這會影響海洋的潮汐。","explanation":"動詞用法，直接接受詞，表示繞行軌道。"},{"sentence":"Scientists launched a new telescope into <orbit> to study distant stars and galaxies that are millions of light-years away from us.","translation":"科學家將一台新望遠鏡發射到軌道上，以研究距離我們數百萬光年的遙遠恆星與星系。","explanation":"launch... into orbit。常見的太空科技搭配。"}],"related_forms":["orbital"]}

{"headword":"orchestra","explanation":"名詞「管弦樂團」。常搭配動詞 play in, join, or perform with。注意拼字，容易在拼寫題中出現。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school <orchestra> *performed* a beautiful symphony by Beethoven at the annual concert last night, impressing the entire audience.","translation":"學校管弦樂團昨晚在年度音樂會上演奏了貝多芬的優美交響曲，令全場觀眾印象深刻。","explanation":"orchestra + perform。描述樂團活動的典型搭配。"},{"sentence":"She has played the violin in the city <orchestra> for over five years, traveling to many countries for music festivals.","translation":"她在城市管弦樂團拉小提琴已經超過五年了，曾去過許多國家參加音樂節。","explanation":"play in the orchestra。表示在樂團中擔任成員。"},{"sentence":"The conductor led the <orchestra> *through* a challenging piece of music, ensuring that every instrument sounded perfectly in harmony.","translation":"指揮帶領管弦樂團演奏了一首高難度的樂曲，確保每種樂器都能完美和諧地發聲。","explanation":"lead the orchestra。描述指揮與樂團的關係。"}],"related_forms":["orchestral"]}

{"headword":"orientation","explanation":"名詞「新生訓練/職前訓練」或「方向/取向」。GSAT常見於學校生活主題，指開學初的迎新活動。","entries":[{"sentence":"All freshmen are required to attend the <orientation> *session* to learn about the campus facilities and school regulations before classes begin.","translation":"所有新生都必須參加新生訓練說明會，在開課前了解校園設施和校規。","explanation":"orientation session/program。指大學或高中的迎新活動。"},{"sentence":"The company provides a two-day <orientation> *for* new employees to help them get familiar with the office environment and their colleagues.","translation":"公司為新進員工提供為期兩天的職前訓練，幫助他們熟悉辦公環境和同事。","explanation":"orientation for new employees。指職場的職前訓練。"},{"sentence":"The building's <orientation> *towards* the south allows it to receive plenty of natural sunlight throughout the day, saving energy on lighting.","translation":"這棟建築面向南方的方位讓它整天都能接收到充足的自然陽光，節省了照明能源。","explanation":"orientation towards。指物理上的「方位/方向」。"}],"related_forms":["orient"]}

{"headword":"orphan","explanation":"名詞「孤兒」；動詞「使成為孤兒」。常用形容詞 orphan (作為名詞修飾語) 或 orphaned。","entries":[{"sentence":"The charity organization works hard to provide food, shelter, and education for every <orphan> in the war-torn region.","translation":"該慈善機構努力為飽受戰亂地區的每一位孤兒提供食物、住所和教育。","explanation":"名詞用法，指失去雙親的孩子。"},{"sentence":"Many animals were <orphaned> *by* the forest fire, leaving them without parents to protect them in the wild.","translation":"許多動物因森林大火而成為孤兒，在野外沒有父母保護牠們。","explanation":"動詞被動語態，orphaned by sth. 表示因某事失去親人。"},{"sentence":"The <orphan> *home* was established ten years ago to offer a safe place for children who have lost their families.","translation":"這所孤兒院成立於十年前，為失去家庭的孩子提供一個安全的地方。","explanation":"orphan home/orphanage。常用複合名詞。"}],"related_forms":["orphanage"]}

{"headword":"otherwise","explanation":"副詞「否則/不然」或「以其他方式」。GSAT常考連接詞用法，表示條件的反面結果，通常用於句首或句中。","entries":[{"sentence":"You should study hard for the upcoming exam; <otherwise>, you might fail the course and have to take it again next semester.","translation":"你應該為即將到來的考試努力學習；否則，你可能會不及格，下學期必須重修這門課。","explanation":"otherwise = if not/or else。這是GSAT最常考的用法，表「如果不這樣做，後果是...」。"},{"sentence":"The weather was bad, but <otherwise>, we had a wonderful time exploring the local markets and tasting the delicious street food.","translation":"天氣很糟，但除此之外，我們在探索當地市場和品嚐美味街頭小吃時玩得很開心。","explanation":"otherwise = apart from that / in other respects。用來補充說明除了一個負面因素外，其他都很好。"},{"sentence":"Unless the manager tells me <otherwise>, I will continue to work on this project according to the original schedule.","translation":"除非經理告訴我其他做法，否則我會繼續按照原定計畫進行這個專案。","explanation":"tell sb. otherwise。表示「指示不同的做法」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"outcome","explanation":"名詞「結果」。常搭配動詞 determine, influence, predict 或形容詞 positive, negative, final。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is difficult to predict the <outcome> *of* the negotiation, as both sides have very different opinions on the main issues.","translation":"很難預測談判的結果，因為雙方對主要議題的意見分歧很大。","explanation":"outcome of sth.。常用搭配，指談判、競賽或事件的最終結果。"},{"sentence":"The <final> <outcome> *of* the experiment was a complete success, confirming the scientists' hypothesis about the chemical reaction.","translation":"實驗的最終結果取得了完全的成功，證實了科學家關於該化學反應的假設。","explanation":"final outcome。強調「最終結果」。"},{"sentence":"Hard work and dedication are key factors that <influence> the <outcome> *of* a student's academic performance in the long run.","translation":"努力工作和奉獻是長期影響學生學業成績結果的關鍵因素。","explanation":"influence the outcome。探討影響結果的因素。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"outstanding","explanation":"形容詞「傑出的/優秀的」或「未解決的(債務)」。GSAT最常用「傑出」之意。常用於稱讚學生表現或員工績效。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student received an award for her <outstanding> *performance* in mathematics throughout her three years in high school.","translation":"這位學生因她在高中三年期間數學方面的傑出表現而獲得獎項。","explanation":"outstanding performance。形容人表現優異的標準搭配。"},{"sentence":"This company is known for its <outstanding> *customer* *service*, which attracts many loyal clients from all over the country.","translation":"這家公司以其傑出的客戶服務聞名，吸引了來自全國各地的許多忠實客戶。","explanation":"outstanding customer service。用於描述服務品質。"},{"sentence":"Despite his <outstanding> *achievements* in the field of science, he remains a humble and down-to-earth person.","translation":"儘管他在科學領域有傑出的成就，他仍然是一個謙虛且腳踏實地的人。","explanation":"outstanding achievements。形容成就非凡。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"oval","explanation":"形容詞/名詞「橢圓形的/橢圓形」。常與 shape 搭配使用。在數學或美術主題中出現。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist drew an <oval> *shape* on the paper to represent the face of the character in the portrait.","translation":"藝術家在紙上畫了一個橢圓形來代表肖像畫中人物的臉部。","explanation":"oval shape。描述幾何外觀。"},{"sentence":"The swimming pool in the park is <oval> *in* *appearance*, providing more space for swimmers to move around compared to a square one.","translation":"公園裡的游泳池外觀是橢圓形的，與方形游泳池相比，為游泳者提供了更多活動空間。","explanation":"oval in appearance。描述物體外觀的慣用語。"},{"sentence":"Most of the small mirrors sold in the gift shop are <oval> rather than circular, which makes them look more elegant.","translation":"禮品店裡賣的大部分小鏡子都是橢圓形而非圓形的，這讓它們看起來更優雅。","explanation":"形容詞用法，直接作補語。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"overcoat","explanation":"名詞「大衣/外套」。指穿在其他衣物外面的厚外套，通常用於寒冷天氣。注意與 jacket 或 coat 的區別，overcoat 強調「罩在外面」的保暖功能。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old man put on his heavy <overcoat> to *keep warm* while walking through the snowy streets during the winter.","translation":"那位老人在冬天走過積雪的街道時，穿上厚重的大衣來保暖。","explanation":"基本用法，指穿在最外層的保暖衣物。搭配 keep warm (保暖)。"},{"sentence":"She hung her <overcoat> on the *coat rack* near the door before entering the living room to greet her guests.","translation":"她在進入客廳問候客人之前，把大衣掛在門邊的衣帽架上。","explanation":"常見生活場景，搭配 coat rack (衣帽架)。"},{"sentence":"Because of the *sudden drop* in temperature, everyone was wearing an <overcoat> on their way to the school assembly this morning.","translation":"由於氣溫突然下降，今天早上大家在去學校集會的路上都穿著大衣。","explanation":"描述天氣與穿著的關聯，搭配 sudden drop (突然下降)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"overcome","explanation":"動詞「克服/戰勝」。常用於克服困難、恐懼、障礙等。注意過去式 overcame，過去分詞 overcome。","entries":[{"sentence":"With enough courage and practice, the shy student finally <overcame> her *fear of* public speaking during the class presentation.","translation":"憑藉足夠的勇氣與練習，那位害羞的學生終於在課堂報告時克服了她對公開演講的恐懼。","explanation":"搭配 fear of (對...的恐懼)，指克服心理障礙。"},{"sentence":"The local community worked together to <overcome> the *serious challenges* caused by the recent natural disaster in the mountain area.","translation":"當地社區齊心協力，克服了近期山區天災所造成的嚴重挑戰。","explanation":"指克服困難或挑戰，搭配 serious challenges (嚴峻挑戰)。"},{"sentence":"Many athletes have to <overcome> *physical pain* to achieve their best performance in international competitions.","translation":"許多運動員必須克服身體上的痛苦，才能在國際賽事中取得最好的表現。","explanation":"指克服身體上的困難，搭配 physical pain (身體痛苦)。"},{"sentence":"Even though they faced many obstacles, the team successfully <overcame> every *difficulty* to finish the project on time.","translation":"儘管面臨許多障礙，團隊還是成功克服了每一個困難，準時完成了專案。","explanation":"搭配 difficulty，指克服問題，達成目標。"}],"related_forms":["overcame","overcoming"]}

{"headword":"overlook","explanation":"動詞「忽略/沒注意到」或「俯瞰」。(1) 忽略：常指因為粗心而沒看見；(2) 俯瞰：指從高處往下看。注意與 ignore 的區別，ignore 是「故意不理」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The editor <overlooked> a *small mistake* in the article, so it was published with a typo in the headline.","translation":"編輯忽略了文章中的一個小錯誤，所以發表的標題上有個錯字。","explanation":"指無心之過，因粗心而沒看到。搭配 small mistake (小錯誤)。"},{"sentence":"From the balcony of the hotel, we could <overlook> the *beautiful beach* and enjoy the sunset every evening.","translation":"從飯店的陽台，我們可以俯瞰美麗的海灘，每天傍晚享受日落。","explanation":"指「從高處俯瞰」，常見於旅遊描述。搭配 beautiful beach (美麗海灘)。"},{"sentence":"It is easy to <overlook> the *simple rules* of safety when you are in a rush to finish your work.","translation":"當你急著完成工作時，很容易忽略簡單的安全規定。","explanation":"指忽略規則或重點，搭配 simple rules (簡單規定)。"},{"sentence":"The manager decided to <overlook> the employee's *minor lateness* because of his outstanding work on the team project.","translation":"經理決定不計較該員工的輕微遲到，因為他在團隊專案中表現傑出。","explanation":"指「寬恕/不追究」，用法較正式。搭配 minor lateness (輕微遲到)。"}],"related_forms":["overlooked","overlooking"]}

{"headword":"overnight","explanation":"副詞「整夜/一夜之間」；形容詞「過夜的/通宵的」。(1) 副詞：表時間持續整晚或發生得很快；(2) 形容詞：指需要過夜的行程。","entries":[{"sentence":"The heavy snow fell <overnight>, covering the entire city in a *white blanket* by the next morning.","translation":"大雪下了一整夜，到隔天早上把整座城市覆蓋在一層白色地毯下。","explanation":"副詞用法，指時間持續「整夜」。"},{"sentence":"You cannot expect to learn a new language <overnight>; it requires *constant practice* and patience over a long period.","translation":"你不能指望一夜之間學會一門新語言；這需要長時間持續的練習與耐心。","explanation":"副詞用法，指「一夜之間/迅速地」，常用於否定句。搭配 constant practice (持續練習)。"},{"sentence":"We are planning an <overnight> *trip* to the mountains this weekend to enjoy the fresh air and nature.","translation":"我們計畫這個週末去山區進行兩天一夜的旅行，享受新鮮空氣與大自然。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指「過夜的」。搭配 trip (旅行)。"},{"sentence":"The package was sent by <overnight> *mail*, so it should arrive at your office early tomorrow morning.","translation":"包裹是用隔夜快遞寄出的，所以應該會在明天一大早抵達你的辦公室。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指「隔夜的/限時快遞的」。搭配 mail (郵件/快遞)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"overthrow","explanation":"動詞「推翻/打倒」。多用於政治情境，指以武力或非法手段推翻政府或體制。注意過去式 overthrew，過去分詞 overthrown。","entries":[{"sentence":"The citizens organized a protest to <overthrow> the *corrupt government* that had ignored their needs for many years.","translation":"市民組織了一場抗議，試圖推翻那個多年來忽視他們需求的腐敗政府。","explanation":"政治語境，指推翻政權。搭配 corrupt government (腐敗政府)。"},{"sentence":"History shows that many dictators were eventually <overthrown> by the *people's power* and the desire for freedom.","translation":"歷史顯示，許多獨裁者最終都被人民的力量與對自由的渴望所推翻。","explanation":"被動語態，搭配 people's power (人民力量)。"},{"sentence":"The rebel group plotted to <overthrow> the *existing regime* in order to establish a new social order in the country.","translation":"叛軍組織密謀推翻現有政權，以便在國內建立新的社會秩序。","explanation":"指推翻政權，搭配 existing regime (現有政權)。"}],"related_forms":["overthrew","overthrown"]}

{"headword":"oxygen","explanation":"名詞「氧/氧氣」。不可數名詞。常與 health, environment 議題結合。","entries":[{"sentence":"Plants are essential for our environment because they produce <oxygen> and help *clean the air* for all living things.","translation":"植物對我們的環境至關重要，因為它們產生氧氣並協助淨化所有生物的空氣。","explanation":"生物與環境基礎詞彙。搭配 clean the air (淨化空氣)。"},{"sentence":"When the climber reached the top of the mountain, he needed a *tank of* <oxygen> because the air was too thin.","translation":"當登山者抵達山頂時，他需要一瓶氧氣，因為空氣太稀薄了。","explanation":"登山情境，搭配 tank of (一瓶/桶...)。"},{"sentence":"All animals and humans need <oxygen> to *survive* and keep their bodies functioning properly every day.","translation":"所有動物與人類都需要氧氣才能生存，並讓身體每天正常運作。","explanation":"搭配 survive (生存)，說明氧氣的重要性。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"pace","explanation":"名詞「步調/速度」；動詞「踱步/緩慢地走」。(1) 名詞：指活動進行的速度；(2) 動詞：常指緊張或焦慮時走來走去。","entries":[{"sentence":"The runner kept a *steady* <pace> throughout the race, allowing him to save energy for the final sprint.","translation":"跑者在比賽全程保持穩定的步調，讓他能為最後衝刺保留體力。","explanation":"名詞用法，指速度、步調。搭配 steady pace (穩定的步調)。"},{"sentence":"Technology is changing at such a *fast* <pace> that it is hard for some people to keep up with the new trends.","translation":"科技正以如此快的速度改變，以至於有些人很難跟上新的趨勢。","explanation":"指變化的速度。搭配 fast pace (快速的步伐)。"},{"sentence":"The nervous student <paced> *back and forth* in the hallway while waiting for the results of the final exam.","translation":"那位緊張的學生在走廊來回踱步，等待期末考的結果。","explanation":"動詞用法，指因緊張走來走去。搭配 back and forth (來回地)。"},{"sentence":"We should *set* a reasonable <pace> for our study plan so that we don't feel too tired before the exam.","translation":"我們應該為讀書計畫設定一個合理的進度，這樣才不會在考試前感到太累。","explanation":"名詞用法，指進度。搭配 set a pace (設定進度)。"}],"related_forms":["paced","pacing"]}

{"headword":"panel","explanation":"名詞「小組/專門小組/鑲板」。(1) 指討論問題的專家小組；(2) 指牆壁、門上的嵌板或控制面板。常考 panel discussion (座談會)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school invited a <panel> of *experts* to discuss the future of education during the annual conference.","translation":"學校邀請了一組專家小組，在年度會議期間討論教育的未來。","explanation":"指專家小組。搭配 experts (專家)。"},{"sentence":"The <panel> *discussion* lasted for two hours, covering many important topics related to environmental protection.","translation":"座談會持續了兩小時，涵蓋了許多與環境保護相關的重要議題。","explanation":"常見片語 panel discussion (座談會)。"},{"sentence":"You can change the settings of the machine by pressing the buttons on the *control* <panel> located at the front.","translation":"你可以透過按位於前方的控制面板上的按鈕來更改機器的設定。","explanation":"指機械的控制面板。搭配 control panel (控制面板)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"parachute","explanation":"名詞「降落傘」；動詞「跳傘」。常與極限運動或軍事救援相關。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soldier jumped out of the plane and opened his <parachute> to *land safely* on the ground below.","translation":"士兵跳出飛機並打開降落傘，以便安全地降落在下方的地面上。","explanation":"基本用法，指降落傘。搭配 land safely (安全著陸)。"},{"sentence":"Many young people enjoy the thrill of <parachuting> as a *popular extreme sport* during their summer vacations.","translation":"許多年輕人在暑假期間享受跳傘的刺激，作為一項受歡迎的極限運動。","explanation":"動詞用法，指跳傘。搭配 popular extreme sport (熱門極限運動)。"},{"sentence":"After the engine failed, the pilot had to use a <parachute> to *escape from* the burning aircraft.","translation":"引擎故障後，飛行員必須使用降落傘從燃燒的飛機中逃生。","explanation":"緊急情境，搭配 escape from (逃離)。"}],"related_forms":["parachuted","parachuting"]}

{"headword":"paragraph","explanation":"名詞「段落」。寫作教學常用詞彙。注意與 essay, sentence 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please write a short <paragraph> to *summarize* the main idea of the story we read in class today.","translation":"請寫一個簡短的段落，總結我們今天在課堂上讀的故事的主旨。","explanation":"寫作任務指令，搭配 summarize (總結)。"},{"sentence":"The first <paragraph> of the *essay* should clearly introduce the topic and state your main argument.","translation":"這篇短文的第一段應該清楚介紹主題並陳述你的主要論點。","explanation":"寫作結構說明，搭配 essay (文章)。"},{"sentence":"I found an interesting <paragraph> in the *textbook* that explains how the human heart works.","translation":"我在課本中發現一個有趣的段落，解釋了人類心臟是如何運作的。","explanation":"指書中的片段，搭配 textbook (課本)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"partial","explanation":"形容詞用法：(1) 「部分的」；(2) 「偏袒的」，常與介係詞 to 搭配 (be partial to sth/sb)。注意：反義詞為 impartial (公正的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The manager admitted that the new policy was only a <partial> solution to the *long-term* problem of employee turnover.","translation":"經理承認這項新政策只是解決員工流動長期問題的部分方案。","explanation":"形容詞「部分的」。搭配 long-term 增加學術語境感。"},{"sentence":"Although he claims to be fair, his decisions often seem <partial> *to* the members of his own sports team.","translation":"儘管他聲稱自己很公平，但他的決定似乎往往偏袒自己球隊的隊員。","explanation":"形容詞「偏袒的」。固定搭配 be partial to sb/sth (偏愛某人/某事)。"},{"sentence":"She has always been <partial> *to* Italian food, so she was thrilled when we suggested visiting a local bistro for dinner.","translation":"她一直以來都很偏愛義大利菜，所以當我們建議去當地的餐酒館吃晚餐時，她感到非常興奮。","explanation":"形容詞「喜愛的/偏愛的」。be partial to 可表示對某種食物或事物的喜好。"}],"related_forms":["partially","impartial"]}

{"headword":"participation","explanation":"名詞「參與」。搭配動詞通常用 active, full, encourage 等。注意不可數用法與可數用法的語境區別 (通常視為不可數)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher *encouraged* active <participation> *in* classroom discussions to help students improve their critical thinking skills.","translation":"老師鼓勵課堂討論中的積極參與，以幫助學生提升批判性思考能力。","explanation":"名詞「參與」。鼓勵參與是 GSAT 常見主題。固定搭配 encourage participation in..."},{"sentence":"Your <participation> *in* the school volunteer project is highly valued, and we hope you can attend the meeting tomorrow.","translation":"我們非常重視您對學校志工計畫的參與，希望您能參加明天的會議。","explanation":"名詞「參與」。在此語境下，participation in... 是常見的搭配結構。"},{"sentence":"The survey results show a decline in student <participation> *in* extracurricular activities compared to the previous semester.","translation":"調查結果顯示，與上學期相比，學生參加課外活動的參與度有所下降。","explanation":"名詞「參與」。用於描述統計數據或趨勢，搭配 decline in 很常見。"}],"related_forms":["participate","participant"]}

{"headword":"partnership","explanation":"名詞「合作關係」。常指企業、組織間的夥伴關係。常見搭配：form/build a partnership with...","entries":[{"sentence":"The two companies decided to *form* a strategic <partnership> *to* share resources and develop new technology together.","translation":"這兩家公司決定建立戰略合作夥伴關係，以共享資源並共同開發新技術。","explanation":"名詞「合作關係」。搭配動詞 form 或 build 建立合作。"},{"sentence":"Through a long-term <partnership> *with* the local university, the museum offers internship opportunities to history students.","translation":"透過與當地大學的長期合作關係，該博物館為歷史系學生提供實習機會。","explanation":"名詞「合作關係」。搭配介係詞 with，表示與某個對象的夥伴關係。"},{"sentence":"The success of the project depends on a strong <partnership> *between* the government and private sectors.","translation":"該計畫的成功取決於政府與民間部門之間的強大合作夥伴關係。","explanation":"名詞「合作關係」。between A and B 常用於描述雙方合作。"}],"related_forms":["partner"]}

{"headword":"passive","explanation":"形容詞「被動的/消極的」。常指態度不積極，或文法中的被動語態。注意與 active (主動的) 對比。","entries":[{"sentence":"Instead of being a <passive> *learner* who only listens to lectures, you should actively participate in class activities.","translation":"與其做一個只聽講的被動學習者，你應該積極參與課堂活動。","explanation":"形容詞「被動的」。指不主動參與的態度。搭配 learner 是不錯的搭配。"},{"sentence":"He took a <passive> *role* in the group project, letting others make all the important decisions without offering any input.","translation":"他在小組報告中採取被動的角色，讓其他人做所有重要的決定，而自己沒有提供任何意見。","explanation":"形容詞「被動的」。take a passive role 是常見搭配，意指在某事中不活躍。"},{"sentence":"The teacher explained that the sentence was written in the <passive> *voice*, which emphasizes the action rather than the doer.","translation":"老師解釋說那個句子是用被動語態寫的，強調的是動作本身而非執行者。","explanation":"形容詞「被動的」。指文法術語「被動語態」。"}],"related_forms":["passively"]}

{"headword":"pasta","explanation":"名詞「義大利麵」。此為不可數名詞。常見搭配有 eat, cook, order pasta。","entries":[{"sentence":"We decided to *cook* some fresh <pasta> *for* dinner since we were too tired to go out to a restaurant.","translation":"我們決定在家煮一些新鮮的義大利麵當晚餐，因為我們太累了，不想去餐廳。","explanation":"名詞「義大利麵」。不可數，所以不加 a/an。cook pasta 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The Italian restaurant offers a wide variety of <pasta> *dishes*, including spaghetti, penne, and fettuccine.","translation":"這家義大利餐廳提供多種義大利麵料理，包括直麵、筆管麵和寬麵。","explanation":"名詞「義大利麵」。此處 pasta 作為修飾詞，說明麵的種類。"},{"sentence":"My little brother loves to *eat* <pasta> *with* tomato sauce, but he hates vegetables.","translation":"我弟弟喜歡吃紅醬義大利麵，但他討厭蔬菜。","explanation":"名詞「義大利麵」。eat pasta with... 是描述吃法與口味的常見表達。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"paw","explanation":"名詞「腳掌」(指動物的)；動詞「用腳爪抓/觸碰」。常見於描述貓狗動作。","entries":[{"sentence":"The dog *lifted* its <paw> to shake hands with the owner, showing how smart it was.","translation":"那隻狗舉起腳掌跟主人握手，展現出牠有多聰明。","explanation":"名詞「腳掌」。lift its paw 是描述動物動作的常見表達。"},{"sentence":"My cat often <paws> *at* the door when it wants to go outside into the garden to play.","translation":"當我的貓想去外面的花園玩時，牠常會用腳爪抓門。","explanation":"動詞「用腳爪抓」。paw at sth 是固定用法。注意第三人稱單數 paw 的變化。"},{"sentence":"Be careful when you touch the bear's <paw>, as its claws are very sharp and dangerous.","translation":"觸摸熊掌時要小心，因為牠的爪子非常鋒利且危險。","explanation":"名詞「腳掌」。指大型動物的腳掌。"}],"related_forms":["paws"]}

{"headword":"peculiar","explanation":"形容詞「奇怪的/獨特的」。意指不尋常或特有的。注意與 strange 區別，peculiar 有時強調「獨特性」。","entries":[{"sentence":"I noticed a <peculiar> *smell* coming from the kitchen, so I went to check if the stove was still on.","translation":"我注意到廚房傳來一股奇怪的味道，所以我去檢查爐火是否還開著。","explanation":"形容詞「奇怪的」。peculiar smell 是一個常見的搭配。"},{"sentence":"That bird species has a <peculiar> *way* of singing, which makes it easy to identify in the forest.","translation":"那種鳥類有一種獨特的鳴叫方式，這使得牠在森林中很容易辨認。","explanation":"形容詞「獨特的」。peculiar way 指獨特且不尋常的方式。"},{"sentence":"It is <peculiar> *that* he didn't call to cancel the meeting, as he is usually very punctual.","translation":"奇怪的是他沒有打電話取消會議，因為他通常都很準時。","explanation":"形容詞「奇怪的」。It is peculiar that... 是一個常見的句型結構。"}],"related_forms":["peculiarly"]}

{"headword":"peep","explanation":"名詞「偷看」；動詞「窺視/隱約出現」。常見片語：take a peep (偷看一眼)；peep at sb/sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"She couldn't help but *take* a quick <peep> *at* the surprise birthday gift hidden in the closet.","translation":"她忍不住偷看了一眼藏在衣櫥裡的生日驚喜禮物。","explanation":"名詞「偷看」。take a peep at 是固定慣用語。"},{"sentence":"The shy child <peeped> *out* from behind his mother's skirt when the stranger tried to talk to him.","translation":"當陌生人試圖跟他交談時，那個害羞的孩子從他媽媽的裙子後面探頭偷看。","explanation":"動詞「窺視/探出」。peep out 指從遮蔽物後面露出。"},{"sentence":"The sun started to <peep> *over* the mountains, signaling the beginning of a beautiful new day.","translation":"太陽開始從山頭隱約出現，象徵著美好新一天的開始。","explanation":"動詞「隱約出現」。此用法較具文學感，指緩慢露出。"}],"related_forms":["peeping"]}

{"headword":"peer","explanation":"名詞「同儕/同輩」；動詞「凝視/費力地看」。GSAT 常見：peer pressure (同儕壓力)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Teenagers often face intense <peer> *pressure* to fit in and follow the trends set by their friends.","translation":"青少年常面臨巨大的同儕壓力，為了融入群體並跟隨朋友設定的潮流。","explanation":"名詞「同儕」。peer pressure 是非常重要的 GSAT 必考詞彙。"},{"sentence":"She *leaned* forward and <peered> *into* the dark cave, trying to see if there was anyone inside.","translation":"她身體前傾，凝視著黑暗的洞穴，試圖看裡面是否有任何人。","explanation":"動詞「凝視」。peered into... 常見於描寫動作，需費力看清。"},{"sentence":"It is important for students to maintain good relationships with their <peers> to create a supportive learning environment.","translation":"對學生來說，與同儕保持良好的關係對於創造一個相互支持的學習環境很重要。","explanation":"名詞「同儕」。指年齡或地位相當的人。"}],"related_forms":["peers"]}

{"headword":"penalty","explanation":"名詞「懲罰/罰球/罰款」。常見搭配：face/pay a penalty; death penalty (死刑)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company had to *pay* a heavy <penalty> *for* violating environmental regulations during its manufacturing process.","translation":"該公司因在製造過程中違反環保法規，而必須支付高額罰款。","explanation":"名詞「罰款」。pay a penalty for... 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"The football player missed the crucial <penalty> *kick* in the final minute of the championship game.","translation":"那位足球員在冠軍賽最後一分鐘錯失了關鍵的罰球機會。","explanation":"名詞「罰球」。penalty kick 是運動用語。"},{"sentence":"Many countries have abolished the death <penalty> because they believe it is not a fair form of justice.","translation":"許多國家已經廢除了死刑，因為他們認為這不是一種公平的司法形式。","explanation":"名詞「懲罰」。death penalty 是固定搭配，指死刑。"}],"related_forms":["penalize"]}

{"headword":"percent","explanation":"名詞「百分比」。注意用法：(1) percent 後面不加 s，即使是複數 (e.g., 50 percent)；(2) 它是單字，而 percentage 是名詞「百分率/比例」；(3) percent 常與介係詞 of 搭配，動詞單複數視 of 後的名詞而定。","entries":[{"sentence":"Approximately fifty <percent> *of* the students in our class prefer studying in the library rather than at home because it is much quieter.","translation":"我們班大約有百分之五十的學生喜歡在圖書館讀書，而不是在家裡，因為那裡安靜得多。","explanation":"percent 作為名詞表示百分比。注意 fifty percent of the students 這裡用複數動詞 prefer，因為 students 是複數。"},{"sentence":"The store offers a twenty <percent> *discount* on all items during the grand opening sale, attracting many customers to visit.","translation":"在盛大開幕特賣期間，這家店對所有商品提供八折優惠，吸引了許多顧客前來參觀。","explanation":"twenty percent discount 為常見搭配，表示「百分之二十的折扣」。"},{"sentence":"The interest rate on this savings account increased by five <percent> *over* the last year, which is great news for investors.","translation":"這個儲蓄帳戶的利率在去年內增加了百分之五，這對投資者來說是個好消息。","explanation":"percent 可以描述數值的變化，常搭配介係詞 over 或 in。"}],"related_forms":["percentage"]}

{"headword":"percentage","explanation":"名詞「百分率/比例」。與 percent 不同，percentage 指的是一個抽象的比例或數值，通常不跟具體數字連用 (e.g., a high percentage of, not a 50 percentage)。","entries":[{"sentence":"A large <percentage> *of* the local population relies on tourism for their primary income during the summer months.","translation":"夏季期間，當地很大一部分人口依靠旅遊業作為主要收入來源。","explanation":"a large percentage of 為常見用法，用於修飾整體中的一部分。"},{"sentence":"The <percentage> *of* people working from home has increased significantly since the pandemic started three years ago.","translation":"自從三年前疫情開始以來，在家工作的人口比例顯著增加。","explanation":"percentage 後面常接 of + 名詞，描述整體中所佔的比例。"},{"sentence":"We need to calculate the exact <percentage> *of* success to determine if this new project is actually worth our time and resources.","translation":"我們需要計算確切的成功率，以確定這個新專案是否真的值得我們投入時間和資源。","explanation":"percentage of success 指「成功率」，強調比例的計算。"}],"related_forms":["percent"]}

{"headword":"perfection","explanation":"名詞「完美」。常用於片語 strive for perfection (追求完美) 或 bring sth. to perfection (使某物臻於完美)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The famous chef practiced making this soup for years until he finally brought the recipe to <perfection>.","translation":"這位名廚練習製作這道湯品多年，直到他最終讓這份食譜臻於完美。","explanation":"bring ... to perfection 是固定用法，表示將某事做到完美無缺。"},{"sentence":"She often *strives for* <perfection> in her academic work, which sometimes makes her feel stressed before big exams.","translation":"她在學業上經常追求完美，這有時會讓她在大型考試前感到壓力。","explanation":"strive for perfection 表示「追求完美」，是常見的高頻搭配。"},{"sentence":"No one is born with total <perfection>, so it is important to accept your flaws and keep improving yourself every day.","translation":"沒有人天生就是完美的，所以接受自己的缺點並每天不斷改進自己很重要。","explanation":"描述人並非天生完美，強調接受不完美。"}],"related_forms":["perfect","perfectly"]}

{"headword":"perfume","explanation":"名詞「香水」；動詞「使充滿香氣」。注意重音位置：名詞通常重音在第一音節 (PER-fume)，動詞在第二音節 (per-FUME)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She received a bottle of expensive <perfume> *as* a birthday gift from her best friend last week.","translation":"她上週收到好友送的一瓶昂貴香水作為生日禮物。","explanation":"a bottle of perfume 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Fresh flowers <perfume> *the* air in the garden, creating a relaxing and pleasant atmosphere for everyone visiting.","translation":"新鮮的花朵讓花園裡的空氣充滿香氣，為每位來訪者營造出輕鬆愉快的氛圍。","explanation":"perfume 在此作動詞，表示「使充滿香氣」。"},{"sentence":"The high-quality <perfume> *has* a long-lasting scent that stays on your clothes throughout the entire day.","translation":"這款高品質香水有著持久的香味，能整天留在你的衣服上。","explanation":"作名詞使用，描述香水的持久特性。"}],"related_forms":["perfumed"]}

{"headword":"permanent","explanation":"形容詞「永久的/長久的」。反義詞為 temporary (暫時的)。常見搭配：permanent address (永久地址), permanent damage (永久性損傷)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After years of living in different cities, they finally decided to settle down and find a <permanent> *home*.","translation":"在不同城市生活多年後，他們終於決定安定下來並找一個永久的家。","explanation":"permanent home 指「永久的住處」，相對於臨時租屋。"},{"sentence":"The accident caused <permanent> *damage* to his hearing, so he now has to use a hearing aid to communicate.","translation":"那場意外對他的聽力造成了永久性損害，所以他現在必須使用助聽器來溝通。","explanation":"permanent damage 是常見搭配，表示「永久的傷害」。"},{"sentence":"She is looking for a <permanent> *job* rather than a temporary position because she wants more financial stability.","translation":"她正在尋找一份永久性的工作，而不是臨時職位，因為她想要更多的財務穩定。","explanation":"permanent job 相對於 temporary position (臨時職位)。"}],"related_forms":["permanently"]}

{"headword":"persuasion","explanation":"名詞「說服/信念」。常見用法：the art of persuasion (說服的藝術)；under the persuasion of sb (在某人的勸說下)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Through the art of <persuasion>, he managed to convince his parents to let him study art in college.","translation":"透過說服的藝術，他成功說服父母讓他去大學學習藝術。","explanation":"the art of persuasion 是固定搭配，指說服人的技巧。"},{"sentence":"Sometimes, gentle <persuasion> *is* more effective than force when you want to change someone's mind about a difficult topic.","translation":"有時，當你想改變某人對棘手話題的想法時，溫和的說服比強迫更有效。","explanation":"gentle persuasion 強調用溫和的方式說服他人。"},{"sentence":"Under the <persuasion> *of* her friends, she finally agreed to join the school drama club this semester.","translation":"在朋友們的勸說下，她最終同意這學期加入學校的戲劇社。","explanation":"under the persuasion of sb. 表示「在某人的說服下」。"}],"related_forms":["persuade","persuasive"]}

{"headword":"persuasive","explanation":"形容詞「有說服力的」。常用於描述文章、演講或人的說話方式。常見搭配：a persuasive argument (有說服力的論點)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The candidate gave a <persuasive> *speech* that convinced many voters to support his plan for the city.","translation":"這位候選人發表了一場有說服力的演講，說服許多選民支持他對城市的計畫。","explanation":"a persuasive speech 是常見搭配，指能打動人的演講。"},{"sentence":"You need to provide more <persuasive> *evidence* to support your theory, or the professor will not accept your paper.","translation":"你需要提供更有說服力的證據來支持你的理論，否則教授不會接受你的報告。","explanation":"persuasive evidence 指能證明觀點正確的證據。"},{"sentence":"He is very <persuasive>, so he is perfect for the sales position where he has to deal with customers daily.","translation":"他很有說服力，所以他非常適合這份必須每天與顧客打交道的銷售職位。","explanation":"形容人很會說服別人，適合業務工作。"}],"related_forms":["persuade","persuasion"]}

{"headword":"pessimistic","explanation":"形容詞「悲觀的」。反義詞為 optimistic (樂觀的)。用法：be pessimistic about sth.
