(對某事感到悲觀)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although the team lost the first game, the coach told them not to be <pessimistic> *about* their chances of winning the championship.","translation":"雖然球隊輸了第一場比賽，教練告訴他們不要對贏得冠軍的機會感到悲觀。","explanation":"be pessimistic about sth. 是固定用法，表示對某事抱持悲觀態度。"},{"sentence":"It is easy to become <pessimistic> *when* you face too many challenges, but you should try to stay positive.","translation":"當你面對太多挑戰時，很容易變得悲觀，但你應該試著保持正面。","explanation":"形容人在困境中容易產生的情緒。"},{"sentence":"The economic report offers a <pessimistic> *view* of the future, predicting that prices will continue to rise next year.","translation":"這份經濟報告提供了對未來的悲觀看法，預測物價明年將持續上漲。","explanation":"a pessimistic view 指悲觀的觀點或預測。"}],"related_forms":["pessimism","pessimist"]}

{"headword":"pest","explanation":"名詞「害蟲/討厭的人事物」。指農作物害蟲，或日常生活中令人心煩的人或物。","entries":[{"sentence":"Farmers often use natural methods to control <pest> *problems* without relying too much on strong chemical pesticides.","translation":"農民經常使用自然方法來控制害蟲問題，而不必過度依賴強效化學殺蟲劑。","explanation":"pest problems 指害蟲造成的困擾。"},{"sentence":"You should keep your kitchen clean to avoid attracting any <pests> *like* cockroaches or ants into your house.","translation":"你應該保持廚房清潔，以避免吸引蟑螂或螞蟻等害蟲進入屋內。","explanation":"複數形 pests，常用 like/such as 列舉害蟲種類。"},{"sentence":"My little brother can be a real <pest> *when* he constantly interrupts me while I am trying to finish my homework.","translation":"當我試著寫作業時，我弟弟一直打斷我，真的很討厭。","explanation":"a real pest 用來形容「很討厭的人」，口語常見用法。"}],"related_forms":["pesticide"]}

{"headword":"phenomenon","explanation":"名詞「現象」。複數為 phenomena。常用於描述自然現象 (natural phenomenon) 或社會現象 (social phenomenon)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Global warming is a complex <phenomenon> *that* affects weather patterns and ecosystems all around the world.","translation":"全球暖化是一個複雜的現象，影響著世界各地的天氣模式和生態系統。","explanation":"描述自然或環境現象，常用 that 引導子句說明其影響。"},{"sentence":"The rise of social media has created a new <phenomenon> *in* which people share their private lives with strangers online.","translation":"社群媒體的興起創造了一種新現象，人們在網路上與陌生人分享私生活。","explanation":"phenomenon in which... 是描述現象內容的常見結構。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are still studying the strange <phenomena> *observed* in the deep ocean, hoping to discover new species.","translation":"科學家們仍在研究深海中觀察到的奇異現象，希望能發現新物種。","explanation":"phenomena 是 phenomenon 的複數，注意拼字變化。"}],"related_forms":["phenomenal"]}

{"headword":"philosopher","explanation":"指「哲學家」，通常指研究人生、倫理或存在意義的學者。需注意與 physics 相關字詞區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The ancient Greek <philosopher> *is* famous *for* his deep thoughts about justice and the meaning of a good life.","translation":"這位古希臘哲學家以他對正義和美好生活意義的深刻思考而聞名。","explanation":"指研究哲學的人物。常與 ancient Greek, famous 等詞搭配。"},{"sentence":"Many people read books by this <philosopher> to find *answers* *to* difficult questions about human nature and society.","translation":"許多人閱讀這位哲學家的著作，以尋找關於人性與社會困難問題的解答。","explanation":"表示研讀某位哲學家的作品。常與 read books by 搭配。"},{"sentence":"He acts like a <philosopher> whenever he talks about his dreams and his future plans for the world.","translation":"每當他談論夢想和對世界的未來規劃時，他的行為舉止就像一位哲學家。","explanation":"比喻用法，形容某人像哲學家一樣深思熟慮。搭配 acts like。"}],"related_forms":["philosophical","philosophy"]}

{"headword":"philosophical","explanation":"形容詞「哲學的」或「豁達的/看得開的」。在日常生活中，常指面對挫折時冷靜、理性的態度。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old man took a <philosophical> *approach* *to* his failures, seeing them as lessons rather than reasons to give up.","translation":"這位老人對他的失敗採取了一種豁達的態度，將它們視為教訓，而不是放棄的理由。","explanation":"形容詞，意指「豁達的、冷靜的」。常搭配 approach to sth。"},{"sentence":"Students often have <philosophical> *discussions* about life and death during their late-night study sessions in the library.","translation":"學生們在圖書館深夜讀書時，經常會進行關於生死的哲學討論。","explanation":"形容詞，指「哲學上的」。常與 discussions, questions, issues 搭配。"},{"sentence":"It is a <philosophical> question whether true happiness can be found in material things or in our inner feelings.","translation":"真正的快樂是來自物質還是來自內心感受，這是一個哲學問題。","explanation":"形容詞，指關於哲學理論的。常放在 question, problem 之前。"}],"related_forms":["philosopher","philosophy"]}

{"headword":"philosophy","explanation":"名詞「哲學」或「人生哲學/原則」。注意發音重音在第二音節 (fi-LOS-o-phy)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Her life <philosophy> *is* *to* help others whenever she can, no matter how small the action may seem.","translation":"她的人生哲學是盡其所能幫助他人，無論這個行動看起來多麼微小。","explanation":"指個人的信念或原則。常搭配 life, personal。"},{"sentence":"He decided to study <philosophy> *at* university because he enjoyed thinking about complex moral issues.","translation":"他決定在大學修讀哲學，因為他喜歡思考複雜的道德問題。","explanation":"指學科領域。常與 study, major in 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The company's business <philosophy> *focuses* *on* environmental protection and making products that last a long time.","translation":"該公司的經營理念專注於環境保護和製造耐用的產品。","explanation":"指公司的經營理念或原則。常搭配 business, corporate。"}],"related_forms":["philosopher","philosophical"]}

{"headword":"photography","explanation":"名詞「攝影（藝術/技術）」。注意與 photographer (攝影師) 的拼寫區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"She has a great interest in <photography> and spends every weekend taking photos in the local park.","translation":"她對攝影有很大的興趣，每個週末都花時間在當地的公園拍照。","explanation":"指攝影這項興趣或活動。常用 have an interest in 搭配。"},{"sentence":"Modern <photography> *has* *changed* a lot because smartphones make it easy for everyone to capture high-quality images.","translation":"現代攝影已經改變了很多，因為智慧型手機讓每個人都能輕易捕捉到高品質的影像。","explanation":"指攝影領域。常與 modern, digital 搭配。"},{"sentence":"He signed up for a <photography> *course* *to* learn how to use a professional camera and edit his pictures.","translation":"他報名了一門攝影課程，以學習如何使用專業相機並編輯照片。","explanation":"當作形容詞修飾名詞，指「攝影的」。常與 course, club, exhibition 搭配。"}],"related_forms":["photograph","photographer"]}

{"headword":"physical","explanation":"形容詞「身體的/實體的/物理的」。常見用法：physical health (身體健康), physical exercise (體能訓練)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Regular <physical> *exercise* *is* essential for maintaining good health and reducing stress during the exam season.","translation":"規律的體能運動對於在考試期間保持身體健康和減輕壓力至關重要。","explanation":"指「身體的」。常搭配 exercise, activity, health。"},{"sentence":"Students often face <physical> *changes* during puberty, which can be a confusing time for many teenagers.","translation":"學生在青春期常面臨身體上的變化，這對許多青少年來說可能是一段困惑的時期。","explanation":"指身體構造或發育。常搭配 changes, development。"},{"sentence":"Although he likes online shopping, he prefers to go to a <physical> *store* to see the products before buying them.","translation":"雖然他喜歡網購，但他更喜歡去實體店面看過商品後再購買。","explanation":"指「實體的/真實存在的」。常搭配 store, shop, office。"},{"sentence":"The teacher noticed that bullying can have both <physical> *and* *mental* effects on the development of children.","translation":"老師注意到霸凌對兒童的發展會產生身體和心理上的影響。","explanation":"常與 mental 形成對比。指身體上的傷害或影響。"}],"related_forms":["physically"]}

{"headword":"physician","explanation":"名詞「內科醫生/醫師」。較正式的用法，指受過專業訓練的醫生，而非泛指所有醫生（如 surgeon 外科醫生）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <physician> *advised* *him* to change his diet and get more rest to improve his blood pressure.","translation":"醫生建議他改變飲食並多休息，以改善他的血壓。","explanation":"指醫生給予建議。常搭配 advise sb to do sth。"},{"sentence":"After years of hard work, she finally became a qualified <physician> *working* *in* a busy city hospital.","translation":"經過多年的努力，她終於成為了一名在繁忙城市醫院工作的合格醫師。","explanation":"指職業身份。常與 hospital, clinic 搭配。"},{"sentence":"It is important to consult a <physician> *if* you experience any pain that lasts for more than a few days.","translation":"如果你經歷任何持續超過幾天的疼痛，諮詢醫生是很重要的。","explanation":"指尋求專業醫療建議。常搭配 consult, see。"}],"related_forms":["physics","physical"]}

{"headword":"physicist","explanation":"名詞「物理學家」。指從事物理研究的科學家。","entries":[{"sentence":"The famous <physicist> *spent* his whole life trying to understand the basic laws that govern the universe.","translation":"這位著名的物理學家花了他的一生試圖了解支配宇宙的基本定律。","explanation":"指職業。常與 famous, brilliant 等形容詞搭配。"},{"sentence":"Many young students want to become a <physicist> *after* learning about space and time in their science class.","translation":"許多學生在科學課學習到空間與時間後，想成為一名物理學家。","explanation":"指未來的志向。常與 become, dream of being 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The <physicist> *worked* *with* a team of researchers to test her new theory about energy in the lab.","translation":"這位物理學家與研究團隊合作，在實驗室測試她關於能量的新理論。","explanation":"指物理學家的工作內容。常與 theory, research, experiment 搭配。"}],"related_forms":["physics","physical"]}

{"headword":"physics","explanation":"名詞「物理學」。注意結尾有 s，但視為單數名詞（學科名稱）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Learning <physics> *helps* *us* understand how things move and interact in the natural world around us.","translation":"學習物理學幫助我們了解事物如何在我們周遭的自然界中移動和交互作用。","explanation":"指學科。常與 study, learn 搭配。"},{"sentence":"He is very good at <physics> *and* *mathematics*, so he plans to study engineering at university.","translation":"他非常擅長物理和數學，所以他計畫在大學攻讀工程學。","explanation":"指學科能力。常與 be good at 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The teacher explained the basic <physics> *concepts* *behind* how airplanes can fly in the sky.","translation":"老師解釋了飛機如何在天空中飛行的基本物理概念。","explanation":"當作形容詞修飾名詞。常搭配 concepts, laws, principles。"}],"related_forms":["physicist","physical"]}

{"headword":"pickle","explanation":"名詞「醃菜/酸黃瓜」，動詞「醃製」。亦可比喻「困境」（in a pickle）。","entries":[{"sentence":"She likes to add a <pickle> *to* her sandwich to give it a fresh and sour taste during lunch.","translation":"她喜歡在三明治裡加一根酸黃瓜，讓午餐吃起來有清爽酸甜的味道。","explanation":"名詞，指醃漬蔬菜。常與 sandwich, burger 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The chef <pickles> *vegetables* *with* vinegar and salt to keep them fresh for a long time.","translation":"廚師用醋和鹽醃製蔬菜，以便讓它們長期保持新鮮。","explanation":"動詞，指醃製。常與 vinegar, salt 搭配。"},{"sentence":"I was really *in* *a* <pickle> when I lost my keys right before the important final exam.","translation":"在重要期末考前弄丟鑰匙，我真的是陷入了困境。","explanation":"慣用語 in a pickle = 處於困境中。常與 find oneself 搭配。"}],"related_forms":["pickles","pickled"]}

{"headword":"pioneer","explanation":"名詞「先驅/開拓者」，動詞「開拓/倡導」。形容在某領域率先做出貢獻的人或事。","entries":[{"sentence":"She was a <pioneer> *in* the field of medicine, being the first woman to win a major science prize.","translation":"她是醫學領域的先驅，是第一位獲得重大科學獎項的女性。","explanation":"名詞，指先行者。常搭配 in the field of, in the area of。"},{"sentence":"The company <pioneered> *new* *technology* that allowed people to connect with others across the world instantly.","translation":"該公司開拓了新技術，讓世界各地的人們能即時與他人聯繫。","explanation":"動詞，指率先開發。常搭配 new technology, methods, research。"},{"sentence":"Early <pioneers> *traveled* *across* the country on foot to find new places to build their homes.","translation":"早期的拓荒者徒步穿越全國，尋找新的地方建立家園。","explanation":"名詞，指開拓者。常與 travel, settle, explore 搭配。"}],"related_forms":["pioneering"]}

{"headword":"plentiful","explanation":"形容詞，意為「豐富的、大量的」。常見用法為 be plentiful (in sth) 或 plentiful supply of sth。注意與 abundant 同義，但 plentiful 常用於強調數量多到足夠或過剩。","entries":[{"sentence":"Fresh water is <plentiful> *in* this region, which allows local farmers to grow crops throughout the entire year without worrying about droughts.","translation":"這個地區淡水資源豐富，讓當地農民可以全年種植農作物，而不必擔心乾旱。","explanation":"be plentiful in sth 指某處某物豐富。本句展示了其在地理與農業情境的用法。"},{"sentence":"There is a <plentiful> *supply* *of* food at the charity event, so everyone will have enough to eat tonight.","translation":"慈善活動現場有充足的食物供應，所以每個人今晚都會有足夠的食物可以吃。","explanation":"a plentiful supply of sth 是常見的詞塊，表示「某物供應充足」。"},{"sentence":"Opportunities for finding a good job are <plentiful> *for* those who have strong language skills and a positive attitude toward learning.","translation":"對於擁有強語言能力且對學習持正向態度的人來說，找到好工作的機會非常多。","explanation":"plentiful for sb 指「對某人來說（機會/資源）很多」。"}],"related_forms":["plenty"]}

{"headword":"plot","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「情節/故事大綱」；(2) 名詞「陰謀/詭計」；(3) 名詞「小塊土地」；(4) 動詞「密謀/策劃」。GSAT 測驗中，情節與陰謀最為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The movie has a complex <plot> *with* many unexpected twists that keep the audience guessing until the very last scene.","translation":"這部電影有複雜的情節，包含許多意想不到的轉折，讓觀眾直到最後一幕都在猜測劇情。","explanation":"名詞「故事/電影情節」。a complex/twisting plot 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The rebels <plotted> *to* overthrow the government, but their secret plan was discovered by the police before it could be carried out.","translation":"叛軍密謀推翻政府，但他們的秘密計畫在執行前就被警方發現了。","explanation":"動詞「密謀」。plot to V 是常見句型。"},{"sentence":"They bought a small <plot> *of* land in the countryside, hoping to build a cozy house where they could retire together.","translation":"他們在鄉下買了一小塊土地，希望能蓋一間舒適的房子，在那裡一起退休。","explanation":"名詞「小塊土地」。a plot of land 為固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"The police uncovered a dangerous <plot> *to* rob the local bank by hacking into the security system during the weekend.","translation":"警方揭發了一個危險的陰謀，意圖在週末駭入保全系統來搶劫當地銀行。","explanation":"名詞「陰謀」。a plot to V 是常見用法，常與 uncover/discover/thwart 連用。"}],"related_forms":["plots","plotted","plotting"]}

{"headword":"plum","explanation":"名詞，意為「李子」。常用於描述顏色（深紫色）或作為水果。注意複數形式 plums。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to bake a delicious <plum> pie using the fresh fruits she picked from the garden this morning.","translation":"她決定用今天早上從花園裡摘的新鮮李子，烤一個美味的李子派。","explanation":"指作為食材的李子。plum pie 是常見的用法。"},{"sentence":"The artist chose a deep <plum> color for the walls of the living room to create a warm and artistic atmosphere.","translation":"藝術家為客廳的牆壁選擇了深李紫色，以營造出溫暖且具藝術氣息的氛圍。","explanation":"指顏色，即深紫色。"},{"sentence":"Sweet and juicy <plums> are in season now, so they are both very cheap and of excellent quality at the market.","translation":"香甜多汁的李子現在正值產季，所以市場上的李子既便宜品質又好。","explanation":"指季節性的水果。"}],"related_forms":["plums"]}

{"headword":"plumber","explanation":"名詞，意為「水管工人/水電工」。注意發音中 b 不發音。常用於維修家庭管線。","entries":[{"sentence":"We had to call a professional <plumber> because the kitchen sink was leaking and flooding the floor.","translation":"我們必須打電話給專業的水電工，因為廚房水槽漏水，淹得地板到處都是。","explanation":"說明呼叫專業人士的必要情境。"},{"sentence":"The <plumber> quickly fixed the broken pipe, saving us from a potential disaster in our bathroom.","translation":"水電工迅速修好了破裂的水管，讓我們免於浴室可能發生的災難。","explanation":"強調水電工的修復功能。"},{"sentence":"Being a skilled <plumber> requires not only physical strength but also a deep understanding of how water systems work.","translation":"成為一名熟練的水電工不僅需要體力，還需要深入了解水系統如何運作。","explanation":"描述職業所需的特質。"}],"related_forms":["plumbing"]}

{"headword":"poisonous","explanation":"形容詞，意為「有毒的」。可用於生物（蛇、蘑菇）或抽象事物（有毒的關係）。注意與 venomous（毒液注射）的差異，poisonous 通常指誤食或接觸會中毒。","entries":[{"sentence":"Some colorful mushrooms in the forest are highly <poisonous>, so you should never touch or eat them without expert advice.","translation":"森林裡一些色彩鮮豔的蘑菇具有劇毒，所以沒有專家的建議，你絕對不應該觸摸或食用它們。","explanation":"指植物或真菌的有毒性。highly poisonous 是常用搭配。"},{"sentence":"The snake is <poisonous>, and a single bite can cause serious health problems if it is not treated immediately.","translation":"這條蛇是有毒的，如果沒有立即治療，咬一口就可能導致嚴重的健康問題。","explanation":"指動物的有毒性。"},{"sentence":"They realized that staying in such a <poisonous> relationship was destroying their mental health and chose to break up.","translation":"他們意識到處在這種有毒的關係中正在摧毀他們的心理健康，因此選擇分手。","explanation":"指抽象的「有毒關係」，指負面、有害的互動。"}],"related_forms":["poison"]}

{"headword":"polish","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 動詞「擦亮/磨光」；(2) 動詞「潤飾/改進（文章或技巧）」；(3) 名詞「亮光劑/鞋油」。注意與 Polish（波蘭的）區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"He spent the whole afternoon <polishing> his car until it shone brightly in the afternoon sun.","translation":"他花了一整個下午擦亮他的車，直到它在午後陽光下閃閃發光。","explanation":"動詞「擦亮」。"},{"sentence":"Before submitting the essay to the teacher, you should take some time to <polish> your writing and correct any grammar mistakes.","translation":"在把文章交給老師之前，你應該花點時間潤飾你的寫作並修正任何文法錯誤。","explanation":"動詞「潤飾/改進文章」。"},{"sentence":"The dancer practiced for hours to <polish> her performance before the final competition on stage.","translation":"舞者練習了數小時，為了在舞台上的最後比賽前讓她的表演更臻完美。","explanation":"動詞「改進技巧/表演」。"},{"sentence":"She used a special <polish> *on* the wooden table to make it look brand new again after years of use.","translation":"她用一種特殊的亮光劑擦拭木桌，讓它在多年使用後看起來煥然一新。","explanation":"名詞「亮光劑」。"}],"related_forms":["polished","polishing"]}

{"headword":"popularity","explanation":"名詞，意為「受歡迎/普及/流行」。常用搭配：gain/lose popularity, grow in popularity。注意其形容詞形式為 popular。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new smartphone has gained great <popularity> *among* teenagers because of its high-quality camera and stylish design.","translation":"這款新款智慧型手機因為高品質的鏡頭和時尚的設計，在青少年之間獲得了極大的歡迎。","explanation":"gain popularity among sb 是常見搭配，指「在某群人中受歡迎」。"},{"sentence":"Despite its <popularity>, the local restaurant decided to close down because the owners wanted to retire and travel the world.","translation":"儘管這家當地餐廳很受歡迎，老闆還是決定歇業，因為他們想退休並環遊世界。","explanation":"despite its popularity 是常見的轉折語氣用法。"},{"sentence":"Online learning has grown in <popularity> recently, especially during the time when students had to stay home for health reasons.","translation":"線上學習最近變得越來越普及，特別是在學生因為健康因素必須待在家裡的那段期間。","explanation":"grow in popularity 指「普及度增加」。"}],"related_forms":["popular","popularize"]}

{"headword":"portable","explanation":"形容詞，意為「輕便的/手提的/可攜帶的」。常用於描述電子產品或工具，強調其便利性。","entries":[{"sentence":"This <portable> speaker is small and light enough for you to carry in your backpack during hiking trips.","translation":"這款手提喇叭又小又輕，足夠讓你登山旅行時放在背包裡攜帶。","explanation":"描述可攜帶的電子產品。"},{"sentence":"We bought a <portable> stove for our camping trip so that we could cook hot meals in the wild easily.","translation":"我們買了一個可攜式爐子去露營，這樣我們就能在野外輕鬆烹煮熱食。","explanation":"描述戶外用具的輕便性。"},{"sentence":"The company developed a new <portable> device that allows doctors to check patients' heart rates anywhere they go.","translation":"這家公司開發了一種新的手提裝置，讓醫生隨時隨地都能檢查病人的心跳。","explanation":"描述醫療設備的可攜性。"}],"related_forms":["portability"]}

{"headword":"portray","explanation":"動詞，意為「描繪/刻畫（角色或畫面）」。常指在文學、藝術或電影中呈現某個人物或主題。注意搭配詞為 portray sb/sth as sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The actor perfectly <portrayed> the hero *as* a brave but lonely person who struggles to find his place in the world.","translation":"那位演員完美地將英雄刻畫成一個勇敢但孤獨的人，掙扎著在世界上尋找自己的位置。","explanation":"portray sb as sth 是非常重要的句型，指「將某人描繪成...」。"},{"sentence":"The novel <portrays> the daily life of people living in a small village during the war with great detail.","translation":"這本小說詳細地描繪了戰爭期間生活在小村莊的人們的日常生活。","explanation":"指對生活或情境的細膩描寫。"},{"sentence":"In many classic movies, the villain is often <portrayed> *as* someone who is cold-hearted and seeks only power.","translation":"在許多經典電影中，反派角色常被描繪成冷酷無情且只追求權力的人。","explanation":"被動語態的使用。portrayed as sth 說明角色設定。"}],"related_forms":["portrayal"]}

{"headword":"possess","explanation":"動詞，意為「擁有/具備（特質或財產）」。比 have 更正式。常用於 possess a quality / possess property。注意不可用進行式 (stative verb)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To succeed in this difficult job, you must <possess> *a* strong desire to learn and the ability to work under pressure.","translation":"要在這份困難的工作中取得成功，你必須具備強烈的學習渴望以及在壓力下工作的能力。","explanation":"指具備某種特質。possess a quality 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The ancient palace is said to <possess> many secret rooms that have not been opened for hundreds of years.","translation":"據說這座古老的宮殿擁有許多已經幾百年沒有被打開過的秘密房間。","explanation":"指擁有財產或物品。"},{"sentence":"She <possesses> a unique talent for music, which allows her to play any instrument after hearing a song only once.","translation":"她擁有獨特的音樂天賦，這使她只要聽過一次歌就能演奏任何樂器。","explanation":"指具備天賦。"}],"related_forms":["possession","possessions"]}

{"headword":"possession","explanation":"名詞「擁有、佔有」或「財產、所有物」。常用搭配：in one's possession (在某人保管中)；take possession of (取得...的佔有權)。不可數指「擁有權」，可數指「個人物品/財產」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police finally found the stolen jewelry in the suspect's <possession> after a long and difficult investigation.","translation":"經過漫長而艱難的調查，警方最終在嫌疑人身上發現了失竊的珠寶。","explanation":"片語 in the possession of sb / in one's possession 表示「在某人保管中/某人持有」。"},{"sentence":"When moving to a new city, she decided to sell most of her personal <possessions> because the apartment was too small.","translation":"搬到新城市時，她決定賣掉大部分個人物品，因為公寓太小了。","explanation":"名詞複數指「個人財產、所有物」。"},{"sentence":"The athlete *took* <possession> *of* the ball and quickly ran down the court to score a winning point.","translation":"這位運動員取得了控球權，並迅速跑過球場得分以贏得比賽。","explanation":"片語 take possession of 表「取得...的控制權/佔有權」。"}],"related_forms":["possess","possessions"]}

{"headword":"postage","explanation":"名詞「郵資」。常見搭配：pay the postage；postage stamp (郵票)。注意此字為不可數名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please make sure to *pay* the <postage> before sending the heavy package abroad, or it will be returned to you.","translation":"在將沉重的包裹寄往國外之前，請務必支付郵資，否則它將會被退回給你。","explanation":"pay the postage 是常見搭配，指支付運送費用。"},{"sentence":"The price of the book does not *include* the <postage>, so you will need to add five dollars for shipping.","translation":"這本書的價格不包含郵資，所以你需要額外支付五美元作為運費。","explanation":"在網購情境中常出現 include/exclude postage。"},{"sentence":"Nowadays, most people prefer sending emails rather than letters because they want to avoid the cost of <postage>.","translation":"如今，大多數人更喜歡發送電子郵件而不是信件，因為他們想節省郵資成本。","explanation":"指郵寄信件所需的費用。"}],"related_forms":["post","postal"]}

{"headword":"potential","explanation":"形容詞「潛在的」；名詞「潛力」。常用搭配：potential customer/problem；reach one's full potential (發揮最大潛力)。注意拼字結尾為 -tial。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new manager sees great <potential> in all the young employees and encourages them to work hard on their projects.","translation":"新經理在所有年輕員工身上看到了巨大的潛力，並鼓勵他們在專案上努力工作。","explanation":"名詞用法，常搭配 see/have potential in sb/sth。"},{"sentence":"Students should *reach* their full <potential> by exploring different interests and challenging themselves in various subjects.","translation":"學生應該透過探索不同興趣並在各學科中挑戰自我，來發揮他們的全部潛能。","explanation":"reach one's full potential 是固定搭配，指發揮最大潛能。"},{"sentence":"We must *identify* all the <potential> risks before starting the experiment to ensure everyone's safety in the lab.","translation":"在開始實驗之前，我們必須識別所有潛在風險，以確保實驗室中每個人的安全。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾名詞，指「潛在的、可能發生的」。"},{"sentence":"The company is looking for <potential> customers by advertising their products on social media platforms.","translation":"該公司正透過在社群媒體平台上廣告其產品，來尋找潛在客戶。","explanation":"potential customers 為常見商業搭配。"}],"related_forms":["potentially"]}

{"headword":"precise","explanation":"形容詞「精確的、準確的」。區別：precise 指細節上的精準；accurate 指與事實相符的準確。常用於描述數據、時間或測量。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist needed a <precise> measurement to finish the research, so she used a high-quality digital scale.","translation":"這位科學家需要精確的測量數據來完成研究，所以她使用了一個高品質的數位秤。","explanation":"形容詞用法，常修飾 measurement, time, data 等名詞。"},{"sentence":"Can you tell me the <precise> time the train left the station? I need to know for my report.","translation":"你能告訴我火車離開車站的確切時間嗎？我的報告需要知道這些資訊。","explanation":"precise time 指「確切的時間」。"},{"sentence":"She followed the instructions with <precise> attention to detail, resulting in a perfectly baked cake.","translation":"她非常注意細節地遵循指示，結果烤出了一個完美的蛋糕。","explanation":"強調對細節的精確掌控。"}],"related_forms":["precisely","precision"]}

{"headword":"predict","explanation":"動詞「預測、預報」。常用於天氣預報或未來趨勢。注意與 forecast 的區別：predict 可用於各種事物，forecast 常指天氣或經濟。","entries":[{"sentence":"Experts <predict> that the use of artificial intelligence will *change* the way we work in the next decade.","translation":"專家預測，人工智慧的使用將在未來十年改變我們的工作方式。","explanation":"常用句型：Experts/Scientists predict that...。"},{"sentence":"It is difficult to <predict> the outcome of the game because both teams are equally strong and skilled.","translation":"很難預測比賽的結果，因為兩隊實力相當且技術精湛。","explanation":"predict the outcome 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Although the weatherman <predicted> sunny skies, it started raining heavily right after we arrived at the park.","translation":"雖然氣象預報員預測是晴天，但我們剛到公園不久就開始下大雨了。","explanation":"用於天氣預報的情境。"}],"related_forms":["prediction","predictable"]}

{"headword":"prediction","explanation":"名詞「預測、預言」。常用搭配：make a prediction；accurate/wild prediction。與動詞 predict 搭配一致。","entries":[{"sentence":"Her <prediction> about the stock market proved to be correct, and she earned a lot of money as a result.","translation":"她對股市的預測被證明是正確的，結果她賺了很多錢。","explanation":"指對未來的看法或預測。"},{"sentence":"It is hard to *make* a <prediction> about the future of this company due to the unstable economic situation.","translation":"由於不穩定的經濟局勢，很難對這家公司的未來做出預測。","explanation":"固定搭配 make a prediction。"},{"sentence":"Many scientists have *based* their <prediction> *on* recent data collected from climate research stations around the world.","translation":"許多科學家根據全球氣候研究站收集的最新數據做出了預測。","explanation":"搭配片語 base... on... 表示「根據...做預測」。"}],"related_forms":["predict"]}

{"headword":"pregnancy","explanation":"名詞「懷孕（時期）」。常用於醫學或生活保健內容。注意此字為可數名詞（指某次懷孕），也可作不可數名詞（指懷孕的狀態）。","entries":[{"sentence":"During her <pregnancy>, she made sure to eat healthy food and exercise regularly to stay strong and fit.","translation":"在懷孕期間，她確保吃健康的食物並定期運動，以保持強壯和健康。","explanation":"during pregnancy 指「懷孕期間」。"},{"sentence":"Doctors often recommend that women take vitamins to support a healthy <pregnancy> and ensure the baby grows well.","translation":"醫生經常建議女性服用維生素，以支持健康的懷孕過程並確保寶寶發育良好。","explanation":"指懷孕的過程。"},{"sentence":"She decided to *announce* her <pregnancy> to her friends and family during the holiday dinner party.","translation":"她決定在假日晚餐聚會時向親友宣布她懷孕的消息。","explanation":"announce one's pregnancy 是常見表達方式。"}],"related_forms":["pregnant"]}

{"headword":"pregnant","explanation":"形容詞「懷孕的」。注意：不可說 pregnant with a baby，直接說 pregnant 即可。常見搭配：get pregnant (懷孕)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The woman is <pregnant> and expects to give birth to her first child early next spring.","translation":"這位女士懷孕了，預計明年春天初將生下她的第一個孩子。","explanation":"形容詞用法，直接修飾主詞。"},{"sentence":"Many women feel tired when they *get* <pregnant> because their bodies are working hard to support the growing baby.","translation":"許多女性在懷孕時會感到疲倦，因為她們的身體正努力支持寶寶的成長。","explanation":"get pregnant 指「懷孕」這個動作/過程。"},{"sentence":"It is important for a <pregnant> woman to visit the doctor regularly to check on her health.","translation":"對孕婦來說，定期去看醫生檢查健康狀況是很重要的。","explanation":"pregnant woman 即「孕婦」。"}],"related_forms":["pregnancy"]}

{"headword":"presentation","explanation":"名詞「簡報、介紹、報告」。常用搭配：give/make a presentation；a slide presentation。在學校與職場中極為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student *gave* a clear <presentation> *on* climate change, using many charts and pictures to explain his points.","translation":"這位學生針對氣候變遷做了一場清晰的簡報，並使用了許多圖表和圖片來解釋他的觀點。","explanation":"give a presentation on sth 是標準用法。"},{"sentence":"To *prepare* for the <presentation>, the team met several times to organize their ideas and practice their speech.","translation":"為了準備簡報，團隊開了幾次會來整理想法並練習演講。","explanation":"prepare for the presentation 是常見情境。"},{"sentence":"The company's marketing <presentation> was so impressive that all the potential clients decided to sign the contract.","translation":"該公司的行銷簡報令人印象深刻，以至於所有潛在客戶都決定簽約。","explanation":"形容詞 marketing 修飾 presentation。"}],"related_forms":["present"]}

{"headword":"preservation","explanation":"名詞「保護、保存、維護」。常用於「環境保育」或「古蹟保存」。動詞為 preserve。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is *working* *on* the <preservation> of old buildings to protect the city's unique history.","translation":"政府正致力於保存古老建築，以維護這座城市獨特的歷史。","explanation":"preservation of sth 指「對某事物的保存」。"},{"sentence":"Environmental groups are fighting for the <preservation> of forests, which are home to many rare animals.","translation":"環保團體正在為森林的保護而奮鬥，這些森林是許多珍稀動物的家園。","explanation":"用於環境保育議題。"},{"sentence":"The food <preservation> method used by ancient people, such as drying or salting, is still useful today.","translation":"古代人使用的食物保存方法，例如乾燥或醃漬，在今天仍然有用。","explanation":"food preservation 指「食物保存」。"}],"related_forms":["preserve"]}

{"headword":"preserve","explanation":"動詞「保存、維護」，強調維持原狀或防止衰退。常見搭配：preserve wildlife, preserve peace, preserve cultural heritage。易混淆：reserve（預訂/保留）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is working hard to <preserve> *the* *natural* *beauty* of the national park for future generations to enjoy.","translation":"政府正在努力維護國家公園的自然美景，讓後代子孫能夠享受。","explanation":"preserve sth of... 表保存某事物的某種狀態。常與環境保護議題連用。"},{"sentence":"To <preserve> *peace* in the region, the two countries agreed to stop their military exercises near the border.","translation":"為了維護該地區的和平，兩國同意停止在邊境附近的軍事演習。","explanation":"preserve peace 為固定搭配，表「維持和平」。"},{"sentence":"This organization aims to <preserve> *cultural* *heritage* by teaching younger people traditional crafts and languages.","translation":"該組織旨在透過教導年輕人傳統工藝和語言，來保存文化遺產。","explanation":"cultural heritage（文化遺產）是學測常考的社會議題詞彙，與 preserve 搭配常見。"},{"sentence":"Salt is often used to <preserve> *food* because it stops the growth of bacteria that cause decay.","translation":"鹽常被用來保存食物，因為它能阻止導致腐敗的細菌生長。","explanation":"指保存食物的新鮮度，preserve food 是基礎用法。"}],"related_forms":["preservation","preservative"]}

{"headword":"prevention","explanation":"名詞「預防、防止」。常見搭配：prevention is better than cure（預防勝於治療）；disease prevention。注意與 prevent (v.) 的詞性區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor emphasized that the <prevention> *of* *heart* *disease* starts with a healthy diet and regular physical exercise.","translation":"醫生強調，心臟病的預防始於健康的飲食和規律的運動。","explanation":"prevention of sth 為固定結構，後接欲預防的對象。"},{"sentence":"Strict safety regulations are essential for the <prevention> *of* *accidents* in this construction site.","translation":"嚴格的安全法規對於預防這個工地的意外事故至關重要。","explanation":"常用搭配 prevention of accidents/crimes，強調透過規範來防止負面結果。"},{"sentence":"The charity focuses its efforts on the <prevention> *of* *child* *abuse* by providing support services to struggling families.","translation":"該慈善機構致力於透過向困難家庭提供支持服務，來防止虐待兒童事件。","explanation":"prevention of + 名詞，表示對於某種不良現象的防治。"}],"related_forms":["prevent","preventive"]}

{"headword":"prime","explanation":"形容詞「首要的、最好的、典型的」；名詞「全盛時期」。常見搭配：prime time (黃金時段), prime location (絕佳位置)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Safety is our <prime> *concern* when we organize school trips for students, so we check every bus carefully.","translation":"我們在組織學生校外教學時，安全是我們首要的考量，所以我們會仔細檢查每一輛巴士。","explanation":"prime concern 指「首要擔憂/關切事項」。"},{"sentence":"The restaurant is located in a <prime> *location* in the city center, which makes it very popular with tourists.","translation":"這家餐廳位於市中心的絕佳位置，這使得它非常受遊客歡迎。","explanation":"prime location 指「黃金地段、絕佳位置」。"},{"sentence":"In his <prime>, the athlete won three gold medals in the Olympic Games, setting a new world record.","translation":"在他全盛時期，這位運動員在奧運會上贏得了三枚金牌，並創下了新的世界紀錄。","explanation":"in one's prime 是名詞用法，指「全盛期」。"},{"sentence":"The company is looking for a <prime> *candidate* who has both leadership skills and years of work experience.","translation":"這家公司正在尋找一位具備領導能力和多年工作經驗的首選候選人。","explanation":"prime candidate 指「最佳人選」。"}],"related_forms":["primarily","primary"]}

{"headword":"primitive","explanation":"形容詞「原始的、簡陋的」。可用於描述遠古社會、技術或設備。注意不要與 primary（主要的）混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tribe still lives in <primitive> *huts* made of wood and leaves, far away from modern city life.","translation":"這個部落仍然住在由木頭和樹葉製成的簡陋小屋裡，遠離現代城市生活。","explanation":"primitive 描述居住環境或工具時，帶有「簡陋、未開化」的意味。"},{"sentence":"Early humans used <primitive> *tools* made of stone to hunt animals and prepare their daily meals.","translation":"早期人類使用石製的原始工具來狩獵動物並準備日常餐點。","explanation":"primitive tools 指技術發展初期的簡單工具。"},{"sentence":"The island's transportation system is quite <primitive>, with only a few unpaved roads and no buses.","translation":"這個島嶼的交通系統相當原始，只有幾條未鋪設的道路，而且沒有公車。","explanation":"形容設施落後、缺乏現代化技術。"}],"related_forms":["primitively"]}

{"headword":"priority","explanation":"名詞「優先權、優先事項」。常見搭配：give priority to (優先考慮...), top priority (首要任務)。易錯：拼字 (priority, -ity 結尾)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Our top <priority> *is* *to* finish the project before the deadline, so we have to work overtime this week.","translation":"我們的首要任務是在截止日期前完成這個專案，所以我們這週必須加班。","explanation":"top priority 是常見搭配，表「最重要的任務」。"},{"sentence":"The committee decided to *give* <priority> *to* the needs of elderly people when distributing the food supplies.","translation":"委員會決定在發放糧食補給時，優先考慮老年人的需求。","explanation":"give priority to sth 是核心用法，表示「把某事視為優先」。"},{"sentence":"Students often struggle to balance their studies and social lives, making it hard to set the right <priority>.","translation":"學生們常在平衡學業和社交生活上掙扎，這讓他們很難設定正確的優先順序。","explanation":"set a priority 指「設定優先順序」。"},{"sentence":"In emergency situations, medical workers *give* <priority> *to* those who are most seriously injured.","translation":"在緊急情況下，醫護人員會優先照顧那些受傷最嚴重的人。","explanation":"give priority to sb 指「優先照顧/處理某人」。"}],"related_forms":["prior","prioritize"]}

{"headword":"privacy","explanation":"名詞「隱私」。常見搭配：invasion of privacy (侵犯隱私), protect one's privacy。注意發音與拼字。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people are worried that the use of smart cameras in public places is an *invasion* *of* <privacy>.","translation":"許多人擔心在公共場所使用智慧攝影機是對隱私的侵犯。","explanation":"invasion of privacy 為固定搭配，常見於相關閱讀測驗。"},{"sentence":"Social media users should be careful about what they share online to better <protect> *their* <privacy>.","translation":"社群媒體使用者應該小心他們在網路上分享的內容，以更好地保護他們的隱私。","explanation":"protect one's privacy 是相關議題常見的動詞搭配。"},{"sentence":"She closed the door to have some <privacy> while she was writing her personal diary in the room.","translation":"她關上門，以便在房間裡寫個人日記時能有一些隱私空間。","explanation":"have some privacy 指「擁有私密空間/不被打擾」。"}],"related_forms":["private"]}

{"headword":"privilege","explanation":"名詞「特權、榮幸」；動詞「給予特權」。常見搭配：have the privilege of doing sth (有幸做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is a great <privilege> *to* *meet* such a famous author and listen to her talk about her new book.","translation":"能見到這麼著名的作家並聽她談論她的新書，真是莫大的榮幸。","explanation":"It is a privilege to V 是正式且常見的表達用法，表「榮幸」。"},{"sentence":"In some ancient societies, only the rich had the <privilege> *of* *receiving* a good education.","translation":"在一些古代社會，只有富人享有接受良好教育的特權。","explanation":"privilege of doing sth 指「做某事的特權/優待」。"},{"sentence":"Driving a car is a <privilege>, not a right, so you must follow all the traffic rules carefully.","translation":"開車是一種特權而非權利，所以你必須謹慎遵守所有的交通規則。","explanation":"區分 privilege (優待) 與 right (基本權利) 的概念。"},{"sentence":"The new policy <privileges> *the* *wealthy* by giving them tax breaks that middle-class families do not get.","translation":"這項新政策優待富人，給予他們中產階級家庭無法獲得的減稅優惠。","explanation":"動詞用法，表「給予...特殊優待」。"}],"related_forms":["privileged"]}

{"headword":"procedure","explanation":"名詞「程序、步驟、手續」。常用於醫療、實驗、行政程序。常見搭配：follow the procedure, standard procedure。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please *follow* *the* <procedure> *carefully* to ensure that the chemical experiment is conducted safely in the lab.","translation":"請小心遵循程序，以確保化學實驗在實驗室中安全地進行。","explanation":"follow the procedure 為標準搭配，表「遵守程序」。"},{"sentence":"The hospital has a *standard* <procedure> for dealing with emergency cases to save as many lives as possible.","translation":"醫院有處理緊急病例的標準程序，以盡可能挽救更多的生命。","explanation":"standard procedure 指「標準作業程序」。"},{"sentence":"Before you can open a bank account, you need to complete several *administrative* <procedures> at the counter.","translation":"在開立銀行帳戶之前，你需要先在櫃檯完成幾項行政手續。","explanation":"administrative procedures 指「行政手續/流程」。"}],"related_forms":["proceed","procedural"]}

{"headword":"proceed","explanation":"動詞「繼續、前往」。常見搭配：proceed to (前往某處), proceed with (繼續進行某事)。注意與 procedure 的詞源關聯。","entries":[{"sentence":"After a short break, the meeting will <proceed> *with* the discussion about next year's marketing plan.","translation":"短暫休息後，會議將繼續討論明年的行銷計畫。","explanation":"proceed with sth 為固定搭配，表「繼續進行某事」。"},{"sentence":"Passengers for the flight to London should <proceed> *to* gate 25 for boarding immediately.","translation":"飛往倫敦的乘客請立即前往 25 號登機門準備登機。","explanation":"proceed to + 地點，是機場/車站廣播常見用法，表「前往」。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer decided to <proceed> *with* the legal action even though the chances of winning were low.","translation":"儘管勝訴機會渺茫，律師仍決定繼續進行法律訴訟。","explanation":"proceed with 指「繼續執行（法律程序或計畫）。"}],"related_forms":["proceeds","procedure"]}

{"headword":"productive","explanation":"形容詞「有生產力的、富有成效的」。常見搭配：productive discussion, be productive at work。反義詞：unproductive。","entries":[{"sentence":"We had a very <productive> *discussion* this morning, and we finally agreed on the design of the new product.","translation":"我們今天早上進行了一場非常有成效的討論，最終對新產品的設計達成共識。","explanation":"productive discussion 為常見用法，表「有建設性的討論」。"},{"sentence":"To be more <productive> *at* *work*, you should avoid checking your phone every few minutes.","translation":"為了在工作上更有效率，你應該避免每隔幾分鐘就查看手機。","explanation":"productive at work 指「工作上有生產力/效率高」。"},{"sentence":"The scientist spent a <productive> *year* in the lab, where she made several important discoveries about plant growth.","translation":"這位科學家在實驗室度過了富有成效的一年，期間她在植物生長方面有了幾項重要發現。","explanation":"productive year 指「成果豐碩的一年」。"}],"related_forms":["produce","production","productivity"]}

{"headword":"profession","explanation":"指需要經過長期教育與專業訓練的工作（如醫師、律師、教師），較強調專業性與社會地位。常見用法：the medical/teaching profession (醫療/教育界)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to enter the medical <profession> because she has always wanted to help sick people regain their health.","translation":"她決定踏入醫療行業，因為她一直希望能幫助病人恢復健康。","explanation":"指稱某個特定的職業領域，常用在學術或社會地位較高的工作中。"},{"sentence":"Choosing a suitable <profession> is a significant decision that requires careful consideration of one's personal interests and skills.","translation":"選擇一個合適的職業是一個重大的決定，需要仔細考慮個人的興趣與技能。","explanation":"泛指職業選擇。注意 profession 通常指需要高等學歷或專業技能的職業。"},{"sentence":"He has spent his whole life in the teaching <profession>, guiding countless students toward a brighter future.","translation":"他畢生投身於教職，引導無數學生邁向更光明的未來。","explanation":"in the ... profession 是固定用法，指從事某種專業領域。"}],"related_forms":["professional"]}

{"headword":"professional","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 形容詞「專業的/職業的」；(2) 名詞「專業人士」。常見搭配：professional advice, professional athlete。","entries":[{"sentence":"To ensure the best results, you should seek *<professional> advice* from a qualified expert before starting your own small business.","translation":"為了確保最好的結果，你在開始自己的小生意前，應該尋求專業人士的建議。","explanation":"形容詞用法，意指具備專業水準的建議。*professional advice* 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"She maintained a highly *<professional> attitude* even when the client was being difficult and unreasonable during the meeting.","translation":"即使客戶在會議中表現得很難搞且不講理，她依然保持著高度專業的態度。","explanation":"形容詞用法，強調工作態度。*professional attitude* 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The young athlete decided to turn <professional> after winning the national championship, hoping to compete in the Olympic Games.","translation":"這名年輕選手在贏得全國冠軍後決定轉為職業選手，希望能參加奧運比賽。","explanation":"形容詞用法，turn professional 指「轉為職業選手」。"},{"sentence":"The project failed because it lacked a *<professional> touch*, making the final report look like it was written by a student.","translation":"該專案失敗了，因為它缺乏專業的感覺，使得最終報告看起來像是由學生寫的。","explanation":"名詞用法，指具備專家水準的處理方式。"}],"related_forms":["profession","professionally"]}

{"headword":"profitable","explanation":"形容詞「有利可圖的、有獲利的」。常與 business, venture, investment 等詞連用。","entries":[{"sentence":"Investing in new technology has proven to be a highly *<profitable> venture* for the company over the last five years.","translation":"過去五年來，投資新科技已被證實對該公司而言是一項獲利極高的事業。","explanation":"形容詞用法。*profitable venture* 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Although the small café is popular with students, it is not very *<profitable> because* the ingredients are expensive.","translation":"雖然這間小咖啡館深受學生歡迎，但它獲利並不高，因為食材很昂貴。","explanation":"形容詞用法，描述獲利狀況。"},{"sentence":"We need to find more *<profitable> ways* to market our products if we want to increase our total annual revenue.","translation":"如果我們想要增加年度總營收，就需要找到更多有利可圖的方式來行銷產品。","explanation":"profitable ways 指能帶來利潤的方法。"}],"related_forms":["profit","profiteer"]}

{"headword":"prominent","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的、傑出的、重要的」。指在某領域中有名氣，或外觀上很顯眼。近義詞：famous, noticeable。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university invited a *<prominent> scholar* to give a speech about the latest developments in artificial intelligence.","translation":"大學邀請了一位傑出的學者，針對人工智慧的最新發展進行演講。","explanation":"形容詞，修飾人，意指知名的、重要的。*prominent scholar* 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"She hung the painting in a *<prominent> place* in the living room so that every guest would notice it immediately.","translation":"她將畫掛在客廳顯眼的地方，這樣每位客人都會立刻注意到它。","explanation":"形容詞，修飾位置，意指顯眼的。*prominent place* 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Because of his *<prominent> role* in the community, he was elected as the leader of the local neighborhood committee.","translation":"由於他在社區中扮演重要角色，他被選為當地鄰里委員會的領導人。","explanation":"形容詞，修飾角色/地位，意指重要的。*prominent role* 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["prominence"]}

{"headword":"promising","explanation":"形容詞「有前途的、大有可為的」。常用來形容新人、計畫或前景，表示未來成功的可能性高。","entries":[{"sentence":"The coach believes the young player is a *<promising> talent* who will eventually become a star in the national league.","translation":"教練認為這位年輕球員是個有前途的天才，終究會成為國家聯賽中的明星。","explanation":"形容詞，描述人才。*promising talent* 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Despite the difficult economic situation, the new startup shows *<promising> signs* of growth in the international market.","translation":"儘管經濟局勢困難，這家新創公司在國際市場上展現出成長的跡象，前景看好。","explanation":"形容詞，描述跡象。*promising signs* 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The project had a *<promising> start*, but it faced many unexpected problems as the deadline approached.","translation":"這個專案有個好的開始，但隨著截止日期逼近，它面臨了許多預料之外的問題。","explanation":"形容詞，描述開始。*promising start* 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["promise"]}

{"headword":"promotion","explanation":"名詞「升遷、促銷、推廣」。常見用法：get a promotion, sales promotion, promotion of health。","entries":[{"sentence":"After working hard for three years, he finally earned a *<promotion> to* the position of project manager.","translation":"工作三年後，他終於獲得了升遷，成為專案經理。","explanation":"名詞，指職位升遷。常用 get/earn a promotion to + 職位。"},{"sentence":"The store is running a special *<promotion> for* the holiday season, offering discounts on almost all electronic items.","translation":"這家商店正在進行假日特別促銷，幾乎所有電子產品都提供折扣。","explanation":"名詞，指銷售推廣活動。*promotion for* + 活動/節日是常見用法。"},{"sentence":"The government launched a public health *<promotion> to* encourage citizens to exercise more frequently and eat healthier food.","translation":"政府發起了一項公共健康推廣活動，鼓勵市民更頻繁地運動並吃更健康的食物。","explanation":"名詞，指推廣某種概念或政策。*promotion to* V. 為常見結構。"}],"related_forms":["promote"]}

{"headword":"prompt","explanation":"多詞性用法：(1) 形容詞「準時的、立即的」；(2) 動詞「促使、導致」；(3) 名詞「提示、作文題目」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company requires *<prompt> action* from all employees whenever a customer reports a serious problem with a product.","translation":"每當客戶反映產品有嚴重問題時，公司都要求所有員工採取立即的行動。","explanation":"形容詞，意指立即的、迅速的。*prompt action* 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Being *<prompt> for* appointments shows that you are a reliable person who respects other people's time.","translation":"準時赴約顯示你是個可靠的人，並且尊重他人的時間。","explanation":"形容詞，指準時的。固定搭配 prompt for + 時間/約會。"},{"sentence":"The sudden drop in stock prices *<prompted> the* investors to sell their shares quickly to avoid losing more money.","translation":"股價的突然下跌促使投資人迅速賣出持股，以避免損失更多金錢。","explanation":"動詞，意指促使某人做某事。結構：prompt sb to V。"},{"sentence":"The teacher gave the students a creative writing *<prompt> about* their dream travel destination to practice their essay skills.","translation":"老師給學生一個關於夢想旅遊目的地的作文題目，讓他們練習寫作技巧。","explanation":"名詞，指寫作提示或命題。"}],"related_forms":["promptly"]}

{"headword":"pronunciation","explanation":"名詞「發音」。注意與動詞 pronounce 的區別。常用搭配：practice one's pronunciation, accurate pronunciation。","entries":[{"sentence":"The English teacher corrected her *<pronunciation> of* the word because she kept stressing the wrong syllable during class.","translation":"英文老師糾正了她對那個字的發音，因為她在課堂上一直重音放錯位置。","explanation":"名詞，指發音。*pronunciation of* 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"You can improve your *<pronunciation> by* listening to podcasts and repeating the phrases after the native speakers.","translation":"你可以透過聽播客並跟著母語人士重複短句來改善你的發音。","explanation":"名詞，指發音能力。常用 improve/practice pronunciation。"},{"sentence":"His clear and accurate *<pronunciation> made* it very easy for the audience to understand his presentation on climate change.","translation":"他清晰且準確的發音讓觀眾非常容易聽懂他關於氣候變遷的簡報。","explanation":"形容詞修飾名詞，指發音的品質。*clear/accurate pronunciation* 為常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["pronounce"]}

{"headword":"proposal","explanation":"名詞「提議、提案、求婚」。常見搭配：submit a proposal, make a proposal。","entries":[{"sentence":"The committee will review the *<proposal> for* the new library building before deciding whether to approve the budget.","translation":"委員會將在決定是否核准預算前，審查新圖書館大樓的提案。","explanation":"名詞，指正式的提案。*proposal for* 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"She spent the whole weekend writing a detailed *<proposal> to* convince her boss that the new project was worth investing in.","translation":"她花了整個週末寫一份詳盡的提案，以說服老闆這個新專案值得投資。","explanation":"名詞，指書面提議。*proposal to* V. 表示提案的目的。"},{"sentence":"He finally decided to make a *<proposal> of* marriage to his girlfriend after dating for five wonderful years.","translation":"在交往了五年美好的時光後，他終於決定向女友求婚。","explanation":"名詞，指求婚。make a proposal of marriage 是較正式的說法。"}],"related_forms":["propose"]}

{"headword":"prosper","explanation":"動詞「繁榮、興旺、成功」。常用於描述企業、城市或個人的發展。","entries":[{"sentence":"With the help of the new government policies, many small businesses have begun to *<prosper> in* the local area.","translation":"在政府新政策的幫助下，許多小型企業開始在當地興旺起來。","explanation":"動詞，指商業繁榮。*prosper in* 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The city has continued to *<prosper> as* a center for trade and technology over the past several decades.","translation":"過去幾十年來，這座城市持續作為貿易與科技中心而繁榮發展。","explanation":"動詞，指城市興旺。*prosper as* + 身分/角色。"},{"sentence":"A supportive and loving environment is essential for children to *<prosper> both* physically and mentally as they grow up.","translation":"一個給予支持且充滿愛的環境，對於孩子在成長過程中身心健全發展至關重要。","explanation":"動詞，指茁壯成長。*prosper both* ... and ... 結構強調多方面的發展。"}],"related_forms":["prosperity","prosperous"]}

{"headword":"prosperity","explanation":"名詞「繁榮、興旺」。常指經濟上的成功或社會整體的富足。常見搭配：economic prosperity, enjoy/bring prosperity。與形容詞 prosperous 區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many experts believe that education is the key to national <prosperity> because it helps create a skilled workforce for the future.","translation":"許多專家相信教育是國家繁榮的關鍵，因為它有助於為未來創造技術純熟的勞動力。","explanation":"名詞用法，指國家層級的繁榮。key to + N 是重要句型。"},{"sentence":"The country *enjoyed* great <prosperity> after the war, with new industries growing rapidly and unemployment rates falling significantly.","translation":"戰後該國享有巨大的繁榮，新興產業快速成長，失業率顯著下降。","explanation":"enjoy prosperity 是常見搭配，表示「享有繁榮」。"},{"sentence":"Sustainable development is essential if we want to ensure long-term <prosperity> for future generations without harming the environment.","translation":"如果我們想要確保後代子孫有長期的繁榮，同時又不破壞環境，永續發展是必要的。","explanation":"指長期的繁榮，常與 sustainable/long-term 連用。"}],"related_forms":["prosperous","prosper"]}

{"headword":"prosperous","explanation":"形容詞「繁榮的、富裕的」。用來形容國家、城市、企業或個人處於成功、富有的狀態。常見搭配：a prosperous country, a prosperous business。","entries":[{"sentence":"In a <prosperous> society, people generally have more access to quality healthcare and better educational opportunities for their children.","translation":"在一個繁榮的社會中，人們通常有更多機會獲得優質的醫療保健，以及為孩子提供更好的教育機會。","explanation":"形容社會狀態，與 prosperous society 連用。"},{"sentence":"The small town became a <prosperous> center of trade after the government decided to build a new harbor nearby.","translation":"在政府決定在附近興建新港口後，這個小鎮成為了一個繁榮的貿易中心。","explanation":"形容地方的繁榮，指經濟活動活躍。"},{"sentence":"She worked hard to build a <prosperous> clothing company that now sells products to customers all over the world.","translation":"她努力建立了一家繁榮的服飾公司，現在產品銷往世界各地的客戶。","explanation":"形容企業的成功與賺錢。"}],"related_forms":["prosperity","prosper"]}

{"headword":"protein","explanation":"名詞「蛋白質」。生物與營養學關鍵字。常見搭配：high-protein diet, rich in protein。注意是不可數名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"Eggs and lean meat are *rich* *in* <protein>, which is necessary for repairing muscles after intense exercise.","translation":"雞蛋和瘦肉富含蛋白質，這對於劇烈運動後修復肌肉是必要的。","explanation":"be rich in + N 為常用句型，表示「富含...」。"},{"sentence":"Many athletes follow a *high-protein* <diet> to build more muscle mass and improve their overall physical performance during competitions.","translation":"許多運動員遵循高蛋白飲食，以增加肌肉量並提高比賽期間的整體身體表現。","explanation":"high-protein diet 是營養學常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Beans and nuts are excellent *sources* *of* <protein> for vegetarians who do not eat any meat or fish products.","translation":"豆類和堅果對於不吃任何肉類或魚類產品的素食者來說，是絕佳的蛋白質來源。","explanation":"source of protein 表示「蛋白質來源」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"protest","explanation":"名詞「抗議、反對」；動詞「抗議、反對」。常見搭配：hold a protest, protest against sth。注意介係詞用法。","entries":[{"sentence":"Hundreds of students *held* a <protest> outside the school gate to express their dissatisfaction with the new cafeteria rules.","translation":"數百名學生在校門口舉行抗議，表達他們對新餐廳規則的不滿。","explanation":"名詞用法，hold a protest 表示「舉行抗議」。"},{"sentence":"The workers decided to <protest> *against* the company's decision to cut their wages without any prior discussion.","translation":"工人們決定抗議公司在沒有事先討論的情況下削減他們工資的決定。","explanation":"動詞用法。protest against 為固定片語，表示「抗議...」。"},{"sentence":"Despite the *peaceful* <protest> by the citizens, the government refused to change the controversial environmental policy.","translation":"儘管市民進行了和平抗議，政府仍拒絕改變那項具爭議性的環境政策。","explanation":"形容詞 peaceful 常用來修飾 protest。"},{"sentence":"The store owner could do nothing but <protest> his innocence when the police accused him of selling illegal goods.","translation":"當警方指控店主販售非法商品時，他除了堅稱自己的清白外，什麼也做不了。","explanation":"動詞用法，protest + that 子句或直接接名詞，表示「聲稱/堅持」。"}],"related_forms":["protester"]}

{"headword":"psychological","explanation":"形容詞「心理的、精神上的」。常用於形容壓力、狀態或影響。對應名詞 psychology。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete suffered from serious <psychological> *pressure* before the final match, which affected his performance on the field.","translation":"這位運動員在決賽前承受了巨大的心理壓力，這影響了他在場上的表現。","explanation":"psychological pressure 是固定搭配，指「心理壓力」。"},{"sentence":"Experts say that color can have a <psychological> *effect* on our mood and how we feel in a particular room.","translation":"專家表示，顏色會對我們的情緒以及我們在特定房間裡的感覺產生心理影響。","explanation":"psychological effect 指「心理影響」。"},{"sentence":"There is a <psychological> *barrier* that prevents many people from speaking a foreign language in public even if they know the grammar.","translation":"有一種心理障礙阻止許多人在公共場合說外語，即使他們懂文法也一樣。","explanation":"psychological barrier 指「心理障礙」。"}],"related_forms":["psychology","psychologist"]}

{"headword":"psychologist","explanation":"名詞「心理學家」。指從事心理學研究或臨床諮商的專業人員。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <psychologist> listened carefully to the patient's problems and provided professional advice on how to manage stress.","translation":"心理學家仔細傾聽病人的問題，並就如何管理壓力提供了專業建議。","explanation":"指諮商心理學家，常與 patient/client 搭配。"},{"sentence":"Many companies now hire a <psychologist> to help employees improve their communication skills and work better as a team.","translation":"許多公司現在聘請心理學家來幫助員工改善溝通技巧，並更好地進行團隊合作。","explanation":"指工業組織心理學家，用於職場情境。"},{"sentence":"The school <psychologist> is available for students who need someone to talk to about their academic or personal difficulties.","translation":"學校心理學家隨時準備為需要找人傾訴學業或個人困難的學生提供幫助。","explanation":"學校輔導情境的常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["psychology","psychological"]}

{"headword":"psychology","explanation":"名詞「心理學；心理狀態」。作為學科時為不可數名詞；指某人的心理時亦可指其思維模式。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to study <psychology> at university because she is interested in understanding why people behave the way they do.","translation":"她決定在大學攻讀心理學，因為她對理解人們為什麼會有那樣的行為很感興趣。","explanation":"指學科，不可數。"},{"sentence":"To be a successful salesperson, you need to understand the <psychology> of the customers and what motivates them to buy.","translation":"要成為一位成功的銷售員，你需要了解顧客的心理以及是什麼驅使他們購買。","explanation":"指顧客心理，the psychology of sb."},{"sentence":"The book explores the <psychology> behind decision-making and how our brains process information when we are under stress.","translation":"這本書探討了決策背後的心理學，以及我們的大腦在壓力下如何處理資訊。","explanation":"指某領域背後的心理機制。"}],"related_forms":["psychological","psychologist"]}

{"headword":"publication","explanation":"名詞「出版；出版物」。指出版的動作或發行的書籍、雜誌等刊物。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <publication> of the scientific report *was* *delayed* by several months because the researchers needed more time to verify the data.","translation":"該科學報告的出版延後了幾個月，因為研究人員需要更多時間來驗證數據。","explanation":"指出版這項行動，常接 of N。"},{"sentence":"This monthly <publication> *features* articles about wildlife conservation and environmental protection around the world.","translation":"這份月刊以關於全球野生動物保育和環境保護的文章為特色。","explanation":"指出版物（如雜誌、期刊），feature 在此表示「以...為特色」。"},{"sentence":"Before the <publication> of her first novel, she spent five years writing and editing the story in her small apartment.","translation":"在她第一部小說出版之前，她花了五年時間在小公寓裡寫作並編輯故事。","explanation":"指書籍出版的時刻。"}],"related_forms":["publish","publisher"]}

{"headword":"publicity","explanation":"名詞「宣傳、名聲」。指為了引起公眾注意而做的宣傳，或指公開的關注度。常用搭配：bad publicity, generate publicity。","entries":[{"sentence":"The movie company *spent* a lot of money on <publicity> to make sure that as many people as possible knew about the film.","translation":"電影公司在宣傳上花了很多錢，以確保盡可能多的人知道這部電影。","explanation":"指廣告宣傳活動。spend money on publicity 為固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"The politician tried to *avoid* bad <publicity> after the scandal, but the news was already all over the internet.","translation":"醜聞爆發後，這位政治人物試圖避免負面宣傳，但新聞早已傳遍網路。","explanation":"bad publicity 指「負面報導/負面宣傳」。"},{"sentence":"The charity event *received* a lot of <publicity> in the local media, which helped them raise enough money for the shelter.","translation":"慈善活動在當地媒體獲得了大量曝光，這幫助他們為收容所籌集了足夠的資金。","explanation":"receive publicity 指「獲得關注/報導」。"}],"related_forms":["public","publicize"]}

{"headword":"publish","explanation":"動詞「出版、發行」。指將書、文章等公開發行，或在網路上發表資訊。","entries":[{"sentence":"The local newspaper *decided* *to* <publish> her article about the city's history in the Sunday edition.","translation":"當地報紙決定在週日版刊登她關於城市歷史的文章。","explanation":"指刊登文章。decide to publish 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Many young authors now choose to <publish> their books online because it is faster and cheaper than traditional printing.","translation":"許多年輕作家現在選擇在網路上出版他們的書，因為這比傳統印刷更快且更便宜。","explanation":"指出版書籍，與 online 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The scientist *was* *proud* *to* <publish> his findings in a famous medical journal after years of hard research work.","translation":"這位科學家很自豪能在經過多年艱苦研究後，將他的發現發表在著名的醫學期刊上。","explanation":"指發表研究結果，常搭配 journal。"}],"related_forms":["publication","publisher"]}

{"headword":"publisher","explanation":"指「出版商」或「出版公司」，通常與書本、報紙或數位媒體相關。注意與 author (作者) 區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <publisher> *rejected* the young writer's manuscript, claiming that the plot was not exciting enough for their current readers.","translation":"出版商拒絕了這位年輕作家的手稿，聲稱情節對他們目前的讀者來說不夠刺激。","explanation":"名詞「出版商」。常見搭配 reject/accept a manuscript。與 author 不同，publisher 是負責發行的人或公司。"},{"sentence":"The book was released by a major <publisher> that has offices in both London and New York, ensuring global distribution.","translation":"這本書由一家在倫敦和紐約都設有辦公室的大型出版商發行，確保了全球發行。","explanation":"名詞「出版公司」。強調規模時常使用 major publisher。"},{"sentence":"As a digital <publisher>, the company focuses on creating online educational content rather than printing traditional paper textbooks.","translation":"作為一家數位出版商，該公司專注於製作線上教育內容，而不是印刷傳統紙本教科書。","explanation":"名詞「出版者」。現代用法可指網路內容發布者。"}],"related_forms":["publish","publishing","publication"]}

{"headword":"pursue","explanation":"動詞「追求」或「從事」。(1) 追求目標/夢想 (pursue a goal/dream)；(2) 從事某種職業或活動 (pursue a career/hobby)；(3) 追逐/追蹤 (pursue a suspect)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to leave her job and <pursue> her *lifelong dream* of becoming a professional photographer in a foreign country.","translation":"她決定辭職並去追求她一生想成為國外專業攝影師的夢想。","explanation":"動詞「追求」。pursue a dream 是經典用法。"},{"sentence":"After graduating from university, he chose to <pursue> a *career* in law because he wanted to help people solve their problems.","translation":"大學畢業後，他選擇從事法律行業，因為他想幫助人們解決問題。","explanation":"動詞「從事」。pursue a career in... 是極常見的固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"The police officers <pursued> the *suspect* through the narrow streets, but he managed to escape into the crowded subway station.","translation":"警察在狹窄的街道上追逐嫌疑犯，但他設法逃進了擁擠的地鐵站。","explanation":"動詞「追逐/追蹤」。指物理上的追趕。"},{"sentence":"If you really want to succeed, you must <pursue> *knowledge* with great passion and never stop asking questions about the world.","translation":"如果你真的想成功，你必須懷著極大的熱情追求知識，並永遠不要停止對世界提出問題。","explanation":"動詞「追求」。用於抽象事物如 knowledge 或 studies。"}],"related_forms":["pursuit","pursuer"]}

{"headword":"pursuit","explanation":"名詞「追求」或「從事」。常見片語：in pursuit of (追求...)。注意與動詞 pursue 的拼寫變化。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many young people move to big cities in *<pursuit> of* better job opportunities and a more exciting social life.","translation":"許多年輕人搬到大城市，以追求更好的工作機會和更精彩的社交生活。","explanation":"名詞片語 in pursuit of 是重點，意為「為了追求」。"},{"sentence":"Hiking is one of his favorite <pursuits>, as it allows him to enjoy nature and get away from the stress of school.","translation":"健行是他最喜歡的休閒活動之一，因為這讓他可以享受大自然並遠離學校的壓力。","explanation":"名詞「休閒活動/從事的工作」。此處指愛好。"},{"sentence":"The <pursuit> of *happiness* is considered a fundamental right in many countries, encouraging people to live their lives fully.","translation":"追求幸福在許多國家被視為一項基本權利，鼓勵人們充分地生活。","explanation":"名詞「追求」。常與抽象名詞如 happiness, excellence 搭配。"}],"related_forms":["pursue"]}

{"headword":"quarrel","explanation":"名詞「爭吵」；動詞「爭吵」。(1) have a quarrel with sb (與某人吵架)；(2) quarrel with/over sth (因某事吵架)。注意與 argue 的細微差別，quarrel 常帶有情緒化色彩。","entries":[{"sentence":"They had a *bitter* <quarrel> over who should pay for the dinner, and as a result, they didn't speak to each other for days.","translation":"他們為了誰該付晚餐錢而發生了激烈的爭吵，結果他們好幾天沒跟對方說話。","explanation":"名詞「爭吵」。bitter quarrel (激烈的爭吵) 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"It is not worth <quarreling> *with* your best friend over such a small and unimportant matter, like whose turn it is to wash dishes.","translation":"為了這種小而不重要的事情，例如輪到誰洗碗，而與最好的朋友爭吵是不值得的。","explanation":"動詞「爭吵」。quarrel with sb over sth 是標準用法。"},{"sentence":"Brothers and sisters often <quarrel> *over* toys when they are young, but they usually become closer as they grow older.","translation":"兄弟姐妹年輕時常因玩具而吵架，但他們通常長大後感情會變得更好。","explanation":"動詞「因...而爭吵」。over 後面接爭吵的原因。"}],"related_forms":["quarreled","quarrelling"]}

{"headword":"quilt","explanation":"名詞「拼布被/被子」；動詞「縫製拼布」。常見於描述手工藝或溫暖的情境。","entries":[{"sentence":"My grandmother spent weeks making a beautiful <quilt> *by hand* as a wedding gift for my older sister.","translation":"我祖母花了好幾週手工製作了一條漂亮的拼布被，作為給我姐姐的結婚禮物。","explanation":"名詞「拼布被」。強調手工製作常用 by hand。"},{"sentence":"On cold winter nights, I like to wrap myself in a warm <quilt> and read my favorite novels by the fireplace.","translation":"在寒冷的冬夜，我喜歡裹著一條溫暖的被子，在壁爐旁閱讀我最喜歡的小說。","explanation":"名詞「被子」。用於溫馨、居家情境。"},{"sentence":"She learned how to <quilt> from her mother and now creates modern patterns using colorful pieces of fabric.","translation":"她從母親那裡學會了縫製拼布，現在使用彩色布料創作出現代風格的圖案。","explanation":"動詞「縫製拼布」。"}],"related_forms":["quilting"]}

{"headword":"quotation","explanation":"名詞「引述/語錄」或「報價」。(1) 引用名人名言 (quotation marks 引號)；(2) 商業上的報價單。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student included a famous <quotation> *from* Shakespeare in his essay to make his argument more powerful and convincing.","translation":"這位學生在文章中引用了一句莎士比亞的名言，使他的論點更有說服力。","explanation":"名詞「引述」。常與 from 搭配引出出處。"},{"sentence":"Don't forget to use <quotation> *marks* when you write down exactly what someone else has said in your report.","translation":"當你在報告中準確寫下別人所說的話時，別忘了使用引號。","explanation":"名詞「引號」。quotation marks 是固定詞組。"},{"sentence":"The company sent us a price <quotation> for the new computer equipment, but it was too expensive for our school budget.","translation":"該公司寄給我們新電腦設備的報價單，但對我們的學校預算來說太貴了。","explanation":"名詞「報價/報價單」。商業情境常用。"}],"related_forms":["quote"]}

{"headword":"radar","explanation":"名詞「雷達」。常用於偵測速度、飛行物或天氣。注意與偵測相關的動詞搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The driver was caught by the <radar> *speed gun* because he was driving much faster than the speed limit on the highway.","translation":"這位駕駛被雷達測速槍抓到，因為他在高速公路上開得比速限快得多。","explanation":"名詞「雷達」。常與 speed gun (測速槍) 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The airplane disappeared from the airport's <radar> *screen* during the heavy storm, causing great concern for the air traffic controllers.","translation":"飛機在暴風雨期間從機場的雷達螢幕上消失，引起了空中交通管制員的極大擔憂。","explanation":"名詞「雷達」。描述偵測範圍或顯示介面。"},{"sentence":"Scientists use advanced <radar> *technology* to track the movement of typhoons and predict where they will hit land.","translation":"科學家使用先進的雷達技術來追蹤颱風的移動，並預測它們將在哪裡登陸。","explanation":"名詞「雷達」。指雷達技術。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"rage","explanation":"名詞「憤怒/狂暴」；動詞「肆虐/發怒」。(1) 名詞：in a rage (憤怒地)；(2) 動詞：指風暴、戰爭、疾病等劇烈進行。","entries":[{"sentence":"He was *blinded by* <rage> and said things he later regretted, which hurt his friend's feelings deeply.","translation":"他被憤怒沖昏了頭，說了一些事後後悔的話，這深深傷害了他朋友的感情。","explanation":"名詞「憤怒」。blinded by rage (被憤怒沖昏頭) 是常見的文學或敘事搭配。"},{"sentence":"A violent storm continued to <rage> *through* the night, causing trees to fall and electricity to go out in many areas.","translation":"一場猛烈的暴風雨整晚持續肆虐，導致許多地區樹木倒塌且停電。","explanation":"動詞「肆虐」。常用於 storm, war, fire 等災難性事物。"},{"sentence":"The debate about the new school policy continued to <rage> *among* the students and teachers for several weeks.","translation":"關於新學校政策的辯論在學生和老師之間持續激烈地進行了好幾週。","explanation":"動詞「激烈進行」。指爭論或衝突。"},{"sentence":"She flew into a <rage> when she discovered that someone had entered her room and moved her personal belongings.","translation":"當她發現有人進了她的房間並移動她的私人物品時，她勃然大怒。","explanation":"名詞「憤怒」。fly into a rage (勃然大怒) 是高頻慣用語。"}],"related_forms":["raged"]}

{"headword":"rainfall","explanation":"名詞「降雨量/降雨」。注意區分 heavy/light rainfall。","entries":[{"sentence":"The area has received very *heavy* <rainfall> this year, which has helped fill the reservoirs and solve the water shortage problem.","translation":"該地區今年降雨量非常大，這有助於蓄滿水庫並解決缺水問題。","explanation":"名詞「降雨」。heavy rainfall 為固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"Farmers are worried because the <rainfall> *in* this region has been lower than usual, affecting the growth of their crops.","translation":"農民們很擔心，因為該地區的降雨量比平常少，影響了農作物的生長。","explanation":"名詞「降雨」。描述特定區域 rainfall in..."},{"sentence":"Experts predict that the *annual* <rainfall> will decrease in the future due to global climate change.","translation":"專家預測，由於全球氣候變遷，未來的年降雨量將會減少。","explanation":"名詞「降雨」。annual rainfall (年降雨量) 是地理或科學考題常字。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"raisin","explanation":"名詞「葡萄乾」。通常作為食物配料。","entries":[{"sentence":"My mother always adds a handful of <raisins> *into* the cake batter to make it taste sweeter and better.","translation":"我媽媽總是在蛋糕麵糊裡加一把葡萄乾，讓它吃起來更甜、更好吃。","explanation":"名詞「葡萄乾」。常用複數形。"},{"sentence":"These *oatmeal* <raisin> cookies are the most popular snacks in our bakery because they are both healthy and delicious.","translation":"這些燕麥葡萄乾餅乾是我們麵包店最受歡迎的點心，因為它們既健康又美味。","explanation":"名詞「葡萄乾」。常作為複合名詞的一部分。"},{"sentence":"Eating a small box of <raisins> can provide a quick boost of energy during a long study session.","translation":"吃一小盒葡萄乾可以在長時間的學習中提供快速的能量補給。","explanation":"名詞「葡萄乾」。作為健康零食。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"realistic","explanation":"形容詞「實際的、現實的」。常搭配 expectation, goal, approach。易混淆：real (真實的) vs. realistic (符合現實的/務實的)。常接不定詞 to V 或介係詞 about。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is important to set <realistic> *goals* for yourself, rather than dreaming of things that are impossible to achieve in a short time.","translation":"為自己設定實際的目標是很重要的，而不是夢想那些在短時間內無法實現的事情。","explanation":"搭配 set realistic goals。強調目標的可行性。"},{"sentence":"The movie offers a <realistic> *portrayal* of life in the countryside, showing both the beautiful scenery and the hardships of farming.","translation":"這部電影對鄉村生活提供了真實的描繪，展示了美麗的風景和務農的艱辛。","explanation":"realistic portrayal 表示「寫實的描述/刻畫」。"},{"sentence":"You need to be <realistic> *about* the costs of studying abroad, as tuition fees and living expenses can be much higher than you expect.","translation":"你需要對出國留學的費用保持務實的態度，因為學費和生活費可能比你預期的要高得多。","explanation":"搭配 be realistic about something。表示對某事有務實的認知。"}],"related_forms":["realistically","realism"]}

{"headword":"rebel","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「反叛者/叛逆者」；(2) 動詞「反抗/造反」。動詞後常接 against。名詞重音在第一音節，動詞重音在第二音節。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teenager began to <rebel> *against* his parents' strict rules by staying out late and ignoring his homework assignments.","translation":"這名青少年開始反抗父母嚴格的規定，藉由晚歸和忽略家庭作業來表達不滿。","explanation":"動詞用法 rebel against，表示反抗某權威或規定。"},{"sentence":"Even though he was a <rebel> *in* his youth, he eventually became a very responsible and traditional businessman as he got older.","translation":"儘管他在年輕時是個叛逆者，但隨著年齡增長，他最終成為了一位非常有責任感且傳統的商人。","explanation":"名詞用法，指反抗社會規範或權威的人。"},{"sentence":"The soldiers decided to <rebel> *against* the cruel leader because they were tired of fighting in unfair and dangerous wars.","translation":"士兵們決定反抗那位殘酷的領袖，因為他們厭倦了在不公平且危險的戰爭中戰鬥。","explanation":"動詞用法，用於描述軍事或政治上的反抗。"},{"sentence":"Dressed in leather jackets and torn jeans, the group acted like <rebels> *without* a cause, seeking attention from everyone around them.","translation":"這群人穿著皮夾克和破洞牛仔褲，表現得像無緣無故的叛逆者，試圖引起周圍每個人的注意。","explanation":"常用片語 rebel without a cause 指「無緣無故的叛逆者」。"}],"related_forms":["rebellion","rebellious"]}

{"headword":"recall","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 動詞「回憶/想起」；(2) 動詞「召回/收回 (產品)」。注意 recall 後面接 V-ing 或名詞，不接 to V。","entries":[{"sentence":"I cannot <recall> *the* exact *name* of the restaurant where we had dinner last week, but the food was absolutely delicious.","translation":"我想不起我們上週去吃晚餐的那家餐廳的確切名字，但食物真的非常好吃。","explanation":"動詞用法，指記憶的提取。常見搭配 recall the name/details。"},{"sentence":"The car company had to <recall> *thousands* of vehicles because of a serious defect found in the braking system.","translation":"這家汽車公司不得不召回數千輛汽車，因為在煞車系統中發現了嚴重的缺陷。","explanation":"動詞用法，指廠商因安全問題召回產品。常用於新聞英語。"},{"sentence":"Do you <recall> *meeting* him at the conference last year? He said he remembers talking to you about the new project.","translation":"你還記得去年在研討會上見過他嗎？他說他記得曾跟你談過那個新專案。","explanation":"動詞用法，recall + V-ing。注意不可用 to meet。"},{"sentence":"The old man smiled as he <recalled> *his* childhood *days* spent playing near the river with his close friends.","translation":"老人回憶起與好友在河邊玩耍的童年時光，臉上露出了笑容。","explanation":"動詞用法，指回想起過去的時光。"}],"related_forms":["recalled","recalling"]}

{"headword":"reception","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「接待/歡迎」；(2) 名詞「招待會/婚宴」；(3) 名詞「收訊狀況」。常搭配 hold/attend a reception。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the wedding ceremony, the couple held a grand <reception> *at* a local hotel to celebrate with their family and friends.","translation":"婚禮儀式結束後，這對新人在當地一家飯店舉辦了盛大的招待會，與家人和朋友一同慶祝。","explanation":"名詞用法，指婚宴或正式招待會。"},{"sentence":"The proposal received a warm <reception> *from* the committee members, who were impressed by the student's creative and practical ideas.","translation":"這項提案受到了委員會成員的熱烈歡迎，他們對這位學生充滿創意且實際的想法印象深刻。","explanation":"搭配 receive a warm/cold reception，意指對某事物的反應或評價。"},{"sentence":"I cannot call you right now because the <reception> *in* this mountain area is very poor, and the signal keeps cutting off.","translation":"我現在不能打給你，因為這個山區的收訊很差，訊號一直斷斷續續的。","explanation":"名詞用法，指手機或廣播的收訊狀況。"}],"related_forms":["receive","recipient"]}

{"headword":"recipe","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「食譜」；(2) 名詞「秘訣/原因」。常搭配 follow a recipe 或 a recipe for success。","entries":[{"sentence":"This secret <recipe> *for* chocolate cake has been passed down in my family for over three generations.","translation":"這個巧克力蛋糕的秘密食譜已經在我們家族流傳了三代以上。","explanation":"指烹飪的配方。常用搭配 recipe for sth。"},{"sentence":"Hard work and a positive attitude are the perfect <recipe> *for* success in any career you choose to pursue.","translation":"努力工作和積極的態度是你在選擇追求任何職業時，邁向成功的完美秘訣。","explanation":"比喻用法，指促成某結果的要素或秘訣。"},{"sentence":"If you want to bake good bread, you must follow the <recipe> *carefully* and measure all the ingredients accurately.","translation":"如果你想烤出好吃的麵包，你必須仔細遵循食譜，並精確測量所有食材。","explanation":"搭配 follow the recipe，表示遵循食譜。"}],"related_forms":["recipes"]}

{"headword":"recognition","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「認出/識別」；(2) 名詞「承認/認可」。常見搭配 in recognition of (為了表彰)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The actor wore a hat and sunglasses to avoid <recognition> *by* fans while walking down the busy street.","translation":"這名演員戴著帽子和太陽眼鏡，走在繁忙的街道上以避免被粉絲認出來。","explanation":"指被認出。avoid recognition 指避免被認出。"},{"sentence":"The doctor received an award *in* <recognition> *of* her outstanding contribution to medical research over the past ten years.","translation":"這位醫生獲得了一個獎項，以表彰她過去十年來在醫學研究上的傑出貢獻。","explanation":"重要片語 in recognition of，意指「為了表彰...」。"},{"sentence":"Facial <recognition> *technology* has become very popular in smartphones, allowing users to unlock their devices just by looking at the screen.","translation":"臉部辨識技術在智慧型手機中變得非常普及，讓使用者只需看著螢幕就能解鎖裝置。","explanation":"搭配 facial recognition technology，指臉部辨識。"}],"related_forms":["recognize","recognizable"]}

{"headword":"recovery","explanation":"名詞「恢復/復甦」。常搭配 make a recovery (康復) 或 economic recovery (經濟復甦)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the operation, the patient made a full <recovery> *within* a few weeks and returned to work as a teacher.","translation":"手術後，這名病人在幾週內完全康復，並回到學校擔任教師的工作。","explanation":"搭配 make a full recovery，指完全康復。"},{"sentence":"The government is implementing new policies to speed up the <recovery> *of* the national economy after the global financial crisis.","translation":"政府正在實施新政策，以加速全球金融危機後國民經濟的復甦。","explanation":"指經濟或局勢的復甦。"},{"sentence":"It takes time for a forest to make a <recovery> *after* a massive wildfire destroys the local ecosystem and trees.","translation":"在一場大規模森林大火摧毀當地生態系統和樹木後，森林需要時間才能恢復。","explanation":"指環境或自然資源的恢復。"}],"related_forms":["recover"]}

{"headword":"recreation","explanation":"名詞「消遣/娛樂」。指休閒活動。常搭配 recreation center (休閒中心) 或 recreational activities。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city built a new <recreation> *center* near the park, where people can go swimming, play basketball, and exercise.","translation":"市政府在公園附近蓋了一座新的休閒中心，人們可以在那裡游泳、打籃球和運動。","explanation":"搭配 recreation center，指公共娛樂設施。"},{"sentence":"Hiking in the mountains is my favorite form of <recreation> *because* it helps me relax and stay away from the noise of the city.","translation":"去山上健行是我最喜歡的消遣方式，因為它能幫助我放鬆並遠離城市的喧囂。","explanation":"指個人的娛樂活動。"},{"sentence":"Schools should provide students with enough time for <recreation> *to* balance their busy academic schedules.","translation":"學校應該提供學生足夠的休閒時間，以平衡他們繁忙的課業。","explanation":"指休閒時間或活動。"}],"related_forms":["recreational"]}

{"headword":"recycle","explanation":"動詞「回收/再利用」。注意拼字，re-cycle。常與 waste, materials, glass, plastic 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"We should all try to <recycle> *paper*, plastic, and glass bottles to protect the environment and reduce waste.","translation":"我們都應該嘗試回收紙張、塑膠和玻璃瓶，以保護環境並減少垃圾。","explanation":"指具體的回收動作。"},{"sentence":"Many companies are now finding ways to <recycle> *materials* from old products to create new and useful items.","translation":"許多公司現在正在尋找方法來回收舊產品中的材料，以創造出新的有用物品。","explanation":"指材料的再利用。"},{"sentence":"The city’s <recycling> *program* has been very successful, with more than half of the households sorting their garbage every day.","translation":"這座城市的回收計畫非常成功，超過半數的家庭每天都在進行垃圾分類。","explanation":"這裡用了分詞作形容詞 recycling program，指回收計畫。"}],"related_forms":["recycling","recyclable"]}

{"headword":"reduction","explanation":"名詞「減少/縮減」。常搭配 reduction in something。注意與 reduce 的拼字差異。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company announced a significant <reduction> *in* production costs, which helped them stay competitive in the global market.","translation":"這家公司宣布大幅降低生產成本，這幫助他們在全球市場中保持競爭力。","explanation":"搭配 reduction in，表示某方面的減少。"},{"sentence":"There has been a steady <reduction> *in* the number of students taking the bus, as more people are choosing to ride bicycles.","translation":"搭乘公車的學生人數持續穩定減少，因為越來越多人選擇騎自行車。","explanation":"指數量上的減少。"},{"sentence":"To improve public health, the government is promoting a <reduction> *of* sugar intake among children and teenagers.","translation":"為了改善大眾健康，政府正在推廣減少兒童和青少年的糖分攝取量。","explanation":"指攝取量的減少。"}],"related_forms":["reduce"]}

{"headword":"refer","explanation":"動詞用法包括：(1) refer to A as B (將 A 稱為 B)；(2) refer to (提及/提到)；(3) refer to (查閱/參考)。注意：refer 後面若接受詞，必須加上介係詞 to，這點在文法測驗中極為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher often <refers> *to* the textbook when explaining complex historical events to ensure the accuracy of the information provided in class.","translation":"老師在課堂上解釋複雜的歷史事件時，常會查閱課本，以確保所提供資訊的準確性。","explanation":"指「查閱/參考」資訊來源。常見搭配：refer to a dictionary/map/book。"},{"sentence":"During the meeting, the manager <referred> *to* the new policy, but he did not explain the specific details clearly to the staff.","translation":"會議期間，經理提到了這項新政策，但他並沒有向員工清楚解釋具體細節。","explanation":"指「提到/談及」。這是在閱讀測驗中常見的用法，指代前文提到的事物。"},{"sentence":"Most of the students in my class <refer> *to* our chemistry teacher *as* a genius because he can answer any question instantly.","translation":"班上大多數學生都把我們的化學老師稱為天才，因為他能瞬間回答任何問題。","explanation":"片語 refer to A as B (將 A 稱為 B)。這是一個相當重要的句型，常在翻譯題中出現。"},{"sentence":"Please <refer> *to* the attached document for more information regarding the upcoming science fair and the registration deadline.","translation":"請參考附件文件，以獲取更多關於即將到來的科學展覽及報名截止日期的資訊。","explanation":"指「請參閱」，常出現在正式書信或公告中。"}],"related_forms":["reference","referred","referring","refers"]}

{"headword":"reference","explanation":"名詞用法包括：(1) 提及/參照 (make reference to)；(2) 推薦信 (letter of reference)；(3) 參考書目/資訊。","entries":[{"sentence":"The author made a brief <reference> *to* his childhood experiences in the introduction of the book, which surprised many of his loyal readers.","translation":"作者在書的序言中簡短地提到了他的童年經歷，這讓許多忠實讀者感到驚訝。","explanation":"片語 make reference to (提及)。這是 refer 的名詞形式。"},{"sentence":"When applying for the scholarship, I needed to submit two letters of <reference> from my former teachers to prove my academic ability.","translation":"申請獎學金時，我需要提交兩封來自前任老師的推薦信，以證明我的學業能力。","explanation":"指「推薦信」，常見搭配 letter of reference/recommendation。"},{"sentence":"The library has a special section for <reference> books that cannot be borrowed and must be used within the building for research purposes.","translation":"圖書館有一個專門的參考書區，這些書不能外借，必須在館內使用以進行研究。","explanation":"指「參考用的(書籍)」。常與 reference books 連用。"}],"related_forms":["refer"]}

{"headword":"reflect","explanation":"動詞用法包括：(1) 反射 (光線/影像)；(2) 反映/顯示 (情況/態度)；(3) 深思/反省 (reflect on)。注意介係詞搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The calm surface of the lake <reflected> the blue sky and the surrounding mountains, creating a beautiful and peaceful view for the hikers.","translation":"平靜的湖面映照出藍天與周圍的山脈，為登山客創造了一幅美麗而寧靜的景色。","explanation":"物理上的「反射/倒映」。這是最基礎的用法。"},{"sentence":"The high test scores of the students <reflect> the hard work they put into their studies throughout the entire semester.","translation":"學生們的高考分反映了他們整個學期在課業上所付出的努力。","explanation":"指「反映/顯示」，常與結果或數據連用，顯示因果關係。"},{"sentence":"Before making a final decision, it is important to <reflect> *on* your goals and consider the long-term consequences of your choices.","translation":"在做出最終決定前，反思你的目標並考慮選擇的長期後果是很重要的。","explanation":"片語 reflect on (深思/反省)。注意後面固定搭配 on，不可省略。"},{"sentence":"His rude behavior at the party does not truly <reflect> his personality, as he is usually a very kind and polite person.","translation":"他在派對上的粗魯行為並不能真正反映他的個性，因為他平常是一個非常善良且有禮貌的人。","explanation":"指「反映出某人的本質」，常用於否定句。"}],"related_forms":["reflection","reflective"]}

{"headword":"reflection","explanation":"名詞用法包括：(1) 反射影像；(2) 反省/深思；(3) 反映/跡象。是 reflect 的名詞形式，常與 upon 或 on 連用。","entries":[{"sentence":"Looking at her own <reflection> *in* the mirror, she realized that she needed to change her hairstyle for the upcoming formal event.","translation":"看著鏡子裡的倒影，她意識到自己需要為即將到來的正式活動改變髮型。","explanation":"指「影像/倒影」。"},{"sentence":"After careful <reflection> *on* the situation, he decided to apologize to his friend for the misunderstanding they had last week.","translation":"在對情況進行仔細反思後，他決定為上週的誤會向朋友道歉。","explanation":"指「反省/思考」。搭配介係詞 on/upon。"},{"sentence":"The increase in traffic accidents is a sad <reflection> *of* the poor road conditions in this area during the rainy season.","translation":"交通事故的增加，反映了雨季期間該地區糟糕的道路狀況，令人難過。","explanation":"指「反映/跡象」。搭配介係詞 of。"}],"related_forms":["reflect"]}

{"headword":"reform","explanation":"可作名詞 (改革) 或動詞 (改革/改過自新)。常與教育 (education)、政治 (political) 或法律 (legal) 相關。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is planning to <reform> the education system to provide students with more practical skills for their future careers.","translation":"政府計畫改革教育體制，以便為學生提供更多未來職涯所需的實用技能。","explanation":"動詞「改革」。常見搭配：reform the system/law。"},{"sentence":"There is a strong demand for political <reform> from the public, who want more transparency and fairness in the upcoming elections.","translation":"大眾對政治改革有強烈的需求，他們希望在即將到來的選舉中有更多的透明度和公平性。","explanation":"名詞「改革」。"},{"sentence":"After spending years in prison, the young man finally decided to <reform> his ways and start a new, honest life.","translation":"在監獄待了幾年後，這名年輕人終於決定改過自新，開始嶄新且誠實的生活。","explanation":"動詞「改過自新」。reform one's ways 是固定搭配。"}],"related_forms":["reformer","reformed"]}

{"headword":"refugee","explanation":"名詞「難民」。常與戰爭 (war)、迫害 (persecution) 和逃離 (flee) 相關。注意拼字。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thousands of <refugees> *fled* their home country due to the ongoing civil war and are now seeking safety in neighboring nations.","translation":"由於持續的內戰，成千上萬的難民逃離了他們的祖國，現在正在鄰國尋求安全。","explanation":"指因戰爭而流離失所的人。常用動詞 flee (逃離)。"},{"sentence":"The international organization provides food, shelter, and medical care to the <refugees> who have lost everything in the disaster.","translation":"該國際組織為在災難中失去一切的難民提供食物、住所和醫療照護。","explanation":"難民常見的處境，常與人道救援 (humanitarian aid) 相關。"},{"sentence":"Many countries have agreed to accept more <refugees> this year to help solve the global humanitarian crisis caused by conflicts.","translation":"許多國家今年同意接納更多難民，以幫助解決衝突所引發的全球人道危機。","explanation":"指國際社會對難民的政策。accept/take in refugees。"}],"related_forms":["refuge"]}

{"headword":"refund","explanation":"可作名詞 (退款) 或動詞 (退還)。在消費情境中極為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you are not satisfied with the product, you can return it within thirty days and get a full <refund> *of* your money.","translation":"如果您對產品不滿意，可以在三十天內退貨並獲得全額退款。","explanation":"名詞「退款」。常見搭配：get/receive a refund, full refund。"},{"sentence":"The airline will <refund> the ticket price to passengers whose flights were canceled due to severe weather conditions this morning.","translation":"航空公司將把機票費用退還給今天早上因惡劣天氣而導致航班取消的乘客。","explanation":"動詞「退款」。refund A to B (將A退還給B)。"},{"sentence":"I requested a <refund> because the electronic device I purchased online was broken when it arrived at my home.","translation":"我要求退款，因為我網購的電子裝置在寄到我家時已經損壞了。","explanation":"常見情境：因商品瑕疵而要求退款。"}],"related_forms":["refundable"]}

{"headword":"refusal","explanation":"名詞「拒絕」。是 refuse 的名詞形式。常與 offer (提議)、request (請求) 或 entry (進入) 連用。","entries":[{"sentence":"Her flat <refusal> *to* comment on the scandal surprised the reporters who had waited for hours outside the building.","translation":"她斷然拒絕對該醜聞發表評論，這讓在建築物外等候數小時的記者感到驚訝。","explanation":"指「拒絕做某事」。常用搭配：refusal to do sth。"},{"sentence":"The manager's <refusal> *of* the worker's request for a pay raise led to a heated argument in the office this afternoon.","translation":"經理拒絕了員工加薪的請求，導致今天下午辦公室內發生了激烈的爭吵。","explanation":"指「對某事物的拒絕」。搭配介係詞 of。"},{"sentence":"Despite his polite <refusal>, the salesman kept trying to convince him to buy the expensive insurance policy for his family.","translation":"儘管他禮貌地拒絕了，推銷員仍不斷試圖說服他為家人購買這份昂貴的保險單。","explanation":"指「拒絕的態度」。常用形容詞修飾，如 polite refusal。"}],"related_forms":["refuse"]}
