{"headword":"regarding","explanation":"介係詞「關於/有關」。用法類似 about 或 concerning，但在正式書信或文件中更常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"I am writing this email <regarding> the job application I submitted last week, as I would like to check the status of my interview.","translation":"我寫這封郵件是關於我上週提交的工作申請，我想查詢面試的進度。","explanation":"正式用法，用於開頭說明信件目的。等於 concerning 或 about。"},{"sentence":"The principal held a meeting with the parents <regarding> the new school regulations that will take effect starting next semester.","translation":"校長與家長召開了會議，內容是關於即將在下學期生效的新校規。","explanation":"用於說明會議或討論的主題。"},{"sentence":"If you have any questions <regarding> the instructions, please feel free to contact the technical support team by phone or email.","translation":"如果您對說明有任何疑問，請隨時透過電話或電子郵件聯繫技術支援團隊。","explanation":"常見於說明書或公告末尾。regarding 在此處非常正式且精確。"}],"related_forms":["regard"]}

{"headword":"register","explanation":"可作動詞 (註冊/登記) 或名詞 (名冊/登記表)。常與 course (課程)、event (活動) 或 name (姓名) 連用。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students must <register> *for* the elective courses online before the deadline, or they will not be allowed to attend the classes.","translation":"學生必須在截止日期前在線上註冊選修課程，否則將不被允許參加這些課程。","explanation":"動詞「註冊」。注意介係詞搭配 for。這是學校生活常見用法。"},{"sentence":"The hotel receptionist asked the guests to write their names and contact information in the guest <register> upon their arrival.","translation":"飯店櫃檯接待員請客人在抵達時在住客登記表上寫下姓名和聯絡資訊。","explanation":"名詞「登記表/名冊」。"},{"sentence":"It is important to <register> your email address on the website so that you can receive the latest news and updates from us.","translation":"在網站上註冊您的電子郵件地址很重要，這樣您才能收到我們最新的消息與更新。","explanation":"動詞「登記/註冊(帳號/資訊)」。"}],"related_forms":["registration","registered"]}

{"headword":"registration","explanation":"名詞「登記/註冊」。常見搭配為 course/voter registration。注意動詞為 register，其名詞形式為 registration。易錯：不要與 registry (登記處) 混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"The deadline for club <registration> is next Friday, so make sure to sign up before the office closes.","translation":"社團註冊的截止日期是下週五，所以請務必在辦公室關門前報名。","explanation":"名詞「註冊」。常與 deadline, date, form 等詞連用。"},{"sentence":"Please bring your student ID card to the office for your <registration> if you want to participate in the summer program.","translation":"如果你想參加暑期課程，請帶著你的學生證到辦公室進行註冊。","explanation":"用於正式程序的登記。搭配動詞：complete/process/finish registration。"},{"sentence":"The <registration> *for* the annual marathon has already begun, and thousands of runners have signed up online.","translation":"年度馬拉松的報名已經開始，已有數千名跑者在線上報名了。","explanation":"名詞「報名/登記」。注意介係詞常用 for。"}],"related_forms":["register","registered","registrant"]}

{"headword":"regulate","explanation":"動詞「調節/管理/控制」。常指透過法律或規則來管理事務。同義詞包含 control, manage, adjust。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government needs to <regulate> the prices of essential goods to protect low-income families from sudden inflation.","translation":"政府需要調節必需品的價格，以保護低收入家庭免受通貨膨脹的影響。","explanation":"動詞「管理/調節」。指透過政府力量介入市場。"},{"sentence":"Our body has a natural system to <regulate> its internal temperature, which helps us stay healthy in different weather.","translation":"我們的身體有一套自然的系統來調節內部溫度，這有助於我們在不同的天氣中保持健康。","explanation":"動詞「調節」。指生理功能的平衡。"},{"sentence":"New laws were passed to <regulate> traffic flow in the city center and reduce the number of car accidents.","translation":"新法律通過以規範市中心的交通流量，並減少車禍的數量。","explanation":"動詞「規範/控制」。指維持秩序。"}],"related_forms":["regulation","regulatory","regulator"]}

{"headword":"regulation","explanation":"名詞「規定/法規/調節」。常見搭配：safety regulation, strict regulation。注意複數形 regulations 常指成文法規。","entries":[{"sentence":"According to school <regulations>, students must wear their uniforms during official school events and ceremonies.","translation":"根據學校規定，學生在正式的學校活動和典禮中必須穿著制服。","explanation":"名詞「規定/校規」。常用複數形。"},{"sentence":"The company had to follow strict safety <regulations> to ensure that all workers stayed safe while using heavy machinery.","translation":"該公司必須遵守嚴格的安全規定，以確保所有工人在使用重型機械時保持安全。","explanation":"名詞「法規/規則」。常與 safety, government, strict 等詞搭配。"},{"sentence":"The <regulation> *of* blood sugar is crucial for people with diabetes to avoid serious health problems.","translation":"血糖的調節對於糖尿病患者來說至關重要，以避免嚴重的健康問題。","explanation":"名詞「調節/控制」。指生理上的機制。"}],"related_forms":["regulate","regulatory"]}

{"headword":"rejection","explanation":"名詞「拒絕/排斥」。動詞為 reject。在 GSAT 中常出現於人際關係或申請被拒的情境。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite the <rejection> *of* his first application, he decided to improve his skills and try again next year.","translation":"儘管他的第一次申請被拒絕，他還是決定提升技能並在明年再試一次。","explanation":"名詞「拒絕」。常搭配介係詞 of 或 from。"},{"sentence":"The artist faced constant <rejection> from galleries at the beginning of his career, but he never gave up on his dream.","translation":"這位藝術家在職業生涯初期不斷面臨畫廊的拒絕，但他從未放棄夢想。","explanation":"名詞「拒絕」。指被拒於門外或不被接受。"},{"sentence":"Fear of <rejection> often prevents people from sharing their true feelings with others, even when they want to be close.","translation":"對被拒絕的恐懼常使人們不敢與他人分享真實感受，即便他們希望能更親近。","explanation":"名詞「拒絕/排斥」。指社交心理上的害怕。"}],"related_forms":["reject"]}

{"headword":"relaxation","explanation":"名詞「放鬆/休息」。動詞為 relax。常指身心靈的休憩。","entries":[{"sentence":"Listening to soft music is a great form of <relaxation> after a long day of studying for exams.","translation":"聽輕音樂是在為考試苦讀一整天後，一種很棒的放鬆方式。","explanation":"名詞「放鬆」。指活動或狀態。"},{"sentence":"Taking a walk in the park provides much-needed <relaxation> for busy office workers who spend hours sitting at desks.","translation":"在公園散步為長時間坐在辦公桌前的忙碌上班族提供了急需的放鬆。","explanation":"名詞「放鬆」。指休閒活動。"},{"sentence":"He went to the beach for a week of total <relaxation> to recover from his stressful job.","translation":"他去海邊度過了一週徹底的放鬆，以從壓力沉重的工作中恢復過來。","explanation":"名詞「放鬆」。指徹底的休息狀態。"}],"related_forms":["relax","relaxed","relaxing"]}

{"headword":"relevant","explanation":"形容詞「相關的」。搭配介係詞 to。易錯：不要與 relative (親戚/相對的) 搞混。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please ensure that the information you provide is <relevant> *to* the topic we are discussing in class today.","translation":"請確保你提供的資訊與我們今天課堂討論的主題相關。","explanation":"形容詞「相關的」。搭配介係詞 to。"},{"sentence":"The teacher gave us some <relevant> examples to help us understand the difficult scientific concept more easily.","translation":"老師給了我們一些相關的例子，幫助我們更容易理解這個困難的科學概念。","explanation":"形容詞「相關的」。指切題或有連結的。"},{"sentence":"When searching for a job, you should highlight your work experience that is <relevant> *to* the position you want.","translation":"在找工作時，你應該強調與你想申請職位相關的工作經驗。","explanation":"形容詞「相關的」。在履歷或面試中很常見。"}],"related_forms":["relevance","irrelevant"]}

{"headword":"relieve","explanation":"動詞「減輕/解除」。常見搭配：relieve stress, relieve pain。注意名詞形式為 relief。","entries":[{"sentence":"Taking a deep breath can help you <relieve> stress and stay calm during a difficult situation.","translation":"深呼吸可以幫助你減輕壓力，並在困境中保持冷靜。","explanation":"動詞「減輕」。常搭配 stress, anxiety。"},{"sentence":"The medicine helped to <relieve> his back pain, allowing him to sleep better at night.","translation":"這種藥物幫助減輕了他的背痛，使他晚上能睡得更好。","explanation":"動詞「解除/緩解」。指身體上的不適。"},{"sentence":"We hired a new assistant to <relieve> some of the pressure on our team during the busy season.","translation":"我們聘請了一位新助理來減輕團隊在忙季時的一些壓力。","explanation":"動詞「減輕/分擔」。指減輕負擔。"}],"related_forms":["relief","relieved"]}

{"headword":"reluctant","explanation":"形容詞「勉強的/不情願的」。常搭配不定詞 to do something。注意與 unwilling 近義。","entries":[{"sentence":"He was <reluctant> *to* accept the new job offer because it meant moving to a different city far from home.","translation":"他很不情願接受這份新工作邀約，因為這意味著要搬到離家很遠的城市。","explanation":"形容詞「不情願的」。常接 to + V。"},{"sentence":"Many people are <reluctant> *to* try new things because they are afraid of failing or making mistakes.","translation":"許多人很不願意嘗試新事物，因為他們害怕失敗或犯錯。","explanation":"形容詞「不情願的」。指心理上的猶豫。"},{"sentence":"The child was <reluctant> *to* leave his friends and go home after playing at the park all afternoon.","translation":"那個孩子在公園玩了一下午後，很不情願離開朋友回家。","explanation":"形容詞「勉強的」。指不想做某事。"}],"related_forms":["reluctance"]}

{"headword":"remark","explanation":"名詞「評論/話語」；動詞「評論/說」。作為動詞時常接 that 子句；作為名詞時常搭配 make a remark。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher made a quick <remark> about the students' hard work, which encouraged everyone in the classroom.","translation":"老師對學生們的努力做了一番簡短的評論，這鼓勵了教室裡的每個人。","explanation":"名詞「評論」。搭配動詞 make。"},{"sentence":"He <remarked> *that* the weather had been unusually hot for this time of year compared to previous summers.","translation":"他評論道，與往年夏天相比，今年的天氣異常炎熱。","explanation":"動詞「評論/說」。後接 that 子句。"},{"sentence":"She did not agree with his rude <remarks> and decided to leave the meeting early.","translation":"她不同意他那些無禮的評論，並決定提早離開會議。","explanation":"名詞「評論」。指說出的話語，常與形容詞搭配。"}],"related_forms":["remarkable"]}

{"headword":"remarkable","explanation":"形容詞「非凡的/顯著的」。常用於正面評價，指令人印象深刻。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student made <remarkable> progress in her English studies after attending the extra classes for three months.","translation":"在參加了三個月的額外課程後，那位學生在英文學習上取得了顯著的進步。","explanation":"形容詞「顯著的」。常用搭配 remarkable progress。"},{"sentence":"It is <remarkable> how the small town has changed into a modern city in just ten years.","translation":"這個小鎮在短短十年內變成了現代城市，這真是非凡。","explanation":"形容詞「非凡的」。用於驚嘆某事。"},{"sentence":"He has a <remarkable> ability to remember names and faces even after meeting people only once.","translation":"他有一種非凡的能力，即使只見過一次面，也能記住別人的名字和長相。","explanation":"形容詞「非凡的/驚人的」。指能力優異。"}],"related_forms":["remark"]}

{"headword":"remedy","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「解決方法/補救措施」；(2) 動詞「修正/補救」。作為名詞時常與 for 搭配使用。作為動詞時，語氣比 fix 更正式，通常用於解決複雜或長期的問題。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is trying to find a <remedy> *for* the economic crisis, but it will take time to see any real progress.","translation":"政府正試圖為經濟危機尋找解決方法，但需要時間才能看到真正的進展。","explanation":"名詞「解決方法/補救措施」。remedy for something 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"To <remedy> the *situation*, the school principal decided to introduce new rules to stop students from cheating on exams.","translation":"為了補救這種情況，校長決定引入新規矩，以防止學生考試作弊。","explanation":"動詞「補救/修正」。常搭配 remedy the situation/problem/issue。"},{"sentence":"Drinking warm water with honey is a simple <remedy> *for* a sore throat that many people find effective during winter.","translation":"喝溫蜂蜜水是許多人在冬天覺得有效的喉嚨痛緩解方法。","explanation":"名詞「治療方法/藥方」。remedy for a disease/illness 是常見用法。"}],"related_forms":["remedies","remedied","remedying"]}

{"headword":"renew","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 動詞「更新/續約」；(2) 動詞「恢復/重新開始」。在 GSAT 中常考「續約」或「更新合約/駕照」。","entries":[{"sentence":"You should <renew> your library *card* before it expires next month so that you can continue borrowing books for your research.","translation":"你應該在下個月過期前更新你的借書證，這樣你才能繼續借書做研究。","explanation":"動詞「更新/換發」。renew one's card/license/passport 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The two countries decided to <renew> their *friendship* and work together to solve the environmental problems in the region.","translation":"這兩國決定重修舊好，並共同努力解決該地區的環境問題。","explanation":"動詞「恢復/重啟」。renew a friendship/relationship 指恢復以往的關係。"},{"sentence":"After the long vacation, the students felt <renewed> *energy* and were ready to focus on their studies for the upcoming final exams.","translation":"長假過後，學生們感到精力充沛，準備好專注於即將到來的期末考。","explanation":"動詞的過去分詞作形容詞用「恢復的/重新賦予的」。renewed energy/hope/interest 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to <renew> the *contract* with the designer for another three years because of his excellent performance.","translation":"由於該設計師表現優異，公司決定與他續約三年。","explanation":"動詞「續約」。renew a contract/lease 是商業英文的標準用法。"}],"related_forms":["renewal","renewable","renewing"]}

{"headword":"repetition","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「重複/反覆」。這是一個不可數名詞，通常指某事反覆發生或練習。","entries":[{"sentence":"Learning a new language requires a lot of <repetition> to *memorize* vocabulary and master the correct pronunciation of difficult sounds.","translation":"學習新語言需要大量的重複才能記住單字並掌握困難發音的正確讀音。","explanation":"名詞「重複/練習」。repetition 常與 learn/practice 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The teacher warned the students against the <repetition> *of* such *mistakes* in their final reports, asking them to double-check their work.","translation":"老師警告學生不要在期末報告中重蹈覆轍，要求他們仔細檢查自己的作業。","explanation":"名詞「重演/重複」。repetition of mistakes 是常見的搭配。"},{"sentence":"Music practice often involves the <repetition> *of* *scales* until the fingers can move quickly and accurately on the piano keys.","translation":"音樂練習通常涉及音階的重複彈奏，直到手指能在琴鍵上靈活準確地移動。","explanation":"名詞「重複/反覆動作」。"}],"related_forms":["repeat","repetitive","repeatedly"]}

{"headword":"representation","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「代表/代理」；(2) 名詞「表現/描繪」。在政治或法律情境中尤為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"The *equal* <representation> *of* men and women in the parliament is a key goal for many modern democratic countries today.","translation":"男女在議會中的平等代表權是許多現代民主國家當今的主要目標。","explanation":"名詞「代表權」。representation of/in 常用於政治或組織情境。"},{"sentence":"The painting provides an *accurate* <representation> *of* *life* in the countryside during the nineteenth century, showing daily farming activities.","translation":"這幅畫精確地描繪了十九世紀農村的生活，展示了日常的農耕活動。","explanation":"名詞「描繪/表現」。representation of sth 指對某事的呈現方式。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer provided legal <representation> *for* the young man during the trial to ensure his rights were protected in court.","translation":"這名律師在審判期間為該年輕人提供法律代理，以確保他在法庭上的權利受到保護。","explanation":"名詞「代理/辯護」。legal representation 是固定搭配。"}],"related_forms":["represent","representative"]}

{"headword":"reputation","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「名聲/聲譽」。常用動詞搭配有 build, establish, ruin, damage。注意發音與拼寫。","entries":[{"sentence":"The restaurant has a *good* <reputation> *for* its fresh seafood and excellent service, attracting many customers from all over the city.","translation":"這家餐廳以其新鮮海鮮和優質服務享有盛譽，吸引了來自全市各地的顧客。","explanation":"名詞「名聲」。reputation for sth 是固定搭配，表示因某事而聞名。"},{"sentence":"It takes years to *build* a *solid* <reputation>, but only one serious mistake can ruin it in a single day.","translation":"建立穩固的聲譽需要數年時間，但一個嚴重的錯誤就可能在一天之內毀掉它。","explanation":"名詞「聲譽」。搭配 build/establish a reputation 表建立名聲；ruin/damage a reputation 表毀掉名聲。"},{"sentence":"The school has a *reputation* *as* one of the most *prestigious* institutions in the country, known for its high academic standards.","translation":"這所學校被譽為全國最負盛名的機構之一，以其高學術標準聞名。","explanation":"名詞「名聲」。reputation as + 身分/角色，表示「作為...的名聲」。"},{"sentence":"The politician's <reputation> *suffered* greatly after the public discovered that he had lied about his educational background.","translation":"當大眾發現該政治人物在學歷上撒謊後，他的聲譽受到了極大的損害。","explanation":"名詞「聲譽」。reputation suffered 表示名聲受損。"}],"related_forms":["repute","reputable","reputedly"]}

{"headword":"rescue","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 動詞「營救/救援」；(2) 名詞「救援行動」。常見搭配 rescue sb from sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The firefighters managed to <rescue> the *cat* *from* the burning building before the roof collapsed completely.","translation":"消防員在屋頂完全倒塌前，成功地將貓從燃燒的建築物中救了出來。","explanation":"動詞「營救」。rescue sb/sth from danger/place 是標準句型。"},{"sentence":"The <rescue> *team* worked through the night to search for the hikers who went missing in the mountains during the storm.","translation":"救援隊徹夜工作，搜尋在暴風雨中於山區失蹤的登山者。","explanation":"名詞「救援」。rescue team/operation 是常見的複合名詞。"},{"sentence":"Thanks to the quick <rescue> *by* the lifeguard, the boy was saved from drowning in the deep end of the pool.","translation":"多虧救生員的及時救援，這名男孩才免於在泳池深水區溺水。","explanation":"名詞「救援」。rescue by someone 表示救援行為。"},{"sentence":"Local volunteers organized a <rescue> *mission* to find homes for the abandoned dogs that were left on the streets.","translation":"當地志工組織了一場救援行動，為被遺棄在街頭的狗尋找家園。","explanation":"名詞「救援行動」。rescue mission 是固定搭配。"}],"related_forms":["rescuer","rescued","rescuing"]}

{"headword":"research","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「研究」；(2) 動詞「做研究/調查」。作為名詞時通常不可數，強調系統性的調查。","entries":[{"sentence":"She spent months doing *extensive* <research> *on* the effects of climate change on local wildlife before writing her final thesis.","translation":"在撰寫畢業論文之前，她花了數月時間對氣候變遷對當地野生動物的影響進行了廣泛研究。","explanation":"名詞「研究」。do research on sth 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are currently <researching> a *new* *method* to produce clean energy that is both affordable and efficient for everyone.","translation":"科學家們目前正在研究一種新的方法來生產清潔能源，這種方法對每個人來說既實惠又有效。","explanation":"動詞「研究」。research a method/topic。"},{"sentence":"Before you buy a new laptop, you should do some <research> *into* the different *models* available to get the best value for your money.","translation":"在購買新筆記型電腦之前，你應該對市面上不同的型號進行一些研究，以獲得最高的性價比。","explanation":"名詞「研究」。research into sth 表示對某領域深入探討。"},{"sentence":"The medical <research> *project* aims to find a cure for the rare disease by studying the DNA of patients.","translation":"這項醫學研究計畫旨在透過研究病患的 DNA 來找到治療這種罕見疾病的方法。","explanation":"名詞「研究」。research project 是常見的搭配。"}],"related_forms":["researcher","researched","researching"]}

{"headword":"researcher","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「研究人員/研究者」。指從事系統性研究工作的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <researcher> *spent* many years *analyzing* data in the laboratory to discover the cause of the mysterious illness spreading in the village.","translation":"這位研究人員在實驗室裡花了多年時間分析數據，以發現村莊中蔓延的神秘疾病的成因。","explanation":"名詞「研究者」。搭配動詞 spend time doing sth。"},{"sentence":"Many *leading* <researchers> from around the world gathered at the international conference to share their latest findings in medicine.","translation":"來自世界各地的許多頂尖研究人員聚集在國際會議上，分享他們在醫學方面的最新發現。","explanation":"名詞「研究者」。leading researchers 是常見的搭配。"},{"sentence":"As a young <researcher>, she was excited to *join* the *team* and contribute to the important project on renewable energy sources.","translation":"作為一名年輕的研究人員，她很興奮能加入團隊，並為這項關於再生能源的重要計畫做出貢獻。","explanation":"名詞「研究人員」。join the team 是相關搭配。"}],"related_forms":["research"]}

{"headword":"resemble","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 動詞「像/類似」。注意：resemble 為狀態動詞，通常不使用進行式（-ing）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people say that the young actor strongly <resembles> his *father*, especially when he smiles in front of the camera.","translation":"許多人說這位年輕演員長得很像他父親，特別是在鏡頭前微笑的時候。","explanation":"動詞「像」。resemble sb (in appearance) 是常見用法。"},{"sentence":"The new building <resembles> a *giant* *ship* sailing on the ocean, attracting many tourists to take photos of it.","translation":"這棟新建築看起來就像一艘航行在海洋上的巨大船隻，吸引許多遊客前來拍照。","explanation":"動詞「類似/像」。resemble a thing 是常見用法。"},{"sentence":"Although the two sisters have different personalities, they <resemble> *each* *other* in their love for classical music.","translation":"雖然這對姊妹個性不同，但她們在對古典音樂的熱愛上很相似。","explanation":"動詞「像」。resemble each other 表示彼此相似。"}],"related_forms":["resemblance"]}

{"headword":"reservation","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「預訂」；(2) 名詞「保留/疑慮」。常見搭配 make a reservation。注意：若表示「有疑慮」，通常用複數 reservations。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is always a good idea to *make* a <reservation> *at* the popular restaurant on weekends to avoid waiting for a long time.","translation":"週末在那家受歡迎的餐廳訂位總是不錯的主意，可以避免排隊等候太久。","explanation":"名詞「預訂」。make a reservation at/for 是固定用法。"},{"sentence":"The teacher had some <reservations> *about* the *plan* because she was worried it would be too expensive for the students.","translation":"老師對這項計畫有一些保留意見，因為她擔心對學生來說太昂貴了。","explanation":"名詞「疑慮/保留意見」。have reservations about sth 是常見用法，通常用複數。"},{"sentence":"Please confirm your hotel <reservation> *by* *email* at least two days before your arrival to ensure your room is ready.","translation":"請在抵達前至少兩天透過電子郵件確認您的飯店預訂，以確保您的房間已準備好。","explanation":"名詞「預訂」。hotel reservation 是常見複合名詞。"},{"sentence":"Despite his initial <reservations>, he finally *agreed* *to* participate in the group project after hearing his teammates' detailed explanation.","translation":"儘管起初有疑慮，在聽取隊友詳細解釋後，他最終同意參加小組計畫。","explanation":"名詞「疑慮」。initial reservations 是常見的搭配。"}],"related_forms":["reserve"]}

{"headword":"resign","explanation":"動詞「辭職」。常見搭配：resign from one's position/job。注意與 resign oneself to (順從/聽任) 的區分，後者為另一種用法，意指被動接受不愉快的現實。","entries":[{"sentence":"Due to poor health, the manager decided to <resign> *from* his position after leading the company for nearly twenty years.","translation":"由於健康狀況不佳，這位經理在領導公司近二十年後決定辭去他的職位。","explanation":"基本用法：resign from sth 表「從某職位辭職」。"},{"sentence":"The politician was forced to <resign> *as* the minister following the public scandal that damaged his reputation.","translation":"由於損害他聲譽的公共醜聞，這位政治家被迫辭去部長職務。","explanation":"用法：resign as + 職稱。此處 resign as minister 意指辭去部長一職。"},{"sentence":"After failing the entrance exam twice, he had to <resign> *himself* *to* the fact that he was not ready for university life.","translation":"兩次入學考試失敗後，他不得不接受自己還沒準備好進入大學生活的事實。","explanation":"用法：resign oneself to sth/doing sth (被迫接受/無奈順從)。注意此處 resign 為「順從」之意，與辭職義完全不同。"}],"related_forms":["resigned","resignation"]}

{"headword":"resignation","explanation":"名詞「辭職」或「辭呈」。亦可指「順從/無奈的接受」。常見搭配：submit/tender one's resignation (提出辭呈)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The CEO surprised everyone by handing in his <resignation> *after* the company reported a massive loss in the fourth quarter.","translation":"在公司第四季報告鉅額虧損後，執行長遞交辭呈，令所有人感到驚訝。","explanation":"搭配詞：hand in/submit/tender one's resignation。"},{"sentence":"He accepted the team's defeat with quiet <resignation>, knowing they had tried their best despite the difficult circumstances.","translation":"他以平靜的態度接受了球隊的失敗，知道儘管情況困難，他們已經盡力了。","explanation":"用法：resignation 在此指「無奈的接受/順從」。"}],"related_forms":["resign"]}

{"headword":"resistance","explanation":"名詞「抵抗/反抗」。常見搭配：meet with resistance (遭遇阻力)、offer/put up resistance (進行抵抗)。注意抗藥性/免疫力用法：resistance to disease/antibiotics。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new policy *met* *with* strong <resistance> *from* employees who feared it would reduce their daily working hours.","translation":"這項新政策遭到了擔心工時會被縮減的員工們的強烈抵制。","explanation":"搭配詞：meet with resistance (遭遇阻力)。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are concerned about the growing <resistance> *to* antibiotics, which makes many common infections harder to treat effectively.","translation":"科學家們對於抗生素抗藥性的增加感到擔憂，這使得許多常見感染更難以有效治療。","explanation":"用法：resistance to sth (對...的抵抗力/抗藥性)。"},{"sentence":"The soldiers *put* *up* a brave <resistance> against the invaders, but they were eventually outnumbered by the enemy forces.","translation":"士兵們對入侵者進行了勇敢的抵抗，但最終因敵眾我寡而戰敗。","explanation":"搭配詞：put up resistance (進行抵抗)。"}],"related_forms":["resist","resistant"]}

{"headword":"resolution","explanation":"名詞 (1)「決心/決定」，常用 make a resolution to do sth；(2)「解決/解答」；(3)「決議案」。常與 New Year's resolution 一詞搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"She *made* a New Year's <resolution> *to* exercise every morning, hoping to improve her overall physical health and energy levels.","translation":"她下定新年決心每天早上運動，希望能改善整體的身體健康和能量水平。","explanation":"搭配詞：make a resolution to do sth (下決心做某事)。"},{"sentence":"The United Nations passed a <resolution> *to* protect the rights of refugees, calling for international cooperation in this crisis.","translation":"聯合國通過了一項保護難民權利的決議，呼籲在此危機中進行國際合作。","explanation":"名詞「決議案」。"},{"sentence":"After long discussions, they finally reached a peaceful <resolution> *to* the conflict, ensuring that both sides were satisfied with the outcome.","translation":"經過長時間的討論，他們最終對衝突達成了和平解決方案，確保雙方對結果都感到滿意。","explanation":"名詞「解決/解答」。"}],"related_forms":["resolve"]}

{"headword":"resolve","explanation":"動詞「下定決心」或「解決(問題)」。名詞時指「堅定的決心」。動詞用法常與 solve 混淆，resolve 偏向於解決衝突、糾紛或難題；solve 偏向於解開謎題、算術或處理具體問題。","entries":[{"sentence":"The committee members met *to* <resolve> the dispute *over* the budget, aiming to find a solution that benefits all departments.","translation":"委員會成員開會討論以解決預算爭議，旨在找到對所有部門都有利的方案。","explanation":"動詞「解決(糾紛/衝突)」。常用 resolve a dispute/problem。"},{"sentence":"He <resolved> *to* quit smoking after realizing how much it was affecting his health and his family's well-being.","translation":"在意識到吸菸對他的健康和家庭幸福影響有多大後，他下定決心戒菸。","explanation":"動詞「下定決心」。常用結構：resolve to do sth (正式用法)。"},{"sentence":"Despite the repeated failures, her <resolve> *to* succeed in the music industry remained stronger than ever before.","translation":"儘管屢次失敗，她要在音樂界取得成功的決心比以往任何時候都更加堅定。","explanation":"名詞「決心/毅力」。"}],"related_forms":["resolution","resolute"]}

{"headword":"respectable","explanation":"形容詞「值得尊敬的/體面的/相當不錯的」。指外表、行為符合社會規範或道德標準，或指數量/品質令人滿意。","entries":[{"sentence":"He comes from a <respectable> family and has always behaved in a polite and honest manner throughout his life.","translation":"他出身於一個受人尊敬的家庭，一生中總是表現得彬彬有禮且誠實。","explanation":"形容詞「值得尊敬的/正派的」。"},{"sentence":"The student achieved a <respectable> score *in* the math test, which was much better than he had originally expected.","translation":"該名學生在數學測驗中取得了相當不錯的分數，比他原本預期的要好得多。","explanation":"形容詞「相當不錯的/可觀的」。"}],"related_forms":["respect","respectful","respective"]}

{"headword":"respectful","explanation":"形容詞「恭敬的/尊重的」。形容人對他人表現出禮貌或敬意。常見搭配：be respectful to/of sb/sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students are expected to *be* <respectful> *to* their teachers and listen carefully when they are speaking in class.","translation":"學生應對老師保持尊重，並在老師上課講話時仔細聆聽。","explanation":"常用搭配：be respectful to sb (對某人保持尊重)。"},{"sentence":"The audience maintained a <respectful> silence while the speaker shared her emotional story about overcoming great challenges.","translation":"當講者分享她克服巨大挑戰的情感故事時，觀眾保持著尊重的沉默。","explanation":"形容詞「恭敬的」。"}],"related_forms":["respect","respectable"]}

{"headword":"restore","explanation":"動詞「恢復/修復」。常用於恢復健康、秩序、舊建築或損壞的物品。搭配：restore sth to sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is working hard to <restore> order *to* the city after the violent protests caused widespread chaos last week.","translation":"在上週暴力抗議造成廣泛混亂後，政府正努力恢復該市的秩序。","explanation":"用法：restore sth to [place/state] (恢復某地/某狀態)。"},{"sentence":"Taking a long vacation helped him <restore> his energy and focus, allowing him to return to work with a fresh perspective.","translation":"休個長假幫助他恢復了體力和專注力，使他能以新的觀點重返工作崗位。","explanation":"動詞「恢復(健康/體力)」。"},{"sentence":"The museum experts spent years <restoring> the ancient painting *to* its original condition using specialized techniques.","translation":"博物館專家花了好幾年時間利用專業技術將這幅古畫修復回原樣。","explanation":"動詞「修復(建築/文物)」。"}],"related_forms":["restoration"]}

{"headword":"restriction","explanation":"名詞「限制/約束」。常見搭配：place/impose restrictions on sth (對某事施加限制)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school decided to *place* strict <restrictions> *on* the use of smartphones during class hours to help students concentrate.","translation":"為了幫助學生專心，學校決定對上課時間使用智慧型手機施加嚴格限制。","explanation":"搭配詞：place/impose restrictions on sth。"},{"sentence":"Due to the drought, the local government announced new <restrictions> *on* water usage to ensure there is enough for everyone.","translation":"由於乾旱，當地政府宣布了新的用水限制，以確保每個人都有足夠的水可用。","explanation":"名詞「限制」。"}],"related_forms":["restrict"]}

{"headword":"retain","explanation":"動詞「保留/保持」。指留住某物，或記住資訊，或保持某種狀態/職位。正式用語。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company offers extra benefits to <retain> talented employees and prevent them from moving to rival firms.","translation":"公司提供額外福利以留住人才，防止他們跳槽到競爭對手公司。","explanation":"動詞「留住(人才/員工)」。"},{"sentence":"Although he is getting older, he still <retains> the ability to learn new languages quickly and effectively.","translation":"雖然他年紀漸長，但仍保持著快速且有效學習新語言的能力。","explanation":"動詞「保持(能力/特徵)」。"},{"sentence":"It is difficult for students to <retain> all the information they hear in a lecture if they do not take notes.","translation":"如果學生不記筆記，很難記住他們在演講中聽到的所有資訊。","explanation":"動詞「記住/保有(記憶)」。"}],"related_forms":["retention"]}

{"headword":"retire","explanation":"動詞「退休」；名詞「退休狀態」。常見用法包括：(1) retire from one's job/profession；(2) be retired (被動式，表示退休狀態)；(3) retirement age/plan。注意名詞與動詞的拼法差異。","entries":[{"sentence":"After working as a teacher for over thirty years, Mr. Lin decided to <retire> *from* his position to spend more time with his grandchildren.","translation":"在擔任教師三十多年後，林先生決定從職位上退休，以便花更多時間陪伴孫子們。","explanation":"動詞用法。retire from sth 是標準用法，表示從某個職位或領域退休。"},{"sentence":"The company offers a generous <retirement> *plan* to all employees, encouraging them to save money for their future living expenses.","translation":"這家公司為所有員工提供豐厚的退休計畫，鼓勵他們為未來的開銷存錢。","explanation":"名詞用法。retirement plan 是常見搭配詞，指為了退休後的財政規劃。"},{"sentence":"At the age of sixty-five, she finally reached the official <retirement> *age* and looked forward to traveling around the world.","translation":"六十五歲時，她終於達到了法定退休年齡，並期待著環遊世界。","explanation":"名詞用法。retirement age 指法定或約定的退休年齡。"},{"sentence":"Many athletes choose to <retire> *at* the peak of their careers to avoid long-term injuries and enjoy a quiet life.","translation":"許多運動員選擇在職業生涯的巔峰時期退休，以避免長期受傷並享受寧靜的生活。","explanation":"動詞用法。at the peak of one's career 是常用的時間狀語，表示事業最成功的階段。"}],"related_forms":["retirement","retired"]}

{"headword":"retreat","explanation":"名詞「撤退/隱居處」；動詞「撤退/退縮」。(1) beat a retreat (撤退)；(2) retreat from (從...撤退/放棄某立場)；(3) safe retreat (避風港/隱居地)。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the heavy storm began, the campers had to <retreat> *to* their tents for safety until the weather finally cleared up.","translation":"當暴風雨開始時，露營者不得不撤退到帳篷裡以保安全，直到天氣終於好轉。","explanation":"動詞用法。retreat to a place 表示移動到某個安全的地方。"},{"sentence":"The soldiers were forced to *beat* a hasty <retreat> *when* they realized they were outnumbered by the enemy forces.","translation":"當士兵意識到敵軍人數遠多於他們時，被迫匆忙撤退。","explanation":"名詞固定片語。beat a retreat 是文學或軍事常見用法，意為「撤退」。"},{"sentence":"The old mountain cabin serves as a peaceful <retreat> *for* writers who want to work away from the noise of the city.","translation":"那間舊山屋是作家們的寧靜隱居處，他們想遠離城市噪音進行創作。","explanation":"名詞用法。在此處意為「避難所、隱居地」，通常指安靜的地方。"},{"sentence":"It is unwise to <retreat> *from* your responsibilities whenever you encounter a difficult challenge at work or school.","translation":"每當你在工作或學校遇到困難挑戰時就逃避責任，這是不明智的。","explanation":"動詞用法。retreat from sth 在此轉喻為「逃避/放棄」，常與 responsibilities 搭配。"}],"related_forms":["retreating"]}

{"headword":"reunion","explanation":"名詞「重聚/團圓」。常用於：(1) family reunion (家庭聚會)；(2) class/school reunion (同學會)；(3) a happy/joyful reunion。","entries":[{"sentence":"Every year during the Lunar New Year, our whole family holds a big <reunion> *dinner* to celebrate being together.","translation":"每年農曆春節，我們全家都會舉行盛大的團圓飯來慶祝相聚。","explanation":"名詞用法。reunion dinner (團圓飯) 是台灣文化中非常重要的搭配詞。"},{"sentence":"I was excited to see my old classmates at the high school <reunion> *after* not seeing them for over ten years.","translation":"在十年沒見面後，我很興奮能在高中同學會上見到以前的同學們。","explanation":"名詞用法。class/high school reunion (同學會) 是社交常見場景。"},{"sentence":"The <reunion> *of* the long-lost siblings was a deeply moving moment that brought tears to everyone's eyes.","translation":"失散已久的兄妹重逢是一個令人感動的時刻，讓所有人都熱淚盈眶。","explanation":"名詞用法。reunion of sb 描述人與人之間的重逢。"}],"related_forms":["reunite"]}

{"headword":"revenge","explanation":"名詞「復仇」；動詞「報復」。(1) take revenge on sb (向某人報復)；(2) get revenge (復仇)。注意與 revenge (報復) 和 vengeance (復仇感) 的語氣差異，revenge 通常指具體行動。","entries":[{"sentence":"The movie tells a story about a hero who decides to *take* <revenge> *on* the villains who destroyed his peaceful hometown.","translation":"這部電影講述了一位英雄決定向摧毀他寧靜家鄉的惡棍們復仇的故事。","explanation":"名詞固定片語。take revenge on sb 是考試重點，介係詞必須用 on。"},{"sentence":"Instead of seeking <revenge> *for* the insult, she chose to forgive him and move on with her life.","translation":"她沒有選擇為那次侮辱進行報復，而是選擇原諒他並繼續過自己的生活。","explanation":"名詞用法。revenge for sth 表示對某事進行報復。"},{"sentence":"The team was eager to <revenge> *their* previous defeat by winning the championship game against their rivals.","translation":"球隊渴望透過贏得對抗勁敵的冠軍賽，來報復之前的失敗。","explanation":"動詞用法。revenge one's defeat/loss 意為「報一箭之仇」。"}],"related_forms":["avenge"]}

{"headword":"revise","explanation":"動詞「修訂/複習」。(1) revise one's opinion/plan (修正意見/計畫)；(2) revise for an exam (複習考試，英式英語常用)。注意名詞為 revision。","entries":[{"sentence":"After receiving feedback from the teacher, the student had to <revise> *her* essay to correct several grammar and spelling errors.","translation":"在收到老師的回饋後，該學生必須修訂她的文章以修正幾個語法和拼字錯誤。","explanation":"動詞用法。意為「修改/潤飾」，常用於寫作。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <revise> *the* current law to better protect the rights of workers in the technology industry.","translation":"政府決定修訂現行法律，以更好地保護科技產業工人的權利。","explanation":"動詞用法。常與 law, plan, policy 等名詞搭配，表示進行法律或計畫的修改。"},{"sentence":"I spent the entire weekend trying to <revise> *for* my final history exam, reading through all my notes repeatedly.","translation":"我花了整個週末試圖複習我的歷史期末考，不斷閱讀我所有的筆記。","explanation":"動詞用法。在英式英語中，revise for an exam 等同於 prepare for an exam (複習考試)。"},{"sentence":"You should <revise> *your* strategy if you find that the current approach is not helping you achieve your goals.","translation":"如果你發現目前的方法無法幫你達成目標，你應該修正你的策略。","explanation":"動詞用法。revise one's strategy/plan 意為調整方向。"}],"related_forms":["revision"]}

{"headword":"revision","explanation":"名詞「修訂/複習」。(1) make a revision (進行修訂)；(2) under revision (修訂中)；(3) revision of sth (對某事的修訂)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The book is currently *under* <revision> *to* include the latest scientific discoveries made in the past five years.","translation":"這本書目前正在修訂中，將納入過去五年內最新的科學發現。","explanation":"名詞固定片語。under revision 是常見用法，表示正在修改狀態。"},{"sentence":"The committee suggested several <revisions> *to* the original proposal to make it more practical for the school board.","translation":"委員會建議對原始提案進行幾項修訂，使其對學校董事會更具實用性。","explanation":"名詞用法。revisions to sth 表示對某事物所做的修改。"},{"sentence":"Constant <revision> *of* your work is necessary if you want to write a high-quality report.","translation":"如果你想寫出一份高品質的報告，不斷地修訂你的作品是有必要的。","explanation":"名詞用法。revision of sth 在此指對作品進行潤飾。"}],"related_forms":["revise"]}

{"headword":"revolution","explanation":"名詞「革命/徹底改變」。(1) start/lead a revolution (發起革命)；(2) a revolution in sth (某領域的革命性改變)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The invention of the internet has caused a <revolution> *in* the way people communicate and share information globally.","translation":"網際網路的發明在人們全球溝通和分享資訊的方式上引發了一場革命。","explanation":"名詞用法。a revolution in sth 指某領域的重大變革。"},{"sentence":"The industrial <revolution> *led* to significant changes in society, shifting people from farm work to factory jobs.","translation":"工業革命導致社會發生重大變革，使人們從農務工作轉向工廠工作。","explanation":"名詞用法。The Industrial Revolution (工業革命) 是歷史專有名詞。"},{"sentence":"The citizens decided to start a <revolution> *against* the unfair government to demand more rights and freedom.","translation":"公民們決定發起一場反對不公政府的革命，以要求更多的權利和自由。","explanation":"名詞用法。revolution against sb 指對抗某體制或政權的革命。"}],"related_forms":["revolutionary","revolutionize"]}

{"headword":"revolutionary","explanation":"形容詞「革命性的/創新的」；名詞「革命者」。(1) a revolutionary idea/change (革命性的想法/改變)；(2) act in a revolutionary way。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist developed a <revolutionary> *new* method to treat the disease, which saved thousands of patients' lives.","translation":"這位科學家開發了一種治療該疾病的革命性新方法，拯救了數千名病人的性命。","explanation":"形容詞用法。修飾名詞 method，指創新且具重大影響力的事物。"},{"sentence":"Many consider the invention of the smartphone to be a <revolutionary> *step* forward in personal technology.","translation":"許多人認為智慧型手機的發明是個人科技向前邁出的革命性一步。","explanation":"形容詞用法。強調該進展對科技領域的重大影響。"},{"sentence":"The historical figure was known as a brave <revolutionary> *who* fought for the independence of his country.","translation":"這位歷史人物以一位為國家獨立而戰的勇敢革命者而聞名。","explanation":"名詞用法。指參與革命的人。"}],"related_forms":["revolution"]}

{"headword":"reward","explanation":"名詞「獎勵/報酬」；動詞「獎勵/回報」。(1) reward sb with sth (用某物獎勵某人)；(2) reap the rewards (獲得回報)；(3) a reward for sth (對某事的獎勵)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Hard work usually brings a great <reward>, such as achieving your goals or gaining valuable experience.","translation":"努力工作通常會帶來巨大的回報，例如實現你的目標或獲得寶貴的經驗。","explanation":"名詞用法。bring a reward 指帶來回報。"},{"sentence":"The company decided to *reward* all the hardworking employees *with* a bonus at the end of the year.","translation":"公司決定在年底用獎金獎勵所有勤奮的員工。","explanation":"動詞用法。reward sb with sth 是標準搭配，表示給予某人獎勵。"},{"sentence":"She was given a generous <reward> *for* her honesty in returning the lost wallet to the police.","translation":"她因誠實將遺失的錢包交給警察而獲得了豐厚的獎勵。","explanation":"名詞用法。a reward for sth 指因某行為獲得的獎賞。"},{"sentence":"If you study consistently every day, you will surely *reap* the <reward> *of* your efforts in the final exam results.","translation":"如果你每天持續學習，你一定會在期末考成績中獲得你努力的成果。","explanation":"名詞固定片語。reap the reward of sth 意為「得到...的成果/回報」。"}],"related_forms":["rewarding"]}

{"headword":"rhyme","explanation":"名詞「韻腳/押韻的詩」；動詞「押韻」。(1) rhyme with (與...押韻)；(2) nursery rhymes (童謠)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is fun to read children's <rhymes> *because* the rhythmic sounds make the stories easier to memorize.","translation":"讀童謠很有趣，因為有節奏的聲音讓故事更容易記住。","explanation":"名詞用法。rhyme 在此指童謠 (nursery rhyme)。"},{"sentence":"Can you think of a word that <rhymes> *with* 'light' to complete the last line of this short poem?","translation":"你能想到一個與 'light' 押韻的詞來完成這首短詩的最後一行嗎？","explanation":"動詞用法。rhyme with sth 是固定用法。"},{"sentence":"The poem is beautiful, but it does not follow a strict <rhyme> *scheme* in its structure.","translation":"這首詩很美，但它的結構並沒有遵循嚴格的押韻格式。","explanation":"名詞用法。rhyme scheme 指詩歌的押韻格式。"}],"related_forms":["rhymed"]}

{"headword":"rhythm","explanation":"常見用法：(1) 名詞「節奏、韻律」，音樂或詩歌的規律；(2) 「規律的變化」，如生活作息。常搭配動詞 follow, keep, break。注意拼字較難，r-h-y-t-h-m，中間有th。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <rhythm> *of* the music was so catchy that everyone in the classroom started tapping their feet along with the beat.","translation":"音樂的節奏太抓耳了，教室裡的每個人都開始跟著節拍用腳打拍子。","explanation":"名詞「節奏」。catchy rhythm 是常見搭配，形容節奏朗朗上口。"},{"sentence":"It takes time for international travelers to adjust their daily <rhythm> *to* a new time zone after a long flight.","translation":"長途飛行後，國際旅客需要時間將每日的生活作息調整到新的時區。","explanation":"名詞「規律/作息」。adjust ... to ... 是重要搭配，指調整生活作息以適應環境。"},{"sentence":"The drummer has a perfect sense *of* <rhythm>, which is why the band relies on him to keep the tempo steady during performances.","translation":"這位鼓手有極佳的節奏感，這就是為什麼樂團在表演時依賴他來保持穩定的速度。","explanation":"名詞「節奏感」。sense of rhythm 為固定搭配，描述一個人音樂天賦的常見用法。"}],"related_forms":["rhythmic","rhythmically"]}

{"headword":"riddle","explanation":"常見用法：(1) 名詞「謎語」，通常指用隱晦語言表達的智力遊戲；(2) 名詞「難解之謎」，比喻無法解釋的問題。動詞用法較少見，通常指「充滿（負面事物）」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The wise old man asked the young hero a difficult <riddle> *to* test his intelligence before letting him pass through the gate.","translation":"那位睿智的老人在讓年輕英雄通過大門前，問了他一個難題來測試他的智力。","explanation":"名詞「謎語」。solve a riddle 或 ask a riddle 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The sudden disappearance *of* the ancient civilization remains a <riddle> *to* historians, who still search for clues in the ruins.","translation":"那個古文明的突然消失對歷史學家來說仍然是一個難解之謎，他們仍在遺址中尋找線索。","explanation":"名詞「難解之謎」。常與 remain 搭配，表示某事依然是個謎。"},{"sentence":"The basement was <riddled> *with* holes, making it a dangerous place for anyone to store valuable items during the storm.","translation":"地下室充滿了破洞，這使得在暴風雨期間，那裡成為任何人存放貴重物品的危險場所。","explanation":"動詞「充滿（負面事物）」。riddle with sth 為固定用法，常見於形容充滿子彈孔 (riddled with bullets) 或充滿錯誤 (riddled with errors)。"}],"related_forms":["riddles"]}

{"headword":"robber","explanation":"常見用法：名詞「強盜、搶劫犯」。與 thief 不同，robber 通常涉及暴力或威脅，而 thief 通常指竊賊（偷竊）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <robber> *ran* *away* from the scene of the crime before the police arrived at the jewelry store to investigate.","translation":"在警察趕到珠寶店調查之前，搶劫犯已經從犯罪現場逃跑了。","explanation":"名詞「搶劫犯」。run away from 是描述逃跑動作的搭配。"},{"sentence":"Banks have installed high-quality security cameras *to* <robbers> *from* entering the building and stealing money from the vaults.","translation":"銀行安裝了高品質的安全攝影機，以防止搶劫犯進入大樓並從金庫中竊取金錢。","explanation":"詞義辨析：robber 指搶劫者。補充：prevents (someone) from (doing) sth 為必考文法。"},{"sentence":"The elderly woman was brave enough *to* fight back when the <robber> tried to take her handbag in the middle of the crowded street.","translation":"當搶劫犯試圖在擁擠的街道中央搶走她的手提包時，這位老婦人勇敢地反擊。","explanation":"名詞「搶劫犯」。描述搶劫場景時常用 take/grab one's bag。"}],"related_forms":["rob","robbery"]}

{"headword":"romance","explanation":"常見用法：(1) 名詞「浪漫情懷/愛情關係」；(2) 名詞「浪漫文學/愛情小說」。注意與 romantic (形容詞) 的區別，romance 是名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"They enjoyed a brief holiday <romance> *in* Paris, walking along the river and sharing coffee at small, quiet cafes.","translation":"他們在巴黎享受了一段短暫的浪漫戀情，沿著河邊散步，在安靜的小咖啡館裡分享咖啡。","explanation":"名詞「戀情」。holiday romance 指度假期間發生的短暫戀情。"},{"sentence":"Many teenagers are attracted *to* high school <romance> novels because they dream of experiencing a similar love story in their own lives.","translation":"許多青少年被高中愛情小說所吸引，因為他們夢想在自己的生活中體驗類似的愛情故事。","explanation":"名詞「愛情小說」。常指代這類文體。"},{"sentence":"The author wanted to *add* a touch *of* <romance> *to* the historical story, so she included a subplot about a secret marriage.","translation":"作者想在歷史故事中增添一點浪漫氣息，所以她加入了一段關於秘密婚姻的支線情節。","explanation":"名詞「浪漫氣息」。add a touch of ... to ... 是描述氣氛營造的絕佳句型。"}],"related_forms":["romantic","romantically"]}

{"headword":"route","explanation":"常見用法：(1) 名詞「路線、路徑」；(2) 動詞「為...規劃路線」。在交通、物流或行程規劃中非常實用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The bus <route> *from* the train station *to* the university campus is very convenient for students who do not own a car.","translation":"從火車站到大學校園的公車路線，對於沒有車的學生來說非常方便。","explanation":"名詞「路線」。bus route 或 train route 是常見用法，搭配介係詞 from...to...。"},{"sentence":"We need to *plan* a new <route> *for* our delivery trucks to avoid the heavy traffic congestion during the morning rush hour.","translation":"我們需要為送貨卡車規劃一條新路線，以避開早晨尖峰時段的嚴重交通擁堵。","explanation":"名詞「路線」。plan/map out a route 是常見動詞搭配。"},{"sentence":"The company decided *to* <route> all its international shipments through the major airport to speed up the delivery process.","translation":"公司決定將其所有國際貨物通過主要機場運送，以加快配送流程。","explanation":"動詞「規劃路線」。這裡指引導貨物運輸路徑。"},{"sentence":"Before we leave for the trip, let's *check* the <route> *on* the map to make sure we do not get lost in the mountains.","translation":"在我們出發旅行前，讓我們查看地圖上的路線，以確保我們不會在山裡迷路。","explanation":"名詞「路線」。check the route on the map 是非常生活化的表達。"}],"related_forms":["routing"]}

{"headword":"ruin","explanation":"常見用法：(1) 動詞「毀壞、破壞」；(2) 名詞「廢墟（常用複數 ruins）」。注意：ruin 和 destroy 意思相近，但 ruin 強調徹底損毀或失去價值。","entries":[{"sentence":"The heavy storm <ruined> *our* plans *for* a picnic at the beach, so we had to stay home and watch movies instead.","translation":"強烈的暴風雨毀了我們去海灘野餐的計畫，所以我們不得不待在家裡看電影。","explanation":"動詞「毀壞（計畫）」。ruin one's plans 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"Smoking for many years will eventually <ruin> *your* health and make it difficult for you to participate in outdoor sports.","translation":"抽菸多年最終會毀了你的健康，並使你難以參與戶外運動。","explanation":"動詞「毀壞（健康）」。ruin one's health 為固定用法。"},{"sentence":"The tourists were amazed by the ancient temple <ruins>, which have stood in the middle of the forest for over a thousand years.","translation":"遊客們對那座古老的神廟廢墟感到驚訝，它已經在森林中央矗立了一千多年。","explanation":"名詞「廢墟」。常用複數 ruins，常搭配 ancient 或 historic。"},{"sentence":"If you do not *take* care *of* your teeth, you will <ruin> *them* and have to spend a lot of money on dental treatment.","translation":"如果你不照顧好牙齒，你就會毀了它們，並且必須花很多錢在牙科治療上。","explanation":"動詞「毀壞」。指損害事物的價值或狀態。"}],"related_forms":["ruined","ruinous"]}

{"headword":"rural","explanation":"常見用法：形容詞「鄉村的、田園的」。與 urban（城市的）相對。常指生活方式、區域或發展。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is trying to *improve* the quality *of* life in <rural> areas by providing better healthcare and education facilities for residents.","translation":"政府正試圖透過為居民提供更好的醫療和教育設施，來改善鄉村地區的生活品質。","explanation":"形容詞「鄉村的」。rural areas 是最常見的搭配。"},{"sentence":"Many city dwellers are choosing to move *to* <rural> villages to escape the noise and stress of the fast-paced urban lifestyle.","translation":"許多城市居民正選擇搬到鄉村村莊，以逃避快節奏都市生活帶來的噪音和壓力。","explanation":"形容詞「鄉村的」。與 urban lifestyle 形成強烈對比。"},{"sentence":"The <rural> *landscape* *in* this part of the country is famous for its rolling hills and beautiful green rice fields.","translation":"該國這一部分的鄉村景觀以連綿起伏的丘陵和美麗的綠色稻田而聞名。","explanation":"形容詞「鄉村的」。rural landscape 描述鄉村的自然風景。"}],"related_forms":["rurally"]}

{"headword":"rusty","explanation":"常見用法：(1) 形容詞「生鏽的」；(2) 形容詞「（技能）生疏的」。指因為長時間沒使用而退步。","entries":[{"sentence":"The garden gate is very <rusty> because it has been exposed *to* rain and wind for many years without any maintenance.","translation":"花園大門非常生鏽，因為它多年來一直暴露在風雨中且沒有任何維護。","explanation":"形容詞「生鏽的」。指金屬因氧化而生鏽。"},{"sentence":"I haven't played the piano for a long time, so my skills are a bit <rusty>, and I need to practice more.","translation":"我已經很久沒彈鋼琴了，所以我的技巧有點生疏，我需要多練習。","explanation":"形容詞「生疏的」。常用於描述技能、語言能力，表示因久未練習而退步。"},{"sentence":"Make sure to *oil* the <rusty> hinges *of* the door so that they will stop making that annoying squeaking noise when you open them.","translation":"務必給生鏽的門鉸鏈上油，這樣當你打開它們時，它們就不會發出那種惱人的吱吱聲。","explanation":"形容詞「生鏽的」。形容金屬零件的常見狀態。"}],"related_forms":["rust"]}

{"headword":"sacrifice","explanation":"常見用法：(1) 動詞「犧牲」；(2) 名詞「犧牲、奉獻」。常指為了更有價值的東西而放棄當前的利益。","entries":[{"sentence":"The brave soldiers were willing to <sacrifice> *their* *lives* to protect their country during the war, earning respect from everyone.","translation":"勇敢的士兵在戰爭期間願意為了保衛國家而犧牲生命，贏得了每個人的尊敬。","explanation":"動詞「犧牲」。sacrifice one's life 為最高級的犧牲描述。"},{"sentence":"She had to <sacrifice> *her* *weekends* to study for the upcoming entrance exam, but she believed it would pay off in the future.","translation":"她必須犧牲週末來為即將到來的入學考試讀書，但她相信未來會有回報。","explanation":"動詞「犧牲」。指犧牲時間或休閒以換取目標。"},{"sentence":"Parents often *make* great <sacrifices> *for* their children, giving up their own interests to ensure their kids have a better future.","translation":"父母經常為孩子做出巨大的犧牲，放棄自己的興趣以確保孩子有更好的未來。","explanation":"名詞「犧牲」。make sacrifices for sb 是常用搭配。"}],"related_forms":["sacrificial"]}

{"headword":"satellite","explanation":"常見用法：(1) 名詞「衛星」（人造或自然）；(2) 名詞「附屬機構/衛星城市」。科技與地理領域常用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The weather <satellite> *sends* real-time data *to* the station, helping scientists predict storms and other natural disasters more accurately.","translation":"氣象衛星將即時數據發送到監測站，幫助科學家更準確地預測風暴和其他自然災害。","explanation":"名詞「衛星」。weather satellite 是常見的科技搭配。"},{"sentence":"With the help *of* global <satellite> *communication*, people can talk to their friends and family on the other side of the world instantly.","translation":"在衛星通訊的幫助下，人們可以即時與世界另一端的朋友和家人通話。","explanation":"名詞「衛星」。satellite communication 是現代通訊的基礎。"},{"sentence":"The city has developed several <satellite> *towns* *around* it to accommodate the growing population and reduce traffic in the center.","translation":"這座城市在其周圍發展了幾個衛星市鎮，以容納不斷增長的人口並減少市中心的交通壓力。","explanation":"名詞「衛星（城市）」。satellite town 指依附於大城市周邊的住宅區或市鎮。"}],"related_forms":["satellites"]}

{"headword":"satisfaction","explanation":"名詞「滿意/滿足」。常用搭配：express/show/gain/find satisfaction。注意常見用法：to one's satisfaction (令某人滿意的是)；guaranteed satisfaction (保證滿意)。不可數名詞，但在指「具體的滿足感或樂趣」時可複數化。","entries":[{"sentence":"He looked at his painting with a great sense of <satisfaction>, feeling that all his hard work had finally paid off.","translation":"他帶著極大的滿足感看著自己的畫作，覺得所有的努力終於有了回報。","explanation":"sense of satisfaction 是常見搭配，形容對結果感到欣慰。"},{"sentence":"The store offers a *guaranteed* <satisfaction> policy, allowing customers to return any product if they are not happy with it.","translation":"這家商店提供保證滿意的政策，允許顧客如果不滿意產品即可退貨。","explanation":"guaranteed satisfaction 是商業行銷用語，意指「滿意保證」。"},{"sentence":"To the teacher's <satisfaction>, all the students finished their assignments on time and followed the instructions carefully.","translation":"令老師滿意的是，所有學生都準時完成了作業，並仔細遵循了指示。","explanation":"to one's satisfaction 是常見用法，表示「令某人滿意的是」。"}],"related_forms":["satisfy","satisfactory","satisfied"]}

{"headword":"scarcely","explanation":"副詞「幾乎不/簡直不」。與 hardly, barely 同義。常見用法：scarcely...when (一...就...)。在句首時，句子需倒裝 (Inversion)。","entries":[{"sentence":"<Scarcely> *had* she entered the room *when* the alarm went off, startling everyone who was resting inside.","translation":"她剛進房間，警報就響了，嚇到了在裡面休息的每個人。","explanation":"scarcely...when 句型表示「一...就...」，前方使用了倒裝句 had she entered。"},{"sentence":"There was <scarcely> *any* food left in the refrigerator, so we decided to order some pizza for dinner instead.","translation":"冰箱裡幾乎沒有剩下任何食物，所以我們決定改訂披薩當晚餐。","explanation":"scarcely any 等同於 almost no，修飾不可數名詞 food。"},{"sentence":"I could <scarcely> *believe* my eyes when I saw the famous singer walking down the street right next to me.","translation":"當我看到那位著名歌手就在我旁邊的街道上走過時，我簡直不敢相信自己的眼睛。","explanation":"scarcely believe 表達「幾乎無法相信/難以置信」。"}],"related_forms":["scarce","scarcity"]}

{"headword":"scenery","explanation":"名詞「風景/景色」。不可數名詞。常指自然景觀。與 scene (某一特定場景/現場) 區分。常用形容詞：breathtaking, beautiful, spectacular, mountain scenery。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the train ride to the mountains, we enjoyed the *breathtaking* <scenery> of green forests and clear rivers outside the window.","translation":"在前往山區的火車旅程中，我們欣賞了窗外綠色森林和清澈河流的壯麗風景。","explanation":"scenery 是不可數名詞，常搭配形容詞 breathtaking (令人屏息的)。"},{"sentence":"Many tourists visit this remote village specifically to admire the *natural* <scenery> and experience a quiet life away from the city.","translation":"許多遊客專程造訪這個偏遠村莊，欣賞自然風光，並體驗遠離城市的寧靜生活。","explanation":"natural scenery 是常見組合，指大自然景觀。"},{"sentence":"The *mountain* <scenery> in Switzerland is famous for its snow-capped peaks and deep, quiet valleys.","translation":"瑞士的山景以其白雪皚皚的山峰和深邃寧靜的山谷而聞名。","explanation":"scenery 也可以作為複合名詞的一部分，如 mountain scenery。"}],"related_forms":["scene","scenic"]}

{"headword":"scold","explanation":"動詞「責罵/訓斥」。常用用法：scold sb. for sth. (因某事責備某人)。名詞形式較少見，指責罵的行為。容易與批評 (criticize) 混淆，scold 帶有對待下屬或小孩的權威感。","entries":[{"sentence":"The mother <scolded> her son *for* breaking the expensive vase while he was playing ball in the living room.","translation":"媽媽因為兒子在客廳玩球打破昂貴的花瓶而責罵他。","explanation":"scold sb. for sth. 是固定用法，表示因某事責備某人。"},{"sentence":"Don't *get* <scolded> by the boss for being late again; you should set an alarm to wake up earlier tomorrow.","translation":"不要再因為遲到而被老闆罵了；你明天應該設鬧鐘早點起床。","explanation":"get scolded 為被動用法，口語中常用 get 取代 be。"},{"sentence":"Although he knew he deserved to be <scolded> *for* his mistake, he still felt very embarrassed in front of his colleagues.","translation":"雖然他知道自己因為犯錯而該被責備，但在同事面前他仍然感到非常尷尬。","explanation":"deserved to be scolded 強調「該被責備」的語氣。"}],"related_forms":["scolding"]}

{"headword":"scoop","explanation":"名詞「勺子/一勺之量」；動詞「挖/舀」。在新聞領域指「獨家新聞」。注意動詞用法：scoop up (撈起/舀起)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She used a large metal <scoop> to *serve* the ice cream into the cones for the waiting customers.","translation":"她用一個大金屬勺子將冰淇淋舀入甜筒給等候的顧客。","explanation":"名詞用法，指舀冰淇淋的器具。"},{"sentence":"The reporter managed to *get* the <scoop> on the politician's secret meeting, which shocked the entire public the next day.","translation":"記者成功取得了那位政客秘密會議的獨家新聞，隔天震驚了整個大眾。","explanation":"名詞用法，指獨家新聞，常搭配 get the scoop on sth."},{"sentence":"The baby <scooped> *up* a handful of sand and threw it into the air, laughing as it fell on his shoes.","translation":"寶寶抓了一把沙子扔向空中，當沙子掉在他鞋子上時，他笑了起來。","explanation":"動詞片語 scoop up 指「抓起/舀起」。"}],"related_forms":["scooped","scooping"]}

{"headword":"scratch","explanation":"動詞「抓/刮/劃」；名詞「抓痕/刮痕」。常用片語：from scratch (從零開始/從頭做起)；up to scratch (達到標準)。注意動詞用法：scratch one's head (抓頭，表示困惑)。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you don't *treat* the cat well, it might <scratch> you with its sharp claws when it feels scared or angry.","translation":"如果你不好好對待那隻貓，當牠感到害怕或生氣時，可能會用尖銳的爪子抓你。","explanation":"動詞用法，指被動物抓傷。"},{"sentence":"The chef decided to *make* the bread *from* <scratch>, using fresh flour and yeast instead of a pre-made mix.","translation":"廚師決定從零開始製作麵包，使用新鮮麵粉和酵母，而不是預先做好的混合粉。","explanation":"from scratch 是極高頻片語，意指「從頭開始/白手起家」。"},{"sentence":"There is a long <scratch> *on* the surface of the car, probably caused by someone walking by with a sharp key.","translation":"汽車表面有一道長長的刮痕，可能是某人拿著鋒利的鑰匙走過時造成的。","explanation":"名詞用法，指物體表面的刮痕，常用介係詞 on。"},{"sentence":"He *scratched* his <head> in confusion, trying to solve the difficult math problem that the teacher had assigned.","translation":"他困惑地抓了抓頭，試圖解開老師指派的困難數學題。","explanation":"scratch one's head 是一個慣用語，表示「困惑/煩惱」。"}],"related_forms":["scratchy","scratched"]}

{"headword":"sculpture","explanation":"名詞「雕塑品」；動詞「雕刻」。常用詞彙：sculpture garden, bronze sculpture。注意區別：sculptor (雕刻家)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum displays a beautiful bronze <sculpture> *of* a galloping horse, which attracts many art lovers every year.","translation":"博物館展出了一座美麗的奔馬青銅雕塑，每年吸引許多藝術愛好者。","explanation":"名詞用法，搭配材質 bronze (青銅)。"},{"sentence":"The artist spent years <sculpting> the hard stone into a lifelike figure of a young woman reading a book.","translation":"這位藝術家花了幾年時間將堅硬的石頭雕刻成一位年輕女子正在讀書的栩栩如生的雕像。","explanation":"動詞形式，指將素材雕刻成型。"},{"sentence":"Walking through the public park, we saw many modern <sculptures> that added a sense of creativity to the green space.","translation":"走在公園裡，我們看到了許多現代雕塑，為這個綠地增添了創造力感。","explanation":"名詞複數用法，指公園裡的藝術裝飾。"}],"related_forms":["sculpt","sculptor"]}

{"headword":"secure","explanation":"形容詞「安全的/牢固的」；動詞「獲得/固定」。常用搭配：secure a job (獲得工作), secure the door (鎖緊門)。注意：insecure (不安全的/沒自信的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is important to *keep* your personal information <secure> when shopping online to prevent identity theft by hackers.","translation":"在網上購物時，確保個人資訊安全很重要，以防止駭客竊取身分。","explanation":"形容詞用法，keep sth. secure (保持某事安全)。"},{"sentence":"After several interviews, the graduate finally <secured> a *position* at a well-known international company in the city.","translation":"經過幾次面試，這位畢業生終於在市內一家知名國際公司獲得了一個職位。","explanation":"動詞用法，secure a position/job 指「爭取到/獲得」。"},{"sentence":"Please *make* sure that the rope is <secure> before you start climbing the rock wall to avoid any fall.","translation":"在開始攀岩之前，請確保繩子固定牢固，以避免跌倒。","explanation":"形容詞用法，意指「牢固的/穩固的」。"},{"sentence":"The security guard *secured* the *gates* of the building at midnight to ensure that no unauthorized people could enter.","translation":"警衛在午夜鎖上了大樓的門，以確保沒有未經授權的人可以進入。","explanation":"動詞用法，意指「鎖緊/固定」。"}],"related_forms":["security","insecure"]}

{"headword":"seize","explanation":"動詞「抓住/奪取/利用」。常見搭配：seize the chance/opportunity (把握機會)；seize power (奪權)。與 grasp 類似，但 seize 強調動作迅速、有力。","entries":[{"sentence":"You should <seize> every *opportunity* to practice speaking English, as it is the best way to improve your fluency.","translation":"你應該把握每個練習說英語的機會，因為這是提高流利度最好的方法。","explanation":"seize the opportunity 是常見搭配，表示「把握機會」。"},{"sentence":"The police <seized> the *illegal* drugs during the raid and arrested the suspects who were hiding in the warehouse.","translation":"警方在突襲行動中查獲了非法毒品，並逮捕了躲在倉庫裡的嫌疑人。","explanation":"動詞用法，指警方「查獲/沒收」非法物品。"},{"sentence":"He <seized> her *arm* to pull her out of the way just as the speeding car drove past them.","translation":"就在那輛超速的車駛過他們身邊時，他抓住她的手臂把她拉開。","explanation":"動詞用法，指用力「抓住」。"}],"related_forms":["seized","seizing"]}

{"headword":"settler","explanation":"名詞「定居者/殖民者」。指移居到新地區居住的人。常與歷史背景相關，如 pioneer (拓荒者)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The early <settlers> *faced* many challenges, including harsh weather and a lack of food, when they first arrived in the new land.","translation":"早期的定居者剛到達這片新土地時，面臨了許多挑戰，包括惡劣的天氣和食物短缺。","explanation":"指早期的移居者，常與 history 相關。"},{"sentence":"A group of <settlers> *established* a small village near the river to ensure they had easy access to fresh water.","translation":"一群定居者在河邊建立了一個小村莊，以確保他們能方便地取得淡水。","explanation":"指建立居住地的人。"},{"sentence":"The museum exhibits tools and clothes that belonged to the *original* <settlers> who lived in this region hundreds of years ago.","translation":"博物館展出了屬於幾百年前居住在這個地區的原始定居者的工具和衣服。","explanation":"original settlers 是指「第一批定居者」。"}],"related_forms":["settle","settlement"]}

{"headword":"severe","explanation":"形容詞「嚴重的」、「嚴厲的」。常見於描述天氣、懲罰或健康狀況。常見搭配：severe weather (惡劣天氣), severe pain (劇烈疼痛), severe punishment (嚴厲懲罰)。注意與 serious 的區別，severe 強調程度極端。","entries":[{"sentence":"The typhoon caused <severe> *damage* to the coastal village, leaving many families without electricity or clean water for several days.","translation":"颱風對沿海村莊造成了嚴重破壞，導致許多家庭好幾天沒有電力或乾淨的水。","explanation":"形容詞「嚴重的」。常與 damage, storm, weather 連用，強調破壞性或危險性。"},{"sentence":"He suffered from <severe> *pain* in his back after lifting the heavy boxes, so he went to the hospital for an X-ray.","translation":"他在搬運重箱子後背部感到劇烈疼痛，所以他去醫院照了X光。","explanation":"形容詞「劇烈的」。搭配 pain, headache 等症狀，表達痛楚程度高。"},{"sentence":"The teacher gave the student a <severe> *warning* about cheating on the exam, stating that it would lead to failure in the course.","translation":"老師對該名學生在考試中作弊發出了嚴厲警告，並表示這會導致該課程不及格。","explanation":"形容詞「嚴厲的」。用於行為規範或處罰，強調態度堅決且後果嚴重。"}],"related_forms":["severely","severity"]}

{"headword":"sew","explanation":"動詞「縫補」、「縫製」。動詞三態變化為 sew-sewed-sewn (或 sewed)。注意拼寫，不要與 saw (看) 搞混。","entries":[{"sentence":"My grandmother likes to <sew> *buttons* onto the clothes she makes for my little sister to ensure they fit perfectly.","translation":"我祖母喜歡把鈕扣縫在她為我妹妹做的衣服上，以確保它們穿起來很合身。","explanation":"動詞「縫上」。sew sth onto sth 為常見用法。"},{"sentence":"She learned how to <sew> *dresses* by hand when she was young, and now she runs a small tailor shop in the city center.","translation":"她年輕時學過手工縫製洋裝，現在她在市中心經營一家小裁縫店。","explanation":"動詞「縫製」。強調製作衣服的過程。"},{"sentence":"If you <sew> *up* the hole in your pocket, you will stop losing your coins while walking to school every morning.","translation":"如果你把你口袋的破洞縫起來，你每天走路上學時就不會再弄丟硬幣了。","explanation":"動詞片語 sew up 表示「縫合/補好」。"}],"related_forms":["sewed","sewn"]}

{"headword":"shade","explanation":"名詞「陰涼處」、「色調」；動詞「遮蔽」。常見搭配：in the shade (在陰涼處)。注意與 shadow (影子) 的區別：shade 通常指避開陽光處，shadow 指物體投射出的具體形狀。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the hot summer afternoon, the stray cats rested in the <shade> *of* the large banyan tree to avoid the burning sun.","translation":"在炎熱的夏日下午，流浪貓在榕樹的陰涼處休息，以避開灼熱的太陽。","explanation":"名詞「陰涼處」。in the shade 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"The painter mixed blue and white to create a lighter <shade> *of* blue, which he then used to paint the clear sky.","translation":"畫家將藍色和白色混合，創造出一種較淺的藍色色調，然後他用它來畫晴朗的天空。","explanation":"名詞「色調/顏色深淺」。用於藝術或色彩描述。"},{"sentence":"We <shaded> *our* eyes with our hands so that we could see the distant mountain more clearly in the bright sunlight.","translation":"我們用手遮住眼睛，這樣我們就能在明亮的陽光下更清楚地看到遠處的山。","explanation":"動詞「遮蔽」。指為了看清事物或避免陽光直射而遮擋。"}],"related_forms":["shady","shades"]}

{"headword":"shady","explanation":"形容詞「多蔭的」、「可疑的」。第一層含義指受遮蔽的；第二層口語含義指不誠實、非法的。GSAT閱讀測驗常見第二層引申義。","entries":[{"sentence":"We decided to have a picnic in the <shady> *spot* under the oak tree, as it was much cooler than the open grass.","translation":"我們決定在橡樹下的陰涼處野餐，因為那裡比開闊的草地涼快得多。","explanation":"形容詞「有遮蔭的」。形容地點舒適。"},{"sentence":"The police were suspicious of the <shady> *character* who was seen hanging around the jewelry store late at night.","translation":"警方對那個深夜被目擊在珠寶店附近徘徊的可疑人物感到懷疑。","explanation":"形容詞「可疑的」。形容人或行為不光明磊落。"},{"sentence":"Some people believe that the company's sudden rise to wealth is the result of some <shady> *business* practices.","translation":"有些人認為這家公司突然致富是某些不正當商業手段的結果。","explanation":"形容詞「非法的/不正當的」。常用於商業或金融語境。"}],"related_forms":["shade"]}

{"headword":"shameful","explanation":"形容詞「丟臉的」、「可恥的」。來自名詞 shame (羞恥)。注意不要與 ashamed (感到羞恥的) 混淆，shameful 修飾事物本身讓人覺得丟臉，ashamed 修飾人感到羞愧。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is <shameful> *to* treat people unfairly just because of their background, as everyone deserves respect and kindness.","translation":"僅僅因為背景而對人不公平對待是可恥的，因為每個人都值得被尊重和善待。","explanation":"形容詞「可恥的」。it is shameful to... 為常見句型。"},{"sentence":"The politician's <shameful> *behavior* in public led to his immediate resignation and a loss of support from his voters.","translation":"那位政治人物在公開場合的丟臉行為導致他立即辭職，並失去了選民的支持。","explanation":"形容詞「丟臉的」。用於評價某人的行為。"},{"sentence":"The amount of food wasted in this city every day is truly <shameful>, given that many people still suffer from hunger.","translation":"考慮到許多人仍受飢餓之苦，這座城市每天浪費的食物數量實在令人羞愧。","explanation":"形容詞「令人羞愧的」。用於對社會現象的批判。"}],"related_forms":["shame","ashamed"]}

{"headword":"shave","explanation":"動詞「刮(鬍子/毛髮)」、「剃」；名詞「刮鬍子」。常見搭配：shave off (刮掉/剃除)。","entries":[{"sentence":"My father usually <shaves> *every* morning before he goes to work to keep himself looking neat and professional.","translation":"我父親通常在每天上班前刮鬍子，以保持自己看起來整潔且專業。","explanation":"動詞「刮鬍子」。指日常個人護理。"},{"sentence":"He decided to <shave> *off* his thick beard because the hot summer weather made him feel uncomfortable.","translation":"他決定把濃密的鬍子刮掉，因為炎熱的夏天讓他感到很不舒服。","explanation":"動詞片語 shave off 表示「將毛髮徹底剃除」。"},{"sentence":"After having a quick <shave> *in* the bathroom, he put on his suit and left the hotel for the conference.","translation":"在浴室快速刮完鬍子後，他穿上西裝離開飯店去參加會議。","explanation":"名詞「刮鬍子」。常見搭配 have a shave。"}],"related_forms":["shaved","shaven"]}

{"headword":"shelter","explanation":"名詞「庇護所」、「遮蔽物」；動詞「掩護」、「庇護」。常見用法：take shelter (尋求庇護/躲避)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the heavy thunderstorm, the travelers found <shelter> *in* a small cave to keep themselves dry and safe.","translation":"在雷雨期間，旅行者在一個小山洞裡找到了庇護所，以保持身體乾燥和安全。","explanation":"名詞「庇護所」。take shelter in... 是重要片語。"},{"sentence":"The animal <shelter> *provides* food and medical care for abandoned dogs and cats waiting to be adopted by new families.","translation":"這間動物收容所為等待新家庭領養的被遺棄貓狗提供食物和醫療照顧。","explanation":"名詞「收容所」。常見於社會議題文章。"},{"sentence":"Large trees can <shelter> *small* plants from the strong wind, allowing them to grow better in the garden.","translation":"大樹可以保護小植物免受強風侵襲，使它們在花園裡長得更好。","explanation":"動詞「保護/遮蔽」。shelter sb/sth from sth 是常用結構。"}],"related_forms":["sheltered"]}

{"headword":"shift","explanation":"名詞「轉變」、「輪班」；動詞「移動」、「改變」。常指觀點、策略或工作時間的調整。","entries":[{"sentence":"There has been a significant <shift> *in* public opinion regarding environmental protection over the past decade in Taiwan.","translation":"過去十年來，台灣大眾對於環境保護的觀點有了顯著的轉變。","explanation":"名詞「轉變」。常用 shift in... 表示某方面的改變。"},{"sentence":"The factory workers usually work in a night <shift> *to* ensure that the machines keep running around the clock.","translation":"工廠工人通常輪夜班，以確保機器能全天候運作。","explanation":"名詞「輪班」。常見工作相關用語。"},{"sentence":"It is difficult to <shift> *the* responsibility onto others when you know you made the mistake yourself.","translation":"當你知道錯誤是自己犯的時候，很難將責任推卸給別人。","explanation":"動詞「轉移」。shift responsibility/blame 為常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The government needs to <shift> *its* focus from economic growth to sustainable development for future generations.","translation":"政府需要將重心從經濟成長轉移到為未來世代的可持續發展上。","explanation":"動詞「轉移(重心/焦點)」。shift focus to... 意指改變關注的對象。"}],"related_forms":["shifted"]}

{"headword":"sightseeing","explanation":"名詞「觀光」、「遊覽」。通常與動詞 go 連用。不可數名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"We plan to go <sightseeing> *around* the city center this weekend to visit the famous museums and historical landmarks.","translation":"我們計畫這個週末去市中心觀光，參觀著名的博物館和歷史地標。","explanation":"名詞「觀光」。go sightseeing 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"After a long day of <sightseeing> *in* Paris, the tourists were very tired but happy with all the beautiful photos they took.","translation":"在巴黎觀光了一整天後，遊客們非常疲憊，但對拍到的所有美麗照片感到開心。","explanation":"名詞「觀光」。用於描述旅遊活動。"},{"sentence":"The travel agency offers several <sightseeing> *tours* that allow visitors to explore the hidden gems of the countryside.","translation":"旅行社提供幾種觀光行程，讓遊客可以探索鄉村隱藏的景點。","explanation":"名詞「觀光的」。作為形容詞用法，修飾 tours。"}],"related_forms":["sightsee"]}

{"headword":"signature","explanation":"名詞「簽名」、「特徵」；形容詞「招牌的」。注意與 sign (標誌/簽名動詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please write your <signature> *at* the bottom of the document to confirm that you have read and agreed to all the terms.","translation":"請在文件底部簽上您的名字，以確認您已閱讀並同意所有條款。","explanation":"名詞「簽名」。常見於正式文件。"},{"sentence":"This restaurant is famous for its <signature> *dish*, a spicy beef noodle soup that attracts customers from all over the country.","translation":"這家餐廳以其招牌菜聞名，那是一道吸引全國各地顧客的麻辣牛肉麵。","explanation":"形容詞「招牌的」。指最具代表性的產品。"},{"sentence":"The artist's <signature> *style* involves using bright colors and bold lines to express his deep emotions.","translation":"這位藝術家的招牌風格包括使用鮮豔的色彩和粗線條來表達他深沉的情感。","explanation":"名詞「標誌性的」。指某人獨有的風格特徵。"}],"related_forms":["sign"]}

{"headword":"significance","explanation":"名詞「重要性/意義」。常用搭配：of great/little significance。注意與 significant (形容詞) 的詞性區分。常與 attach/importance 連用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The discovery of the ancient ruins is *of* great <significance> to our understanding of early human civilization in this region.","translation":"古遺跡的發現對我們了解該地區早期人類文明具有重大意義。","explanation":"片語 be of great significance = be very important。是學測寫作中提升句型的常用結構。"},{"sentence":"The politician failed to realize the *full* <significance> of his controversial remarks, which offended many voters across the country.","translation":"那位政治人物沒有意識到他爭議性言論的全部含義，這冒犯了全國許多選民。","explanation":"指「深層含義」或「影響力」。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are discussing the <significance> *of* the recent climate data, as it suggests that global warming is accelerating faster than expected.","translation":"科學家們正在討論最近氣候數據的重要性，因為這顯示全球暖化加速得比預期更快。","explanation":"指數據的「意義/影響」。"}],"related_forms":["significant","signify"]}

{"headword":"sincerity","explanation":"名詞「誠懇/真心」。常見用法：in all sincerity (真心誠意地)。常與 sincerity 和 honesty 連用。","entries":[{"sentence":"He apologized to his teacher *with* deep <sincerity>, promising that he would never cheat on an exam again in the future.","translation":"他帶著深深的誠意向老師道歉，承諾未來再也不會在考試中作弊。","explanation":"搭配詞 with sincerity 表「誠懇地」。"},{"sentence":"Despite his *lack of* <sincerity> during the initial interview, he eventually proved himself to be a dedicated and honest worker.","translation":"儘管他在初次面試時缺乏誠意，但他最終證明自己是一位敬業且誠實的員工。","explanation":"lack of sincerity 是常見的負面搭配。"},{"sentence":"The charity worker spoke *with* such <sincerity> that many people in the audience were moved to tears and decided to donate money.","translation":"那位慈善工作者講話時極其誠懇，以至於許多觀眾感動落淚，並決定捐款。","explanation":"強調說話者的真誠態度如何影響他人。"}],"related_forms":["sincere","sincerely"]}

{"headword":"singular","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 形容詞「單一的/非凡的/單數的」；(2) 名詞「單數」。在文法題中，singular noun 指單數名詞。","entries":[{"sentence":"In English grammar, a <singular> subject must always *agree with* a singular verb form to maintain proper sentence structure.","translation":"在英文語法中，單數主詞必須與單數動詞形式一致，以維持正確的句子結構。","explanation":"文法術語，指「單數的」。agree with 是搭配動詞。"},{"sentence":"The artist received <singular> honor for his *contribution to* contemporary music, being the first person in his family to win the award.","translation":"這位藝術家因其對當代音樂的貢獻而獲得非凡的榮譽，他是家族中第一位獲得該獎項的人。","explanation":"形容詞「非凡的/卓越的」，較高級用法，同義詞為 remarkable/extraordinary。"},{"sentence":"She has a <singular> talent for painting, which allows her to create beautiful images that no one else can replicate.","translation":"她有著獨特的繪畫天賦，這使她能創作出無人能複製的精美圖像。","explanation":"形容詞「獨特的/唯一的」，指與眾不同。"}],"related_forms":["singularity"]}

{"headword":"site","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「地點/現場/網站」；(2) 動詞「位於/設置於(常被動)」。注意與 sight (視力/景象) 的拼字區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government has chosen a new <site> *for* the construction of the public library, which is closer to the city center.","translation":"政府已為興建公共圖書館選擇了一個新地點，那裡離市中心更近。","explanation":"名詞「地點」。site for... 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The new factory is <situated> *in* an industrial area, away from residential neighborhoods to reduce noise pollution for the citizens.","translation":"新工廠位於工業區，遠離住宅區，以減少對市民的噪音污染。","explanation":"動詞 be situated in = be located in。注意過去分詞用法。"},{"sentence":"Visitors can find more information about the historical <site> *on* the official tourism website before planning their weekend trip.","translation":"遊客在規劃週末行程前，可以在官方旅遊網站上找到更多關於這個歷史遺址的資訊。","explanation":"名詞「遺址/場所」。"},{"sentence":"The construction *work* <site> is strictly off-limits to the public to ensure everyone's safety during the building process.","translation":"為了確保施工過程中的安全，施工現場嚴禁公眾進入。","explanation":"名詞「工地/現場」。"}],"related_forms":["situated","situation"]}

{"headword":"sketch","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「素描/草圖/簡述」；(2) 動詞「畫素描/概述」。常與 draw/make/give 連用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The architect *made* a quick <sketch> *of* the house design to show the clients his initial ideas for the renovation project.","translation":"建築師畫了房子設計的草圖，向客戶展示他對翻修計畫的初步構想。","explanation":"名詞「草圖/簡圖」。make a sketch of 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The detective *asked* the witness to <sketch> *out* the face of the suspect based on what she remembered from that night.","translation":"偵探請目擊者根據她那一晚的記憶，畫出嫌疑犯的臉部素描。","explanation":"動詞「繪製/概述」。sketch out 常用於「草擬/粗略描繪」。"},{"sentence":"The biography provides a brief <sketch> *of* the author's early life, explaining how his childhood experiences influenced his later literary style.","translation":"這本傳記簡略地描述了作者的早年生活，解釋了他的童年經歷如何影響他後來的文學風格。","explanation":"名詞「簡述/概略」。"},{"sentence":"During the long flight, she spent most of her time <sketching> *in* her notebook to pass the time and practice her drawing skills.","translation":"在漫長的飛行過程中，她大部分時間都在筆記本上畫素描，以打發時間並練習繪畫技巧。","explanation":"動詞「畫素描」。"}],"related_forms":["sketched","sketchy"]}

{"headword":"skyscraper","explanation":"名詞「摩天大樓」。指極高且現代化的辦公或住宅大樓。常與 tall/modern/city skyline 連用。","entries":[{"sentence":"Taipei 101 is one of the most famous <skyscrapers> *in* the world, known for its unique design and height in the city center.","translation":"台北101是世界上最著名的摩天大樓之一，以其獨特的設計和位於市中心的高度而聞名。","explanation":"名詞「摩天大樓」。"},{"sentence":"The reflection of the *modern* <skyscrapers> *on* the glass windows of the building created a beautiful view for the city residents.","translation":"現代摩天大樓在建築玻璃窗上的倒影，為城市居民創造了美麗的景色。","explanation":"描述都市景觀。"},{"sentence":"Many companies choose to *set up* their headquarters *in* a <skyscraper> to symbolize their success and professional status in the market.","translation":"許多公司選擇將總部設在摩天大樓裡，以象徵他們在市場上的成功和專業地位。","explanation":"與商業成功意象連結。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"slight","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 形容詞「輕微的/瘦小的」；(2) 名詞「輕蔑/冷落」；(3) 動詞「輕視/冷落」。注意與 slighty (副詞) 的區分。常見搭配：a slight change/improvement。","entries":[{"sentence":"There was a <slight> *change* *in* the schedule, but the meeting will still take place at the same time and location.","translation":"時間表有輕微變動，但會議仍會在相同的時間和地點舉行。","explanation":"形容詞「輕微的」。a slight change 是固定搭配。"},{"sentence":"Even a <slight> *improvement* *in* your diet can have a significant effect on your overall health and energy levels.","translation":"即使你的飲食有輕微的改善，也會對你的整體健康和能量水平產生顯著影響。","explanation":"形容詞「輕微的」。常用於正面改變。"},{"sentence":"She felt deeply insulted because she interpreted his silence as a deliberate <slight> *against* her efforts to help the team.","translation":"她感到深深受辱，因為她將他的沉默解讀為對她協助團隊努力的蓄意輕視。","explanation":"名詞「輕蔑/忽視」。"},{"sentence":"The boy was <slight> *in* build, yet he was surprisingly strong and good at playing basketball with his classmates.","translation":"那個男孩身材瘦小，但他竟然意外地強壯，且很擅長和同學們打籃球。","explanation":"形容詞「瘦小的」。"}],"related_forms":["slightly"]}

{"headword":"slogan","explanation":"名詞「標語/口號」。常用於廣告或政治活動。常用搭配：catchy slogan, advertising slogan。注意拼字。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company created a *catchy* <slogan> *for* their new product, which helped increase sales significantly during the first month.","translation":"這家公司為他們的新產品創造了一個朗朗上口的口號，這在第一個月內幫助銷售額大幅提升。","explanation":"名詞「標語」。catchy slogan 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"The <slogan> *of* the campaign focuses on environmental protection, encouraging people to reduce the use of plastic bags in daily life.","translation":"這項運動的口號聚焦於環境保護，鼓勵人們在日常生活中減少塑膠袋的使用。","explanation":"名詞「口號」。"},{"sentence":"Successful brands often use a simple <slogan> *to* connect with their customers and build a strong image in the competitive market.","translation":"成功的品牌通常使用簡單的口號與顧客建立連結，並在競爭激烈的市場中建立強大形象。","explanation":"名詞「口號」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"socket","explanation":"名詞「插座/插孔」。注意與 outlet (美式常用) 的區分。常與 power, plug, wall 連用。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please make sure to *plug* the computer *into* the wall <socket> correctly to avoid any potential electrical problems or damage.","translation":"請務必將電腦正確插入牆上的插座，以避免任何潛在的電力問題或損壞。","explanation":"名詞「插座」。plug into... socket 是標準搭配。"},{"sentence":"Before you leave the room, remember to *unplug* all your devices from the <socket> to save electricity and stay safe.","translation":"離開房間前，記得將所有設備從插座拔掉，以節省電力並確保安全。","explanation":"名詞「插座」。"},{"sentence":"There is a loose <socket> *in* the living room that needs to be repaired by a professional electrician as soon as possible.","translation":"客廳有一個鬆動的插座，需要盡快請專業電工修理。","explanation":"描述設備故障。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"software","explanation":"名詞「軟體」。不可數名詞，不可加 s。常與 computer, update, install, run 連用。","entries":[{"sentence":"Our school has *installed* new educational <software> *on* all the computers in the library to help students with their studies.","translation":"我們學校已在圖書館的所有電腦上安裝了新的教育軟體，以幫助學生學習。","explanation":"不可數名詞。install software on... 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"You should *update* the <software> *on* your phone regularly to ensure that you have the latest features and security protection.","translation":"你應該定期更新手機上的軟體，以確保擁有最新的功能和安全保護。","explanation":"不可數名詞，不可用 softwares。"},{"sentence":"The *development* *of* new <software> requires a team of skilled engineers who work together to solve complex technical problems.","translation":"新軟體的開發需要一個由技術熟練的工程師組成的團隊，他們共同合作解決複雜的技術問題。","explanation":"名詞「軟體」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"solar","explanation":"指「太陽的；太陽能的」。常見搭配：solar energy (太陽能), solar system (太陽系), solar panel (太陽能板)。注意與 lunar (月亮的) 做區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school decided to install <solar> *panels* on the roof to generate clean electricity and save on monthly energy costs.","translation":"學校決定在屋頂安裝太陽能板來產生乾淨的電力，並節省每個月的能源開銷。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾 panels。solar panels 是 GSAT 常見的環保相關詞彙。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are working on new technologies to make <solar> *energy* more affordable and efficient for households around the world.","translation":"科學家們正在致力於新技術，讓全球家庭都能以更實惠且有效率的方式使用太陽能。","explanation":"常見搭配 solar energy。solar 描述能源來源。"},{"sentence":"Earth is one of the eight planets in our <solar> *system*, all of which orbit the Sun at different speeds and distances.","translation":"地球是我們太陽系中八大行星之一，它們都以不同的速度和距離繞著太陽運轉。","explanation":"固定搭配 solar system。形容詞修飾 system。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"spade","explanation":"名詞「鏟子」；動詞「用鏟挖掘」。常用於園藝或工地場景。慣用語：call a spade a spade (直言不諱，說實話)。","entries":[{"sentence":"He picked up a <spade> to *dig* a small hole in the garden so he could plant the new rose bush.","translation":"他拿起一把鏟子在花園裡挖了一個小洞，這樣他就能種下新的玫瑰花叢。","explanation":"名詞用法。搭配動詞 dig (挖掘)。"},{"sentence":"The workers <spaded> the *dirt* carefully to avoid damaging the old pipes buried beneath the surface of the park.","translation":"工人們小心地用鏟子挖掘泥土，以避免損壞埋在公園地表下的舊水管。","explanation":"動詞用法。spade 亦可指用鏟子挖掘，past tense 為 spaded。"},{"sentence":"It is better to just *call* a <spade> a <spade> and tell the truth about the team's poor performance than to hide it.","translation":"與其隱瞞，不如直言不諱，說出團隊表現不佳的事實。","explanation":"慣用語 call a spade a spade，意指「實話實說，不加修飾」。"}],"related_forms":["spades"]}

{"headword":"spare","explanation":"(1) 形容詞：多餘的、備用的 (spare time/spare tire)；(2) 動詞：騰出、寬恕、免除 (spare some time for/spare no effort)；(3) 名詞：備用品。","entries":[{"sentence":"I usually read books or listen to music in my <spare> *time* to relax after a long day at school.","translation":"我在空閒時間通常會讀書或聽音樂，在漫長的學校生活後放鬆一下。","explanation":"形容詞「空閒的/多餘的」。常用搭配 spare time。"},{"sentence":"Could you <spare> *a* few *minutes* to help me review my English essay before the deadline tomorrow?","translation":"你能撥出幾分鐘幫我檢查一下明天截止前的英文作文嗎？","explanation":"動詞「騰出/撥出」。常用句型 spare some time for sb/sth。"},{"sentence":"The driver had to change the flat tire because he luckily kept a <spare> *tire* in the trunk of his car.","translation":"司機不得不更換爆胎，因為他幸運地在汽車後車廂裡放了一個備用輪胎。","explanation":"形容詞「備用的」。常用搭配 spare tire/key/part。"},{"sentence":"The judge decided to <spare> the *criminal's* life because he felt deep regret for his past mistakes in court.","translation":"法官決定饒過罪犯一命，因為他感受到罪犯在法庭上對過去的錯誤深感懊悔。","explanation":"動詞「饒恕/寬恕」。"}],"related_forms":["sparingly"]}

{"headword":"spark","explanation":"名詞「火花；誘因」；動詞「激發；引發」。常用於抽象概念，如 spark interest (激發興趣) 或 spark a debate (引發爭論)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The friction between the two stones created a small <spark>, which eventually started a fire in the dry grass.","translation":"兩塊石頭之間的摩擦產生了小火花，最終在乾草中引發了大火。","explanation":"名詞「火花」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher's interesting stories about history really <sparked> *an* *interest* in learning for all the students in class.","translation":"老師關於歷史的有趣故事確實激發了班上所有學生的學習興趣。","explanation":"動詞「激發」。搭配 spark an interest in sth 是常見考點。"},{"sentence":"The new government policy has <sparked> *a* *heated* *debate* among citizens regarding how to improve the public transportation system.","translation":"新的政府政策在公民之間引發了關於如何改善大眾運輸系統的熱烈辯論。","explanation":"動詞「引發」。常搭配 debate, controversy, protest 等負面或爭議性名詞。"}],"related_forms":["sparkle","sparkling"]}

{"headword":"spear","explanation":"名詞「矛；槍」；動詞「刺穿」。在文學或歷史場景中常見。亦可指類似矛狀的東西。","entries":[{"sentence":"Ancient warriors used a sharp <spear> to *defend* their tribe from wild animals and other enemies in the forest.","translation":"古代戰士使用尖銳的長矛來保護部落免受森林中野生動物和其他敵人的侵害。","explanation":"名詞「矛」。"},{"sentence":"The chef used a long fork to <spear> a *piece* of meat from the hot pan to check if it was cooked perfectly.","translation":"廚師用長叉子從熱鍋裡刺穿一塊肉，以檢查它是否煮得剛剛好。","explanation":"動詞「刺穿/叉起」。"},{"sentence":"The statue shows a brave hunter holding a <spear> *in* *his* *hand*, ready to face any challenge that comes his way.","translation":"這座雕像展示了一位勇敢的獵人手持長矛，準備迎接任何阻擋他的挑戰。","explanation":"名詞用法。搭配 hold a spear。"}],"related_forms":["spears"]}

{"headword":"species","explanation":"名詞「物種」。注意該字單複數同形，前面若加不定冠詞需用 a species，複數則為 species。常與 endangered (瀕臨絕種的) 一起考。","entries":[{"sentence":"Scientists have discovered a new <species> of *bird* in the remote rainforest that had never been seen before.","translation":"科學家在偏遠的雨林中發現了一種以前從未見過的鳥類物種。","explanation":"名詞「物種」。單數用法 a species of..."},{"sentence":"Due to climate change and habitat loss, many <species> are now *at* *risk* of becoming extinct in the near future.","translation":"由於氣候變遷和棲息地喪失，許多物種現在面臨在不久的將來滅絕的風險。","explanation":"名詞複數用法。此處 species 為複數。"},{"sentence":"Protecting endangered <species> is *crucial* for maintaining the balance of our ecosystem and ensuring a healthy planet for future generations.","translation":"保護瀕危物種對於維持生態系統平衡並確保後代擁有健康的地球至關重要。","explanation":"常見搭配 endangered species (瀕危物種)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"spiritual","explanation":"形容詞「精神上的；心靈的」。與 material (物質的) 相對。常與 health, life, growth 等詞搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many people practice yoga and meditation to find <spiritual> *peace* and improve their overall mental health in this busy life.","translation":"在這忙碌的生活中，許多人透過瑜珈和冥想來尋求心靈平靜並改善整體心理健康。","explanation":"形容詞「精神上的」。搭配 spiritual peace/growth。"},{"sentence":"The temple provides a <spiritual> *home* for those who are looking for comfort and guidance during difficult times.","translation":"這座寺廟為那些在困難時期尋求安慰和指引的人們提供了一個心靈的歸宿。","explanation":"形容詞「心靈的」。"},{"sentence":"Beyond his physical training, the athlete focuses on his <spiritual> *well-being* to stay motivated and calm before every big competition.","translation":"除了體能訓練外，這位運動員還專注於心靈的健康，以便在每場大賽前保持動力和冷靜。","explanation":"形容詞用法。spiritual well-being 指心靈健康。"}],"related_forms":["spirit","spiritually"]}

{"headword":"splendid","explanation":"形容詞「極好的；壯麗的」。常用於形容風景、表現或主意。語氣比 good 強烈。","entries":[{"sentence":"The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely <splendid>, with the sun setting behind the clouds in the distance.","translation":"從山頂看下去的景色簡直壯麗極了，太陽在遠處的雲層後落下。","explanation":"形容詞「壯麗的」。常用於描述風景。"},{"sentence":"It was a <splendid> *idea* to organize a surprise party for Grandma; she looked so happy and moved by our effort.","translation":"為奶奶舉辦驚喜派對真是個好主意；她看起來非常高興，也被我們的努力感動了。","explanation":"形容詞「極好的」。常用於形容想法 (idea) 或表現 (performance)。"},{"sentence":"The dancers gave a <splendid> *performance* at the theater last night, earning a long round of applause from the audience.","translation":"舞者們昨晚在劇院獻上了精彩絕倫的表演，贏得了觀眾長久的掌聲。","explanation":"形容詞「精彩的」。"}],"related_forms":["splendidly"]}
