{"headword":"split","explanation":"(1) 動詞：分裂、分開、平分 (split the bill)；(2) 名詞：裂縫、分歧。注意動詞過去式與過去分詞皆為 split (不加 -ed)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the movie, we decided to <split> *the* *bill* at the restaurant because everyone wanted to pay for their own meal.","translation":"電影結束後，我們決定在餐廳平分帳單，因為每個人都想付自己的餐費。","explanation":"動詞「平分」。固定用法 split the bill。"},{"sentence":"The group <split> *into* two teams to play basketball, as there were too many people for just one game.","translation":"這群人分成兩隊打籃球，因為參加的人太多，一場比賽玩不完。","explanation":"動詞「分裂/分開」。常用句型 split into + 數量。"},{"sentence":"There is a deep <split> *in* *opinion* among the members of the committee regarding the new school rules for next semester.","translation":"委員會成員對於下學期的新校規存在嚴重意見分歧。","explanation":"名詞「分歧」。常用搭配 split in opinion / split between A and B。"}],"related_forms":["splits"]}

{"headword":"sprinkle","explanation":"動詞「撒；灑」；名詞「少量；細雨」。常與 sugar, salt, water 等搭配。形容少量降雨時常用 a sprinkle of rain。","entries":[{"sentence":"The chef likes to <sprinkle> *a* *little* *salt* and pepper over the steak to enhance its natural flavor before serving.","translation":"廚師喜歡在牛排上撒一點鹽和胡椒，在上菜前提升其天然風味。","explanation":"動詞「撒」。常用搭配 sprinkle sth over/on sth。"},{"sentence":"Please <sprinkle> *some* *water* on the flowers every morning to keep them fresh and healthy during the hot summer.","translation":"請每天早上在花上灑一些水，好讓它們在炎熱的夏天保持新鮮健康。","explanation":"動詞「灑」。"},{"sentence":"There was just a light <sprinkle> *of* *rain* this afternoon, so we could still finish our outdoor soccer practice.","translation":"今天下午只有下了一點小雨，所以我們仍然可以完成戶外的足球練習。","explanation":"名詞「少量/細雨」。常用搭配 a sprinkle of rain。"}],"related_forms":["sprinkles"]}

{"headword":"stab","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 動詞「刺傷/戳」；(2) 名詞「嘗試」take a stab at sth (試試看)。注意動詞過去式與過去分詞為 stabbed。","entries":[{"sentence":"The man was <stabbed> *in* the back during the fight, but thankfully, his injuries were not life-threatening.","translation":"那名男子在打鬥中背部被刺傷，但幸運的是，他的傷勢沒有生命危險。","explanation":"動詞「刺傷」。常用搭配 stab sb in the back (暗箭傷人/背叛)。"},{"sentence":"Although I had never played chess before, I decided to *take* a <stab> *at* it when my friend invited me to join.","translation":"雖然我以前從未下過西洋棋，但當朋友邀請我參加時，我決定嘗試看看。","explanation":"名詞用法，片語 take a stab at sth = try / make an attempt。常搭配 take。"},{"sentence":"She felt a sharp <stab> *of* pain *in* her knee while running, so she had to stop her exercise immediately.","translation":"她在跑步時感到膝蓋一陣劇痛，所以不得不立即停止運動。","explanation":"名詞「刺痛感/一陣劇痛」。常用搭配 a stab of pain。"}],"related_forms":["stabbed","stabbing"]}

{"headword":"statistic","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞 (復數)「統計數據」statistics；(2) 名詞 (單數)「統計量/一個數據」statistic。注意統計數據 (statistics) 作學科時動詞用單數，作數據時用複數。","entries":[{"sentence":"According to the latest government <statistics>, more than half of the residents in this city prefer using public transportation.","translation":"根據最新的政府統計數據，這個城市超過一半的居民傾向使用大眾運輸工具。","explanation":"名詞「統計數據」。通常用複數 statistics，後面接複數動詞。"},{"sentence":"The study of <statistics> *is* essential for students who want to conduct scientific research or analyze social trends.","translation":"對於想要進行科學研究或分析社會趨勢的學生來說，統計學這門學科是必不可少的。","explanation":"當 statistics 指「統計學」這門科目時，視為單數名詞，動詞用 is。"},{"sentence":"The report provides a key <statistic> *regarding* the decline in global sales, which surprised the company's board members.","translation":"該報告提供了一個關於全球銷售額下降的關鍵數據，這讓公司董事會成員感到驚訝。","explanation":"名詞 (單數)「統計數值/一個數據」。指單一項數據時可用單數。"}],"related_forms":["statistics","statistical","statistically"]}

{"headword":"status","explanation":"名詞「地位/身分/狀態」。常見錯誤是與 state 混淆。status 多指社會地位或系統的運作狀態。","entries":[{"sentence":"He worked hard for many years to *achieve* a high social <status> *within* the business community.","translation":"他努力工作多年，在商界獲得了崇高的社會地位。","explanation":"名詞「社會地位」。常搭配 high/low status。"},{"sentence":"Please *check* the current <status> *of* your order on our website to see if it has been shipped yet.","translation":"請在我們的網站上查詢您訂單的最新狀態，看看是否已經出貨了。","explanation":"名詞「狀態/進度」。常搭配 check the status of sth。"},{"sentence":"The new law aims to *improve* the legal <status> *of* migrant workers, ensuring they receive fair treatment.","translation":"這項新法律旨在改善移工的法律地位，確保他們獲得公平的對待。","explanation":"名詞「法律地位/身份」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"stem","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「莖/柄」；(2) 動詞「起源於」stem from (固定搭配 from)；(3) 動詞「阻止/遏止」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Most of the problems in our friendship <stem> *from* a lack of communication, so we need to talk more.","translation":"我們友誼中的大部分問題都源於缺乏溝通，所以我們需要多交流。","explanation":"動詞片語 stem from = originate from / be caused by。介係詞固定用 from，不可用 of。"},{"sentence":"The scientist carefully cut the flower <stem> and placed it *in* a glass of water to keep it fresh.","translation":"科學家小心地剪下花莖，並將其放入裝水的玻璃杯中以保持新鮮。","explanation":"名詞「植物的莖」。"},{"sentence":"The government needs to take immediate action to <stem> the spread of the virus throughout the country.","translation":"政府需要採取立即行動來遏止病毒在全國範圍內的傳播。","explanation":"動詞「遏止/阻止」。常用於 stem the tide / stem the flow / stem the spread。"}],"related_forms":["stemmed","stemming"]}

{"headword":"stereo","explanation":"名詞「立體聲/音響系統」。注意這是常見的電子產品名稱。","entries":[{"sentence":"He turned on the <stereo> *at* a high volume, but his parents asked him to turn it down immediately.","translation":"他把音響開得很大聲，但他父母立刻要求他把它關小聲一點。","explanation":"名詞「音響」。常用搭配 turn on/off the stereo。"},{"sentence":"The quality of sound from this new <stereo> *system* is amazing; it makes you feel like you are at a concert.","translation":"這套新立體聲音響系統的音質太棒了；讓你感覺就像在演唱會現場一樣。","explanation":"名詞「立體聲」。常用於形容音質或設備。"},{"sentence":"Listening to music *through* a high-quality <stereo> helps me relax after a long day of studying at school.","translation":"透過高品質的音響聽音樂，有助於我在學校讀書一整天後放鬆心情。","explanation":"名詞「音響」。"}],"related_forms":["stereos"]}

{"headword":"stingy","explanation":"形容詞「吝嗇的/小氣的」。同義詞為 mean, ungenerous。反義詞為 generous。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although he is very wealthy, he is surprisingly <stingy> *with* his money and rarely donates to charity.","translation":"雖然他非常富有，但他對錢卻出奇地吝嗇，很少捐錢給慈善機構。","explanation":"形容詞「小氣的」。常用搭配 stingy with sth。"},{"sentence":"It is not fair to be <stingy> *about* sharing your notes, especially when your classmates have helped you before.","translation":"對於分享你的筆記表現得如此吝嗇是不公平的，特別是當你的同學以前也曾幫助過你時。","explanation":"形容詞「小氣的」。"},{"sentence":"Don't be so <stingy>! A little tip would show that you appreciate the waiter's hard work during the dinner.","translation":"別那麼小氣！給一點小費可以表示你感謝服務生在晚餐期間的辛勤工作。","explanation":"形容詞「小氣的」。"}],"related_forms":["stingily"]}

{"headword":"stocking","explanation":"名詞「長襪」。注意 Christmas stocking 是西方文化常見用法，指聖誕襪。","entries":[{"sentence":"The children hung their Christmas <stockings> *by* the fireplace, hoping that Santa would fill them with gifts.","translation":"孩子們把聖誕襪掛在壁爐旁，希望聖誕老人能把它們裝滿禮物。","explanation":"名詞「長襪」。常用搭配 Christmas stocking。"},{"sentence":"She bought a new pair of silk <stockings> to wear *with* her formal dress for the school graduation party.","translation":"她買了一雙新絲襪，要在學校畢業舞會上搭配她的禮服穿。","explanation":"名詞「長襪」。"},{"sentence":"Make sure to check your <stockings> *for* any holes before wearing them, or they might tear during the day.","translation":"穿之前務必檢查你的長襪是否有破洞，否則它們可能會在白天穿著時破掉。","explanation":"名詞「長襪」。"}],"related_forms":["stockings"]}

{"headword":"strengthen","explanation":"動詞「加強/鞏固」。由名詞 strength 變化而來。常用於關係、肌肉、經濟等。","entries":[{"sentence":"Regular exercise can help <strengthen> your *muscles* and improve your overall health in the long run.","translation":"規律的運動可以幫助你增強肌肉，並從長遠來看改善你的整體健康。","explanation":"動詞「增強」。常用搭配 strengthen muscles/bones。"},{"sentence":"The government is trying to <strengthen> *ties* *with* neighboring countries to promote regional trade and peace.","translation":"政府正試圖加強與鄰國的關係，以促進區域貿易與和平。","explanation":"動詞「加強」。常用搭配 strengthen ties/relationships with..."},{"sentence":"Taking extra English classes will <strengthen> your *ability* to communicate with people from different cultures.","translation":"參加額外的英語課程將增強你與來自不同文化背景的人溝通的能力。","explanation":"動詞「增強/強化」。"}],"related_forms":["strength","strong"]}

{"headword":"stripe","explanation":"名詞「條紋」。常見形容詞為 striped。","entries":[{"sentence":"The zebra is famous for the black and white <stripes> *on* its body, which make it look unique in the wild.","translation":"斑馬以牠身上黑白相間的條紋聞名，這讓牠在野外看起來很獨特。","explanation":"名詞「條紋」。常用搭配 black and white stripes。"},{"sentence":"He wore a shirt with blue and white <stripes> to the interview, hoping to look professional and clean.","translation":"他穿了一件有藍白條紋的襯衫去面試，希望能看起來專業且乾淨。","explanation":"名詞「條紋」。"},{"sentence":"Can you see the tiger hiding *in* the tall grass? Its <stripes> help it blend *into* the environment perfectly.","translation":"你看到躲在長草叢裡的老虎了嗎？牠的條紋幫助牠完美地融入環境中。","explanation":"名詞「條紋」。"}],"related_forms":["stripes","striped"]}

{"headword":"strive","explanation":"動詞「努力/奮鬥」。語氣較正式，強調持續性的努力。過去式 strove 或 strived，過去分詞 striven 或 strived。","entries":[{"sentence":"We should <strive> *for* excellence *in* our studies rather than just focusing on getting high scores.","translation":"我們應該在學業上追求卓越，而不僅僅是專注於拿到高分。","explanation":"動詞「努力追求」。常用搭配 strive for sth (追求某物)。"},{"sentence":"The organization <strives> *to* provide equal opportunities *for* all students, regardless of their background.","translation":"該組織致力於為所有學生提供平等的機會，無論他們的背景為何。","explanation":"動詞「致力於/努力做某事」。常用搭配 strive to V。"},{"sentence":"Even when faced with difficult challenges, she never gave up and continued to <strive> *towards* her dream.","translation":"即使面臨困難的挑戰，她也從未放棄，繼續朝著她的夢想奮鬥。","explanation":"動詞「努力/奮鬥」。常用搭配 strive towards sth。"}],"related_forms":["strove","striven"]}

{"headword":"stroke","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「中風」have a stroke；(2) 動詞「撫摸」stroke sth/sb gently；(3) 名詞「一筆、一下」a brush stroke / a stroke of luck。注意中風是 health issue，常考片語 suffer a stroke。","entries":[{"sentence":"The elderly man sadly suffered a severe <stroke> last month, which left him unable to move his left arm or leg properly.","translation":"這位長者上個月不幸中風，導致他的左臂或左腿無法正常活動。","explanation":"名詞「中風」。Suffer a stroke 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"She *gently* <stroked> the cat's soft fur while reading a book, enjoying the quiet moment of relaxation after a busy school day.","translation":"她在讀書時輕輕撫摸貓柔軟的毛，享受忙碌校園生活後難得的放鬆時刻。","explanation":"動詞「撫摸」。副詞 gently 是常搭配。"},{"sentence":"With a *single* <stroke> of his pen, the artist created a beautiful line that completed the drawing perfectly.","translation":"畫家只用了一筆，就畫出了一條完美的線，讓這幅畫大功告成。","explanation":"名詞「一筆」。常用於藝術或書寫情境。"},{"sentence":"It was just a *stroke* *of* luck that he found his lost wallet on the bus; otherwise, he would have missed his flight.","translation":"他能在公車上找回遺失的錢包純屬運氣好；否則他就會錯過航班了。","explanation":"片語 a stroke of luck 表「運氣好」。"}],"related_forms":["strokes","stroking","stroked"]}

{"headword":"submarine","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 名詞「潛水艇」the submarine; (2) 形容詞「海底的」submarine cables。GSAT多見於科技與軍事閱讀題。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <submarine> silently dived deep into the ocean to avoid being detected by enemy ships during the naval exercise.","translation":"那艘潛水艇在海軍演習中悄悄潛入深海，以避免被敵艦發現。","explanation":"名詞「潛水艇」。"},{"sentence":"Modern global communication relies heavily *on* <submarine> cables laid across the ocean floor to transmit data between continents.","translation":"現代全球通訊極度依賴鋪設在海底的海底電纜，以傳輸各大洲之間的資料。","explanation":"形容詞「海底的」。常與 cable 搭配。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are using a specialized <submarine> to explore the deep-sea environment and study creatures that live in total darkness.","translation":"科學家正使用專門的潛水艇探索深海環境，研究生活在完全黑暗中的生物。","explanation":"名詞「潛水艇」。"}],"related_forms":["submarines"]}

{"headword":"sue","explanation":"動詞「控告、起訴」。用法：sue sb for sth。注意不要與 accuse (指責) 混淆，sue 強調法律行動。","entries":[{"sentence":"The customer decided to <sue> the company *for* selling a defective product that caused damage to his home kitchen.","translation":"那位顧客決定控告這家公司，因為他們賣出的瑕疵產品損壞了他的家庭廚房。","explanation":"動詞用法：sue someone for something。"},{"sentence":"After the car accident, the victim was *advised* *to* <sue> the driver for the high medical expenses incurred during his recovery.","translation":"車禍後，受害者被建議控告該駕駛，以索賠復健期間產生的高額醫療費用。","explanation":"法律情境的常見動詞。"},{"sentence":"If the landlord fails to return the deposit, the tenant has the right to <sue> him *in* court to get the money back.","translation":"如果房東不退還押金，房客有權上法院控告他以索回錢款。","explanation":"sue in court 是法律程序用語。"}],"related_forms":["sues","sued","suing"]}

{"headword":"suggestion","explanation":"名詞「建議」。(1) make a suggestion; (2) 句型建議：the suggestion that S + (should) + V。注意不可說 suggest to sb to V。","entries":[{"sentence":"Thanks for your helpful <suggestion>; I will definitely consider changing the topic of my final research project to make it more interesting.","translation":"謝謝你提供的實用建議；我一定會考慮更改最終研究報告的主題，讓它更有趣。","explanation":"常用搭配 helpful suggestion。"},{"sentence":"The teacher made a *constructive* <suggestion> *that* all students should participate in the school clean-up day to improve the campus environment.","translation":"老師提出了一個建設性的建議，即所有學生都應該參加學校清潔日，以改善校園環境。","explanation":"後接 that 子句，動詞需用原形 (should 可省略)。"},{"sentence":"Do you have any <suggestions> *for* a good place to visit during our upcoming spring break? I am looking for something quiet.","translation":"你對於我們即將到來的春假有什麼旅遊景點的建議嗎？我正在尋找安靜的地方。","explanation":"名詞複數與介係詞 for 的搭配。"}],"related_forms":["suggestions","suggest"]}

{"headword":"summarize","explanation":"動詞「總結、摘要」。常用於寫作與閱讀測驗。注意拼字：-ize (美式) 或 -ise (英式)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The speaker <summarized> the main points of the lecture *at* the end to help students remember the most important information.","translation":"演講者在最後總結了講座的要點，以幫助學生記住最重要的資訊。","explanation":"常用搭配 summarize the main points。"},{"sentence":"It is difficult to <summarize> such a long and complex novel *in* just a few sentences, but I will try my best.","translation":"要用幾句話總結這本既長又複雜的小說很難，但我會盡力而為。","explanation":"summarize... in... (用...來總結)。"},{"sentence":"Please read the article and <summarize> the author's argument *in* your own words for tomorrow's class discussion.","translation":"請閱讀這篇文章，並用你自己的話總結作者的論點，以備明天的課堂討論使用。","explanation":"in your own words 是常見寫作搭配。"}],"related_forms":["summarizes","summarized","summary"]}

{"headword":"surgeon","explanation":"名詞「外科醫生」。注意與 physician (內科醫生) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The famous <surgeon> performed a successful operation on the patient, which lasted for more than ten hours yesterday.","translation":"那位著名的外科醫生昨天為病人進行了一場成功的手術，手術持續了十多個小時。","explanation":"surgeon 搭配動詞 perform an operation/surgery。"},{"sentence":"She dreams of becoming a skilled <surgeon> because she wants to save lives and help people recover from serious injuries.","translation":"她夢想成為一名熟練的外科醫生，因為她想拯救生命並幫助人們從嚴重傷害中康復。","explanation":"形容詞 skilled 常與職業搭配。"},{"sentence":"The hospital needs more experienced <surgeons> to handle the increasing number of emergency cases in the trauma center.","translation":"醫院需要更多經驗豐富的外科醫生來處理創傷中心日益增加的緊急病例。","explanation":"名詞複數用法。"}],"related_forms":["surgeons"]}

{"headword":"surgery","explanation":"名詞「外科手術」。(1) have/undergo surgery; (2) perform surgery。注意不可數名詞，不可說 a surgery。","entries":[{"sentence":"The old man had to *undergo* <surgery> to repair his broken hip after the fall at home last week.","translation":"那位老人上週在家跌倒後，必須接受手術來修復骨折的髖部。","explanation":"undergo surgery 是比 have surgery 更正式的用法。"},{"sentence":"The doctor said that the <surgery> was a total success, and the patient will be able to leave the hospital soon.","translation":"醫生說手術非常成功，病人很快就可以出院了。","explanation":"名詞用法。注意 surgery 不可數，不用 a/an。"},{"sentence":"Modern technology has *made* <surgery> much safer and less painful than it was several decades ago.","translation":"現代科技讓外科手術比幾十年前安全得多，痛苦也減少了許多。","explanation":"make + O + adj. 的句型。"}],"related_forms":["surgeries"]}

{"headword":"surrender","explanation":"動詞/名詞「投降、放棄」。(1) surrender to sb/sth; (2) surrender one's rights/power。強調無力抵抗後的妥協。","entries":[{"sentence":"The soldiers had no choice but to <surrender> *to* the enemy after running out of food and ammunition.","translation":"在糧食和彈藥耗盡後，士兵們別無選擇，只能向敵人投降。","explanation":"動詞用法，搭配介係詞 to。"},{"sentence":"He finally decided to <surrender> his seat on the bus to an elderly woman who looked very tired.","translation":"他最後決定將公車上的座位讓給一位看起來很累的老婦人。","explanation":"surrender sth to sb (讓出某物給某人)。"},{"sentence":"After hours of negotiation, the criminal *gave* *in* and decided to <surrender> *to* the police without any further resistance.","translation":"經過數小時的談判，罪犯屈服了，並決定不再抵抗，向警方投降。","explanation":"surrender to police 是常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["surrenders","surrendered"]}

{"headword":"surroundings","explanation":"名詞「環境」。通常用複數形。指人或物所在的周遭環境 (physical environment)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The luxury hotel is famous for its *beautiful* <surroundings>, including a large garden and a view of the mountains.","translation":"這家豪華飯店以其美麗的環境而聞名，包括一座大花園和山景。","explanation":"surroundings 通常指物理環境，常搭配 beautiful, quiet, peaceful 等形容詞。"},{"sentence":"New students often feel nervous because they are not yet *familiar* *with* their new <surroundings> at the university.","translation":"新生通常會感到緊張，因為他們還不熟悉大學裡的新環境。","explanation":"be familiar with + surroundings (對環境熟悉)。"},{"sentence":"The cat needs a few days to *explore* its new <surroundings> before it feels comfortable enough to play and run around.","translation":"這隻貓需要幾天時間探索新環境，然後才感到自在，開始四處跑跳。","explanation":"explore + surroundings 是常見搭配。"}],"related_forms":["surround","surrounding"]}

{"headword":"suspicious","explanation":"形容詞「可疑的、懷疑的」。(1) be suspicious of sb (對某人存疑)；(2) look/act suspicious (看起來/行為可疑)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police officer became <suspicious> *of* the man who was walking around the bank building late at night.","translation":"那位警察對深夜在銀行大樓附近徘徊的男子產生了懷疑。","explanation":"be suspicious of (對...感到懷疑)。"},{"sentence":"Neighbors called the police because they noticed some <suspicious> activity *around* the empty house next door.","translation":"鄰居報了警，因為他們注意到隔壁空屋周圍有一些可疑的活動。","explanation":"suspicious activity (可疑活動) 是常見搭配。"},{"sentence":"She *looked* <suspicious> when I asked her about the broken vase, so I knew she was hiding something from me.","translation":"當我問她關於花瓶打破的事時，她看起來很可疑，所以我知道她在對我隱瞞什麼。","explanation":"look suspicious (看起來很可疑)。"}],"related_forms":["suspicion","suspiciously"]}

{"headword":"sway","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 動詞「搖擺/晃動」，指緩慢的左右移動；(2) 動詞「影響/說服」，指改變某人的意見；(3) 名詞「影響力/統治」，常與 hold 搭配。注意 sway 既可指實體擺動，也可指抽象的心理動搖。","entries":[{"sentence":"The tall trees <swayed> *gently in* the summer breeze, creating a peaceful atmosphere in the quiet, green park.","translation":"高大的樹木在夏日的微風中輕輕搖擺，在寧靜的綠色公園裡營造出一種平和的氛圍。","explanation":"動詞「搖擺」。常用於描寫自然景象，搭配副詞 gently, slowly 或介係詞 in。"},{"sentence":"The politician's emotional speech successfully <swayed> many *undecided voters* to support his campaign for the upcoming election.","translation":"這位政治人物感性的演講成功地說服了許多未決定的選民，支持他即將到來的選舉活動。","explanation":"動詞「影響/說服」。sway sb to V 表示影響某人做某事。常與 opinion, voter, decision 等詞連用。"},{"sentence":"Don't let your personal feelings <sway> your *judgment* when you evaluate the project proposals from your colleagues.","translation":"當你評估同事的專案提案時，不要讓你的個人情感影響你的判斷。","explanation":"動詞「影響」。常用於否定句，表示不被情緒或偏見所左右，搭配 judgment, decision 等詞。"},{"sentence":"For centuries, the region remained *under* the <sway> *of* a powerful king who controlled all the local trade routes.","translation":"幾個世紀以來，該地區一直處於一位控制所有當地貿易路線的強大國王的統治之下。","explanation":"名詞「影響力/統治」。固定搭配：under the sway of...。指受某人或某勢力的強大影響或控制。"}],"related_forms":["swayed","swaying"]}

{"headword":"syllable","explanation":"用法：(1) 名詞「音節」。GSAT 常考單字拼寫或字根變化，理解音節有助於背誦長單字；(2) 常見搭配如 stress/accent a syllable (重音)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The word \"education\" has four <syllables>, and the *primary stress* falls on the third one when we pronounce it.","translation":"「教育」這個字有四個音節，我們發音時，主要重音落在第三個音節上。","explanation":"名詞「音節」。解釋單字發音規則時常用。搭配 stress (重音) 或 pronounce (發音)。"},{"sentence":"He was so angry that he could not utter a single <syllable> to express his frustration about the unfair treatment.","translation":"他非常生氣，以至於無法說出一個字來表達他對這種不公平對待的挫折感。","explanation":"名詞「音節」。常用於否定句 (not a single syllable)，強調「連一個字也說不出」。"},{"sentence":"If you break down long words into smaller <syllables>, it becomes much easier to *memorize* their spelling and correct pronunciation.","translation":"如果你把長單字拆解成較小的音節，記憶它們的拼寫和正確發音會變得容易得多。","explanation":"名詞「音節」。學習策略情境，強調拆解單字以利記憶。"}],"related_forms":["syllabic"]}

{"headword":"sympathetic","explanation":"用法：(1) 形容詞「有同情心的/表示同情的」，對別人的不幸感到難過；(2) 形容詞「贊同的」，對某個計畫或想法表示支持。常與 to/toward 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"My teacher was very <sympathetic> *to* my situation and allowed me to submit my report a few days late.","translation":"我的老師對我的情況非常體諒，並允許我晚幾天繳交報告。","explanation":"形容詞「體諒的/有同情心的」。搭配介係詞 to，表示對某人的處境感同身受並給予支持。"},{"sentence":"The audience gave a <sympathetic> *nod* as the speaker shared his personal struggles with overcoming a severe illness.","translation":"當演講者分享他克服嚴重疾病的個人掙扎時，聽眾給予了同情的點頭。","explanation":"形容詞「表示同情的」。常用於描寫表情或反應，如 sympathetic nod, look, smile。"},{"sentence":"Most of the board members were <sympathetic> *to* the *proposal* and agreed to provide more funding for the new project.","translation":"大多數董事會成員對該提案表示贊同，並同意為新專案提供更多資金。","explanation":"形容詞「贊同的/支持的」。表示對某個想法、計畫持正面態度，非單指同情。"}],"related_forms":["sympathetically"]}

{"headword":"sympathy","explanation":"用法：(1) 名詞「同情/憐憫」，對他人的遭遇感到難過；(2) 名詞「支持/贊同」。注意與 empathy (同理心) 的區別：sympathy 是覺得對方可憐，empathy 是能感同身受。","entries":[{"sentence":"I would like to *express* my deep <sympathy> *for* the victims and their families after the terrible earthquake last night.","translation":"在昨晚那場可怕的地震之後，我想向受害者及其家屬表達我深切的同情。","explanation":"名詞「同情」。固定搭配：express/offer sympathy for sb。這是寫作中表達慰問的標準用語。"},{"sentence":"He has little <sympathy> *for* people who complain about their problems but refuse to take any action to solve them.","translation":"他對那些抱怨自己的問題卻拒絕採取任何行動去解決的人，幾乎沒有什麼同情心。","explanation":"名詞「同情」。常用句型 have sympathy for sb。強調「同情心」或「認同感」。"},{"sentence":"The political party gained a lot of public <sympathy> because of its focus on *helping* the poor and elderly citizens.","translation":"該政黨因為專注於幫助貧困和年長的公民，而獲得了許多大眾的支持。","explanation":"名詞「支持/認同」。在社會議題中，指公眾對於某個立場的心理支持或共鳴。"}],"related_forms":["sympathize"]}

{"headword":"systematic","explanation":"用法：形容詞「有系統的/有條理的」。指做事方法周密、講求步驟。常與 approach, way, method 搭配。","entries":[{"sentence":"The team adopted a <systematic> *approach* to *organizing* the data, which saved them a lot of time during the final report.","translation":"團隊採取了一種有系統的方法來整理數據，這在最終報告時為他們節省了許多時間。","explanation":"形容詞「有系統的」。搭配 approach 或 method，強調工作效率與邏輯性。"},{"sentence":"Learning a new language requires a <systematic> *study* of grammar rules and constant practice to improve your speaking skills.","translation":"學習一門新語言需要對文法規則進行有系統的學習，並不斷練習以提高你的口語能力。","explanation":"形容詞「有系統的」。修飾 study 或 training，強調按部就班的過程。"},{"sentence":"The company conducted a <systematic> *review* of its safety procedures to ensure that all workers are protected from harm.","translation":"該公司對其安全程序進行了有系統的審查，以確保所有員工都免受傷害。","explanation":"形容詞「有系統的/全面的」。強調審查或檢查的徹底性與規律性。"}],"related_forms":["systematically","system"]}

{"headword":"technician","explanation":"用法：名詞「技術人員/技師」。指在特定領域（如電腦、電器、醫療）有專業技術的人。","entries":[{"sentence":"If your computer is not working properly, you should call a qualified <technician> to *inspect* the hardware and software problems.","translation":"如果你的電腦運作不正常，你應該打電話請合格的技術人員來檢查硬體和軟體問題。","explanation":"名詞「技術人員」。常用於維修情境，搭配 qualified (合格的) 或 skilled (熟練的)。"},{"sentence":"The laboratory <technician> carefully *tested* the blood samples to ensure the accuracy of the medical report for the doctor.","translation":"實驗室技術員小心地測試了血液樣本，以確保給醫生的醫療報告準確無誤。","explanation":"名詞「技術員」。常指實驗室或醫療場所中負責操作儀器的人員。"},{"sentence":"The senior <technician> provided *technical support* to the engineering students who were building a robot for the competition.","translation":"資深技術員為正在製造比賽用機器人的工程系學生提供了技術支援。","explanation":"名詞「技術人員」。常與 technical support (技術支援) 搭配出現。"}],"related_forms":["technical","technology"]}

{"headword":"technological","explanation":"用法：形容詞「科技的/技術的」。用來修飾與科技發展相關的名詞，如 advancement, change, development。","entries":[{"sentence":"Rapid <technological> *advancement* has changed the way we communicate, work, and access information in our daily lives.","translation":"科技的快速進步已經改變了我們在日常生活中交流、工作和獲取資訊的方式。","explanation":"形容詞「科技的」。常與 advancement (進步) 或 change (變革) 搭配，是科技主題作文的高頻詞。"},{"sentence":"Despite many <technological> *innovations* in the medical field, some diseases still remain difficult to cure or prevent effectively.","translation":"儘管醫療領域有許多科技創新，但有些疾病仍然難以治癒或有效預防。","explanation":"形容詞「科技的」。修飾 innovation (創新)，強調科技帶來的進展與局限。"},{"sentence":"The government is investing heavily in <technological> *research* to maintain its competitive edge in the global market.","translation":"政府正大力投資於科技研究，以維持其在全球市場的競爭優勢。","explanation":"形容詞「科技的」。修飾 research (研究)，強調國家級或企業級的研發投資。"}],"related_forms":["technology","technically"]}

{"headword":"telegraph","explanation":"用法：(1) 名詞「電報」；(2) 動詞「發電報/打信號」。現在多指歷史性技術或隱喻「洩漏/暗示」。注意：GSAT考題中較少見，但與通訊歷史相關時會出現。","entries":[{"sentence":"Before the invention of the telephone, people used the <telegraph> to *send* urgent *messages* across long distances quickly.","translation":"在電話發明之前，人們使用電報來快速發送緊急訊息到遠距離的地方。","explanation":"名詞「電報」。描述通訊技術演變的歷史背景。"},{"sentence":"The boxer's *repeated* movements <telegraphed> his *intentions* to his opponent, who easily dodged the next punch.","translation":"這位拳擊手重複的動作向對手洩漏了他的企圖，對手輕鬆地躲過了下一拳。","explanation":"動詞「洩漏/預示」。引申用法，指透過肢體語言或行為無意間透露接下來的行動。"},{"sentence":"In the nineteenth century, the <telegraph> *system* revolutionized communication by connecting cities around the world.","translation":"十九世紀時，電報系統透過連接世界各地的城市，徹底改變了通訊方式。","explanation":"名詞「電報」。強調其對通訊史的貢獻。"}],"related_forms":["telegraphic"]}

{"headword":"telescope","explanation":"用法：名詞「望遠鏡」。常與 observe, gaze, look through 搭配。用於天文學或觀察遠處事物的情境。","entries":[{"sentence":"With a powerful <telescope>, students were able to *observe* the craters on the moon and the rings around Saturn.","translation":"透過強大的望遠鏡，學生們能夠觀察到月球上的坑洞以及土星周圍的環。","explanation":"名詞「望遠鏡」。常與 observe (觀察) 搭配。描述科學實驗或天文觀測。"},{"sentence":"The astronomer spent many nights *looking* *through* his <telescope>, hoping to discover a new star in the distant galaxy.","translation":"這位天文學家花了很多個夜晚透過望遠鏡觀察，希望能在遙遠的銀河系中發現一顆新恆星。","explanation":"名詞「望遠鏡」。搭配動詞片語 look through，描述天文探究過程。"},{"sentence":"We set up a <telescope> on the roof to get a better *view* of the night sky, which was full of bright stars.","translation":"我們在屋頂架設了一台望遠鏡，以便更清楚地看到佈滿明亮星星的夜空。","explanation":"名詞「望遠鏡」。描述戶外活動或休閒觀察。"}],"related_forms":["telescopic"]}

{"headword":"tendency","explanation":"用法：名詞「傾向」。指某人或某事的慣性行為。常與 have a tendency to V 搭配，是寫作與閱讀的高頻字。","entries":[{"sentence":"Some students have a <tendency> *to* *procrastinate* when they are faced with difficult assignments or long-term projects.","translation":"有些學生在面對困難的作業或長期專案時，有拖延的傾向。","explanation":"名詞「傾向」。常用句型 have a tendency to V。procrastinate (拖延) 是常見的搭配詞。"},{"sentence":"The weather in this region shows a strong <tendency> *toward* rain during the summer months, so remember to carry an umbrella.","translation":"該地區的天氣在夏季幾個月裡有強烈的降雨傾向，所以記得隨身攜帶雨傘。","explanation":"名詞「傾向」。搭配介係詞 toward，表示某種現象發生的可能性高。"},{"sentence":"There is a growing <tendency> *among* young people *to* use social media as their primary source of daily news.","translation":"年輕人中有一種日益增長的傾向，即使用社群媒體作為他們每日新聞的主要來源。","explanation":"名詞「傾向」。描述社會現象，常用於開頭句以引出討論話題。"}],"related_forms":["tend"]}

{"headword":"tense","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 形容詞「緊張的」，描述人的情緒或氣氛；(2) 動詞「使肌肉緊繃」；(3) 名詞「時態」（文法）。注意形容詞與動詞的用法區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The atmosphere in the classroom became very <tense> before the teacher announced the final exam results to the students.","translation":"在老師向學生宣布期末考成績之前，教室裡的氣氛變得非常緊張。","explanation":"形容詞用法，描述一種讓人感到壓力或焦慮的氛圍。搭配動詞 become 或 feel。"},{"sentence":"I felt <tense> about the upcoming interview, so I took a deep breath to calm my nerves.","translation":"我對即將到來的面試感到緊張，所以我深呼吸來平復情緒。","explanation":"形容詞用法，描述人的內心狀態。常見搭配：feel tense about sth."},{"sentence":"Please try to relax your shoulders and avoid <tensing> your muscles while you are practicing the piano.","translation":"練習鋼琴時，請試著放鬆肩膀，避免讓肌肉緊繃。","explanation":"動詞用法，指身體部位變得僵硬或緊繃。常與肌肉 (muscles) 搭配。"},{"sentence":"In English grammar, students need to learn how to use the correct <tense>, such as the past or future, to describe events.","translation":"在英語語法中，學生需要學習如何使用正確的時態，例如過去式或未來式，來描述事件。","explanation":"名詞用法，指文法上的「時態」。"}],"related_forms":["tensed","tensing","tenses"]}

{"headword":"tension","explanation":"名詞「緊張局勢/張力」。與形容詞 tense 不同，tension 通常指人與人之間的關係緊繃，或是物理上的張力。","entries":[{"sentence":"There is a lot of *political* <tension> between the two countries, which makes people worry about a possible war.","translation":"兩國之間存在著巨大的政治緊張局勢，這讓人們擔心可能發生戰爭。","explanation":"名詞用法，描述國家或群體間的對立。常用形容詞 political, social, international 修飾。"},{"sentence":"The *growing* <tension> between the two brothers led to a big argument during the family dinner last night.","translation":"兩兄弟之間日益增長的緊張關係導致昨晚家庭晚餐時發生了激烈的爭吵。","explanation":"描述人際關係的緊張。常用搭配：growing/rising tension。"},{"sentence":"Yoga is a great way to *release* <tension> in your body after sitting at a desk all day at school.","translation":"瑜珈是在學校整天坐在書桌前之後，釋放身體緊張感的好方法。","explanation":"描述身體或心理的緊繃感。搭配動詞 release 或 ease。"}],"related_forms":["tensions"]}

{"headword":"terror","explanation":"名詞「恐怖/恐懼」。指極度的恐懼，或者恐怖主義活動。常考片語 strike terror into sb. (使某人感到極度恐懼)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little boy *looked at* the big dog *in* <terror> because he was afraid of being bitten by it.","translation":"小男孩驚恐地看著那隻大狗，因為他害怕被牠咬。","explanation":"名詞用法，指極度的恐懼。片語 in terror 表示「驚恐地」。"},{"sentence":"The news of the explosion *struck* <terror> *into* the hearts of the local residents living in the small town.","translation":"爆炸的消息讓住在這個小鎮的當地居民心中充滿了恐懼。","explanation":"固定搭配：strike terror into the hearts of sb.，表示「使人感到極度恐懼」。"},{"sentence":"The government is working hard to fight against *international* <terror> to keep the citizens safe from any harm.","translation":"政府正努力打擊國際恐怖主義，以保護公民免受任何傷害。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「恐怖活動」或「恐怖主義」。"}],"related_forms":["terrible","terrify","terrified","terrifying"]}

{"headword":"theme","explanation":"名詞「主題/主旨」。廣泛用於文學、電影、派對或網站設計中。注意區分 topic (話題) 與 theme (核心主題)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The main <theme> of this novel is the *importance of* friendship and how it helps people overcome difficult times.","translation":"這部小說的主題是友誼的重要性，以及友誼如何幫助人們克服困難時期。","explanation":"名詞用法，指文學作品的核心思想。常與 main, central 搭配。"},{"sentence":"The students decided to *choose* a *space* <theme> for the school dance to make it look unique and fun.","translation":"學生們決定為學校舞會選擇太空主題，讓它看起來獨特又有趣。","explanation":"名詞用法，用於活動的主題設計。搭配動詞 choose 或 have。"},{"sentence":"In the final essay, you should *explore* the *recurring* <theme> of nature in the poet's early works.","translation":"在期末報告中，你應該探討這位詩人早期作品中不斷出現的自然主題。","explanation":"recurring theme 指「一再出現的主題」。"}],"related_forms":["themes","thematic"]}

{"headword":"thorough","explanation":"形容詞「徹底的/仔細的」。強調做事情沒有遺漏。注意拼寫，容易與 through (穿過) 混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor gave the patient a <thorough> *examination* to make sure there were no hidden health problems.","translation":"醫生對病人進行了徹底的檢查，以確保沒有隱藏的健康問題。","explanation":"thorough examination 指「詳細的檢查」。"},{"sentence":"Before you submit your research project, please *make* a <thorough> *check* for any spelling or grammar mistakes.","translation":"在繳交研究報告之前，請徹底檢查是否有任何拼字或文法錯誤。","explanation":"thorough check 指「仔細檢查」。"},{"sentence":"The police conducted a <thorough> *investigation* *into* the cause of the fire to find out who was responsible.","translation":"警方對火災原因進行了徹底的調查，以找出是誰該負責。","explanation":"thorough investigation 是常見搭配，意指「詳盡的調查」。"}],"related_forms":["thoroughly"]}

{"headword":"thoughtful","explanation":"形容詞「體貼的/沉思的」。(1) 體貼、為人著想；(2) 深思熟慮的。注意與 thoughtless (不體貼的/輕率的) 做對比。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was very <thoughtful> *of* you to bring me some hot soup when I was feeling sick at home.","translation":"當我在家生病時，你帶熱湯給我，真是太體貼了。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指「體貼的」。句型：It is thoughtful of sb. to do sth."},{"sentence":"He gave a <thoughtful> *reply* to my question after taking some time to consider all the facts carefully.","translation":"他在花了一些時間仔細考慮所有事實後，對我的問題給出了深思熟慮的回答。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指「經過深思熟慮的」。"},{"sentence":"The teacher *made* a <thoughtful> *suggestion* that helped the student improve his study habits and grades.","translation":"老師提出了一個深思熟慮的建議，幫助學生改善了他的讀書習慣和成績。","explanation":"thoughtful suggestion 指「考慮周詳的建議」。"}],"related_forms":["thoughtfully","thoughtfulness"]}

{"headword":"tickle","explanation":"動詞/名詞「搔癢」。除了實質的搔癢，也可以指「引起興趣」。注意動詞變化 tickled。","entries":[{"sentence":"The baby laughed loudly when his father started to <tickle> his feet during playtime.","translation":"當爸爸在遊戲時間開始搔他的腳時，寶寶開心地大笑起來。","explanation":"動詞用法，指物理上的搔癢。"},{"sentence":"The long feather <tickled> my nose, so I could not help but sneeze several times.","translation":"長羽毛搔到了我的鼻子，所以我忍不住打了好幾個噴嚏。","explanation":"動詞用法，指輕微的觸摸引起癢感。"},{"sentence":"The funny story really *tickled* my *funny bone*, and I couldn't stop laughing for a while.","translation":"那個有趣的故事真的逗樂了我，我有一陣子笑個不停。","explanation":"片語 tickle one's funny bone 指「逗某人發笑」。"}],"related_forms":["tickled","tickling"]}

{"headword":"timetable","explanation":"名詞「時間表」。英式用法，美式通常用 schedule。注意搭配動詞 check 或 follow。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please *check* the <timetable> carefully to see when the next bus to the city center arrives.","translation":"請仔細查看時間表，看看下一班往市中心的公車什麼時候到。","explanation":"名詞用法，指公車、火車等時刻表。搭配動詞 check。"},{"sentence":"Our teacher gave us a *new* <timetable> for the final exam week so that we know which subject to study.","translation":"老師給了我們一張期末考週的新時間表，這樣我們就知道該讀哪一科了。","explanation":"名詞用法，指學校考試或課表。"},{"sentence":"It is difficult to *follow* the <timetable> when there are so many unexpected interruptions during the day.","translation":"當一天中有這麼多意想不到的中斷時，很難按照時間表進行。","explanation":"搭配動詞 follow，意指「遵守/依照時間表」。"}],"related_forms":["timetables"]}

{"headword":"timid","explanation":"形容詞「膽小的/羞怯的」。指缺乏自信或容易害怕。近義詞 shy, cowardly。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <timid> *student* felt too shy to raise her hand and answer the questions in front of the whole class.","translation":"那個膽小的學生太害羞了，不敢在全班面前舉手回答問題。","explanation":"形容詞用法，描述個性膽小、害羞。"},{"sentence":"Even though he is a <timid> person, he decided to face his fear and give a speech on stage.","translation":"儘管他是個膽小的人，他還是決定面對恐懼並在台上發表演講。","explanation":"描述人性格內向、不敢嘗試。"},{"sentence":"The little cat was very <timid> and hid under the sofa whenever strangers entered the house.","translation":"那隻小貓非常膽小，每當陌生人進屋時，牠就會躲在沙發底下。","explanation":"形容動物也可用 timid，表示怕生。"}],"related_forms":["timidity"]}

{"headword":"tolerable","explanation":"形容詞「可忍受的」。指狀況還可以接受，雖然不完美。通常帶有「勉強可以」的語氣。","entries":[{"sentence":"The noise from the construction site is <tolerable> during the day, but it is annoying at night.","translation":"工地的噪音在白天還算可以忍受，但在晚上就很煩人。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指狀況在可接受範圍內。"},{"sentence":"Although the food was not delicious, it was <tolerable> enough for us to finish the meal.","translation":"雖然食物不好吃，但還勉強可以接受，讓我們把餐點吃完了。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示勉強可以接受。"},{"sentence":"The hot weather today is barely <tolerable>, so we should stay indoors and use the air conditioner.","translation":"今天的天氣熱到幾乎無法忍受，所以我們應該待在室內並使用冷氣。","explanation":"常用搭配 barely/hardly tolerable (幾乎無法忍受)。"}],"related_forms":["tolerate","tolerance","tolerant"]}

{"headword":"tolerance","explanation":"名詞「容忍/忍受力」。常指對不同意見、信仰或行為的接受程度。常見搭配：show/have tolerance for sth。注意與 tolerant (形容詞) 的詞性區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school promotes <tolerance> *for* different cultures, encouraging students to respect the diverse backgrounds of their classmates.","translation":"學校提倡對不同文化的包容，鼓勵學生尊重同學多樣的背景。","explanation":"名詞用法，搭配介係詞 for，指對某事物的寬容。"},{"sentence":"He has a high <tolerance> *for* spicy food, so he can eat dishes that many other people find too hot to handle.","translation":"他對辣食的耐受度很高，所以他能吃許多其他人覺得太辣而無法入口的菜餚。","explanation":"指對某種刺激（如辣味、酒精、藥物）的生理耐受力。"},{"sentence":"In a democratic society, mutual <tolerance> *is* essential *for* maintaining peace and stability among various political groups.","translation":"在民主社會中，相互包容對於維持各政治團體間的和平與穩定至關重要。","explanation":"指社會層面的包容與寬容，常與 peace, stability 等詞連用。"}],"related_forms":["tolerant","tolerate"]}

{"headword":"tolerant","explanation":"形容詞「寬容的/容忍的」。常用於描述人的個性或對於不同意見的態度。常見搭配：be tolerant of sb/sth。注意其反義詞為 intolerant。","entries":[{"sentence":"Teachers should be <tolerant> *of* their students' mistakes while helping them learn and grow from their errors during class.","translation":"老師應該對學生的錯誤保持寬容，同時在課堂中幫助他們從錯誤中學習與成長。","explanation":"形容詞用法，後面接 of 加上受詞。指對某人的過失保持包容。"},{"sentence":"The local community is very <tolerant> *of* visitors, making it a popular destination for travelers from all over the world.","translation":"當地社區對遊客非常包容，這使得它成為世界各地旅客的熱門目的地。","explanation":"描述對外來者或不同群體的態度，強調開放與接納。"},{"sentence":"Being <tolerant> *of* opposing views allows for more productive discussions and better decision-making in group projects.","translation":"對反對意見保持寬容，能讓小組專案的討論更有效率，決策也更完善。","explanation":"指對意見的包容，是學術與職場討論中常見的用語。"}],"related_forms":["tolerance","tolerate"]}

{"headword":"tolerate","explanation":"動詞「容忍/忍受」。指忍受不喜歡、不贊同或困難的事物。常與 can/cannot 搭配。注意其與 endure 或 bear 的差異，tolerate 較偏向對「不認同的事」表示寬容。","entries":[{"sentence":"The strict manager will not <tolerate> *any* *delay* in submitting the project reports, as deadlines are crucial for the company.","translation":"嚴格的經理不會容忍繳交專案報告的任何延誤，因為截止日期對公司至關重要。","explanation":"表示無法忍受某種行為，後面直接接名詞作為受詞。"},{"sentence":"Many people find it hard to <tolerate> the noise from the construction site located right next to their apartment building.","translation":"許多人發現很難忍受緊鄰他們公寓大樓的工地所發出的噪音。","explanation":"指對生理上的不適（如噪音、高溫）的忍受。"},{"sentence":"We cannot <tolerate> bullying in this school; every student deserves a safe and supportive learning environment.","translation":"我們不能容忍校園霸凌；每一位學生都應享有安全且受支持的學習環境。","explanation":"用於表達對負面行為的零容忍態度，是高中作文常見主題。"}],"related_forms":["tolerance","tolerant"]}

{"headword":"tomb","explanation":"名詞「墳墓/塚」。常指古代宏偉的陵墓或具有歷史意義的墓地。注意 b 不發音。","entries":[{"sentence":"Archaeologists discovered an ancient <tomb> *filled* *with* gold artifacts, offering new insights into the civilization of that era.","translation":"考古學家發現了一座充滿黃金文物的古墓，為該時代的文明提供了新的見解。","explanation":"指考古挖掘出的陵墓，常與 ancient, discover 等詞連用。"},{"sentence":"Tourists visit the grand <tomb> to pay their respects and admire the impressive architecture of the historical monument.","translation":"遊客造訪這座宏偉的陵墓以表達敬意，並欣賞這座歷史古蹟令人印象深刻的建築。","explanation":"指歷史性的陵墓，常用作觀光景點。"},{"sentence":"The king was buried in a royal <tomb> surrounded by beautiful gardens that are open to the public today.","translation":"國王被安葬在皇家陵墓中，周圍環繞著現今對公眾開放的美麗花園。","explanation":"指君主或權貴的墓地，強調其規模與歷史背景。"}],"related_forms":["tombs"]}

{"headword":"tortoise","explanation":"名詞「陸龜」。注意與 turtle (海龜) 的區別。常用於寓言故事（如龜兔賽跑）。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the famous fable, the slow but steady <tortoise> *wins* the *race* against the arrogant and overconfident hare.","translation":"在著名的寓言中，緩慢但穩定的陸龜在比賽中贏過了傲慢且過度自信的野兔。","explanation":"指寓言故事中的角色，象徵堅持不懈。"},{"sentence":"Some species of giant <tortoise> can live for over a hundred years, making them one of the longest-living animals on Earth.","translation":"某些種類的巨型陸龜可以活超過一百年，使牠們成為地球上最長壽的動物之一。","explanation":"描述生物特性，搭配 live for 等用法。"},{"sentence":"Children were excited to see the giant <tortoise> slowly eating its lunch of fresh leaves at the city zoo.","translation":"孩子們很興奮地看著巨大的陸龜在市立動物園裡緩慢地吃著牠的午餐——新鮮的葉子。","explanation":"日常情境描述，常與 zoo 或觀察行為連用。"}],"related_forms":["tortoises"]}

{"headword":"torture","explanation":"名詞/動詞「折磨/拷打」。可指生理上的拷問，或心理上的極大痛苦。常見搭配：mental torture (心理折磨)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hero in the movie refused to reveal the secret plan even after being subjected to cruel <torture> by his enemies.","translation":"電影中的英雄即使在遭受敵人的殘酷拷問後，仍拒絕透露秘密計畫。","explanation":"作為名詞，指嚴酷的刑求或折磨，常與 cruel 或 suffer 等詞搭配。"},{"sentence":"Waiting for the final exam results was pure <torture> for the anxious students who had worked hard all semester.","translation":"等待期末考成績對那些整學期努力用功的焦慮學生來說，簡直是一種心理折磨。","explanation":"比喻用法，形容心理上的極度煎熬或焦慮。"},{"sentence":"The kidnappers <tortured> their hostage for days, hoping to force the family to pay the large amount of money demanded.","translation":"綁匪折磨人質數天，希望強迫其家人支付要求的巨額贖金。","explanation":"動詞用法，指對某人施加痛苦。"}],"related_forms":["tortured","torturing"]}

{"headword":"tragedy","explanation":"名詞「悲劇」。除指戲劇類型外，也常用於新聞事件，描述重大不幸事故。常見搭配：a personal tragedy, a human tragedy。","entries":[{"sentence":"The earthquake in the southern region was a terrible <tragedy> *that* *caused* the loss of many homes and innocent lives.","translation":"南部地區的地震是一場可怕的悲劇，導致了許多家園與無辜生命的喪失。","explanation":"指災難性事件，通常搭配形容詞 terrible, great 等。"},{"sentence":"The play is a classic <tragedy> *about* a king who loses everything due to his own pride and poor decisions.","translation":"這部戲劇是一齣關於一位因自己的驕傲與錯誤決定而失去一切的國王的經典悲劇。","explanation":"指文學或戲劇上的悲劇作品。"},{"sentence":"It is a true <tragedy> *that* so many talented young people are unable to pursue their dreams due to financial problems.","translation":"許多有才華的年輕人因為經濟問題而無法追求夢想，這真是一場悲劇。","explanation":"表達感嘆，指令人遺憾或惋惜的事。"}],"related_forms":["tragic","tragically"]}

{"headword":"tragic","explanation":"形容詞「悲劇的/悲慘的」。描述令人極度難過或不幸的事件。注意與 tragedy (名詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young athlete's <tragic> *death* *in* a car accident shocked the entire community and left his fans in deep sorrow.","translation":"這位年輕運動員在車禍中的悲慘死亡震驚了整個社區，並讓他的粉絲陷入深切的悲傷中。","explanation":"常用於形容死亡或意外，帶有惋惜的語氣。"},{"sentence":"They made a <tragic> *mistake* by ignoring the warning signs, which eventually led to the failure of their business.","translation":"他們忽略了警示標誌，犯了一個慘痛的錯誤，最終導致了他們事業的失敗。","explanation":"指帶來嚴重後果的錯誤，常用 tragic mistake。"},{"sentence":"The novel tells the <tragic> *story* *of* a family separated by war and the difficulties they faced to reunite.","translation":"這部小說講述了一個因戰爭而分離的家庭的悲慘故事，以及他們為了團聚所面臨的困難。","explanation":"形容故事或情節充滿悲劇色彩。"}],"related_forms":["tragedy","tragically"]}

{"headword":"transfer","explanation":"動詞/名詞「轉移/調動/轉乘」。指將人、物或數據從一處移至另一處。常見搭配：transfer to (地點/職位)。注意重音位置會隨詞性改變（動詞重音在後，名詞在前）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company decided to <transfer> *him* *to* the overseas branch to help improve communication with international clients.","translation":"公司決定將他調往海外分部，以協助改善與國際客戶的溝通。","explanation":"指職務上的調動，常用 passive voice (be transferred to)。"},{"sentence":"You need to <transfer> *to* the red line at the next station to reach the city center by subway.","translation":"你需要在下一站轉乘紅線，才能搭乘地鐵抵達市中心。","explanation":"指交通工具的轉乘，常見於旅遊或通勤情境。"},{"sentence":"Please <transfer> the files *from* your computer *to* the USB drive so that we can print them later.","translation":"請將檔案從你的電腦傳輸到隨身碟，這樣我們稍後才能把它們列印出來。","explanation":"指數據或物品的轉移。"},{"sentence":"After the <transfer> *of* power, the new government promised to focus on creating more job opportunities for young people.","translation":"在權力轉移之後，新政府承諾將專注於為年輕人創造更多工作機會。","explanation":"作為名詞，指權力、資金等的轉移。"}],"related_forms":["transferred","transferring"]}

{"headword":"transform","explanation":"動詞「轉變/改造」。強調徹底的改變，通常是外觀、性質或狀態的改變。常見搭配：transform A into B。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new interior design will <transform> this old, dark room *into* a bright and comfortable space for everyone.","translation":"新的室內設計將把這間老舊、陰暗的房間改造成一個對每個人來說都明亮且舒適的空間。","explanation":"指空間或環境的改造，搭配 into。"},{"sentence":"The rapid development of the internet has completely <transformed> *the* *way* people communicate and share information globally.","translation":"網際網路的快速發展徹底改變了人們在全球溝通與分享資訊的方式。","explanation":"指抽象概念或模式的徹底改變，常用於科技或社會議題。"},{"sentence":"With enough practice, the student was able to <transform> his weak writing skills *into* a powerful tool for his future career.","translation":"經過足夠的練習，這名學生能夠將他薄弱的寫作技巧轉化為他未來職涯的強大工具。","explanation":"指能力的提升或轉化。"}],"related_forms":["transformation","transformed"]}

{"headword":"translate","explanation":"動詞「翻譯；轉換」。注意介係詞搭配：translate A into B (將A譯成B)。常見搭配：translate ... into ...。此詞亦可延伸為「轉化、實踐」，如 translate ideas into action。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is difficult to <translate> this poem *into* English without losing the original beauty and emotional depth of the poet's words.","translation":"要將這首詩翻譯成英文而不失去詩人文字原有的美感與情感深度，是相當困難的。","explanation":"基本用法：translate A into B。強調翻譯時的語意轉換。"},{"sentence":"The company plans to <translate> its ambitious marketing strategies *into* actual profits by expanding its sales to international markets next year.","translation":"該公司計畫透過明年將銷售擴展到國際市場，將其宏偉的行銷策略轉化為實際利潤。","explanation":"延伸用法：translate sth into sth，意指將抽象概念落實為具體結果。"},{"sentence":"When you <translate> the technical manual *into* simple language, more students will be able to understand the complex instructions easily.","translation":"當你把這本技術手冊翻譯成簡單的語言時，更多的學生將能夠輕鬆理解這些複雜的說明。","explanation":"常見搭配：translate into simple language / plain English。"}],"related_forms":["translated","translating","translation","translator"]}

{"headword":"translation","explanation":"名詞「翻譯；譯文」。常見搭配：a literal translation (直譯) vs. a free translation (意譯)。注意詞性變化，這是 translate 的名詞形式。","entries":[{"sentence":"The official <translation> *of* the ancient document reveals that the king had signed a peace treaty with the neighboring country centuries ago.","translation":"這份古代文件的官方譯文顯示，國王早在幾個世紀前就與鄰國簽署了和平條約。","explanation":"名詞用法。搭配介係詞 of 後接翻譯的對象。"},{"sentence":"Some students prefer a literal <translation> when studying foreign languages, but sometimes it fails to convey the true meaning of idioms.","translation":"有些學生在學習外語時偏好直譯，但有時這無法傳達慣用語的真正含義。","explanation":"搭配形容詞 literal/free 來區分翻譯方式。"},{"sentence":"The publisher is seeking a professional for the English <translation> *of* a popular novel that has won many awards in Taiwan.","translation":"出版社正在尋找一位專業人士來負責這本在台灣獲獎無數的流行小說的英譯工作。","explanation":"常用搭配：do/provide a translation of sth。"}],"related_forms":["translate","translator"]}

{"headword":"translator","explanation":"名詞「翻譯者；譯者」。指從事翻譯工作的人。注意此字結尾為 -or。","entries":[{"sentence":"Being a professional <translator> requires not only excellent language skills but also a deep understanding of the culture behind the words.","translation":"成為一名專業的翻譯者，不僅需要出色的語言能力，還需要對文字背後的文化有深刻的理解。","explanation":"職業名詞。形容詞搭配 professional/skilled/experienced。"},{"sentence":"The author met with her <translator> to discuss the nuances of the characters' dialogue in her new book before it was published.","translation":"作者在書出版前與她的譯者會面，討論書中角色對話的細微差別。","explanation":"常見情境：作者與譯者溝通。"},{"sentence":"Many companies now use online tools to assist the <translator> *in* completing documents more quickly and accurately during busy workdays.","translation":"許多公司現在使用線上工具來協助譯者在繁忙的工作日中更快速、準確地完成文件。","explanation":"動詞搭配：assist the translator in doing sth。"}],"related_forms":["translate","translation"]}

{"headword":"transportation","explanation":"名詞「運輸；交通工具」。此字在美式英語中為不可數名詞，通常指整體交通系統或運輸方式。常見搭配：public transportation。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city government is investing a huge amount of money to improve public <transportation> and reduce the traffic jams during rush hours.","translation":"市政府正在投入大量資金以改善大眾運輸，並減少尖峰時刻的交通擁塞。","explanation":"最常見搭配：public transportation。注意不可數。"},{"sentence":"For many students living in the suburbs, reliable <transportation> *to* school is essential for maintaining their daily attendance and academic performance.","translation":"對於許多住在郊區的學生來說，可靠的交通方式到校對於維持每日出勤和學業表現至關重要。","explanation":"表達「前往某處的交通方式」常用 transportation to + 地點。"},{"sentence":"The company provides free <transportation> for its employees who live far away, making it easier for them to get to work on time.","translation":"公司為住在遠處的員工提供免費交通接送，讓他們更容易準時上班。","explanation":"provide transportation = 提供交通服務/接送。"}],"related_forms":["transport"]}

{"headword":"tremble","explanation":"動詞「顫抖」；名詞「顫抖」。常用於描述因恐懼、寒冷或憤怒而發抖。注意與 shake 的細微差別，tremble 通常帶有情感或生理上的不自主反應。","entries":[{"sentence":"When the young boy stood on the stage to give his first speech, his hands began to <tremble> because of his nervousness.","translation":"當那個小男孩站在台上發表第一次演講時，因為緊張，他的手開始發抖。","explanation":"動詞用法。常見搭配：tremble with fear/excitement/cold。"},{"sentence":"She felt a slight <tremble> in his voice as he told the sad story about his family's experience during the war.","translation":"當他講述關於他家人在戰爭期間的經歷時，她感覺到他的聲音有一絲顫抖。","explanation":"名詞用法。搭配 a slight/noticeable tremble。"},{"sentence":"The earth began to <tremble> violently just before the earthquake hit the city, causing panic among the people in the streets.","translation":"地震襲擊城市前夕，大地開始劇烈搖晃，引起街上民眾的恐慌。","explanation":"描述自然現象（地震）時的動詞用法，強調震動感。"}],"related_forms":["trembling"]}

{"headword":"tremendous","explanation":"形容詞「極大的；巨大的；極好的」。常用於形容規模、數量、重要性或程度。注意不要與 terrible 混淆。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist made a <tremendous> contribution to the field of medicine by discovering a new way to treat this rare disease.","translation":"這位科學家透過發現治療這種罕見疾病的新方法，對醫學領域做出了巨大的貢獻。","explanation":"常見搭配：make a tremendous contribution (to)。"},{"sentence":"There has been a <tremendous> increase in the number of tourists visiting this small town since the new train station was built last year.","translation":"自從去年新火車站建成以來，到訪這個小鎮的遊客數量有了巨大的增長。","explanation":"常用搭配：a tremendous increase/amount。"},{"sentence":"We had a <tremendous> time at the graduation party, sharing stories and laughing with all our friends before saying goodbye.","translation":"我們在畢業派對上玩得非常開心，在道別前與所有朋友分享故事並歡笑。","explanation":"口語用法：have a tremendous time = have a great time。"}],"related_forms":["tremendously"]}

{"headword":"tribal","explanation":"形容詞「部落的」。指與部落文化、社會結構或成員相關的。常見於社會學或人類學相關主題。","entries":[{"sentence":"The anthropologist spent years living with the local people to study their <tribal> customs and traditions in the remote mountain areas.","translation":"這位人類學家在偏遠山區與當地居民生活了數年，以研究他們的部落習俗與傳統。","explanation":"常見搭配：tribal customs/traditions/society。"},{"sentence":"In the past, <tribal> warfare was quite common among different groups fighting over the limited resources in the region.","translation":"過去，部落戰爭在該地區爭奪有限資源的不同群體間相當普遍。","explanation":"常見搭配：tribal warfare/conflict。"},{"sentence":"The museum exhibition displays various <tribal> artifacts that provide insights into how people lived thousands of years ago.","translation":"博物館展覽陳列了各種部落文物，讓人們深入了解幾千年前人們是如何生活的。","explanation":"常見搭配：tribal artifacts/art。"}],"related_forms":["tribe"]}

{"headword":"triumph","explanation":"名詞「勝利；巨大的成就」；動詞「戰勝」。強調克服困難後的成功，語氣比 victory 更強烈。常見片語：in triumph。","entries":[{"sentence":"After years of hard work and endless practice, the athlete finally <triumphed> *over* her rivals and won the gold medal in the competition.","translation":"經過多年的努力和無盡的練習，這位運動員終於戰勝對手，在比賽中贏得了金牌。","explanation":"動詞用法：triumph over sb/sth (戰勝/克服)。"},{"sentence":"The team returned home *in* <triumph> after winning the championship, and thousands of fans cheered for them at the airport.","translation":"球隊贏得冠軍後凱旋而歸，成千上萬的球迷在機場為他們歡呼。","explanation":"名詞片語：in triumph (勝利地)。"},{"sentence":"It was a great <triumph> for the young director when her first movie became a box-office success worldwide.","translation":"當這位年輕導演的第一部電影在全球取得票房成功時，這是她的一個巨大成就。","explanation":"名詞用法。指成就或成功。"}],"related_forms":["triumphant","triumphantly"]}

{"headword":"troublesome","explanation":"形容詞「麻煩的；惱人的」。用來形容造成困難、困擾或問題的人事物。注意與 troubled (感到困擾的) 的差別。","entries":[{"sentence":"Dealing with <troublesome> students in the classroom requires patience and effective communication skills from the teachers.","translation":"處理教室裡那些愛搗蛋的學生，需要老師具備耐心與有效的溝通技巧。","explanation":"形容人或行為麻煩。"},{"sentence":"The computer software has a <troublesome> bug that causes the system to crash unexpectedly whenever I try to save my work.","translation":"這個電腦軟體有個麻煩的程式錯誤，導致我每次試圖存檔時系統就會意外當機。","explanation":"形容事物/問題棘手。"},{"sentence":"It is <troublesome> to find that you have lost your keys just minutes before you need to leave for an important meeting.","translation":"在需要出門參加重要會議的前幾分鐘發現鑰匙不見了，真是件麻煩事。","explanation":"It is troublesome to... (做某事很麻煩)。"}],"related_forms":["trouble"]}

{"headword":"tumble","explanation":"動詞「跌倒；滾落」；名詞「跌倒；滾落」。強調失去平衡而掉落。常見搭配：tumble down/over。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little child lost his balance and <tumbled> *down* the stairs, but luckily he was not seriously hurt in the accident.","translation":"那個小孩子失去平衡滾下樓梯，但幸運的是，他沒有在這起意外中受重傷。","explanation":"動詞用法：tumble down (滾落)。強調失去平衡。"},{"sentence":"Prices of oil have <tumbled> sharply in the past few months, causing significant changes in the global economic situation.","translation":"石油價格在過去幾個月中急劇下跌，導致全球經濟局勢發生重大變化。","explanation":"動詞用法：(價格) 急劇下跌。"},{"sentence":"After taking a bad <tumble> on the icy road, he decided to walk much more slowly to avoid falling again.","translation":"在結冰的路上重重摔了一跤後，他決定走慢一點以避免再次跌倒。","explanation":"名詞用法。take a tumble (摔倒)。"}],"related_forms":["tumbled","tumbling"]}

{"headword":"twig","explanation":"通常指樹木上的小細枝。在描述自然景觀或童話故事場景時較為常見，雖非核心單字，但具象徵意義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little bird landed on a thin <twig> and started singing, breaking the silence of the early morning forest.","translation":"小鳥停在一根細小的樹枝上開始鳴叫，打破了清晨森林的寧靜。","explanation":"指樹上細小的枝條。常與 thin, dry 等形容詞搭配。"},{"sentence":"The child picked up a broken <twig> from the ground and used it to draw a picture in the mud.","translation":"孩子從地上撿起一根斷掉的樹枝，用它在泥地上畫畫。","explanation":"描述撿拾樹枝的動作，常見於與自然互動的情境。"},{"sentence":"During the winter, the trees were bare, with only a few brown <twigs> sticking out against the cold gray sky.","translation":"冬天時，樹木光禿禿的，只有幾根褐色的細枝在寒冷的灰色天空下伸展。","explanation":"描述冬季枯枝的畫面。注意複數形 twigs。"}],"related_forms":["twigs"]}

{"headword":"universal","explanation":"用法：(1) 形容詞「普遍的/全體的」；(2) 形容詞「宇宙的/通用的」。注意與 general 的區別，universal 強調「適用於每一個人或事物」。","entries":[{"sentence":"Music is often called a <universal> language because it can express emotions that people from different cultures can understand.","translation":"音樂常被稱為通用的語言，因為它能表達來自不同文化的人們都能理解的情感。","explanation":"指具有普世性、人人皆可理解的。常用搭配：a universal language / truth。"},{"sentence":"The proposal to improve school lunches received <universal> *support* from both parents and teachers during the meeting.","translation":"改善學校午餐的提議在會議中得到了家長和老師們的一致支持。","explanation":"指「一致的/全體的」。常用搭配：universal support / acclaim。"},{"sentence":"It is a <universal> *fact* that all living things need water to survive on this planet.","translation":"所有的生物都需要水才能在這個星球上生存，這是一個普遍的事實。","explanation":"指「普遍的/眾所周知的」事實。常用搭配：universal fact / truth。"},{"sentence":"The new software is designed to be <universal>, meaning it works on all types of computer systems without any problems.","translation":"這款新軟體被設計成通用的，意味著它可以在所有類型的電腦系統上運作，不會有任何問題。","explanation":"指「通用的/適用於各處的」。"}],"related_forms":["universally","universe"]}

{"headword":"urge","explanation":"用法：(1) 動詞「力勸/激勵」urge sb to V；(2) 名詞「強烈的衝動/慾望」the urge to V。注意語氣比 advise 更強烈。","entries":[{"sentence":"The principal <urged> students *to* study hard and make the most of their time while they are still in high school.","translation":"校長力勸學生在高中期間要努力學習，充分利用時間。","explanation":"動詞用法：urge sb to V。表示強烈建議或敦促。"},{"sentence":"Despite the diet, she could not *resist* the <urge> *to* eat a piece of chocolate cake after dinner.","translation":"儘管在節食，飯後她仍無法抗拒想吃一塊巧克力蛋糕的衝動。","explanation":"名詞用法：the urge to V。常搭配 resist (抗拒) 或 feel (感到)。"},{"sentence":"Environmentalists <urged> the government *to* take immediate action to reduce carbon emissions and protect the planet.","translation":"環保人士敦促政府立即採取行動減少碳排放，以保護地球。","explanation":"動詞用法：常用於呼籲或請求。搭配介係詞 to 引導動作。"},{"sentence":"He felt a sudden <urge> *to* travel around the world and learn about different cultures firsthand.","translation":"他突然感到一股想要環遊世界並親身體驗不同文化的衝動。","explanation":"名詞用法：表示內心強烈的渴望或念頭。"}],"related_forms":["urged","urges","urgent"]}

{"headword":"urgent","explanation":"形容詞「緊急的/迫切的」。常指需要立刻處理的事務。注意與 emerging (新興的) 拼法區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor told him that his medical condition was <urgent> and required immediate surgery at the hospital.","translation":"醫生告訴他病情很緊急，需要立即在醫院進行手術。","explanation":"形容需要立刻處理的狀況。常用搭配：urgent need / matter。"},{"sentence":"There is an <urgent> *need* for more volunteers to help clean up the park after the big festival.","translation":"在大型節慶過後，迫切需要更多志工來協助清理公園。","explanation":"常用搭配：urgent need for sth。表示緊急的需求。"},{"sentence":"She received an <urgent> *message* from her office saying that she needed to return to work right away.","translation":"她收到辦公室傳來的緊急訊息，說她必須馬上回去工作。","explanation":"指必須優先處理的訊息或任務。"},{"sentence":"Climate change is an <urgent> *issue* that requires global cooperation to find effective solutions.","translation":"氣候變遷是一個迫切的議題，需要全球合作來尋找有效的解決方案。","explanation":"形容必須馬上關注的社會議題。"}],"related_forms":["urgently","urgency"]}

{"headword":"usage","explanation":"名詞「用法/使用方式」。主要指語言的使用慣例或設備的使用方法。常見於語言學習或說明書。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher explained the correct <usage> *of* the word 'effect' in formal writing to help students avoid common mistakes.","translation":"老師解釋了單字 'effect' 在正式寫作中的正確用法，以幫助學生避免常見錯誤。","explanation":"指語言的慣用法。常用搭配：usage of sth。"},{"sentence":"The manual provides clear instructions on the <usage> *of* the new coffee machine to ensure safety and efficiency.","translation":"這本手冊提供了關於這台新咖啡機的清晰使用說明，以確保安全和效率。","explanation":"指設備的使用方式。常用搭配：instruction on the usage of..."},{"sentence":"Water <usage> usually increases significantly during the hot summer months because people use more water for bathing and gardening.","translation":"炎熱的夏季月份，用水量通常會顯著增加，因為人們洗澡和園藝用水變多了。","explanation":"指水、電、燃料等資源的消耗量。常用搭配：water/energy usage。"}],"related_forms":["use","useful"]}

{"headword":"vacancy","explanation":"名詞「空缺/職缺」。常指工作職位或是旅館房間的空位。注意與 vacation (假期) 拼法不同。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company has a <vacancy> in the marketing department and is looking for a creative person to fill the position.","translation":"公司行銷部門有一個職缺，正在尋找有創意的人來填補這個位子。","explanation":"指工作職缺。常用搭配：job vacancy; fill a vacancy。"},{"sentence":"We called several hotels, but there was no <vacancy> available during the busy tourist season.","translation":"我們打了幾家旅館，但在繁忙的旅遊季節裡都沒有空房。","explanation":"指旅館的空房。常用片語：No Vacancy (客滿)。"},{"sentence":"Due to a sudden <vacancy> on the student council, a new election will be held next week to choose a replacement.","translation":"由於學生會突然出現職位空缺，下週將舉行新的選舉來選出遞補人選。","explanation":"指職位或席次的空缺。"}],"related_forms":["vacant"]}

{"headword":"vain","explanation":"用法：(1) 形容詞「徒勞的」in vain；(2) 形容詞「愛慕虛榮的」。後者在描述人物性格時常用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The rescue team searched for the missing hiker for hours, but all their efforts were in <vain> due to the heavy rain.","translation":"救援隊搜尋失蹤登山客數小時，但由於大雨，他們所有的努力都徒勞無功。","explanation":"片語 in vain = 徒勞無功。這是最常見的用法。"},{"sentence":"He is so <vain> that he spends hours in front of the mirror every morning checking his appearance.","translation":"他非常愛慕虛榮，每天早上都要花好幾個小時在鏡子前檢查自己的外表。","explanation":"形容人過度在意自己的外表。常見於描述自戀或愛漂亮的人。"},{"sentence":"She tried to fix the broken computer herself, but it was in <vain>, so she eventually called a professional.","translation":"她試著自己修理壞掉的電腦，但徒勞無功，所以最後還是請了專業人士。","explanation":"再次強調 in vain 的用法，表示結果失敗。"},{"sentence":"Being too <vain> can sometimes make people feel uncomfortable around you because you talk about yourself too much.","translation":"太愛慕虛榮有時會讓別人跟你相處時感到不自在，因為你談論自己太多了。","explanation":"形容因愛慕虛榮而導致的人際關係問題。"}],"related_forms":["vanity"]}

{"headword":"vast","explanation":"形容詞「巨大的/廣大的」。用於描述空間、數量、程度等。與 huge 或 massive 意思相近，但常帶有「廣闊」的意味。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <vast> *ocean* covers most of the Earth's surface and remains a mysterious place for many scientists to explore.","translation":"廣闊的海洋覆蓋了地球表面大部分區域，對許多科學家來說仍是一個神祕的探索之地。","explanation":"描述空間廣大。常用搭配：vast ocean / area / desert。"},{"sentence":"The library holds a <vast> *collection* of books, covering topics from science to history and art.","translation":"圖書館收藏了大量的書籍，涵蓋了從科學到歷史和藝術等各類主題。","explanation":"描述數量極多。常用搭配：vast collection / amount / number。"},{"sentence":"There is a <vast> *difference* between what he says and what he actually does in real life.","translation":"他嘴上說的和現實生活中實際做的，有著巨大的差異。","explanation":"描述程度差異巨大。常用搭配：vast difference。"}],"related_forms":["vastly"]}

{"headword":"vegetarian","explanation":"用法：(1) 名詞「素食者」；(2) 形容詞「素食的」。在討論健康飲食或生活方式時極為常見。","entries":[{"sentence":"More and more people are becoming <vegetarians> because they want to live a healthier lifestyle and protect animals.","translation":"越來越多人成為素食者，因為他們想要過更健康的生活方式並保護動物。","explanation":"名詞用法。注意複數形 vegetarians。"},{"sentence":"The restaurant offers a wide range of delicious <vegetarian> *dishes* for those who do not eat meat.","translation":"這家餐廳為不吃肉的人提供各式各樣美味的素食餐點。","explanation":"形容詞用法。常用搭配：vegetarian dish / meal / diet。"},{"sentence":"Even though he is a <vegetarian>, he still enjoys cooking different kinds of vegetables in creative ways.","translation":"即使他是素食者，他仍然喜歡用創意的方式烹飪各種蔬菜。","explanation":"名詞用法，描述生活習慣。"}],"related_forms":["vegetable","vegetation"]}

{"headword":"vessel","explanation":"名詞「船艦/血管/容器」。常見於歷史描述（大型船隻）或生物學（血管）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Large <vessels> carrying goods from other countries arrived at the port early this morning to unload their cargo.","translation":"載運來自他國貨物的大型船隻今天清晨抵達港口，準備卸貨。","explanation":"名詞用法：指大型船隻。常用於新聞或地理主題。"},{"sentence":"The blood <vessels> in our body help carry oxygen and nutrients to every part of our system.","translation":"我們體內的血管有助於將氧氣和營養運送到我們系統的每個部位。","explanation":"名詞用法：指血管。常見於生物學相關試題。"},{"sentence":"In ancient times, people used clay <vessels> to store water and food for long journeys across the desert.","translation":"在古代，人們使用陶製容器來儲存水和食物，以供穿越沙漠的長途旅行使用。","explanation":"名詞用法：指容器（花瓶、罐子等）。"}],"related_forms":["vessels"]}

{"headword":"violate","explanation":"動詞「違反、侵犯」。常用於法律、規則、權利等語境。常見搭配：violate a rule/law/right/privacy。","entries":[{"sentence":"Drivers who <violate> *traffic* *regulations* will face heavy fines from the police to ensure everyone stays safe on the road.","translation":"違反交通規則的駕駛將面臨警方重罰，以確保每個人在路上的安全。","explanation":"violate regulations 是常見搭配。violate 在此指觸犯規定。"},{"sentence":"The reporter claimed that the government's new surveillance policy <violated> *the* *privacy* of ordinary citizens without any good reason.","translation":"該記者聲稱政府的新監控政策在沒有正當理由的情況下侵犯了普通公民的隱私。","explanation":"violate privacy 是常見用法，指侵犯隱私。"},{"sentence":"The athlete was disqualified from the competition because he <violated> *the* *rules* regarding the use of performance-enhancing drugs.","translation":"該運動員因違反有關使用增強表現藥物的規定而被取消比賽資格。","explanation":"violate the rules 是最基礎的用法，指違反競賽規則。"}],"related_forms":["violation","violator"]}

{"headword":"violation","explanation":"名詞「違反、違背、侵犯」。為 violate 的名詞形式。常搭配介係詞 of。常見用法：in violation of (違反)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company was shut down for a serious <violation> *of* *labor* *laws* after failing to provide safe working conditions for its employees.","translation":"這家公司因嚴重違反勞動法而被勒令停業，因為未能為員工提供安全的工作環境。","explanation":"in violation of 是常見片語，這裡作「違反...的行為」。"},{"sentence":"Any <violation> *of* *the* *contract* will result in immediate termination of the agreement and potential legal action against the responsible party.","translation":"任何違反合約的行為都將導致協議立即終止，並可能對責任方採取法律行動。","explanation":"violation of the contract 為固定搭配，指違約。"},{"sentence":"The judge dismissed the case, stating that the evidence obtained by the police was a clear <violation> *of* *human* *rights*.","translation":"法官駁回了此案，指出警方獲得的證據明顯侵犯了人權。","explanation":"violation of human rights 是常用詞組，指侵犯人權。"}],"related_forms":["violate","violator"]}

{"headword":"virtue","explanation":"名詞「美德、優點」。(1) 指道德上的高尚品質；(2) 指事物的優點或長處。常見片語：by virtue of (憑藉、因為)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Honesty is considered a great <virtue>, and many parents try to teach their children to be truthful from a very young age.","translation":"誠實被視為一種偉大的美德，許多父母試著從小教導孩子要誠實。","explanation":"virtue 在此指道德上的美德。"},{"sentence":"The new software succeeded *by* <virtue> *of* its simple design, which allows even elderly people to use it without much difficulty.","translation":"這款新軟體憑藉其簡單的設計而成功，即使是老年人也能毫不費力地使用它。","explanation":"by virtue of 是重要片語，意為「憑藉/由於」，需熟記。"},{"sentence":"One <virtue> *of* *living* in a small town is the strong sense of community that you cannot easily find in big cities.","translation":"住在小鎮的一個優點是強烈的社區意識，這是你在大城市不容易找到的。","explanation":"virtue 在此指「優點/長處」，後面常接 of + V-ing。"}],"related_forms":["virtuous"]}

{"headword":"virus","explanation":"名詞「病毒」。可用於生物學（引起疾病的病毒）或電腦科學（電腦病毒）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor advised everyone to wash their hands frequently to prevent the <virus> *from* *spreading* during the flu season.","translation":"醫生建議大家在流感季節勤洗手，以防止病毒傳播。","explanation":"virus 指流感病毒。搭配 spread (傳播)。"},{"sentence":"My computer crashed because it was infected with a dangerous computer <virus> that deleted all my important files yesterday.","translation":"我的電腦當機了，因為它感染了一種危險的電腦病毒，刪除了我昨天所有的重要檔案。","explanation":"指電腦病毒，常與 infected 搭配。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are working hard to develop a new vaccine that can effectively fight against the deadly <virus> currently affecting many countries.","translation":"科學家們正努力開發一種新疫苗，以有效對抗目前影響許多國家的致命病毒。","explanation":"fight against a virus 是常見用法，指對抗病毒。"}],"related_forms":["viral"]}

{"headword":"visual","explanation":"形容詞「視覺的」。常指與看、圖像、視覺效果有關的事物。常見搭配：visual aids (視覺輔助工具), visual arts (視覺藝術)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher used colorful <visual> *aids* to help students better understand the complex scientific concepts in the textbook.","translation":"老師使用色彩鮮豔的視覺輔助工具，幫助學生更好地理解課本中複雜的科學概念。","explanation":"visual aids 是教學常用詞組，指圖表、投影片等教學輔助。"},{"sentence":"Some people learn better through <visual> *information*, such as pictures and charts, while others prefer listening to lectures.","translation":"有些人透過視覺資訊（如圖片和圖表）學習效果更好，而其他人則更喜歡聽講座。","explanation":"visual information 指視覺傳達的資訊。"},{"sentence":"The movie is famous for its stunning <visual> *effects*, which made the imaginary world look incredibly real on the big screen.","translation":"這部電影以其驚人的視覺效果而聞名，讓想像中的世界在銀幕上看起來不可思議地真實。","explanation":"visual effects (VFX) 是電影領域的專有名詞。"}],"related_forms":["visually","vision"]}

{"headword":"vital","explanation":"形容詞「極其重要的、不可或缺的、維持生命的」。強調對於成功或生存而言是必要的。常見搭配：vital to/for sth, play a vital role in。","entries":[{"sentence":"Exercise and a balanced diet are <vital> *to* *maintaining* good health and preventing many chronic diseases as we grow older.","translation":"運動和均衡飲食對於保持健康以及在我們變老時預防許多慢性病至關重要。","explanation":"vital to + V-ing 是固定搭配，表示對...極其重要。"},{"sentence":"Water plays a <vital> *role* *in* the survival of all living organisms, from the smallest plants to the largest animals on Earth.","translation":"水在所有生物的生存中扮演著至關重要的角色，從地球上最小的植物到最大的動物皆是如此。","explanation":"play a vital role in 是非常高頻的學測考點，意為「扮演關鍵角色」。"},{"sentence":"It is <vital> *that* every team member finishes their assigned tasks on time so that the project can be completed by the deadline.","translation":"每一位團隊成員準時完成指派任務是至關重要的，這樣專案才能在期限內完成。","explanation":"vital that 子句中通常使用虛擬語氣 (should + V 或直接用 V)，表示「某事是必要的」。"}],"related_forms":["vitally"]}

{"headword":"voluntary","explanation":"形容詞「自願的、志願的」。指不是被強迫，而是主動選擇去做的。與 compulsory (強迫的) 相反。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school offers several <voluntary> *activities* after classes, such as music clubs and sports teams, for students to join if they wish.","translation":"學校課後提供幾項自願參加的活動，例如音樂社團和運動隊，學生若有意願皆可參加。","explanation":"voluntary activities 指非強制性的課外活動。"},{"sentence":"Participating in <voluntary> *work* helps teenagers gain valuable experience and develop a sense of responsibility toward their community.","translation":"參與志願工作有助於青少年獲得寶貴的經驗，並培養對社區的責任感。","explanation":"voluntary work 即志工服務。"},{"sentence":"Many people make a <voluntary> *contribution* to charity organizations every year to help those who are in need of support.","translation":"許多人每年都會向慈善機構進行自願捐款，以幫助那些需要支持的人。","explanation":"voluntary contribution 指自願性的捐獻。"}],"related_forms":["volunteer","voluntarily"]}

{"headword":"volunteer","explanation":"名詞「志工」；動詞「自願做...」。常見搭配：volunteer for/to do sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student decided to <volunteer> *for* the local animal shelter, where he spent his weekends taking care of homeless cats and dogs.","translation":"那名學生決定到當地的動物收容所當志工，他在那裡度過週末，照顧無家可歸的貓狗。","explanation":"volunteer for + 組織/活動，指擔任志工。"},{"sentence":"When the teacher asked for a <volunteer> *to* *help* clean the classroom, Sarah immediately raised her hand to show she was willing.","translation":"當老師詢問是否有志願者幫忙打掃教室時，莎拉立刻舉手表示她願意。","explanation":"名詞用法，指自願者。常用 volunteer to do sth。"},{"sentence":"Many retired teachers <volunteer> *to* *teach* reading to young children in the neighborhood during their spare time.","translation":"許多退休老師在空閒時間自願教社區裡的幼童閱讀。","explanation":"動詞用法，volunteer to do sth (自願做某事)。"}],"related_forms":["voluntary"]}

{"headword":"voyage","explanation":"名詞「航行、航海」；動詞「航行」。通常指長途的水上或太空旅行。","entries":[{"sentence":"The explorers set off on a long <voyage> *across* *the* *ocean* to discover new lands and trade routes centuries ago.","translation":"幾個世紀前，探險家們開始了橫跨海洋的漫長航行，去發現新的土地和貿易路線。","explanation":"voyage across the ocean 是常見搭配，指橫渡海洋的航行。"},{"sentence":"The captain described his first <voyage> *at* *sea* as a challenging yet exciting experience that changed his perspective on life.","translation":"船長將他的第一次海上航行描述為一次充滿挑戰卻又令人興奮的經歷，這改變了他的人生觀。","explanation":"voyage at sea 指海上的航行。"},{"sentence":"Space scientists are planning a daring <voyage> *to* *Mars* to see if there is any evidence of life on the red planet.","translation":"太空科學家正在計畫一場大膽的火星航行，以查看紅色星球上是否有任何生命跡象。","explanation":"voyage to + 地點，現在也常用於太空旅行。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"waken","explanation":"動詞「喚醒、醒來」。與 wake 的用法相似，但 waken 常帶有「從睡眠中甦醒」或「喚醒某種感覺/意識」的文學色彩。","entries":[{"sentence":"The loud noise from the street <wakened> the baby, who then started crying because he was frightened by the sudden sound.","translation":"街上的巨大噪音吵醒了嬰兒，他因為突如其來的聲音受到驚嚇而開始哭泣。","explanation":"waken sb 指把某人吵醒。"},{"sentence":"The fresh mountain air helped <waken> her senses, making her feel more alive and energetic than she had felt in weeks.","translation":"清新的山間空氣喚醒了她的感官，使她感到比過去幾週更有活力、更有朝氣。","explanation":"waken one's senses 是一種文學用法，指喚醒感官。"},{"sentence":"She <wakened> early in the morning to the sound of birds singing, feeling ready to start her busy day at school.","translation":"她清晨在鳥叫聲中醒來，覺得準備好開始在學校忙碌的一天了。","explanation":"waken 可作不及物動詞，指醒來。"}],"related_forms":["wake","awaken"]}

{"headword":"website","explanation":"名詞「網站」。注意拼字為 web + site，非 web-site。常搭配動詞 visit, create, launch, browse。常見搭配包含 official website (官方網站)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students decided to create a <website> *to* share their creative writing projects and photos with the rest of the school community.","translation":"學生們決定建立一個網站，與學校其他成員分享他們的創意寫作計畫和照片。","explanation":"名詞「網站」。搭配 create a website 描述架設行為。"},{"sentence":"Please *visit* our official <website> for more information about the upcoming science fair and the registration process.","translation":"請造訪我們的官方網站，以獲取更多關於即將舉行的科學展覽和報名流程的資訊。","explanation":"常用動詞搭配 visit our official website。"},{"sentence":"Many online shoppers spend hours *browsing* the <website> to find the best deals on clothing and accessories before making a final purchase.","translation":"許多網路購物者花費數小時瀏覽該網站，以便在最終購買前找到服裝和配件的最佳優惠。","explanation":"動詞 browse 常用於網站瀏覽。"}],"related_forms":["web"]}

{"headword":"welfare","explanation":"名詞「福祉、福利」。(1) 指個人或群體的幸福/安康 (well-being)。(2) 政府提供的社會救助 (social welfare)。注意與 well-being 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government is dedicated *to* the <welfare> *of* all citizens, ensuring that everyone has access to basic healthcare and education services.","translation":"政府致力於所有公民的福祉，確保每個人都能獲得基本的醫療保健和教育服務。","explanation":"片語 be dedicated to the welfare of sb. 指致力於某人的福祉。"},{"sentence":"The animal rights organization works tirelessly *to* *promote* the <welfare> *of* stray animals in the city by providing shelter and food.","translation":"動物權利組織孜孜不倦地工作，透過提供收容所和食物來促進城市流浪動物的福利。","explanation":"搭配 promote the welfare of，指促進福利。"},{"sentence":"Many families depend *on* social <welfare> payments to cover their daily expenses when they face unexpected financial difficulties.","translation":"許多家庭在面臨意外的經濟困難時，依賴社會福利津貼來支付日常開支。","explanation":"指政府發放的救濟金，常用 social welfare payments。"}],"related_forms":["well-being"]}

{"headword":"wink","explanation":"動詞/名詞「眨眼」。(1) 動詞：眨眼暗示或示意。搭配 wink at sb.。 (2) 片語：not sleep a wink (徹夜未眠)。","entries":[{"sentence":"He gave me a friendly <wink> *at* the meeting, suggesting that our plan would be successful despite the difficult circumstances.","translation":"他在會議上對我眨了眨眼，暗示儘管情況困難，我們的計畫仍會成功。","explanation":"動詞用法，搭配 at sb. 表示暗示或示意。"},{"sentence":"I was so nervous about the final exam that I *didn't* *sleep* a <wink> last night and felt exhausted this morning.","translation":"我對期末考太緊張了，以至於昨晚徹夜未眠，今天早上感到精疲力竭。","explanation":"固定用法 not sleep a wink，強調一點覺都沒睡。"},{"sentence":"She <winked> *at* her brother to hide the surprise party, and he understood immediately that he should keep quiet.","translation":"她向她哥哥眨眼示意要隱瞞驚喜派對，他立刻明白應該保持安靜。","explanation":"過去式 winked，同樣搭配介係詞 at。"}],"related_forms":["winking"]}

{"headword":"wit","explanation":"名詞「機智、風趣」。(1) 指說話聰明、幽默的特質 (quick wit)。(2) 指智慧/理智 (keep one's wits about one - 保持冷靜/警覺)。注意複數形 wits 通常指理智。","entries":[{"sentence":"The comedian is known for his sharp <wit>, often making the audience laugh with his clever and funny comments about everyday life.","translation":"這位喜劇演員以其敏銳的機智聞名，經常以他對日常生活的聰明風趣評論讓觀眾大笑。","explanation":"sharp wit 指機智、反應快。"},{"sentence":"It is important *to* *keep* your <wits> *about* you when traveling alone in a foreign country to stay safe and aware of your surroundings.","translation":"獨自在國外旅行時，保持警覺是很重要的，這樣才能保持安全並留意周遭環境。","explanation":"固定片語 keep one's wits about one，意指保持冷靜、警覺。"},{"sentence":"Her quick <wit> helped her resolve the argument between her friends without offending anyone during the group discussion.","translation":"她敏捷的機智幫助她在小組討論中化解了朋友們之間的爭論，且沒有冒犯到任何人。","explanation":"quick wit 形容反應機敏。"}],"related_forms":["witty"]}

{"headword":"witch","explanation":"名詞「女巫」。在西方文化中常與萬聖節 (Halloween) 連結。注意區分 witch (女巫) 與 wizard (男巫/術士)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The little girl dressed up as a <witch> *for* Halloween, wearing a black hat and carrying a broomstick to the school party.","translation":"小女孩為了萬聖節裝扮成女巫，戴著黑色帽子並帶著掃帚去學校派對。","explanation":"常見萬聖節情境。"},{"sentence":"In many fairy tales, the <witch> lives in a dark forest and tries *to* *cast* a spell *on* the main characters.","translation":"在許多童話故事中，女巫住在黑森林裡，並試圖對主角施咒。","explanation":"搭配動詞 cast a spell on sb. (對某人施咒)。"},{"sentence":"The story tells of a powerful <witch> who learns *to* *use* her magic powers *for* good rather than to cause trouble.","translation":"這個故事講述了一位強大的女巫，她學會運用魔法行善，而不是製造麻煩。","explanation":"描述角色的成長與魔法使用。"}],"related_forms":["wizard"]}

{"headword":"withdraw","explanation":"動詞「提款、退出、撤退」。(1) 銀行提錢 (withdraw money from an account)；(2) 退出比賽或組織 (withdraw from)；(3) 撤退軍隊或想法。(過去式 withdrew, 過去分詞 withdrawn)。","entries":[{"sentence":"I need to *go* *to* the ATM *to* <withdraw> some cash *from* my savings account for the weekend trip.","translation":"我需要去提款機從我的儲蓄帳戶提一些現金，以備週末旅行使用。","explanation":"銀行提款用法，搭配 from an account。"},{"sentence":"Due to a sudden injury, the athlete had to <withdraw> *from* the international marathon just two days before the event.","translation":"由於突然受傷，這位運動員不得不在比賽前兩天退出國際馬拉松。","explanation":"withdraw from sth. 指退出活動/賽事。"},{"sentence":"The army <withdrew> *from* the border area after the peace agreement was signed by the leaders of both countries.","translation":"在兩國領導人簽署和平協議後，軍隊從邊境地區撤退了。","explanation":"指軍事撤退，withdraw from 某地。"}],"related_forms":["withdrew","withdrawn","withdrawal"]}

{"headword":"witness","explanation":"動詞/名詞「目擊、證人」。(1) 動詞：親眼看見某事發生 (witness a crime/accident)。(2) 名詞：在法庭上作證的人 (eye-witness)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The police asked the man who <witnessed> the car accident *to* provide a statement about what he saw at the scene.","translation":"警方要求那位目擊車禍的男子提供關於他在現場看到的陳述。","explanation":"動詞用法，witness an accident。"},{"sentence":"Several people served as <witnesses> *in* court, giving their firsthand accounts of the robbery that occurred last month.","translation":"幾個人在法庭上擔任證人，提供了他們對上個月發生的搶劫案的第一手敘述。","explanation":"名詞複數型 witnesses，搭配 in court。"},{"sentence":"It was truly amazing *to* <witness> the sunrise *from* the top of the mountain during our recent hiking trip.","translation":"在我們最近的登山旅行中，從山頂目擊日出真是太神奇了。","explanation":"動詞用法，指親眼見證/看見美好的事物。"}],"related_forms":["witnesses","witnessed"]}

{"headword":"workout","explanation":"名詞「健身、訓練」。(1) 指身體鍛鍊/運動。常用搭配 do a workout, daily workout。注意與動詞片語 work out (健身/解決問題) 的區別，名詞為一個字。","entries":[{"sentence":"Regular exercise is important, so I try *to* *do* a thirty-minute <workout> every morning before I go to school.","translation":"規律運動很重要，所以我試著每天上學前做三十分鐘的健身。","explanation":"搭配 do a workout。"},{"sentence":"After a long and difficult <workout> *at* the gym, he felt exhausted but very proud of his progress.","translation":"在健身房進行了一場漫長且艱苦的訓練後，他感到筋疲力盡，但對自己的進步感到非常自豪。","explanation":"形容詞搭配 difficult workout。"},{"sentence":"Following a healthy diet and a consistent <workout> plan can help you improve your physical health and energy levels.","translation":"遵循健康的飲食和持續的健身計畫可以幫助你改善身體健康和能量水平。","explanation":"指健身計畫。"}],"related_forms":["work out"]}

{"headword":"workplace","explanation":"名詞「工作場所」。指辦公室、工廠或其他工作的地方。常用搭配 create a positive workplace, in the workplace。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company strives *to* *create* a friendly and respectful <workplace> where all employees feel valued and supported.","translation":"公司致力於創造一個友善且相互尊重的職場，讓所有員工都感到被重視和支持。","explanation":"常見搭配 create a ... workplace。"},{"sentence":"Communication skills are essential *in* the <workplace> because they help team members solve problems and share ideas effectively.","translation":"溝通技巧在職場中至關重要，因為它們能幫助團隊成員解決問題並有效地分享想法。","explanation":"固定搭配 in the workplace。"},{"sentence":"Safety regulations must be strictly followed *in* the <workplace> *to* prevent accidents and protect the health of all staff.","translation":"在工作場所必須嚴格遵守安全法規，以預防事故並保護所有員工的健康。","explanation":"常見於強調職場安全的主題。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"wreck","explanation":"名詞/動詞「毀壞、殘骸」。(1) 動詞：摧毀/損壞 (wreck the car/plans)。(2) 名詞：船隻或車輛的殘骸 (shipwreck/car wreck)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The storm was so strong that it <wrecked> the small fishing boat, leaving nothing but broken wood floating *on* the sea.","translation":"暴風雨太強烈了，摧毀了那艘小漁船，只留下破碎的木頭漂浮在海上。","explanation":"動詞用法，指摧毀物體。"},{"sentence":"He was devastated because his careless mistake <wrecked> his chances *of* winning the competition this year.","translation":"他感到崩潰，因為他粗心的錯誤毀掉了他今年贏得比賽的機會。","explanation":"動詞用法，抽象意義的摧毀（計畫/機會）。"},{"sentence":"The police were called *to* the scene *of* the car <wreck> to help clear the traffic and investigate the cause of the accident.","translation":"警方被叫到車禍現場，以協助疏導交通並調查事故原因。","explanation":"名詞用法，指車禍殘骸或車禍事故現場。"}],"related_forms":["wrecked","shipwreck"]}

{"headword":"yawn","explanation":"用法包括：(1) 動詞「打呵欠」；(2) 名詞「呵欠」；(3) 名詞「令人無聊的人事物」(口語用法，如 a big yawn)。注意打呵欠通常是因為疲倦或無聊。相關詞彙：yawning (adj.)。","entries":[{"sentence":"During the long lecture on history, the student could not help but <yawn> *repeatedly* because he had stayed up late studying.","translation":"在漫長的歷史課中，這名學生忍不住一直打呵欠，因為他昨晚熬夜讀書。","explanation":"動詞「打呵欠」。搭配副詞 repeatedly 或 suppress a yawn。此處呈現因疲倦而打呵欠的情境。"},{"sentence":"She stifled a <yawn> *behind* her hand while listening to the director's boring speech about the new company policy.","translation":"在聽主管關於新公司政策的無聊演講時，她用手遮住嘴打了一個呵欠。","explanation":"名詞「呵欠」。stifle a yawn 是常見搭配。呈現因感到無聊而打呵欠的情境。"},{"sentence":"The movie was supposed to be an exciting action film, but for most of the audience, it was just a total <yawn>.","translation":"這部電影本該是一部刺激的動作片，但對大多數觀眾來說，它簡直無聊透頂。","explanation":"名詞「令人無聊的人事物」(口語用法)。a total/big yawn 用來形容乏味的事物。"},{"sentence":"The <yawning> *gap* between the rich and the poor in this city has become a major issue that the government must address soon.","translation":"這座城市貧富之間巨大的鴻溝已成為政府必須儘快解決的主要問題。","explanation":"形容詞 yawning (字源為 yawn)，此處轉化為「巨大的/顯著的」(常用於 gap, chasm, abyss)。"}],"related_forms":["yawned","yawning","yawns"]}

{"headword":"youthful","explanation":"形容詞「年輕的/有活力的/具備年輕特質的」。常用於形容外表、精神或活力。注意與 young 的區別：young 指年齡小，youthful 指具有年輕人的特質（如：青春洋溢的臉龐、充滿活力的態度）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Despite being over sixty, the famous actor still maintains his <youthful> *appearance* through a strict diet and regular exercise.","translation":"儘管已經六十多歲，這位知名演員仍透過嚴格的飲食和規律運動，保持著他年輕的外貌。","explanation":"形容詞「年輕的」。youthful appearance / look 是常見搭配，指看起來年輕。"},{"sentence":"The politician's <youthful> *enthusiasm* impressed the voters, as he promised to bring fresh ideas and changes to the local community.","translation":"這位政治人物年輕般的熱情打動了選民，因為他承諾為當地社區帶來新穎的想法和改變。","explanation":"形容詞「年輕的/充滿活力的」。youthful enthusiasm 指年輕人特有的熱忱。"},{"sentence":"She made some <youthful> *mistakes* when she first started her business, but she learned valuable lessons from those difficult experiences.","translation":"她在剛創業時犯了一些年輕人會犯的錯誤，但她從那些困難的經驗中學到了寶貴的一課。","explanation":"形容詞「年輕的」。youthful mistakes 指因缺乏經驗而犯的錯，通常帶有包容的意味。"},{"sentence":"The team's <youthful> *energy* helped them win the championship, as they were able to run faster and longer than their older opponents.","translation":"該團隊年輕的活力幫助他們贏得了冠軍，因為他們比年長的對手跑得更快、更久。","explanation":"形容詞「年輕的/有活力的」。強調年輕人特有的體力和衝勁。"}],"related_forms":["youth","youthfully"]}
